article.articleHeadline: World Cup preparations complicated by Ebola outbreak concerns
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is complicating World Cup preparations. DRC national-team players and the head coach have not spent time in the DRC since the outbreak began; most players are based in France or English Premier League clubs. A planned three-day training camp in the DRC was canceled, with warm-up matches in Belgium and Spain planned for early June. U.S. protocols require testing and isolation for players and coaches returning from the region. The DHS ordered all flights from affected areas to enter the United States via Washington Dulles for enhanced screening. Fans from Africa face visa hurdles: those with visas must show 21 days outside DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan; those without visas face tougher access as the U.S. embassy in the DRC paused visa services and the CDC bans travel for recent entrants. No dispensation or lift date is provided.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱の発生懸念によりワールドカップの準備が複雑化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当し、DRC本国でのエボラ熱の実際の発生に加えて国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限がすでに実施されている。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数基準に該当し、社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC内のエボラ熱発生が主題。Bluedot APIが米国、フランス、ベルギー、スペイン、ウガンダなど複数地域を検出しているが、これらは対応措置（訓練キャンプ中止、試合会場変更、渡航制限）の実施地であり、実際の発生地はDRCのみ。Washington、District of Columbia等の米国領域は検疫スクリーニングの実施地であり、発生地ではない。該当対象国リスト内ではDRCのみが実際の感染症発生国。

article.articleHeadline: La Nación / Casa Blanca en la polémica, mientras el ébola se propaga sin control en África
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: La Nación / White House at the center of the controversy, as Ebola spreads out of control in Africa.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) with first transmission cases reported in South Kivu; Ituri remains the outbreak epicenter. The World Health Organization has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern for the 17th Ebola outbreak in eastern DRC, with national and regional risk assessed as high and global risk as low. As of May 22, 2026, the DRC reports 64 confirmed Ebola cases and 6 deaths, while authorities say about 671 probable cases with roughly 160 deaths suspected. Ongoing response is challenged by conflict and response logistics. The article notes a controversy surrounding the evacuation of an exposed American physician, Peter Stafford, with White House denials amid reports that he was delayed before transport to Germany.

triage.headline_ja: ホワイトハウスが論争の中心に、エボラがアフリカで制御不能に拡散
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、予想外の多数患者発生、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスク）。WHO による国際的懸念事項の公開宣言済み。
triage.notes: DRCでのエボラの第17次流行。South Kivu及びIturiで確認患者671例（疑い例を含む）、死亡者160例程度。WHOによるPHEIC宣言済み。紛争による対応の困難が指摘されており、国際支援が必要。米国医師の退避に関する政治的論争も報道されている。

article.articleHeadline: 米到着便、エボラ対応でカナダへ　コンゴ人搭乗、パリ発
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: US-bound flight diverted to Canada for Ebola response; Congolese passenger aboard, from Paris.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease remains a concern as a US-bound Air France flight from Paris to Detroit diverted to Montreal on May 20 after a Congolese passenger aboard raised concerns amid the Ebola outbreak expanding in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The United States restricts entry for non-U.S. citizens with recent stays in Ebola-affected areas—Congo, Uganda, and the neighboring South Sudan—where infection has been confirmed. The passenger said he boarded by mistake; no infection status for him is reported in the article. The incident highlights ongoing cross-border public health measures in response to the Congo Ebola outbreak, with Montreal handling the diverted flight.

triage.headline_ja: 米到着便、エボラ対応でカナダへ　コンゴ人搭乗、パリ発
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラ出血熱の国際的な懸念事例であり、複数国にまたがる対応が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはカナダ、米国、フランス、スーダン、ウガンダが含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題は「コンゴでのエボラ出血熱の流行に関連して、米国行きの飛行機がカナダにダイバートされた」事象である。実際のエボラ発生地はコンゴとウガンダであるが、対象国リストではコンゴのみが該当（203312）。本イベントは国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念として高いリスク評価に値する。

article.articleHeadline: 因刚果乘客误登引发埃博拉恐慌，航班被迫改道Australia ChinaTown News 中文华人新闻 - NEWS.CHINA.COM.AU 这里是生活在墨尔本咱自家人的地盘！把客场当主场，视异乡为故园。澳洲唐人街 - 中华澳网 China Town News澳洲唐人街;澳大利亚华人社区和主流新闻媒体
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola panic sparked by a Congolese passenger boarding by mistake; flight diverted.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-05-22, an Air France Paris–Detroit flight was diverted to Montreal after a Congolese passenger boarded in error amid an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The passenger was screened by Canadian public health officials in Montreal and found asymptomatic; the individual later flew back to Paris while the Detroit-bound leg continued. U.S. entry rules now require travelers from Ebola-affected countries to enter through Washington, D.C., and apply to U.S. citizens or permanent residents who have visited the DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan in the previous 21 days. The World Health Organization has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. In the DRC and Uganda, at least 88 deaths and hundreds of cases have been reported. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo virus, with an estimated fatality rate around 30% and no vaccine; two Uganda fatalities were not linked.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの乗客の誤乗降によるエボラパニック、便が迂回
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的な感染症イベントで、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。DRCおよびウガンダで88名以上の死亡と複数の確認症例があり、WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言している。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドにはUS、Canada、Franceなども含まれているが、記事サマリーの主要な感染イベントはDRCとウガンダで発生しており、検出された対象国はDRCのみ。USおよびカナダの言及は旅行制限や患者スクリーニングの対応に関するものであり、当該地域での発生ではない。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: RDC/Ebola: l'épidémie s'étend au Sud-Kivu avec la hausse des cas suspects
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC/Ebola: the outbreak is spreading to South Kivu as suspected cases rise.
article.articleSummary: As of May 21, 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo Ebola outbreak has spread from Ituri to North Kivu and South Kivu, with 626 suspected cases and 159 probable deaths. Bukavu in South Kivu reports a newly confirmed case, a 28-year-old man from Kisangani (Tshopo) who died before confirmation; Kisangani is under scrutiny as a potential transmission hub. The M23 group, which controls Bukavu, notes the confirmation and ongoing surveillance. Two confirmed cases have been reported in Uganda. In Nord-Kivu, more than 200 samples from suspects have been sent to Goma for laboratory testing; one confirmed case remains under strict medical surveillance in Goma, with contacts isolated. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo Ebola virus; no approved vaccine or specific treatment exists. Vaccines mainly target Zaïre; several candidates are under study, unlikely to be available for months. Immediate priorities: safe treatment centers, contact tracing, rapid case management, and community engagement to counter resistance.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国/エボラ：南キヴ州への流行拡大、疑い例増加
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の多国家流行（DRC、ウガンダ）であり、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。死亡例159件、複数州での拡大、国際的な疾患伝播、ワクチン不在等から高リスク。
triage.notes: 発生地域にウガンダ(226074)が含まれているが、記事サマリーでは「2件の確認例がウガンダで報告」と限定的な記載であり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCはリストに含まれるため登録。エボラ出血熱は致死率が高く、現在利用可能なワクチン・治療法の限定、複数州への急速な拡大という特性から、国際的支援が急務の状況。

article.articleHeadline: 米到着便、エボラ対応でカナダへ | 中国新聞デジタル
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. Arrival Flights Bound for Canada for Ebola Response
article.articleSummary: On May 20, an Air France flight from Paris to Detroit diverted to Montreal after a passenger from the Democratic Republic of the Congo was aboard. The Congo is experiencing a growing outbreak of Ebola virus disease. U.S. entry rules bar non-U.S. passport holders with recent stays in Ebola-affected areas—including the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, and neighboring South Sudan—from entering the United States. The passenger reportedly boarded the flight by mistake, and authorities have not disclosed any confirmed exposure on board. The incident underscores persistent Ebola concerns linked to Africa and cross-border travel involving Canada and the United States.

triage.headline_ja: 米到着便、エボラ対応でカナダへ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（異常性・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病の国際輸送リスク事例として、複数国間の迅速な対応を伴う公衆衛生上の重要なシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は、コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行と関連した国際輸送リスク事例である。カナダ、米国、フランスなどの言及は対象国リストに含まれず、また記事の焦点も「DRCでの流行と旅客の誤乗車」にある。WPRO基準の「流行しやすさ」および「管理可能性」は、ヒト-ヒト感染リスクおよび国際対応の必要性から Yes と判定。

article.articleHeadline: 【茨城新聞】米到着便、エボラ対応でカナダへ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. arrival flight diverted to Canada for Ebola response.
article.articleSummary: On May 20, a Paris-origin Air France flight bound for Detroit diverted to Montreal, Canada after a Congolese national on board prompted an Ebola-response precaution. The Democratic Republic of the Congo is experiencing an expanding Ebola outbreak. U.S. authorities have restricted entry for travelers without U.S. passports who have stayed in Congo, Uganda, or the neighboring South Sudan where Ebola has been confirmed. The passenger said he boarded the flight by mistake. The diversion illustrates ongoing public health measures tied to the Congo outbreak; the article provides no further details on infection status or laboratory confirmation. No confirmed infections were reported in the article.

triage.headline_ja: 【茨城新聞】米到着便、エボラ対応でカナダへ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準は2つ以上該当（異常性・国際的拡大リスク）するが、確定患者がなく、記事に具体的な感染者情報がないため、継続的な情報監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ共和国でのエボラ流行を主題としており、カナダ・米国への転航は流行国からの人の移動に関連する対応措置である。確定患者なし・検査未確認であるため、IHR基準はYesが複数あるもののWATCH判定。DRC発の拡大流行が背景にあり、今後の患者発生状況を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ex CDC head warns Ebola will become a 'very significant pandemic'
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri Province, has killed more than 130 people as of May 22, 2026. The Bundibugyo strain, for which no vaccine exists, averages about 40% fatality. First suspected death was reported on April 20; investigations say the outbreak likely started a couple of months earlier. The World Health Organization has declared a public health emergency of international concern, but not a pandemic emergency. Former CDC director Robert Redfield warns it could become a very significant regional pandemic, with spillover risk to Tanzania, South Sudan, and Rwanda. Funding cuts in 2025 reduced surveillance and preparedness in Ituri, delaying detection. A handful of Americans have been exposed; no US cases have been reported, and public risk remains low.

triage.headline_ja: 前CDC所長がエボラは『非常に重大なパンデミック』になると警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準も5つ全て該当。WHO緊急事態宣言済み、死者130名以上、ワクチン未開発の株による流行。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はDRCのイトゥリ州中心のブンディブギョエボラ流行。タンザニア、南スーダン、ルワンダへのこぼれ落ちリスク言及あるが、現在の確認症例はDRCのみ。米国との関連は曝露のみで症例なし。Bundibugyo株は致死率40%、ワクチン未開発という医学的懸念が高い。WHO PHEIC宣言済み。フルRRA推奨。

article.articleHeadline: [자막뉴스] 수백 km 떨어진 곳까지 퍼졌다...바이러스 재창궐에 '아비규환'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: [Caption News] It spread to locations up to hundreds of kilometers away... Pandemonium as the virus resurges.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak declared in the Democratic Republic of the Congo on May 15 has surged, with the epicenter in Ituri Province and the virus spreading hundreds of kilometers to rebel‑held South Kivu, including the Miti‑Murhesa health zone. The circulating strain is Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no licensed vaccine, and the case fatality rate is about 30–50%. As of May 21, 2026, the country reports roughly 670 suspected cases and 160 deaths. A Congolese national who died in Kampala, Uganda, prompted cross‑border containment: Uganda suspended flights to the DRC for 48 hours and halted ferry and border bus services for four weeks; about 65 contacts are in isolation, with 9 showing symptoms but all testing negative for Ebola. Social unrest followed funeral restrictions. This outbreak has persisted for about five months, the 17th Ebola event in DRC since 1976. The India–Africa Summit in New Delhi, planned to begin May 28, was postponed due to the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: [字幕ニュース] 数百km離れた場所まで広がった...ウイルス再発生で『阿鼻叫喚』
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱の急速な拡大、高い致死率、国際的拡散リスク、国際イベント（インド・アフリカサミット）の延期という顕著な社会的・政治的影響あり。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダ（Kampala）での死亡例と接触者隔離が記述されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCでの発生地域はIturi Province および South Kivu Provinceで確認されており、ウガンダへの越境感染により国際的対応が実施されている。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ワクチンなし）の流行であり、約5ヶ月間継続している。

article.articleHeadline: Khi nào thế giới có vaccine cho chủng Ebola mới?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: When will the world have a vaccine for the new Ebola strain?
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain outbreak in North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, prompts intensified surveillance as WHO ships PPE and testing kits to frontline workers in Ituri. There is no vaccine approved specifically for Bundibugyo; Merck’s Ervebo (Zaire ebolavirus vaccine) has shown some protective effect against Bundibugyo in animal studies. Experts caution that turning this into a licensed vaccine will take time, even with existing Ebola platforms (vector vaccines, mRNA). CEPI is funding broadly protective filovirus vaccines and rapid-response platforms to guard against multiple Ebola strains. The global context notes Africa’s Ebola toll—about 15,000 deaths historically—and the 2013–2016 West Africa outbreak with around 11,000 deaths. In parallel, authorities anticipate experimental vaccines from the United States and United Kingdom, while ongoing outbreaks receive vaccines and supplies as needed.

triage.headline_ja: 新しいエボラ株に対するワクチンは世界いつ手に入る？
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国（Ituri）でのBundibugyo ebolavirus株の発生は異常・予想外であり、WHOが対応を開始し国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。IHR基準3つ以上該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当するため。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus株はZaire ebolavirus株と異なる希少株である。既存のErveboワクチンは動物試験で部分的な保護効果を示しているが、ライセンス取得には時間を要する。WHOは既にPPEと検査キットをIturi地域の前線労働者に配送しており、米国と英国からの実験的ワクチンの配備が予想されている。これは新規・異常な株であるため、リスク評価の優先度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Vigilância Ebola: São Paulo intensifica medidas contra surtos na África - Fato Paulista
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Surveillance: São Paulo Steps Up Measures Against Outbreaks in Africa - Fato Paulista
article.articleSummary: São Paulo's State Health Secretariat has reinforced Ebola surveillance, tightening guidelines to identify, notify, isolate, and treat suspected cases. The move follows renewed African outbreaks drawing WHO attention. The state notes nearly 600 suspected Ebola cases and 139 suspected deaths in active foci in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, figures the OMS acknowledges as likely underestimated. Ebola presents with fever, severe headache, muscle pain, fatigue, and gastrointestinal symptoms; incubation ranges from 2 to 21 days, requiring 21-day traveler monitoring. Brazil’s import risk is low due to no local transmission and no direct flights from Africa, but SP maintains vigilance. The plan includes rapid notification to municipal Vigilance Epidemiology and state epidemiology centers; transport is coordinated by GRAU, with Emílio Ribas Institute as the state reference for Ebola care. Bundibugyo vaccines/therapies are not licensed; current vaccines target Zaire and may not be effective against the current strain.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ監視：サンパウロがアフリカのアウトブレイクに対する対策を強化 - Fato Paulista
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病は国際的に極めて高い関心を持つ病原体であり、DRCとウガンダでの活動的なアウトブレイク（～600疑似症例、139疑似死亡）が報告されている。ブラジルは低リスクと評価していますが、IHR基準で「異常/予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」「渡航制限リスク」に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも「重症度」「流行易さ」「管理可能性」に該当するため、フルRRA評価の実施が必要です。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはブラジルが含まれていますが、記事の主題は「DRCとウガンダでのアウトブレイク」に対する「ブラジルの監視強化」です。実際のエボラ発生地はDRCとウガンダで、ブラジルは対応国です。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当するため verified_locations はDRCのみとしました。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 米到着便、エボラ対応でカナダへ　コンゴ人搭乗、パリ発（共同通信）｜熊本日日新聞社
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: US-bound flight diverted to Canada for Ebola response; Congolese passenger on board, departing Paris (Kyodo News) | Kumamoto Nichinichi Shimbun
article.articleSummary: Air France flight from Paris to Detroit, Michigan, diverted to Montreal, Canada on May 20 to support an Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). A Congolese passenger was aboard; the DRC is experiencing ongoing Ebola virus disease outbreaks. The United States prohibits entry for non‑U.S. passport holders who have recently been in Ebola-affected areas—specifically the DRC, Uganda, and neighboring South Sudan. The passenger reportedly boarded the flight by mistake. No confirmed Ebola cases or transmissions are reported on the aircraft or in Montreal in connection with the incident. The diversion underscores continued concern about Ebola outbreaks in Central Africa and relates to U.S. border controls tied to Ebola exposure history.

triage.headline_ja: 米到着便、エボラ対応でカナダへ　コンゴ人搭乗、パリ発（共同通信）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。進行中のコンゴのエボラアウトブレイク、国際路線の迂回、複数国への規制措置があり、フルRRA実施の対象。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は進行中のコンゴ民主共和国のエボラアウトブレイク。カナダ・米国への患者搭乗便の迂回はこのアウトブレイク対応の結果。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。

article.articleHeadline: 米到着便、エボラ対応でカナダへ コンゴ人搭乗、パリ発:医療・健康:福島民友新聞社
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S.-bound arrival flight diverted to Canada for Ebola precautions; Congolese passenger on board, Paris-origin
article.articleSummary: Air France flight from Paris to Detroit was diverted to Montreal, Canada on May 20 for Ebola precautions after a Congolese passenger was on board. The Democratic Republic of the Congo is experiencing an expanding Ebola virus disease outbreak. The United States restricts entry for non-U.S. passport holders who have recent travel history to Ebola-affected areas, including the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, and neighboring South Sudan. The Congolese passenger said he boarded the flight by mistake. The incident highlights ongoing travel-safety measures in response to the Ebola outbreak in Africa and the continued risk of cross-border movement during such outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: 米到着便、エボラ対応でカナダへ コンゴ人搭乗、パリ発
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常・予想外、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、エボラウイルス病の確認されたDRCからの患者接触が報告されている。国際的な航空機運用への影響が現実化した実例。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の流行国（DRC）からの乗客が国際線に搭乗した事案。既知の流行地域での発生であるため、対象地域外（Canada, US, France）での二次感染リスクは記事では低いと示唆されているが、国際的な疾病移動の実例として重要。DRCが対象国であるため verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Antallet ebola-dødsfall i Kongo stiger
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola deaths in the Congo is rising.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo variant of Ebola virus disease is spreading northeast in the Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri Province with the city of Goma, and spillover into neighboring Uganda. The Congolese health ministry reports 671 suspected cases and 160 deaths, with 64 confirmed infections and six deaths. This surpasses WHO's earlier tallies of roughly 600 suspected cases and more than 130 suspected Ebola deaths. WHO regards the outbreak as a public health emergency of international concern but not a pandemic, noting it began a couple of months ago. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids and contaminated materials. Estimated case fatality rate is 25-40%.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ死亡数が増加している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。エボラウイルスのBundibugyo変異株がコンゴ民主共和国（Ituri州、Goma市）で拡大し、ウガンダへの越境例あり。WHO公式に国際的公衆衛生上の懸念事象（PHEIC）として認識。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはUgandaも含まれているが、サマリーでは「spillover into neighboring Uganda」と記載されており、確認された患者の主要な拠点はDRC（Ituri州・Goma市）。ウガンダは越境例の言及に留まるため、現時点では主要発生地はDRCのみとした。今後ウガンダでの確認例増加状況を継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: L'épidémie d'Ebola se propage en RDC, des cas signalés au Sud-Kivu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak is spreading in the DRC, with cases reported in South Kivu.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) worsens, with about 671 probable cases and 160 deaths; 64 confirmed cases and six deaths in DRC as of May 21 per INSP. The WHO declared an international health alert on May 16 for a 17th Ebola outbreak in eastern DRC, with high national/regional risk but low global risk. The epidemic has spread to North Kivu and South Kivu, separated by frontlines with M23. A first case in Goma; a new positive case in Kabare, South Kivu; M23 says the patient originated from Kisangani (Tshopo). In Ituri, response hampered by conflict; displacement camps host about 16,000 people without adequate sanitation. Bundibugyo strain lacks a vaccine or approved treatment; control relies on barrier measures, rapid detection, and border screening. Cross-border concerns include a Ugandan case/death, US border controls, a patient hospitalized in Germany, and a Bahrain travel ban on arrivals from affected countries.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス病の流行がコンゴ民主共和国で拡大、南キブ州で症例が報告されている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の多国間クラスター、高い死亡率、国際的な流行拡大リスク、国境検疫実施により確実なシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）におけるエボラ流行が主題。Bluedot APIがUSA、Bahrain、Germanyなどを含めているのは、これらが二次的な国境検疫対応国であり、流行の実際の発生地ではない。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。本流行はBundibugyo株、ワクチン未利用、高い死亡率、紛争による対応困難、難民キャンプの衛生不備など複合的なリスク要因を含む。WHOは5月16日に国際保健警報を宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: コンゴ反政府勢力支配下にもエボラ出血熱の感染拡大
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Spread of Ebola hemorrhagic fever infections even under rebel control in Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola hemorrhagic fever outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo expands into eastern South Kivu under Rwanda-backed M23 rebels, who have established local administration. WHO has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. A new case in South Kivu’s Kabare area is linked to a person from Kisangani in eastern Tshopo Province. Congolese authorities report 1 suspected and 1 confirmed case in South Kivu as of May 21. The National Institute of Public Health lists about 671 suspected cases and 160 suspected deaths, with 64 confirmed cases and 6 deaths. Uganda has halted all public transport into Congo for four weeks; Ituri Province in eastern Congo reports a large outbreak, and Uganda notes 2 suspected cross-border cases. Cargo and food transport are exempt from the suspension.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ反政府勢力支配下にもエボラ出血熱の感染拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の多地域広がり、死亡例を含む重症例、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダへの境界線越え例）、渡航制限実施により、フルRRAが必要な重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが主題。ウガンダはイベント発生地ではなく対応国として言及されているため、verified_locationsには含めない。ルワンダも同様に地理的背景として記載されているが、イベント発生地ではないため除外。IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準いずれも全項目Yes。WHOがPHEIC（国際懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言した段階のシグナルであり、即フルRRA移行が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak 2026 Update: Former CDC Director Warns It Could 'Become a Very Significant Pandemic'
article.articleSummary: DRC and Uganda report 34 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 134 suspected deaths, with 536 suspected and 105 probable cases ongoing as of May 22, 2026. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo virus; current data indicate severe illness with fever, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, and bleeding, and a case fatality rate estimated by the strain at 25–50%. Transmission occurs through direct contact with blood or bodily fluids of a symptomatic person or contaminated objects; no vaccine exists for Bundibugyo Ebola. The situation prompted a warning by former CDC Director Robert Redfield that the outbreak could become a significant pandemic, with potential spillover into Tanzania, southern Sudan, and Rwanda, highlighting cross-border transmission risks. An American worker exposed in Congo was treated in Germany. The U.S. travel advisory requires enhanced screening for travelers from Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan within 21 days of US entry.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染症2026年更新：元CDC長官『非常に重大なパンデミックになる可能性がある』と警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。Bundibugyo Ebolaウイルスの大規模発生（確認34例、疑い死亡134例、CFR 25-50%）、複数国への国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施済み。元CDC長官による重大警告と高い社会的関心あり。フルRRAに進める必要あり。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはDRC、ウガンダ、タンザニア、スーダン、ルワンダが含まれるが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRC（203312）のみ。記事サマリーでは主にDRCとウガンダでの発生が述べられており、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。アメリカのケースとドイツでの治療は二次的な報告であり、実発生地ではないため対象外。Bundibugyo Ebolaは稀な株であり、CFR 25-50%の高致命率、ワクチンなし、ヒト-ヒト感染可能という特性により極度に重大。複数国への拡大警告と渡航制限実施の事実が社会政治的関心の高さを示している。

article.articleHeadline: 这一次埃博拉会否传出非洲 多国加强防控措施
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Will Ebola spread beyond Africa this time? Several countries tighten prevention and control measures.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda have accelerated containment efforts across Africa as of May 22, 2026. In the DRC, ongoing transmission centers in Ituri and North Kivu provinces, with Goma constructing an Ebola isolation and close-contact observation point as health workers conduct temperature checks. The DRC health ministry reports 131 suspected-death cases and 513 suspected cases; investigations continue to confirm if all fatalities are due to Ebola. In Uganda, two laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases have been reported, including one death; both cases have travel history from the DRC and are not clearly linked. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. Africa CDC has declared a Public Health Emergency of African Concern, while WHO has declared the event a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on May 17, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが今回はアフリカの外に広がるのか、複数国が感染防止措置を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。WHO PHEIC宣言済み、複数国での確認症例、死亡例あり、国際的拡大リスク高い。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: WHO PHEIC宣言（2026年5月17日）済み。DRCでIturi・North Kivu州で継続的感染、死亡例131疑い、513疑い症例。ウガンダでも2確認症例（1死亡）、DRC渡航歴あり。Bundibugyo ebolavirus、ワクチン・治療法なし。Africa CDC も Public Health Emergency of African Concern 宣言済み。国際的拡大懸念が明示的に提示されている。

article.articleHeadline: NIH Infectious Disease Leadership Shake-Up Raises Concerns Amid Ebola, Hantavirus Outbreaks - EconoTimes
article.articleSummary: Leadership uncertainty at NIAID as acting director Jeffery Taubenberger resigns amid Ebola and hantavirus outbreak concerns; the departure was disclosed at a Senate hearing on the NIH 2027 budget. Taubenberger has served since April 2025 after a prior leadership shake-up. NIH Director Jay Bhattacharya said the agency is shifting priorities away from civilian biodefense and pandemic preparedness toward direct infectious-disease response, allergy research, and immunology. Africa's Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and potential hantavirus exposure linked to a luxury cruise ship in the Atlantic are ongoing concerns. No confirmed U.S. Andes hantavirus cases; 41 individuals remain under observation, including 18 quarantined in Nebraska. Former NIAID director Jeanne Marrazzo warned the institute is disconnected from researchers and pharma working on Ebola treatments. NIAID budget exceeds $6.5B; NIH has 27 institutes, many led by acting directors.

triage.headline_ja: NIH感染症指導部の人事異動がエボラ、ハンタウイルス感染拡大懸念の中で波紋を呼ぶ - EconoTimes
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。アフリカでのエボラウイルス感染症の流行とハンタウイルスの米国での曝露が報告されており、両者ともWHO通知基準を満たす可能性がある。
triage.notes: 記事はNIAIDの指導部交代を主題としているが、進行中の感染症イベントとしてコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラウイルス感染症流行と、米国でのハンタウイルス曝露が明記されている。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。米国でのハンタウイルス事例は豪華客船関連の曝露であり、確認例がないため部分的な評価となるが、複数の隔離ケースが報告されており対応必要性は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak explained: What you need to know | BBC News - ExBulletin
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has been declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern by the World Health Organization. In a BBC Health explainer, Dominic Hughes leads a filmed Q&A that outlines what Ebola is, its origins, and how the virus spreads and its contagiousness, including potential transmission via funeral rituals. The video reviews the typical symptoms, the reported mortality rate, and whether a cure or vaccine exists. It also tackles whether the outbreak could trigger a global pandemic and explains the threshold for such concerns. The article excerpt does not provide specific case or death counts, laboratory confirmation details, or identified infection sources. Published May 22, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: エボラの発生について説明：知っておくべきこと | BBC News
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで発生し、WHOが国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言している。IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）を複数満たし、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性、重症度、流行性、管理可能性）も複数該当する。
triage.notes: WHOによるPHEIC宣言済み。記事では具体的な感染者数・死亡者数が記載されていないが、PHEIC宣言という国際的認知の高さから社会的・政治的関心は極めて高い。続報での具体的疫学情報の収集が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Ex CDC head warns Ebola outbreak will become a 'very significant pandemic'
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo could become a very significant regional pandemic, warns former CDC director Dr. Robert Redfield. He cites potential spillover into Tanzania, South Sudan, and Rwanda. The outbreak, rooted in eastern DRC (Ituri Province), has killed more than 130 people and surpassed 100 cases; investigations seek to establish when and where it started, with first suspected death reported on April 20. The Bundibugyo Ebola strain drives the outbreak, a rare variant for which there is no vaccine and which carries about a 40% fatality rate per WHO. The World Health Organization declared a public health emergency of international concern, but not a pandemic emergency. March 2025 funding cuts reduced health and preparedness work in Ituri; U.S. officials report no confirmed U.S. Ebola cases, though a handful of Americans in DRC may have been exposed, with overall public risk deemed low by the CDC.

triage.headline_ja: 元CDC所長がエボラ症例の大流行警告「非常に重大なパンデミックになる」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。WPRO基準も複数該当。WHO公衆衛生上の国際的懸念事象（PHEIC）宣言済み。フルRRAに進む必要がある。
triage.notes: DRC（イトゥリ州）が主たる発生地。タンザニア、南スーダン、ルワンダへの拡大リスク言及あるも、記事サマリー上で確認症例は東DRCのみ。Bundibugyo株（致死率40%、ワクチン未開発）により発生。WHO既にPHEIC宣言。資金削減により保健体制脆弱化している点も懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: India Issues Ebola Advisory, Postpones India-Africa Forum Summit Amid Health Concerns
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Africa, led by the Democratic Republic of Congo, is designated a WHO Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) and has resulted in more than 136 deaths. India issued a Directorate General of Health Services health advisory for passengers arriving from or transiting through Ebola-affected countries, naming DR Congo, Uganda and South Sudan as high-risk. It urges those with fever, weakness, headache, muscle pain, vomiting, diarrhea, sore throat or unexplained bleeding or anyone with exposure to blood or body fluids to report to airport health authorities before immigration clearance. Travellers developing symptoms within 21 days of arrival should seek urgent medical care and disclose travel history. India postponed the Fourth India-Africa Forum Summit (May 28-31, New Delhi) after consultations with African nations; fresh dates will be decided. No cases in India; surveillance and SOPs have been strengthened; India supports Africa CDC.

triage.headline_ja: インド、エボラ警告を発表し、健康上の懸念からインド・アフリカフォーラム首脳会議を延期
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限、異常性）。アフリカでの大規模エボラ流行による PHEIC 指定、複数国での確認、インドの公式警告発令と首脳会議延期という政治的影響も重大。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから確認される実際のエボラ発生地はアフリカ（DRC主導）。インドは警告発令国かつ首脳会議延期による政治的影響の主体。Uganda と South Sudan も高リスク国として言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めず。DRC と India のみを検証地域として列挙。WHO PHEIC 指定済みで国際的な危機管理段階にあり、フルRRA 実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: US begins tightening airport screenings as race to contain Ebola outbreak continues - ExBulletin
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak continues in the DRC with 600+ suspected cases and 148 deaths; transmission likely since early April, with the WHO declaring the outbreak on May 15. U.S. tightens airport screening: starting today, U.S. nationals and permanent residents who traveled to DRC, South Sudan, or Uganda in the last 21 days must pass through Washington-Dulles for enhanced screening. Foreign nationals from these countries in the past three weeks cannot enter the U.S.; the 30-day restriction is paired with a CDC low national-risk assessment and no suspected, probable, or confirmed U.S. cases. An Air France flight bound for Detroit was diverted to Montreal after CBP flagged a passenger from the DRC. In Ituri’s Rwampara, an arson attack targeted an Ebola treatment center amid concerns over corpse handling. The Bundibugyo strain has no vaccine or treatment. Africa CDC will hold a Kampala meeting with Uganda, DRC and South Sudan to establish outbreak-response protocols.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱の流行封じ込めが続く中、米国は空港スクリーニングの厳格化を開始 - ExBulletin
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ熱の大規模アウトブレイク（600+疑い例、148死亡）、複数国での検出、国際渡航制限措置の実施、および米国空港での強化スクリーニング開始により、緊急性と国際的影響が明確。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCにおける主要エボラアウトブレイク（Bundibugyo株、ワクチンなし）を中心としている。ウガンダとスーダンは国境での協調対応に言及されているが、確認された症例は記述されていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。米国・カナダの空港措置や迂回事案は、国際的な波及を示す重要な指標。Africa CDCのカンパラ会議はアウトブレイク対応の国際的協調の証。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）东部地区的埃博拉疫情
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the eastern region of the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Ituri Province, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, declared on May 15 in Bunia and two other locations, Lwanpala and Mumbuvalu. By May 20, the World Health Organization reported about 600 suspected cases and 139 suspected deaths. Uganda has confirmed two Ebola cases, including one death, both with travel history to the DRC, indicating cross-border transmission. On May 21 in Bunia, health workers conducted disinfection in the Ebola isolation zone. The outbreak centers on Bunia and surrounding districts in Ituri, with ongoing surveillance and response efforts to contain spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国東部地域のエボラ疫情
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、確認された死亡例と国境越え伝播が報告されているため、フルRRA対象とする。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）東部のイツリ州ブニアで主要な発生が報告されており、ウガンダでの確認例も記載されているが、詳細な伝播箇所がDRC側である。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを記載した。死亡数139例（疑い例）、確認例は少なくとも複数国に及んでいる極めて深刻な状況。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, il report e l'allarme: "I casi reali potrebbero essere il doppio" - Sassari Notizie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, the report and the alarm: "The real cases could be twice as many" - Sassari Notizie
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri Province) caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. As of 16 May 2026, 336 suspected cases and 88 deaths reported, with laboratory-confirmed infections identified in Ituri and 2 additional exportations to Kampala, Uganda among travelers from the affected region. Independent modeling by Imperial College London, in collaboration with WHO and regional health authorities, estimates total infections may be roughly 400–800 and could exceed 1,000, indicating substantial undercount and broader transmission. Methods include geographic spread and population movement (exported cases) and back-calculation from deaths using historical onset-to-death intervals and mortality rates. MSF highlights critical healthcare capacity strain in Bunia, with isolation beds full and suspected cases redirected to other facilities. Emphasized need for rapid, coordinated regional surveillance and response to improve data collection and outbreak control.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、報告と警告：「実際の症例は2倍の可能性がある」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、複数国への国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、WPRO基準でも5項目全て該当する高リスクシグナル。
triage.notes: エボラアウトブレイクはコンゴ民主共和国Ituri州で確認され、ウガンダのカンパラへの輸入事例も報告されている。Imperial College Londonの独立モデリングでは実際の感染者数が報告数の2～3倍（400-800人、最大1,000人超）と推定されており、大幅な過小報告と地域的な広がりを示唆。医療キャパシティの逼迫（Bunia）と地域的な監視強化の必要性が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: Is Ebola the next major pandemic? CDC chief sounds alarm as African countries battle outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in Africa escalates as Congo and Uganda report a rapid growth in cases; the May outbreak has surpassed 500 infections with about 150 linked deaths. Former CDC director Robert Redfield warns it could seed a 'very significant pandemic,' potentially spreading to Tanzania, southern Sudan, and Rwanda, and notes the outbreak is moving faster than typical Ebola events. WHO places fatality risk in outbreaks broadly at 25–90%, depending on access to care. The May event marks the 17th Ebola outbreak in the region over the past five decades, with the most recent ending last December. An American employee contracted Ebola in the Congo and was treated in Germany. In response, CDC and U.S. Customs and Border Protection announce enhanced public health screening for U.S.-bound travelers who visited Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan within 21 days.

triage.headline_ja: エボラは次の大規模パンデミックか？アフリカ諸国がアウトブレイクと闘う中、CDC長官が警告を発令
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、かつWPRO基準も5つすべて該当。エボラウイルス疾患の急速な拡大、高い致死率、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限の実施により、フルRRAに進むべきシグナルである。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明確にコンゴとウガンダでのエボラアウトブレイクが報告されているが、ウガンダはGeoNames対象国リストに含まれていないため、DRCのみを verified_locations に記載。タンザニア、スーダン、ルワンダへの拡大リスクが指摘されているが、現時点での発生確認は記述されていない。米国への拡大（従業員が米国に移送）が言及されているが、米国は対象国外であるため含めない。CDC長官による警告、渡航スクリーニング強化の実施、急速な感染増加（500感染、150死亡）などから、社会的・政治的関心は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, Hantavirus Take Center Stage in WHA Geneva Talks
article.articleSummary: At the 79th World Health Assembly in Geneva, more than 190 countries focus on urgent threats, including an Ebola outbreak in the Republic of Congo and Uganda and a hantavirus outbreak. The WHO director-general declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern over the Ebola epidemic, the first time a PHEIC was invoked before convening an emergency committee, citing the scale and speed of transmission and in line with International Health Regulations Article 12; an emergency committee will gather to advise on next steps. The two-week window highlighted why global coordination is needed. Belize’s health minister, representing Belize, backed a proposal to add the issue to the Assembly agenda; the proposal failed. Delegates also reference the WHO results report, praising achievements and underscoring the need for stronger collaboration to translate ground impact into action.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、ハンタウイルスがジュネーブのWHA会談の中心課題に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WHO事務局長がPHEIC宣言を発令し、複数国での同時多発アウトブレイク。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（id: 203312）とウガンダでのエボラアウトブレイク、およびハンタウイルスアウトブレイクが報告されている。これはWHA（世界保健総会）での国際的議論の対象となっている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。スイス・ジュネーブはWHA開催地であり、実際の発生地ではないため除外。ベリーズの言及も会談への参加国であり発生地ではないため除外。WHO事務局長によるPHEIC宣言は国際緊急事態への格上げを意味し、最高レベルの警告。

article.articleHeadline: New Ebola case confirmed in rebel-held area in DR Congo's South Kivu province
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease confirmed in rebel-held Miti-Murhesa, Kabare territory, South Kivu. The patient, a 28-year-old man traveling from Kisangani in Tshopo province, died before diagnosis and was buried per health protocols to prevent spread. No cases in Tshopo to date. More than 200 suspected cases sampled and sent to Goma; one confirmed case remains under strict medical supervision in Goma; identified contacts isolated. Outbreak began May 15 in Ituri and has spread to North Kivu and South Kivu. About 600 suspected cases and 139 probable deaths reported by Congolese authorities and WHO. Two imported cases in Uganda. WHO declared a global health emergency on May 17, 2026. Ebola spreads via direct contact with bodily fluids, contaminated materials, or corpses.

triage.headline_ja: DR コンゴ南キブ県の反政府勢力支配地域で新たなエボラ症例が確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な健康影響、異常性、国際的拡大、渡航制限リスク）。WHOが5月17日にグローバルヘルスエマージェンシーを宣言しており、複数国での症例報告と高い致死率が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでウガンダへの輸入症例（2件）言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。複数省にわたる地理的拡大（Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu）とTshopo州からの移動を通じた拡散が確認されている。死亡率の高さ（139件の推定死亡）と既存の反政府勢力支配地域での管理困難性が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Live Chat: Top Doctors Warn Dengue Can Be Life-Threatening Even After Fever Drops
article.articleSummary: Dengue cases are rising across India, with doctors warning the danger extends well after fever subsides. The critical phase post-fever can trigger internal bleeding, breathing difficulties, dangerously low platelets, or life-threatening shock, making dengue potentially fatal even when initial symptoms improve. Eight top doctors participated in a live chat to address common questions about dengue—from risk of reinfection and warning signs in children to the effectiveness of vaccines and vector control. The discussion emphasizes that a low platelet count is not the sole concern and that children may deteriorate faster than adults. It also notes that simple household practices, like storing stagnant water, can fuel outbreaks. The article does not provide case counts; focus remains on awareness and timely recognition amid rising cases in India.

triage.headline_ja: ライブチャット：トップドクターがデング熱は発熱が下がった後でも生命を脅かす可能性があると警告
triage.triage_reason: インドでのデング熱症例の急増が報告されており、重症度基準（内出血、呼吸困難、血小板減少、ショック等の重篤な合併症）に該当。異常/予想外の発症パターン（発熱消退後の悪化）と公衆衛生への深刻な影響が明確。
triage.notes: インドでのデング熱の流行が進行中。記事は医療専門家による警告を強調し、発熱後の重篤な合併症リスク、特に子どもにおける急速な悪化に焦点。蚊媒介対策と家庭内予防（水たまり管理）の重要性も言及されている。具体的な症例数は記載されていないが、「rising cases」と複数回述べられており流行状況が進行中であることが示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Merebak, Bahrain Tutup Akses dari Kongo, Sudan Selatan, dan Uganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Spreads, Bahrain Closes Entry from Congo, South Sudan, and Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Bahrain bans entry for foreign nationals traveling from the Democratic Republic of Congo, South Sudan, and Uganda for 30 days, effective 19 May 2026, as a precaution amid the spread of Ebola virus disease in Central Africa. The Civil Aviation Authority of Bahrain issued a policy covering all flight routes from the three countries. Bahraini citizens returning from affected areas may enter but must undergo strict health screening on arrival at Bahrain International Airport. The measure aims to limit cross-border transmission during the ongoing Ebola outbreak. The report provides no specific Ebola case counts, laboratory confirmation, or infection sources. No details on imported/exported cases beyond the travel ban. Information current as of 22 May 2026.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行、バーレーン、コンゴ、南スーダン、ウガンダからのアクセスを遮断
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病は国際保健規則(IHR)上の極めて重大な疾患であり、中央アフリカでの流行に対応した渡航・入国制限が実施されている。IHR基準の3つ以上に該当し、かつWPRO基準でも複数該当することから、フルRRA実施対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国、南スーダン、ウガンダでのエボラ流行が記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRC(203312)のみ。バーレーンは対象国ではなく、入国制限を実施する措置国として言及されているため verified_locations に含めない。南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。具体的な症例数や検査確認情報は記事に含まれておらず、フルRRA実施時には現地情報の詳細な確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 女孩怕被责备隐瞒被狗咬狂犬病离世 沉默酿成致命悲剧
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Girl dies of rabies after concealing a dog bite for fear of being blamed; silence leads to a fatal tragedy.
article.articleSummary: Rabies death of an 11-year-old girl in Hunan Province underscores the deadly consequences of concealing a dog bite. In December 2025, a girl living with her grandfather kept a white native dog; the dog later bit her sister, brother, and another villager. Fearing blame, the sister concealed the bite and did not wash the wound or seek vaccination. In February 2026, she developed rabies and died within 48 hours of symptom onset; laboratory tests confirmed rabies virus in her saliva. Rabies remains nearly 100% fatal after symptoms appear; incubation ranges from days to months or years, and hydrophobia and aerophobia indicate central nervous system involvement. By contrast, the brother informed relatives and received wound cleaning, vaccination, and rabies immunoglobulin, avoiding severe outcomes, and another bitten villager also received prompt treatment. Hunan CDC warns against the 'silent trap' of rabies and advocates immediate wound care and vaccination after exposure.

triage.headline_ja: 女の子が犬に咬まれた狂犬病を隠して死亡——沈黙が招いた致命的悲劇
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病による死亡例が報告されており重症度の基準を満たすが、単一事例の報道であり国際的拡大リスク、公式な公衆衛生政策的関心の明確な兆候が記事からは読み取れない。地域特性と対策状況の観点からは要経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は湖南省での狂犬病死亡例を中心に報道。狂犬病は散発的に発生する疾患であり、単一事例報告。ただし地域の公衆衛生当局（湖南CDC）が「沈黙の罠」として警告を発しており、公式な関心が存在する。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: Ebola outbreak to grow | New Straits Times
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, caused by the Bundibugyo strain with no vaccine, has triggered more than 600 suspected cases and 139 suspected deaths, with 51 laboratory-confirmed cases in Congo and two confirmed in neighbouring Uganda. Declared last Friday, the outbreak is expected to grow; investigators cite a likely start two months ago and a four-week detection gap between symptom onset and laboratory confirmation. The first suspected death occurred April 20, followed by a suspected super-spreading event at a funeral or healthcare facility. The Bundibugyo strain carries about a 40 percent fatality rate. Two candidate vaccines are under consideration but could take three to nine months to develop. An American doctor working in Congo is among confirmed cases, transferred to Germany; his family is in isolation. The United States has mobilized about 13 million US dollars to respond and will help open 50 clinics to treat Ebola cases.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：エボラ出血熱の流行が拡大する見通し
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、予想外の発生、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。Bundibugyo株による600件超の疑い患者、139件の死亡、確定患者の国際流出を確認。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはUganda、Germany、USAが含まれているが、サマリーに基づくと主要な流行地はDRCである。ウガンダは隣国で2件の確定患者がいるが、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。ドイツとUSAの患者は国際流出であり、これらの国での流行ではない。ワクチンなし、40%の致命率、4週間の検出遅延ギャップが懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: 疫区回国现症状速就医 . 汶 BVD低风险区 - 地方 - 汶莱
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Returning from an outbreak area with symptoms, seek medical attention promptly. Wen BVD low-risk area - Local - Brunei.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD), an Ebola-virus disease variant, is outbreaking in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), with spillover reported in Uganda and the Kinshasa region. As of May 16, there were 246 suspected cases, 80 deaths, and 8 laboratory-confirmed cases. On May 17, the World Health Organization designated the BVD outbreak as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern under the International Health Regulations, though it has not been classified as a pandemic emergency and overall risk remains low. Brunei's Ministry of Health reports the importation risk of BVD as low. Precautions include avoiding travel to affected areas in DR Congo and Uganda; if returning from these areas and symptoms develop within 21 days, seek medical care and disclose travel history to healthcare workers; maintain hand hygiene with soap and water or alcohol-based sanitizers.

triage.headline_ja: 疫区回国現症状速就医。ブルネイ BVD低リスク地域 - 地方 - ブルネイ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHOが公式にPHEIC宣言し、複数国で確認されている。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo virus disease（BVD）はエボラウイルス病の亜種で、DRC（Ituri Province、Kinshasa region）で発生。ウガンダでもスピルオーバーが報告されている。記事配信時点（2026年5月）でWHOが正式にPHEIC宣言。Bruneiは当該感染症イベント発生地域ではなく、輸入リスク評価対象国のため verified_locations には含めない。UgandaはWPRO対象国外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Médico é transferido para a República Tcheca após ter contato com infectados por ebola em Uganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A doctor is transferred to the Czech Republic after contact with people infected with Ebola in Uganda.
article.articleSummary: An American doctor who had contact with Ebola patients in Uganda, Africa, was transferred on Thursday, May 21, to the Czech Republic in Europe. The Czech Ministry of Health said he is asymptomatic for Ebola and will be isolated for three weeks upon arrival, with monitoring during the quarantine. The report underscores ongoing Ebola concerns tied to the Congo outbreak, described as the focus of the crisis, where protesters burned a hospital after being blocked from removing the bodies of relatives who died with suspected disease. No details on laboratory confirmation, case counts, or the precise source of exposure beyond the initial contact with infected patients are provided.

triage.headline_ja: 医師がウガンダのエボラ感染者との接触後、チェコに転院される
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスは国際保健規則の最高優先度疾患であり、国際的な患者移送を伴う多国間イベント。DRCでの流行継続を背景とした国際的な拡大リスクが存在する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主要な流行地はDRC（「コンゴの流行が危機の中心」と明記）。ウガンダは医師の接触地点として言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。チェコはEU内での隔離受け入れであり、感染症イベント発生地ではない。DRC由来のエボラウイルスが国際的に移動する状況であり、IHR Annex2の全4基準に該当する重大なシグナルと判定。

article.articleHeadline: China bucks global trend, curbs dengue
article.articleSummary: China has curbed domestic dengue transmission despite rising global infections, with imported cases up 89% in 2025 and local outbreaks down 65% year-on-year. Dengue is endemic in more than 100 countries, with a 2024 global peak of 14.4 million and elevated levels in 2025. The approach blends government leadership, intensified vector surveillance and control, rapid outbreak responses, climate-informed early warning, and public health awareness, reinforced by dengue-control funds since 2005. Cross-border port cooperation, syndromic surveillance via digital systems, vector ecology monitoring, environmental management, and risk-zone designation underpin suppression of transmission and traveler protection. Internationally, China offers training and shares low-cost technologies through the GX Foundation and WHO coordination. A GX Foundation consensus on physical control—mosquito lamps, bed nets, sticky traps—has yielded results in Timor-Leste and Honduras and is expanding to Cambodia and Vanuatu, with plans to upgrade devices, rapid tests, and supply chains.

triage.headline_ja: 中国が世界的トレンドに逆行、デング熱を抑制
triage.triage_reason: 中国を含む複数国でのデング熱管理・制御に関する公衆衛生上の重要な動向を報告。国際的な技術共有とWHO連携による対策強化は国際的関心が高く、シグナルとして追跡の価値あり。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱の世界的流行（2024年ピーク1,440万件、2025年も高水準）と対比して、中国国内の局所流行が65%削減された異例の成功を報告。ただし、記事本文未提供のため詳細評価に制限あり。Timor-Leste、Honduras、Cambodia、Vanutuは中国の対外協力先として言及されているが、これらの国での実際の発生状況は不明であり、記事の主題は中国の対策成功にあるため verified_locations は中国のみに限定。国際的な技術共有とWHO連携による公衆衛生アプローチの報告として注視対象。

article.articleHeadline: 'Cautiously optimistic': American doctor with Ebola hopes for recovery - AOL
article.articleSummary: An American physician, Dr. Peter Stafford, 39, who treated patients in the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ituri Province, has Ebola. Diagnosed May 17, he was evacuated to Berlin’s Charité University Hospital for treatment. Stafford, his wife Dr. Rebekah Stafford, and their four children are in an isolation ward in Germany, separated from him by a window; the family remains asymptomatic. Stafford's symptoms include vomiting, diarrhea and a rash; lab results are trending slightly in the right direction, though he is described as critically ill but not acutely deteriorating. The Ebola outbreak in the area has led to about 134 deaths and up to 600 infections. U.S. risk is considered low; Americans who recently traveled to DRC, South Sudan or Uganda should undergo screening at Dulles International Airport. As of May 21, Stafford said he is cautiously optimistic about recovery.

triage.headline_ja: 「慎重に楽観的」：エボラウイルスに感染したアメリカ人医師の回復を望む - AOL
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当し、エボラウイルスの国際的拡大（DRC→Germany）、重症例、死亡例を伴う活動的な流行があり、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はDRC Ituri Province での活動的なエボラ流行（134死亡、約600感染例）です。患者の国際移送（DRC→Germany）は治療目的であり、DRCが実際の発生地点です。発生地域にはBerlin、Virginia、Sudan、Uganda等が含まれていますが、サマリーに基づき verified_locations はDRCのみとしています。米国への拡大リスク評価も記載されていますが、現在の確定患者はDRCで発症しDRCで治療中の事例のため、検証済み発生地はDRCに限定されます。

article.articleHeadline: Former CDC chief warns Ebola outbreak could become next major pandemic
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in East and Central Africa intensifies; majority of cases in Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. CDC reports 536 suspected, 105 probable, 34 lab-confirmed cases with about 134 suspected deaths. Transmission via contact with bodily fluids causing hemorrhagic fever and multi-organ failure. WHO has declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern. Former CDC chief Robert Redfield warned on May 20 that the outbreak could become a very significant pandemic, potentially spilling into Tanzania, South Sudan, and Rwanda. U.S. response includes May 20 screening at Chicago O’Hare; a CDC order denying entry to passport holders who visited DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan in the past three weeks (in effect for at least 30 days). Six Americans exposed; an American doctor infected in the DRC evacuated to Germany with his wife and four children. Trump also expressed concern.

triage.headline_ja: 元CDC長官がエボラ流行が次の大規模パンデミックになる可能性があると警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限措置実施）。既にWHOが国際的関心事項（PHEIC）を宣言し、複数国での確認例あり。
triage.notes: 記事は東・中央アフリカのエボラ流行を報じており、DRCとウガンダが主要な発生地。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。Bluedot APIが列挙した他のアフリカ諸国（スーダン、ルワンダ、ウガンダ、タンザニア）は記事で「潜在的拡大リスク」として言及されているが、実際の発生確認地ではなく対象リストにもないため除外。米国での検疫・暴露事例は確認されるが、感染症発生地ではなく対応措置のため除外。既にWHO-PHEICが宣言されている重大事象。

article.articleHeadline: 에볼라 공포에 美입국 불허...파리발 여객기 결국 캐나다로 | 연합뉴스
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola fears prompt U.S. entry ban... Paris-originating passenger plane ultimately diverted to Canada | Yonhap News
article.articleSummary: US authorities tightened Ebola-related entry controls amid ongoing outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. On May 21 local time, Air France Flight 378 from Paris to Detroit was denied US entry after it emerged a passenger from the Congo was aboard; the plane diverted to Montreal, Canada. CBP stated the Congo national boarded the aircraft in error and should not have been allowed on board due to entry restrictions intended to reduce Ebola risk; the aircraft landed in Detroit but could not disembark the passenger. The passenger underwent screening in Montreal and returned to Paris, with no symptoms reported. The State Department issued a travel health advisory restricting entry within 21 days of visiting Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan to Washington Dulles International Airport, with enhanced screening. WHO cited about 600 suspected Ebola cases and 139 deaths in DRC and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ恐怖で米入国不許可...パリ発旅客機、結局カナダへ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の国際的拡大リスク、複数国での継続的流行、渡航制限実施、米国・カナダを含む北米への波及が確認され、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はコンゴ民主共和国およびウガンダでのエボラ流行の国際的波及を示しており、DRCが対象国として検証された。北米（米国、カナダ）への波及は記事中心的だが、米国・カナダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCでの継続的流行（約600例疑い、139死亡）と国際的な渡航制限実施が確認される。

article.articleHeadline: Angry crowd sets Ebola hospital tents on fire in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Angry crowd in eastern DR Congo attacked Rwampara General Hospital in Ituri, burning two isolation tents and a body after being barred from reclaiming an Ebola victim. Six patients were in tents. A healthcare worker was injured, and medical staff were later protected by security forces. The unrest stems from public misunderstanding of Ebola; some believe the disease is real or fictitious, and mistrust toward aid groups lingers. The outbreak is linked to the Bundibugyo Ebola strain in eastern DR Congo; WHO reports nearly 600 suspected cases and about 139 deaths, with Congolese authorities citing a higher toll. Cases have appeared in neighboring Uganda, where cross-border transport was suspended. There is no approved vaccine for Bundibugyo, and containment could take months. WHO has described the outbreak as a public health emergency of international concern; authorities urge cooperation, including in areas controlled by M23.

triage.headline_ja: 怒った群衆がコンゴでエボラ病院のテントに火をつける
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認された流行であり、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）の全て4項目に該当。WHO PHEIC宣言済みで国際支援が必要な状況。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州での集団暴動によるエボラ治療施設破壊を主題としている。ウガンダは隣接国として言及されているが、記事の主要な発生地はDRCである。WHO PHEIC宣言済みの確認済み流行。パンデミック予防に関わる管理可能性の懸念（ワクチンなし、社会的不安定性）が著しい。

article.articleHeadline: 아프리카 강타한 죽음의 에볼라...사망자 속출하자 마지막 경고 [지금이뉴스]
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deadly Ebola strikes Africa hard... as the death toll soars, final warning [지금이뉴스].
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to surge, with the WHO declaring a Public Health Emergency of International Concern and monitoring a rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV) variant whose vaccines show limited efficacy. As of May 20, suspected deaths exceed 139 and suspected cases over 600, with spread expanding in North Kivu and South Kivu. WHO also warned of hantavirus spread linked to climate change and environmental disruption. The U.S. CDC has imposed entry restrictions on travelers from DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan, while WHO deployed $3.9 million in emergency funds. South Korea raised its alert to 'watch' and designated DRC and Uganda as quarantine zones. The Global Preparedness Monitoring Board (GPMB) cites conflict and weak coordination and calls for a pandemic treaty to ensure fair access to vaccines and treatments; without it, outbreaks could be more frequent and costly.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカを襲った死のエボラ...死者が続出し最終警告 [今がニュース]
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、PHEIC宣言済みの大規模エボラアウトブレイク。WPRO基準もすべてに該当し、社会的・政治的関心が極めて高い。DRCは対象国であり、フルRRA進行が必須。
triage.notes: DRCでのエボラアウトブレイクが主題。北キブ州および南キブ州で拡大中。WHO PHEIC宣言済み。死亡者139名以上、疑い症例600名以上。レアな Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV)変異株で、ワクチン効果が限定的との懸念。複数国（米国、南韓国）で渡航制限・入国規制実施済み。ハンタウイルスについても言及されているが、気候変動関連の警告に留まり、具体的なアウトブレイクではない。対象国リストにはUgandaおよびSouth Sudanはないため、DRCのみ verified_locations に記載。

article.articleHeadline: Dispertan Gresik Tinjau Pasar Hewan Kurban, Pastikan Tak Terjangkit PMK - Surya.co.id
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gresik's Dispertan Inspects Sacrificial Animal Market, Ensures No Foot-and-Mouth Disease Infection.
article.articleSummary: Gresik's Dispertan inspected the sacrificial animal market to prevent Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD) infection among goats and other sacrificial animals. They report 10,000 FMD vaccinations have been administered to animals bound for sacrifice, with vaccination teams available at stalls at no cost. Vendors say demand is strong, and goats appear healthy, with good appetite, bright eyes, and clean skin. For PMK (FMD) prevention, sellers vaccinate animals to ensure fitness before sale, prioritizing healthy pens. Officials note that PMK vaccines pose no danger to consumers when meat is properly cooked and handled under established safety rules. The market appears healthy, with goats selling quickly and vendors selecting animals from fit cages prior to vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: グレシック県農業局が犠牲動物市場を調査、口蹄疫感染がないことを確認
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアでの口蹄疫（FMD）ワクチン接種活動の報告だが、既に感染が確認された危機ではなく、予防的措置の段階。情報不足により、実際の発生リスク評価が困難。
triage.notes: 記事は犠牲祭向けの動物市場でのFMD予防対策を報告しており、既に感染症が発生している状況ではなく、当局による予防的ワクチン接種キャンペーンの段階。動物への影響であり人への直接的な脅威ではない。ただしFMDは家畜伝播性疾患として流行しやすく、継続的な監視が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: الأمم المتحدة : بعثة حفظ السلام الأممية في الكونغو تساهم في مكافحة فيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: United Nations: The UN peacekeeping mission in the Congo contributes to the fight against the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: On May 22, 2026, the United Nations says the Congo peacekeeping mission continues humanitarian support to the government’s Ebola response and worsening humanitarian conditions. Ituri province remains the outbreak’s epicenter, with the towns Rombara, Monbulu, and Bunia cited. The mission provides logistical support to speed medical deliveries to Bunia, with two peacekeeping cargo flights from Nairobi and Kinshasa. Over 4,600 kilograms of medical supplies were moved from WHO’s Nairobi regional warehouse by air, and four light vehicles were allotted to bolster epidemiological teams in Ituri. A helicopter supports flights to affected areas; ambulances and two armored vehicles are being moved from Goma to Bunia for medical evacuation and field access, under WHO oversight. Concerns rise about possible spread to North Kivu, with confirmed cases in Goma, Butembo, and Katwa. North Kivu partners strengthen surveillance, entry-point screening, and adaptable field operations amid displacement, insecurity, and access constraints.

triage.headline_ja: 国連：コンゴの国連平和維持活動がエボラウイルス対策に貢献
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。多地域での確認例、人道的危機の悪化、国際支援体制の稼働が認められる。
triage.notes: 発生地域にKenyaが含まれているが、サマリーではKenyaでの実際のエボラ発生は記載されておらず、Nairobiは物資搬入の中継地点として言及されているのみ。よってDRCのみを対象国として検証。複数地域（Ituri州のBunia、Katwa、Butembo、Goma）での確認事例あり。4600kg以上の医療物資輸送、ヘリコプター支援など国際的な対応体制が稼働中。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : l'IFRC renforce sa réponse dans l'est de la RDC alors que les risques régionaux augmentent
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: the IFRC reinforces its response in eastern DRC as regional risks increase.
article.articleSummary: As of 22 May 2026, the IFRC intensified its Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), Uganda, and neighboring countries, launching a regional emergency appeal of 29 million Swiss francs. In DRC's Bunia and Uganda's Rwampara, 200 Red Cross volunteers are conducting community engagement and frontline health activities, including door-to-door visits and a radio program to counter misinformation and promote early care. Families are educated not to touch or wash bodies of suspected Ebola decedents; on day one, volunteers reached 645 families. The Bundibugyo strain is of particular concern given limited evidence on treatments and vaccines for Zaïre-related Ebola. The outbreak spreads in insecure areas with fragile health systems and cross-border movement, raising regional risk; Uganda has confirmed Bundibugyo-linked cases, while Burundi, Rwanda, and South Sudan bolster border preparedness. Urgent funding is needed to expand surveillance, safe burial teams, PPE, and frontline response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：地域的リスクが増加する中、IFRC（赤十字社国際連盟）がコンゴ民主共和国東部での対応を強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の多国間での確認と急速な地域拡大、限定的な治療・ワクチン選択肢、脆弱な保健システム、越境人口移動による国際的な蔓延リスクが存在し、IHR基準およびWPRO基準の複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域フィールドには複数国が列挙されているが、記事サマリーの主題は「DRC東部（Bunia）とウガンダ（Rwampara）」でのエボラ発生及び地域的な懸念である。ウガンダはWPRO対象国ではないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを記載した。Bundibugyo株の存在、脆弱な保健体制、越境移動による国際的拡大リスク、および緊急資金要請により、フルRRA実施の優先度は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Caritas se mobilise pour répondre à la 17e flambée d'Ebola en République démocratique du Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Caritas mobilizes to respond to the 17th Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease resurges in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, marking the 17th outbreak. Caritas Congo Asbl convened an extraordinary Country Forum meeting on May 19, 2026 to coordinate an urgent response, with support from Caritas Internationalis member networks (CRS, Secours Catholique-Caritas France, CAFOD, Caritas Spain, Caritas Norway). Caritas Bunia is highlighted for its operational presence in multiple health zones and referral health facilities. The network’s strength lies in its close community ties through parishes, Basic Ecclesial Communities, deans, and faith platforms, enabling risk communication and prevention messaging. Protective equipment shortages raise serious concerns for health workers and community agents, with reports of fatalities among staff. Emphasis on community sensitization, training religious leaders to relay prevention messages, and behavior change communications. Displaced persons in camps require reinforced WASH; crowded camps amplify transmission risk. Logistics and operational constraints pose challenges to the response.

triage.headline_ja: カリタス、コンゴ民主共和国での17番目のエボラ感染症流行に対応するため動員
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病はIHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、DRCでの第17波流行という異常・予想外の事象。国際的な支援体制が既に構築されており、公衆衛生への重大な影響が明確である。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが検出した発生地域にはスペイン、フランス、ノルウェーも含まれているが、記事サマリーではこれらの国での発生は述べられていない。これらは国際支援提供国（Caritas組織）として言及されているのみであり、verified_locationsには含めない。DRCでの実際の発生のみを対象とする。エボラウイルス病は極めて重大な感染症であり、第17波という繰り返される流行パターン、保健労働者への感染と死亡報告、避難民キャンプでの感染リスク増加がすべてシグナル基準を満たしている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, war and aid cuts: How Congo's fragile economy is buckling under a new health emergency
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's latest Ebola outbreak, centered in Ituri and spreading to adjacent provinces and Uganda, prompted the WHO to declare a global health emergency. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine, complicating containment, and true case numbers may exceed official tallies due to weak surveillance and limited labs. Health facilities report shortages of PPE, patchy surveillance, and overstretched staff. The outbreak unfolds amid a fragile economy, rising debt, and shrinking aid. Recent cuts in US funding—about $33 million in 2024 to under $10 million in 2025 for DHHS, and USAID disbursements down from roughly $1.2 billion in 2024—have eroded outbreak preparedness and rural networks. Some 920,000 internally displaced in Ituri, plus security challenges from armed groups, hinder response. Tensions have flared, including an Ebola treatment centre being burned in Rwampara, reflecting growing distrust.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、戦争と援助削減：コンゴの脆弱な経済が新しい健康危機の下で崩壊している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO緊急宣言、ワクチン未承認株、複数国への拡大報告など、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでIturi州およびウガンダへの拡大が明記されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCのみ対象国リストに該当。WHO緊急宣言、ワクチン未承認株（Bundibugyo株）、PPE不足、武装勢力による社会不安、米国援助削減による対応体制の脆弱化が記載されており、WPRO全5基準が該当。

article.articleHeadline: Er hat Ebola: USA lehnten eigenen Arzt ab
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: He Has Ebola: The U.S. Rejected Its Own Doctor.
article.articleSummary: An American physician infected with Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo arrived in Berlin and is in a high-security isolation unit at Charité Hospital. The United States reportedly refused to repatriate the doctor, instead requesting Germany evacuate him; authorities cited shorter flight time and Charité’s Ebola expertise, though the White House denies the report. The Washington Post, citing five sources, and CBS also discuss political concerns and public perception. CBS notes a plane from France could not land in Detroit due to a Congo passenger, reflecting U.S. entry restrictions for people from Congo. The patient is in stable condition and receiving antibodies, able to eat and write. His wife and four children, who had contact with him, were flown to Berlin and are asymptomatic with negative tests. In Congo, WHO reports about 160 Ebola deaths and roughly 670 suspected cases; 2014 West Africa context and Trump-era criticisms are referenced in background.

triage.headline_ja: 彼はエボラに感染している：米国は自国の医師の送還を拒否した
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認患者が複数国（DRC、ベルリン）に関連し、国際的な医療対応と政治的関心が高い。IHR基準3項目以上に該当し、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 本イベントは記事サマリーに基づき、DRCで感染した患者がベルリン搬送された国際的なエボラ症例である。発生地域としてUSA、Germany、Franceが含まれているが、記事の主題は『DRCで感染した患者のエボラウイルス病』であり、対象国リストに該当するのはDRC（203312）のみ。進行中のDRC内のエボラアウトブレイク（WHO報告：約160死亡、約670疑い症例）も記事で言及されており、シグナル性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Demokratische Republik Kongo: Zahl der Ebola-Verdachtsfälle steigt auf mehr als 670
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo: Number of Ebola suspected cases rises to more than 670.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease continues in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) with 671 suspected cases and 160 suspected deaths reported by the Ministry of Health; 61 cases have been laboratory-confirmed. In Uganda, no new infections besides two confirmed cases; a newly confirmed case is in South Kivu, a rebel-controlled province far from the initial epicenter, signaling broader spread. WHO experts say the outbreak has been active for months, often undetected. In Ituri, a treatment center experienced protests over rules for handling Ebola corpses. A US physician treated in Berlin’s Charité, who contracted Ebola in the Congo, and his wife plus four children are in isolation; another American is treated in Prague after Ugandan exposure, currently asymptomatic and under observation. For Bundibugyo ebolavirus, there is no approved vaccine or therapy; two candidate vaccines exist, with timelines uncertain—one 6–9 months, the other 2–3 months but lacking animal data.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ疑い患者が670人以上に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の地理的拡大、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性）。WPRO基準も複数該当。エボラウイルス病の多国間拡大は高リスク事象。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはベルリン、プラハ、ドイツ、チェコが含まれるが、これらは患者の治療地または経由地であり、エボラウイルス病の実際の発生地域ではない。DRCでの継続的な感染伝播、ウガンダでの確認例、地理的拡大（South Kivuでの新規確認例）、予防接種・治療薬の不足などの複合的リスク要因により高リスク事象として判定。

article.articleHeadline: Caritas se moviliza para responder al 17º brote de Ébola en la República Democrática del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Caritas mobilizes to respond to the 17th Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: 17th Ebola outbreak re-emerges in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), with initial signs detected March 29, 2026 in Bunia, Ituri Province; official confirmation recently obtained. The Ebola virus strain identified so far differs from the Zaire ebolavirus, and there is no vaccine or specific treatment for this variant. First-hand data shows daily updated death tolls by provincial authorities. Caritas Bunia has convened an extraordinary forum on May 19, 2026 to coordinate urgent response with Caritas network members, the DRC government, technical and financial partners, and other humanitarian actors, including Caritas Internationalis members CRS, Secours Catholique-Caritas France, CAFOD, Caritas Spain, Caritas Norway. Emphasis on infection prevention and control, protection of health workers (PPE shortages), community risk communication to counter beliefs linking deaths to mysticism, and training religious leaders for outreach. Ongoing WASH and displacement-related needs are highlighted.

triage.headline_ja: カリタスが民主共和国コンゴにおける17番目のエボラ流行への対応に動員される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス（致死的、既知治療法なし）の新規アウトブレイク、既知の株とは異なる変異体、複数国での調整対応が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedotが報告したスペイン、フランス、ノルウェーは、記事サマリーに基づくと対応調整の参加国（Caritas加盟国）であり、実際の発生地ではないため除外。実際の感染症イベント発生地はDRCのBunia（イツリ州）のみ。致死的で治療法のない新規変異エボラ株のため、高リスク判定。

article.articleHeadline: La carrera contrarreloj de los laboratorios para desarrollar una vacuna contra el ébola tras brote por nueva cepa en África Central - La Tercera
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The laboratories' race against the clock to develop an Ebola vaccine after an outbreak caused by a new strain in Central Africa.
article.articleSummary: As of May 22, 2026, an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo caused by the Bundibugyo strain has reached Uganda and South Sudan, with about 1,000 cases and roughly 140 deaths (WHO). A May early-spreader event likely fueled transmission, with Ituri Province heavily affected. It is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC since 1976 and the third linked to Bundibugyo, a strain with no approved vaccines or therapies. Vaccine efforts are urgent: Ervebo (Zaire strain) is under review; Chinese researchers report an mRNA candidate targeting three major Ebola strains; Oxford University, with Serum Institute of India, is pursuing ChAdOx1 BDBV. OMS cautions that no doses are yet available for trials and estimates 6–9 months before clinical doses, though a second platform could enter trials in 2–3 months if animal data are favorable. A VSV-BDBV vaccine is in academic development at UT Austin. The priority is tracing transmission chains to define outbreak size and guide care. Bundibugyo was first identified in 2007 in Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の新型株によるアフリカ中央部での流行後、ワクチン開発をめぐる研究室の時間との戦い
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。Bundibugyo株による多国間拡大（DRC→Uganda→South Sudan）、約1,000例・140死亡、新しいワクチン未承認株、国際的支援の必要性が明確。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは DRC が主たる発生地とされ、Uganda と South Sudan への拡大を記述。ただし対象国リストでは DRC のみ該当。Uganda（226074）と Sudan（366755）は対象国に含まれないため verified_locations から除外。Bundibugyo株は承認ワクチン・治療法がなく、緊急のワクチン開発が進行中。WHO公式数値に基づく報告。

article.articleHeadline: Top US Professor Warns Congo Ebola Outbreak May Be Far Bigger Than Reported
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Central Africa linked to the Bundibugyo strain is affecting the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and neighboring Uganda as of 2026-05-22. Health experts warn the true number of infections and deaths may be substantially higher than official figures. The Bundibugyo strain is described as having no approved vaccine. Delayed identification of the outbreak is cited as a factor allowing the virus to spread across multiple communities before authorities could respond. Dr. Nita Bharti, an infectious disease expert at Penn State University, notes that late recognition has contributed to wider transmission. With no vaccine for Bundibugyo, containment is complicated. The report emphasizes concern over potential undercounting and the need for vigilant surveillance in the DRC and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: 米国の有力教授がコンゴのエボラ流行は報告より規模が大きい可能性があると警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の規模拡大、複数国への国際的拡大、渡航制限リスク）。Bundibugyo株はワクチンなく致死性も高く、過小報告の懸念と遅延対応により広域伝播が進行中。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCとウガンダの両国での発生を述べているが、対象国リスト上はDRCのみ該当。ウガンダ（1269750範囲外）は除外。Bundibugyo株の特性（ワクチン未承認、致死率高）、遅延対応による広域伝播、過小報告の懸念が判定理由。米国Penn State大学の専門家による警告により国際的な社会的関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: Former CDC director warns Ebola outbreak 'going to become significant pandemic'
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), centered in eastern Ituri province near Uganda, caused by Bundibugyo virus; highest case load in the region. Health authorities report 536 suspected cases, 105 probable, 34 confirmed, and about 134 suspected deaths. Transmission via contact with bodily fluids drives a haemorrhagic fever with rapid multi-organ failure; there are no approved vaccines for Bundibugyo virus. WHO has declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern. The outbreak spans DRC and Uganda with ongoing humanitarian concerns in conflict-affected, mobile populations. CDC screening has begun at Chicago O’Hare; a 30-day entry ban applies to U.S. passport holders who visited DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan in the prior three weeks. At least six Americans have been exposed; an American doctor infected in the DRC was evacuated to Germany. Former CDC director Redfield warns the outbreak could become a significant pandemic.

triage.headline_ja: 前CDC長官が「エボラ流行は重大なパンデミックになる」と警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の高致死性病原体、国際的な地理的拡大、国際的な渡航制限の実施）。WHO PHEIC宣言済み、複数国での確認、米国での入国スクリーニング開始、国際支援の必要性が明確。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで「DRCおよびウガンダ」と記載されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。米国の地名（Chicago, Illinois）も対象国外のため除外。スーダンも記事では言及されるが、事象の主体は DRC-Uganda 境界域。WHO PHEIC宣言、高い死亡率（疑い例を含む概況死亡率≈25%）、Bundibugyo ウイルスへのワクチン未承認、紛争影響地域での拡大易性、米国での検疫措置実施など、複合的に高リスク。フルRRA推奨。

article.articleHeadline: มีสัญญาณที่ต้องระวัง 'ภัยเชื้อโรครีเทิร์น' ไทยไม่ซ้ำรอยยุคโควิด? | เดลินิวส์
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: There are warning signs to watch out for: the 'return of pathogens' threat—will Thailand avoid a repeat of the COVID era?
article.articleSummary: Thailand faces warning signs of pathogen resurgence in 2026, with mentions of hantavirus and Ebola as new signals after early-year outbreaks and a cruise-ship case; there is currently no confirmed hantavirus outbreak in Thailand. The piece emphasizes that public health preparedness in Thailand must extend beyond hospitals and vaccines to robust early-warning systems, transparent data sharing, diagnostic capacity, and laboratory networks, all linked by effective risk communication and resilient supply chains. Drawing on COVID-19 lessons, it argues that readiness depends on integrated systems that connect human, animal, and environmental health data to detect abnormal disease signals and respond proportionally to risk. It highlights gaps in knowledge, coordination, and cross-sector collaboration that can delay response. The article advocates strengthening One Health surveillance and rapid-response capability now, so Thailand can act quickly if new threats emerge.

triage.headline_ja: 注意が必要な警告信号：『病原体の回帰』の脅威—タイはコロナ時代の繰り返しを避けられるか？
triage.triage_reason: 複数の重篤疾患（COVID-19、ハンタウイルス、エボラ）が言及されているが、記事は主に「警告信号」と「公衆衛生準備体制」に関する論説であり、確認済みの流行は示されていない。ハンタウイルスアウトブレイクは『現在、タイでは確認されていない』と明示されている。スクリーニング基準の1つ（異常性/予想外性、重症度の可能性）に該当するが、情報が限定的であるため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は『早期の流行』および『クルーズ船事案』への言及があるが、具体的な確認患者数、死亡数、現在の感染状況は記されていない。ハンタウイルスについて『現在タイでの確認アウトブレイクはない』と明言されている。この記事は主にタイの公衆衛生システムの脆弱性と準備体制の必要性に関する評論・提言記事である。実際の流行の具体的な規模や影響については、さらなる情報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو الديمقراطية تعلن حصيلة جديدة لضحايا إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports a new Ebola death toll.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri, northeast) shows rising activity with 671 suspected cases and 160 suspected deaths reported by health authorities, including 64 laboratory-confirmed infections and 6 deaths. The World Health Organization cited about 600 suspected cases and over 130 suspected deaths, noting underreporting likely inflates true figures. In Uganda, health officials report no new cases among two previously confirmed Congolese nationals; one patient died, while the second has twice-tested negative for Ebola and remains under treatment. Africa CDC indicates the outbreak began in Ituri Province, which borders Uganda and South Sudan, marking the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC since 1976. The outbreak involves the rare Bundibugyo strain, whose vaccine and specific treatment are unavailable, complicating containment. Ebola is highly contagious via direct contact with infected individuals or body fluids; the 2014–2015 West Africa epidemic caused over 11,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱の新しい死亡者数を発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の確認患者・死亡者が報告され、国境を越えた拡大リスク（ウガンダ）がある。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国のイトゥリ州におけるエボラアウトブレイクを主題としており、ウガンダでの疑い患者言及も含まれているが、確認患者はDRC内のみ。稀少なBundibugyo株であり、対象国内での発生であるためDRCのみを verified_locations に含める。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: VIDEO Kriza s ebolom se ozbiljno otima kontroli? Bijesna masa zapalila karantenu: 'Tragično je u što oni vjeruju'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: VIDEO: The Ebola crisis is seriously spiraling out of control? Angry mob sets the quarantine on fire: "It's tragic what they believe."
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: Ebola in Ituri, eastern DRC; mob attacked Rwampara Hospital after families couldn't perform traditional burial; two isolation tents burned; one health worker injured; six patients treated in improvised tents; all patients located and under care per Alima. WHO has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, and emphasizes safe and dignified burials. As of midweek, WHO reported about 139 deaths among more than 600 suspected cases; Congolese health authorities later cited 159 deaths. Two imported cases confirmed in Uganda, which suspended cross-border transport and river ferry traffic along Semliki River. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; no vaccine yet, with vaccine development up to nine months. A first confirmed case in South Kivu involved a 28-year-old man who traveled from Kisangani and died before diagnosis; M23 says it will cooperate with partners. The epicenter remains Ituri; risks extend to neighboring regions.

triage.headline_ja: 動画：エボラ危機が深刻化？激怒した群衆が隔離テント焚火に放火：「彼らが何を信じているかは悲劇的」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外の事象、国際的拡大リスク・ウガンダへの波及、渡航・貿易制限実施）。WHO PHEIC宣言、複数国への波及確認、死亡者増加報告により、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも2例の輸入確認例があるが、記事の主題は東部コンゴ（イトゥリ州）のエボラ発生。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。Bundibugyo ebolavirus によるアウトブレイク、ワクチン未利用、医療施設への攻撃と患者ケアの破壊が懸念。

article.articleHeadline: Vishwavani Editorial: ಎಬೋಲಾ: ಎಚ್ಚರಿಕೆ ಇರಲಿ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vishwavani Editorial: Ebola: Be on alert.
article.articleSummary: As of May 22, 2026, India has reported no Ebola cases. The World Health Organization designates parts of Central Africa as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, with Congo and Uganda reporting Ebola outbreaks and about 91 deaths. Consequently, the India-Africa Forum Summit in Delhi, slated for May 28, has been postponed by consensus due to the African situation. The piece also flags hantavirus concerns; Ebola’s case fatality is near 50%, a vaccine exists but the Bundibugyo strain is highly pathogenic and not covered by it.
