It urges the central government to tighten surveillance at international airports, issue precautionary guidelines, and raise public awareness. Experts say the risk of wider spread to India is low, but health checks and quarantine protocols for travelers from Africa are advisable, and basic COVID-era hygiene and sanitization remain prudent.

triage.headline_ja: Vishwavani Editorial: エボラ：警戒が必要
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスク）。DRC/ウガンダでのエボラ流行、インドへの入国管理強化の提案、国際フォーラムの延期という具体的な事象がある。
triage.notes: 記事はインド（Delhi）からの視点でアフリカ（DRC、ウガンダ）のエボラ流行を論じており、インドでの警戒と国際的な影響を強調している。未確認の要素として、記事サマリーにはハンタウイルスとCOVID-19も疾患リストに含まれているが、サマリー本文では主にエボラのみが詳細に論じられている。2026年5月という未来日付は検証が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 인도, 에볼라 우려에 동물보호단체 창립 정상회의도 연기
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: India postpones the inaugural summit of animal welfare organizations due to Ebola concerns.
article.articleSummary: India postpones two major meetings due to Ebola concerns amid rising outbreak activity in Africa. The Ministry of Environment announced the inaugural summit of big cat species protection, scheduled for June 1–2 in New Delhi, will be rescheduled to allow attendance by about 95 representatives from Asia, Africa, and the Americas. Hours earlier, India and the African Union postponed the 4th India–Africa Summit planned for June 28–31 in New Delhi. Ebola activity is expanding in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. In the DRC, suspected Ebola cases reach 671 with 160 suspected deaths; health authorities confirm 64 laboratory-confirmed cases and 6 deaths. In Uganda, 2 confirmed cases, with 1 death reported. The suspensions reflect public health caution as India remains a lead partner in big cat conservation and IBCA biodiversity collaborations.

triage.headline_ja: インド、エボラ懸念で動物保護団体首脳会議を延期
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の活動がアフリカで拡大し、インドが主要イベントを延期する決定を下した。IHR基準2項目以上該当し、国際的な関心の高さが認められる。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はインドがエボラ懸念によりニューデリー予定のイベントを延期した点であり、実際の患者発生地域はDRCおよびウガンダである。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めていない。エボラウイルス病は高い死亡率を特徴とし、DRCでの確認例と疑い例が報告されており、国際的な関心は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: الإيبولا يتمدد في الكونغو.. 671 إصابة مشتبه بها و160 وفاة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spreads in the Democratic Republic of the Congo... 671 suspected cases and 160 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri Province, near Uganda and South Sudan) accelerates, with 671 suspected cases and 160 deaths; 64 lab-confirmed infections and 6 confirmed deaths. The current outbreak involves the rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus lineage, for which there is no licensed vaccine or approved therapy, hindering containment. WHO warns true numbers may be higher due to underreporting. This is the seventeenth Ebola outbreak in DRC since 1976. In response, the United States imposes travel measures on arrivals from Congo, Uganda and South Sudan: Americans who visited those countries in the past three weeks must enter exclusively via Dallas International Airport near Washington for enhanced health screening; non-US citizens from those countries face entry restrictions. Uganda reports no new local cases after two Congolese nationals were detected (one died; the other tested negative). WHO has declared an international health emergency due to cross-border risk.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴに拡大... 671の疑い例と160人の死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目で該当。エボラウイルス病の大規模アウトブレイクであり、国際保健上の緊急事態が宣言されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、エボラアウトブレイクの主要な発生地はコンゴ東部（イトゥリ州）である。アメリカとウガンダでの対応措置が記述されているが、実際の感染事例の発生はコンゴが中心。ウガンダは接触者スクリーニングレベルの段階。対象国リストではDRC（203312）のみが該当。

article.articleHeadline: 에볼라 공포에 미 입국 불허...파리발 여객기 캐나다로
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. bars entry amid Ebola fears... Paris-originating passenger plane bound for Canada.
article.articleSummary: On May 20, 2026, amid U.S. Ebola-related entry restrictions, a passenger from the Democratic Republic of Congo was denied entry to the United States when Air France Flight 378 (Paris–Detroit) diverted to Montréal, Canada. U.S. Customs and Border Protection said the Congolese national was aboard due to an airline error and should not have boarded under Ebola risk controls. The Detroit landing was prevented. Canadian health authorities screened the passenger at Montréal-Trudeau airport, after which the traveler returned to Paris; no symptoms were reported. The incident underscores strict Ebola-entry measures in the United States and cross-border coordination when travelers from Ebola-affected regions are involved.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ恐怖で米国入国不許可...パリ発旅客機がカナダへ
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスに関する国際的な渡航制限措置とその運用が報道されているが、実際の患者発生や流行拡大は報告されていない。DRCでのエボラ発生が背景にあるが、本イベントは単一の入国管理案件である。
triage.notes: 本イベントは実患者の発生ではなく、DRCからの渡航者に対する米国の入国管理措置の実例報道である。エボラ流行自体がDRCで継続中であることは示唆されているが、本記事の主題は国際渡航管理の運用であり、新たな流行拡大を示すシグナルではない。カナダに該当する対象国がないため、DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Waspadai Penyebaran Ebola, AS Perketat Pembatasan Perjalanan dari Afrika Timur dan Tengah
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beware the spread of Ebola as the U.S. tightens travel restrictions from East and Central Africa.
article.articleSummary: US tightens travel restrictions from East and Central Africa to curb Bundibugyo Ebola virus spread. In a May 18 statement, the CDC, with Homeland Security and other agencies, intensifies border screening and traveler monitoring. Non-US passport holders who have recently been in Uganda, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, or South Sudan within 21 days are barred from entry. The agency will bolster laboratory capacity, hospital preparedness, and border surveillance, coordinating with airlines, international partners, and port authorities to identify exposed travelers. CDC personnel will be deployed to affected areas to support the response. Immediate risk to the general US population remains low, and there is no vaccine for Bundibugyo virus; treatment is supportive. In the DRC: 11 confirmed, 336 suspected cases, 88 deaths; Uganda: 2 confirmed, 1 death. Symptoms include fever, headache, vomiting, weakness, abdominal pain, epistaxis, and hematemesis.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染拡大に警戒、米国がアフリカ東部・中部からの渡航制限を強化
triage.triage_reason: Bundibugyo Ebolaウイルスの確認症例と死亡があり、IHR基準で複数該当（異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度、流行性、管理可能性が認められ、米国を含む国際的対応が既に実施されている。フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: DRCで確認症例11例、疑い例336例、死亡88例が報告されている。ウガンダでも確認症例2例、死亡1例。米国がウガンダ、DRC、南スーダンからの渡航制限を実施。国際的な公開衛生上の懸念が高まっている。

article.articleHeadline: സംസ്‌ക്കരിക്കാന്‍ മൃതദേഹം വിട്ടു നല്‍കിയില്ല; കോംഗോയില്‍ എബോളാ ചികിത്സാ കേന്ദ്രത്തിന് തീയിട്ട് ജനക്കൂട്ടം | news
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Body not released for embalming; mob sets Ebola treatment center ablaze in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Mob sets Ebola treatment center ablaze in Ituri Province, Rampaar, Democratic Republic of the Congo, on Tuesday as distrust of Ebola response deepens. The violence followed a demand by relatives to release the body of a local footballer who died amid suspected Ebola; authorities refused given the risk of transmission and strict burial protocols. Protesters forced entry, damaged equipment, and set fire to tents housing Ebola patients. A body prepared for burial, along with the tents, was burnt. Police used tear gas and fired into the air but could not stop the attackers. Six patients at the center were safely moved to another hospital for treatment.

triage.headline_ja: 遺体が埋葬のために引き渡されず；コンゴのエボラ治療センターに群衆が放火
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当。エボラ出血熱の治療施設が破壊されることで、感染制御体制の崩壊と地域内での感染拡大リスクが急速に高まる。
triage.notes: エボラ治療施設の破壊は感染制御体制の著しい崩壊を意味する。隔離患者の安全な移送が確認された一方で、焼失した遺体と医療機器による感染リスク、および地域住民による医療施設への不信感の深刻化は、今後の疫学的統制を著しく困難にする。イトゥリ州での感染拡大リスクは極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: '에볼라' 민주콩고서 치료 시설 화재···희생자 시신 인도 두고 갈등
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 'Ebola' treatment facility fire in the Democratic Republic of the Congo ... dispute over the handover of the victims' bodies.
article.articleSummary: On May 21, 2026, in Ituri province's Lwampara area of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, an Ebola treatment facility caught fire after clashes between mourners seeking the body of a presumed Ebola fatality and protesters who believed the deceased died of typhoid. The facility housed two tents; both burned, with six patients inside who were subsequently moved to hospital; one healthcare worker was injured by a stone. The incident underscores mistrust and misinformation around Ebola; local officials noted the deceased was a well-known community member and some residents doubt Ebola's reality. The International Medical Corps said six patients were in the tents at the time. WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern over the DRC's Ebola outbreak; as of May 22, 2026, 64 confirmed, 671 suspected cases, and over 1,260 contacts traced. Meanwhile, Uganda reported two confirmed cases in Kampala via laboratory testing, with one death.

triage.headline_ja: 民主共和国のエボラ治療施設で火災...犠牲者の遺体引き渡しをめぐり紛争
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、予想外の事象）。WHO既に公衆衛生上の国際的に懸念される事態を宣言済みのエボラ感染症における施設火災による患者管理危機であり、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: DRCのイトゥリ州ルワンパラ地区でのエボラ治療施設火災は、既存のエボラ流行中の重大な管理危機。WHOが既にPHEIC宣言済み（64確定例、671疑い例、1260以上接触者追跡）。ウガンダでもカンパラにて確定例2例（1死亡）報告。地域住民の不信感・誤情報が対応を複雑化させている点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: エボラ治療施設に放火、遺体の返還求める遺族が抗議　コンゴ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Arson at Ebola treatment facility; families demanding the return of bodies protest in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Arson at an Ebola treatment center in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri Province) as protesters tried to forcibly remove the body of a young Ebola victim; two ALIMA tents burned. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain is identified as the outbreak cause. DR Congo reported at least 64 laboratory-confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 671 suspected, with over 1,260 contacts tracked. Officials say approximately 160 deaths linked to the outbreak have been recorded. On May 21, 2026, authorities confirmed new infections: 13 more in Ituri, plus 78 suspected cases. The incident occurred amid WHO declaring the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, although global risk remains low. Uganda confirmed two cases in Kampala (one death), later stating the female patient had two negative tests and is no longer ill; border suspensions and enhanced security ensue. ALIMA noted six patients were under care at the time of the attack.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ治療施設に放火、遺体の返還求める遺族が抗議　コンゴ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による急速な患者増加（64確診例、671疑い例、160死亡例）、WHOによる国際的懸念事項の公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）宣言、ウガンダへの国際的拡大、旅行・貿易制限リスク。
triage.notes: Ituri州での治療施設放火は社会的混乱を示唆。ウガンダでも確認されているが、記事の主題はDRC。WHOがPHEIC宣言済み。Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain は比較的稀な株。160死亡例、進行中の患者追跡（1,260+ contacts）。緊急的なフルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: [인터뷰] 문성철 코미팜 대표 "ASF 백신, 연구 넘어 상용화 임박"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: [Interview] Moon Seong-cheol, CEO of Komipharm, 'African Swine Fever vaccine nearing commercialization beyond research'
article.articleSummary: African Swine Fever (ASF) vaccine development by Komipharm is entering global commercialization from research. CEO Moon Seong-cheol notes five studies to be released at IPVS 2026, June 16–19, in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, to demonstrate practical viability and safety. The vaccine program emphasizes sow safety, horizontal transmission among cohabiting pigs, durability of immunity under outdoor exposure, and immune persistence in real farm settings. Overseas field trials are accumulating data on commercial farms to support country-by-country approvals and worldwide market entry. Southeast Asia is the core strategic market, with rising demand as ASF persists, while Eastern Europe and other ASF-affected regions seek vaccines. Data on applicability to Philippine commercial farms will be disclosed as part of the practical-use metrics.

triage.headline_ja: [インタビュー] コミファーム代表のムン・ソンチョル氏 「アフリカ豚熱ワクチン、研究から商用化が迫る」
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はASFワクチン開発の進捗状況に関するインタビューで、新規の疾病発生事例ではなく、既知疾病の医学的進展報告である。公衆衛生上の急性危機を示唆する情報がない。
triage.notes: 本記事は疾病の新規発生を報告するものではなく、ASFワクチン開発企業（コミファーム）の商用化計画に関するインタビュー記事である。ベトナムのホーチミンでIPVS 2026カンファレンスで研究成果を発表予定との内容。シグナルトリアージの対象外とすべき情報タイプである。

article.articleHeadline: The WHO has declared the Ebola outbreak in DR Congo a global health emergency BBC News - ExBulletin
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-22, the World Health Organization has declared the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo a public health emergency of international concern (PHEIC). The outbreak is centered in the eastern Ituri province, with about 246 suspected cases and 80 deaths reported. The declaration notes that while the situation is serious, it does not meet criteria for a pandemic emergency. WHO officials warned that the outbreak could be larger than currently recognized and reported, with a high risk of local and regional spread. The update calls for intensified international coordination, surveillance, rapid response, and risk communication to contain transmission. No laboratory-confirmed details or infection sources are provided in the article, and there is no mention of affected countries beyond the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行をグローバルヘルスエマージェンシーと宣言
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全てに該当。WHO公式なPHEIC(国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態)宣言、国際的対応が求められるエボラ流行であり、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: WHO公式PHEIC宣言により、国際的な感染症対応のための最高レベルのアラート。246疑い患者・80死亡、地域及び地域外への拡大リスク高。DRC(コンゴ民主共和国)が対象国リスト外であるが、PHEICの性質上、国際的スクリーニングおよび周辺国(Zambia等)への波及監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Filovirus: Emergency scientific consultation on Bundibugyo medical countermeasures R&D
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda has been declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) by the WHO, triggering an urgent scientific consultation to align research and development priorities for medical countermeasures against Bundibugyo ebolavirus. The Filovirus Collaborative Open Research Consortium (CORC), led by ANRS-MIE, in partnership with Africa CDC and the WHO R&D Blueprint, convenes the session to review MCM priorities and coordination. The event is scheduled for Friday, 22 May 2026, from 13:00 to 16:00 CET (Geneva time), and will be held as a Zoom webinar. Submissions via chat will be addressed during the session. For queries, contact corc.filovirus@anrs.fr. A recording will be posted on the event page after the session.

triage.headline_ja: フィロウイルス：ブンディブギオ医療対抗策R&Dに関する緊急科学協議会
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、PHEIC宣言、複数国への国際的拡大、国際的懸念）。エボラ出血熱の新興クレード（Bundibugyo）によるアウトブレイクが DRC・ウガンダで発生し、WHO により PHEIC として宣言されている。
triage.notes: 記事では DRC とウガンダでの Bundibugyo ebolavirus アウトブレイクが明記されているが、対象国リストに Uganda が含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみ記載。ジュネーブでの科学協議会は対応活動の本体ではなく、イベント開催地であるため含めていない。PHEIC 宣言済みの重大アウトブレイクとして、フルRRA 実施が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Are we heading for another Ebola crisis? - podcast
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has escalated rapidly, with 246 suspected cases and 65 deaths initially, rising to about 500 cases and 130 suspected deaths within days. On 17 May, the World Health Organization declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern. The crisis centers in eastern DRC’s Ituri province, with Guardian global health correspondent Kay Lay and Goma-based reporter Prosper Heri Ngorora reporting from the field and speaking to residents about the impact. The podcast examines why experts are concerned and what the WHO PHEIC designation implies, highlighting transmission pace and the international response. Published 22 May 2026, the piece frames the situation as a potential repeat of prior Ebola crises in the region.

triage.headline_ja: 別のエボラ危機に向かっているのか？ - ポッドキャスト
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の急速な拡大、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性）。WHOがPHEIC宣言済み。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は高い致死率を持つ危険病原体。サマリーに記載される数値（初期246疑似症例・65死亡、後に500症例・130死亡推定）は極めて深刻。WHOがPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）宣言（2026年5月17日）済みであり、既に公式なシグナル。DRC東部Ituri州およびGoma（北キブ州）が震央。記事日付は2026年であり未来設定であるが、情報内容のリスク評価は現在的評価に準拠している。

article.articleHeadline: Рейс из Франции в США перенаправлен в Канаду из-за мер борьбы с Эболой
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Flight from France to the United States diverted to Canada due to Ebola control measures.
article.articleSummary: Air France flight from Paris to Detroit was diverted to Montreal due to Ebola outbreak control measures. The Washington Post reports a passenger from the Democratic Republic of Congo was allowed on board by mistake. US entry restrictions apply to anyone who has spent the previous three weeks in the DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan; such travelers may only enter the United States through Dulles International Airport in Virginia, applicable to both foreign nationals and U.S. citizens. The measures respond to a new Ebola strain driving a broader outbreak; latest counts show at least 139 deaths and about 600 probable cases. A vaccine is not expected to be available for at least six months, per WHO estimates. The incident highlights ongoing travel disruptions related to the outbreak and tightened border controls.

triage.headline_ja: フランスからアメリカへのフライトがエボラ対策措置によりカナダへ迂回
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の新規株による広域流行（少なくとも139人の死亡、約600例の患者）が報告されており、複数国での国境検査強化と渡航制限が実施されている。IHR基準（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）および社会的・政治的関心の両面でシグナル基準を満たす。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでエボラ流行の発生国はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）、ウガンダ、南スーダンと記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。フライトの迂回先（カナダ、米国、フランス）は二次的な影響であり、一次的な感染症イベント発生地としては確認されていない。ワクチン不在（6ヶ月以上不可能）により対応能力に懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: Врач рассказал, кто находится в группе риска заболевания Эболой
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A doctor explained who is in the high-risk group for Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola high-risk groups include the elderly and diabetics, with pregnant women also at risk, Ugandan doctor Elijah Kiiza told RIA Novosti. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain outbreak has affected the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, with the WHO declaring it a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Transmission starts from wildlife reservoirs to humans and then spreads between people. Early symptoms are fever, muscle spasms, headache, and sore throat, followed by kidney and liver failure and, in some cases, internal and external bleeding. Kiiza notes that older individuals and diabetics tend to show rapid onset, while in children the incubation can reach about 1.5 weeks. The report highlights ongoing outbreaks and vulnerable groups, including pregnant women, in the context of this international public health alert.

triage.headline_ja: 医者がエボラ病の高リスク群について説明
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WHO PHEIC宣言されたBundibugyo ebolavirus アウトブレイク。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCとウガンダを言及しているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ウガンダは対象国外のため除外。WHO PHEIC宣言済みのBundibugyo ebolavirus アウトブレイクであり、高リスク群の特定と症状情報を含む公開報道。国際的関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: 米、エボラ対策強化　帰国米国人にダレス空港経由を義務付け
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. tightens Ebola measures, mandates returning Americans to transit via Dulles International Airport.
article.articleSummary: On May 21, 2026, the U.S. State Department ordered Americans who recently stayed in the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan within the past three weeks to transit through Washington Dulles International Airport for enhanced Ebola virus disease testing. The CDC and CBP are intensifying public-health screening at Dulles as Ebola outbreaks unfold in Congo, with 139 deaths and up to 600 cases reported. Earlier this week, the United States barred entry of non-U.S. citizens who had visited the same countries. The move concentrates travelers at a single airport, risking bottlenecks and logistical challenges, unlike the 2014–2016 West Africa response that used five airports. IDSA CEO Jean Marazzo (former director of NIAID) said regional coverage would be preferable but requires resources, noting budget constraints in public health.]

triage.headline_ja: 米、エボラ対策強化　帰国米国人にダレス空港経由を義務付け
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当する。エボラ出血熱は公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限措置を伴う異常事象である。DRCで139死亡・最大600症例が報告されており、WPROスクリーニング基準（重症度、異常性、流行可能性）も複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC、Uganda、South Sudanにおけるエボラ流行が述べられているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。米国の検疫措置は対象国外の事象であり含めない。DRCでの139死亡と最大600症例は重症度・深刻性を示す重要な指標。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Uganda gantung perkhidmatan pengangkutan awam ke Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Uganda suspends public transport services to Congo.
article.articleSummary: On 22 May 2026, Uganda suspended all public transport to the Democratic Republic of Congo for four weeks due to the Ebola outbreak declared a public health emergency by WHO. The measures cover ferries, buses, and cross-border services; flights to DRC are halted for 48 hours, with cargo and food-supply vehicles exempt. Uganda reports two border-crossing cases linked to Congo: one confirmed positive and one death. No active cases are currently reported in Uganda, and a previously suspected case tested negative on two screens. In the DRC, INSP data show an Ebola outbreak in Ituri province, eastern DRC, with about 671 probable cases and 160 deaths. There is no vaccine or specific antiviral treatment for the Bundibugyo strain involved. International responses include tighter U.S. air screening for travelers from DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan, and Bahrain’s one-month ban on visitors from the three countries.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：ウガンダがコンゴへの公共交通サービスを停止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、エボラウイルス病による国際的な公衆衛生上の重大な懸念事項。DRCで671例以上の患者、160例の死亡があり、複数国での対応・渡航制限が実施されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの分析：DRCのイトゥリ州でエボラ実際の発生（671例、160死）が確認されている。ウガンダは2例の境界越境ケース（1確認陽性、1死亡）を報告しているが、現在ウガンダ国内に活動的症例はない。アメリカとバーレーンは複数国への渡航制限を実施。WHOが公衆衛生上の緊急事態として宣言。Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはUgandaも含まれるが、記事サマリー上ウガンダは実質的な患者集積地でなく、対応国である。したがってverified_locationsはDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: EE.UU. activa el Título 42 por brote de ébola: ¿qué significa para los fanáticos del Mundial 2026?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. activates Title 42 due to Ebola outbreak: What does it mean for 2026 World Cup fans?
article.articleSummary: As of May 22, 2026, the United States invoked Title 42 to restrict entry for non-U.S. travelers who have recently been in Uganda, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, or South Sudan within the past 21 days, for 30 days with exemptions for U.S. military, diplomats and their families. The action follows an Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak in the DRC, with imported Ugandan cases and the WHO declaring a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17. Authorities report more than 130 suspected deaths and at least 600 cases under investigation; no vaccines or approved treatments exist for Bundibugyo Ebola virus. The DR Congo national team, preparing for the 2026 World Cup, canceled a three-day Kinshasa training camp and a farewell event; some delegation members may face extra screening or preventive quarantines. The U.S. embassy in Kampala suspended visa services; CDC says immediate risk to the U.S. population remains low. Fans should monitor CDC and State Department updates.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がエボラ熱流行により第42条を発動：2026年ワールドカップファンにとって何を意味するのか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ・ブンディブギョウの国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威、WHO PHEIC宣言、複数国への拡大、国際的な渡航制限実施により、フルRRA評価に進める。
triage.notes: エボラ・ブンディブギョウ（Bundibugyo Ebola virus）はWHO PHEICが宣言された急性脅威。DRC内で130以上の疑い死亡、600以上の調査中症例。ウガンダからの輸入症例確認。米国がTitle 42で渡航制限を発動。ワールドカップ準備活動にも影響。ウガンダ・スーダンでの確認については記事サマリーに「imported Ugandan cases」と記載されており、これらは二次的影響と解釈される。主たる発生地はDRCであるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: ¿Una pandemia "muy importante"? Exjefe de los CDC hace saltar alarmas por el brote de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A 'very important' pandemic? Former CDC director raises alarm over the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in Africa has killed 130 people and surpassed 500 confirmed or suspected cases, concentrated mainly in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo. Former U.S. CDC director Robert Redfield warned the situation could become a 'very significant pandemic,' potentially spreading to Tanzania, South Sudan, and possibly Rwanda. The World Health Organization declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern, citing rapid spread and the Bundibugyo virus, which is highly contagious and lacks approved vaccines or targeted therapeutics. WHO officials noted a promising vaccine candidate would not be available for at least six months. In response, Washington allocated $23 million to fight the outbreak and banned entry to foreigners who have visited the DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan within the prior 21 days.

triage.headline_ja: 「非常に重要なパンデミック」か？ 米CDC前長官がエボラ流行について警告を発する
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を4項目すべて満たす。エボラ出血熱の大規模流行で死亡者130名、確定・疑い例500件超、複数国への拡大リスク、国際的な渡航制限実施、WHO PHEIC宣言済み。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでエボラ流行は主にウガンダとDRCに集中と明記。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。ウガンダ、タンザニア、南スーダン、ルワンダは対象国外のため除外。WHO PHEIC宣言、米国の渡航禁止措置、CDC前長官の重大警告により社会的・政治的関心極めて高い。ワクチン不在（6ヶ月以内に利用不可）による管理可能性の懸念も指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Moeizame strijd tegen ebola in Oost-Congo: 'Het transport van een monster naar het lab kan een week duren'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An uphill battle against Ebola in eastern Congo: "Transporting a sample to the lab can take a week."
article.articleSummary: As of May 22, 2026, the World Health Organization reports about 600 suspected Ebola cases and at least 139 suspected deaths in an eastern Congo outbreak. The Bundibugyo variant has circulated for about a month before the outbreak was declared and has crossed into Uganda, heightening cross-border risk. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, the affected provinces are Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, with Cordaid active in those areas. Laboratory confirmation is hampered by tests designed for the Zaïre variant; Bundibugyo-specific rapid tests are unavailable, and transporting samples to a lab can take up to a week. Rwanda and Uganda have closed border crossings to curb spread, disrupting livelihoods in a densely cross-border region. Authorities, with support from M23, emphasize safe burials and isolation, but healthcare access remains severely limited in Congo's outbreak zones.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ東部でのエボラとの苦しい闘い：「検体をラボに運ぶのに1週間かかる可能性がある」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべて該当。推定600例の患者、少なくとも139人の死亡を伴う深刻な多国間エボラアウトブレイク。国際的な広がり、越境リスク、旅行制限が既に実施されている。
triage.notes: アウトブレイク規模は推定600例の疑似患者と139人の死亡で深刻。Bundibugyo変異株が検出され、既にUgandaに越境している。実験室確認の遅延（検体輸送に1週間要する）が対応を複雑化させている。Rwanda、Ugandaが国境封鎖を実施済みであり、既に国際的な対応措置が取られている。ただし、記事サマリーではUgandaとRwandaの内部感染事例の確実な報告がないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: 加拿大準備迎FIFA世界盃旅客 密切關注非洲埃博拉疫情 | 非洲埃博拉疫情，加拿大 | 大紀元
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Canada prepares to welcome FIFA World Cup travelers, closely monitoring the African Ebola outbreak | African Ebola outbreak, Canada | Epoch Times
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo-type Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda has caused at least 134 deaths and more than 500 suspected cases, with WHO declaring it a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. An Ontario resident who recently visited East Africa is undergoing Ebola testing; no diagnosis yet. An Air France flight bound for the United States diverted to Montreal on May 20 because a passenger with travel history to the DRC raised public health concerns; the passenger later returned to France. US CBP has restricted entry for non-US passport holders from Uganda, DRC, and Sudan since May 18. Ebola Bundibugyo virus currently has no approved vaccine. Transmission occurs via bodily fluids; incubation 2-21 days; deaths up to 80-90% per CDC. Canada’s overall risk is low; no travel restrictions, but caution advised for Ituri Province.

triage.headline_ja: カナダがFIFAワールドカップ旅客の受け入れ準備、アフリカのエボラ疫情を厳重に監視 | アフリカのエボラ疫情、カナダ | 大紀元
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。コンゴ民主共和国・ウガンダでのエボラ爆発的発生（134人死亡、500人以上の疑い例）はWHOがPHEICを宣言。国際的な感染拡大リスク（カナダでの検査事例、航空機迂回、米国の入境制限）と渡航制限が現実化しており、国際社会での対応が進行中。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでのBundibugyo型エボラウイルスの爆発的発生が主題。対象国リストの確認により、DRC（203312）のみが該当。ウガンダ・スーダン・モザンビークはEBS対象国リストに含まれないため除外。カナダ・米国・フランスでの事例は報告されているが、これらは対象国リストにないため verified_locations から除外。WPRO基準は全5項目に該当し、社会的・政治的関心も極めて高い。WHOのPHEIC宣言により国際的対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Awareness, timely vaccination crucial in Rabies prevention: Experts
article.articleSummary: In Kashmir, Prof M. Saleem Khan warns that eating properly cooked meat from an animal bitten by a rabid dog does not transmit rabies, as the virus is destroyed by heat. However, bites and scratches from infected animals remain dangerous, and individuals handling carcasses should be cautious if they have cuts or abrasions, with prophylactic anti-rabies vaccination advised in such cases. Rabies is almost always fatal once symptoms appear and is transmitted mainly through saliva via bites, scratches, or contact with open wounds or mucous membranes; it is not spread through cooked food, according to health authorities including the WHO. Immediate wound washing with soap and water, followed by timely post-exposure prophylaxis, offers the best protection. With rising stray dog numbers in Kashmir, experts call for sterilisation drives, vaccination of stray animals, and stronger pet vaccination to reduce transmission risk.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病予防における認識啓発とワクチン接種の重要性：専門家の見解
triage.triage_reason: カシミール地域での狂犬病に関する啓発・予防に焦点した記事。現在の流行・アウトブレイク報告ではなく、専門家による予防啓発と情報提供が主題であり、具体的な症例数や発生状況の詳細が不明。
triage.notes: 記事はカシミール地域の狂犬病予防啓発に関する専門家コメント中心であり、アクティブなアウトブレイク報告ではない。野犬の増加に伴う継続的な曝露リスク（prolonged_exposure）と、ヒト-動物感染の可能性（epidemic_prone）が認められるが、現在の発生状況の詳細（症例数、死亡者、発生動向）が不明。続報を注視する段階。

article.articleHeadline: Jelang Idul Adha 2026, Kenali Gejala PMK pada Hewan Kurban
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ahead of Eid al-Adha 2026, Recognize the Symptoms of Foot-and-Mouth Disease in Sacrificial Animals.
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-Mouth Disease (PMK) poses a heightened risk in Indonesia ahead of Eid al-Adha 1447 Hijriah (May 27, 2026). PMK is a viral disease of cloven-hooved livestock, including cattle, buffalo, goats, and sheep, caused by an Aphthovirus. While not easily transmitted to humans, PMK spreads rapidly among animals, causing weight loss and reduced milk production, with substantial economic impact on the national livestock sector. Before purchasing or slaughtering sacrificial animals, buyers should screen for signs such as lethargy and depression, reluctance to eat, fever up to 41°C with shivering, and excessive hypersalivation foaming from the mouth. Early detection and veterinary assessment are crucial to prevent outbreaks during peak trading. The article emphasizes awareness as Eid al-Adha approaches.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年イード・アル=アドハ前夜、犠牲動物のPMK（口蹄疫）症状を認識する
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおける口蹄疫の季節的リスク上昇の報告だが、記事は予防啓発が主体であり、現在の具体的な流行データや患者数は記載されていない。疫学的情報不足のため経過観察対象とする。
triage.notes: 記事は宗教的行事（イード・アル=アドハ）前の口蹄疫症状認識啓発が主体。動物への長期曝露リスクと流行性が認識されるが、現在のアウトブレイク確認報告ではなく予防・警戒情報である。具体的な患者発生数、地域、流行状況の記載がなく、情報不足のため WATCH 判定。

article.articleHeadline: Can Congo's Rare Ebola Outbreak Trigger A Wider Global Health Emergency?
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-22, Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain is driving a rare, rapidly expanding outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) with at least 131 deaths and more than 513 suspected infections, spreading across eastern Congo into Uganda. WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). There are no licensed vaccines or approved therapeutics for Bundibugyo Ebola. Early field tests failed to detect the strain, with regional labs initially testing negative before Kinshasa confirmed Bundibugyo, suggesting months of possible undetected transmission. Healthcare workers are notably affected, raising concerns about hospital-based transmission and infection-control gaps. The epicenter is Ituri province amid conflict and displacement, with insecurity hindering response. Cross-border spread risk is high due to porous borders with Uganda, South Sudan, and Rwanda; Uganda reports cases linked to travel from Congo. Calls for rapid, multi-species Ebola diagnostics are emphasized.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの稀なエボラアウトブレイクが世界的な保健上の緊急事態をもたらす可能性があるか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当し、PHEIC宣言済みのエボラアウトブレイク。131死亡、513感染疑い例、複数国への越境拡大が確認されており、シグナル評価の最高レベルに該当する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、DRCでのBundibugyo Ebola outbreakが主題であり、ウガンダへの越境拡大言及はあるがサマリーの論点はDRCのアウトブレイク自体。ウガンダ、スーダン、ルワンダは対象国リスト外のため除外。WHO PHEIC宣言済み、医療従事者の感染が多数報告され、ワクチン・治療薬なし、越境リスク高い。早急なフルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: 160명으로 늘어난 에볼라 사망자... 시위와 방화는 왜? - 코메디닷컴
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll rises to 160... Why protests and arson? - Komedi.com
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has risen to 160 deaths with about 670 suspected cases since the first suspected case last month, affecting eastern regions and neighboring Uganda. The World Health Organization has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). Protests and violence erupted in Bunia over burial-and-disposal procedures for suspected Ebola deaths, including a fire in an isolation ward used for suspected cases. Ebola causes acute fever and systemic bleeding with a high fatality rate; there are no readily available vaccines or treatments per the report. The outbreak’s regional impact is ongoing, and vaccine deployment is projected to take up to nine months. Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency assesses the domestic risk of importation as low, but has raised a watch level and established a response team as of May 17.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ死者数160人に増加... なぜ抗議デモと放火が？
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。PHEIC宣言済み。複数国での発生確認。
triage.notes: Republic of KoreaはAPI発生地域に含まれるが、サマリーでは韓国は低リスク評価対象であり、主要な感染症イベント発生地ではないため除外した。Uganda（対象国リスト外）での影響も言及されているが、記事主題はDRCでのエボラ流行。PHEIC宣言によるWHO認識済み。

article.articleHeadline: Bundibugyo Ebola vaccines, treatments in development
article.articleSummary: As of 22 May 2026, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo faces an outbreak of Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV). About 600 suspected cases and 139 suspected deaths signal a rising toll, with WHO warning figures will likely increase. BDBV has a fatality rate up to 40%. Unlike the Zaire strain, there are no approved vaccines or treatments for Bundibugyo. A small number of experimental vaccines and therapies are under assessment, while authorities review whether existing Ebola treatments might offer protection; evidence remains limited to animal studies, and most candidates have not been tested in humans, requiring emergency or compassionate-use authorization. Gilead Sciences’ remdesivir has shown laboratory activity against Bundibugyo, with some data suggesting stronger performance than against Zaire, though the company has not commented on potential use. Limited testing capacity has slowed response efforts; several tools are in use.

triage.headline_ja: ブンディブギョ・エボラ：ワクチンと治療薬の開発進行中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。DRCにおけるエボラアウトブレイク（疑い症例600件、疑い死亡139件）は深刻な公衆衛生上の影響を有し、予防措置の不十分さと高い致死率（40%）により国際的拡大リスクと渡航・貿易制限リスクが存在する。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス（BDBV）はザイール型と異なり承認されたワクチンと治療法が存在しない点が重要。記事サマリーに基づき、発生地域はDRC東部で確認。WHO警告により症例数増加が予想される。限定的な検査能力が対応を遅延させている。

article.articleHeadline: India postpones India-Africa Forum Summit and Big Cat Alliance Summit amid Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Due to the evolving health situation in parts of Africa amid an Ebola outbreak, India has postponed the fourth India-Africa Forum Summit (IAFS-IV), originally set for May 28–31 in New Delhi, and the inaugural International Big Cat Alliance (IBCA) Summit planned for June 1 in New Delhi. African nations have reported Ebola virus cases, with the most recent infections in the South Kivu province of the Democratic Republic of Congo. After consultations with the Chairperson of the African Union and the African Union Commission, officials deferred both summits to later dates to ensure broader and more meaningful participation from Africa and other stakeholders; no new schedule has been announced. The IAFS serves as a platform for India-Africa diplomatic and developmental dialogue, while IBCA focuses on wildlife conservation and biodiversity across participating countries.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行を受け、インドがインド・アフリカフォーラムサミットとビッグキャットアライアンスサミットを延期
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の発生は深刻だが、本記事はインドの外交行事の延期決定が主題であり、感染症イベント自体の新規情報や拡大リスク、公衆衛生対応の詳細は限定的。DRC南キブ州での発生確認は既知情報と考えられる。
triage.notes: 記事はインド政府の外交イベント延期決定が主題であり、エボラ出血熱の流行そのもの（特にDRC南キブ州での発生）は背景情報として扱われている。インドでの感染は言及されていない。Bluedot APIが New Delhi と Republic of India を位置付けているのは、延期されたサミット開催予定地であり、発生地域ではない。したがって verified_locations には DRC のみを含める。既知の流行に対する政治的対応の報道であることからWATCHレベルの評価とした。

article.articleHeadline: എബോള: മരണം ഉയരുന്നു
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Death toll rising
article.articleSummary: As of May 22, 2026, Ebola deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda have climbed to 139, with more than 680 cases confirmed. The outbreak involves the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, a virulent form for which there is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. Containment zones in Congo have been breached, enabling the virus to spread beyond initial areas. The outbreak originated in mid-April in eastern Congo’s Ituri Province and has since reached Uganda. The report highlights ongoing transmission and the absence of targeted medical countermeasures for this variant, underscoring the need for intensified cross-border surveillance and rapid response to curb further spread.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：死者数が増加中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。確定症例680件以上、死者139人、複数国（DRC・ウガンダ）への国際的拡大、封じ込めゾーン突破、ワクチン・治療法なしのBundibugyo株。公衆衛生への深刻な脅威。
triage.notes: Uganda はWPRO対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCのみ該当。4月中旬からIturi州で発生し、ウガンダへ拡大した多国境流行。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株（ワクチン・特異的治療なし）、高い致命率、封じ込めゾーン突破のリスク。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Incendian dos carpas hospitalarias donde eran tratados pacientes de ébola en la zona más castigada por el brote en la República Democrática del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two hospital tents where Ebola patients were being treated were set on fire in the hardest-hit area of the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Two Ebola treatment tents at Rwampara Hospital in Ituri province’s northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo were set on fire, worsening conditions in one of the outbreak’s hardest-hit areas. The ALIMA NGO reported six patients were being treated in those tents and are now all under hospital care. The incident raises life-risk concerns and the destruction of essential medical equipment as response teams stay mobilized in close coordination with authorities and partners to limit the outbreak’s impact. Earlier the same day, a patient suspected of Ebola died after presenting at Rwampara Hospital, with his family attempting to retrieve the body while staff tried to deter them. The outbreak has reached about 500 cases and more than 130 suspected deaths in the DRC, with Mongbwalu and Rwampara in Ituri; Bunia and Nyakunde also affected, along with Butembo and Goma in North Kivu.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ患者が治療されていた野戦病院の2つのテントが放火される
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の継続的な流行（約500症例、130名超の死亡疑い）に加え、医療施設の破壊という異常事象が発生。IHR基準で「深刻な公衆衛生影響」「予想外の事象」「国際的拡大リスク」が該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも「重症度」「長期曝露」「流行しやすさ」が明確。フルRRAに進むべきシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC（イトゥリ州・北キブ州）でのエボラ流行を主題としている。ルワンダ（Kigali Province）は発生地域フィールドに含まれているがサマリーでは言及されていないため除外。医療施設への攻撃は対応能力を著しく低下させ、リスク増幅要因となる。

article.articleHeadline: अफ्रीका में इबोला के कहर के चलते स्थगित हुआ चौथा भारत-अफ्रीका शिखर सम्मेलन
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fourth India-Africa Summit postponed due to Ebola outbreak in Africa.
article.articleSummary: Fourth India-Africa Summit postponed due to Ebola outbreak in Africa. As of 22 May 2026, a dangerous Ebola virus strain is wreaking havoc across the African continent, with Congo reporting worsening conditions. The World Health Organization recently declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. To ensure African leaders' full participation amid rising health risks, the India-Africa summit scheduled for 28-31 May has been postponed following a joint press release by the African Union chair and commission with the Indian government. The postponement echoes the 2014-2015 disruption when Ebola necessitated delays before the event could proceed. India commits solidarity and readiness to contribute to Africa CDC-led responses; India has stepped up Ebola screening at airports and issued health advisories. The talks on enhanced development assistance, including a concessional $10 billion line of credit, as in 2015, were to be discussed, but dates will be fixed later.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカのエボラ流行により第4回インド・アフリカ首脳会談が延期
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスがアフリカ大陸で流行し、WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言。IHR基準3つ（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）を満たし、国際イベント延期による社会的政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はアフリカ大陸全体でのエボラ流行を報道しており、DRCが「悪化する状況」と記載。インドはスクリーニング強化等の対応を実施中。WHOによるPHEIC宣言は国際的対応の必要性を裏付ける。Bluedot APIが付与した3地域（Africa大陸、DRC、India）のうち、実際のイベント発生地はDRCおよびアフリカであり、インドは対応地域として検証。

article.articleHeadline: คุมเข้มคัดกรองผู้เดินทางจาก 'คองโก-ยูกันดา' สกัด 'อีโบลา' ระบาดไทย
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tighten screening of travelers from Congo-Uganda to curb the Ebola outbreak in Thailand
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo and the Republic of Uganda are designated as Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) risk areas, effective 21 May 2026, as WHO labels the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). Thailand tightens traveler screening from these zones to curb cross-border spread. The Ministry of Public Health, via the Department of Disease Control, requires pre-registration for arrivals: foreigners use the Thailand Digital Arrival Card (TDAC) and Thais use the Thai Health Pass, with fever checks, exposure history, and 21-day post-arrival monitoring. The Civil Aviation Authority of Thailand (CAAT) coordinates with MOH, airlines, and other agencies, emphasizing three pillars: predeparture information and registration, at-entry screening, and post-arrival surveillance, including drills for onboard and post-landing cases. Officials stress preparedness and urge the public to follow health guidance and not panic.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ・ウガンダからの渡航者の厳格なスクリーニングでタイでのエボラアウトブレイクを抑制
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）。WHOがPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）として認定したエボラウイルス病の国境超過事例であり、複数国にまたがる懸念される流行。
triage.notes: 記事は DRC・ウガンダにおけるエボラアウトブレイク（WHO PHEIC認定）を背景として、タイが国境スクリーニングを強化している状況を報じている。ウガンダ（対象国リストに含まれない）は発生地域として挙げられているが、記事の主題はDRCからタイへの流入防止が中心であるため、verified_locations はDRCとタイのみとした。エボラは致死率が高く、複数国間での流行拡大リスクが顕著なため、全てのWPRO基準に該当する。

article.articleHeadline: รัฐบาลยกระดับคัดกรองผู้เดินทางจากพื้นที่เสี่ยง "อีโบลา"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The government intensifies screening of travelers from Ebola-risk areas.
article.articleSummary: Thailand designates overseas areas affected by Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) — the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda — as danger zones, effective May 21, 2026, following WHO’s Public Health Emergency of International Concern declaration. The government tightens entry screening for travelers from risk areas: foreigners must pre-register via the Thailand Digital Arrival Card (TDAC); Thais use the Thai Health Pass. Entrants will undergo fever checks, exposure-history interviews, and symptom screening, with 21-day follow-up monitoring. The Civil Aviation Authority of Thailand (CAAT) coordinates with the Ministry of Public Health, airlines, and related agencies to enhance aviation health measures in three areas: pre-travel public information for passengers; screening at origin; and verification of registration and symptom assessment on arrival. Plans are rehearsed for suspected cases on board or after arrival to ensure rapid, effective management. The government urges the public to follow official health guidance and not panic.

triage.headline_ja: タイ政府、エボラ出血熱のリスク地域からの渡航者スクリーニングを強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当し、WHOの国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）宣言と連動した多国間の対応体制が確認された。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（EVD）の西アフリカでの発生拡大を受け、WHO がPHEIC宣言を発出。タイは DRC およびウガンダをリスク地域に指定し、公式な出入国管理・検疫体制を強化。Uganda は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。複数国にまたがる同時的な公衆衛生対応であり、フルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）へ進めることが適切。

article.articleHeadline: സംസ്‌കരിക്കാന്‍ മൃതദേഹം വിട്ടുനല്‍കിയില്ല, തര്‍ക്കത്തിന് പിന്നാലെ എബോള ചികിത്സാ കേന്ദ്രത്തിന് തീയിട്ട് ജനക്കൂട്ടം
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The body was not handed over for cremation; following the dispute, a mob set fire to an Ebola treatment center.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of Congo, centered on Ramppar town. A dispute over handing over the body of a person suspected to have Ebola—a local footballer—sparked a crowd to storm an Ebola treatment center on Thursday. The mob damaged facilities, set tents ablaze, and attacked equipment, while police used tear gas and fired into the air to restore order. The incident occurred despite strict funeral safety rules designed to prevent transmission from deceased Ebola patients. Six patients under treatment were safely moved to another hospital. The footballer’s body had not been released for cremation, fueling the unrest. No confirmed casualty reports are stated in the article; authorities are investigating, and security measures around Ebola treatment facilities remain in place.

triage.headline_ja: 遺体が火葬のため引き渡されず、紛争後に群衆がエボラ治療センターに放火
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の発生地域における治療施設への攻撃は、感染症対応の大幅な阻害要因となり、IHR基準の「深刻な公衆衛生への影響」「異常/予想外」に該当。WPRO基準でも「異常性」「長期曝露リスク」「管理可能性」が顕著。
triage.notes: イトゥリ州ランパル町でのエボラ治療施設への市民によるアクセス阻害。疑似患者の遺体処理をめぐる地域社会との対立が根本原因。6名の患者は別施設に無事移送されたが、同様の市民不安が今後の感染症対応能力に影響するリスクが高い。セキュリティと地域信頼構築が喫緊の課題。

article.articleHeadline: Những yếu tố khiến dịch Ebola liên tục bùng phát tại Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The factors behind the ongoing Ebola outbreak in Congo
article.articleSummary: An ongoing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is centered in Ituri province with index cases in Bunia, Mongwalu, and Rwampara. The Bundibugyo strain, a rare Ebola variant, drives the outbreak, for which there is no licensed vaccine or approved therapy. After a first health-worker case on 24 April and a death in Bunia, WHO confirmed Bundibugyo as the cause on 15 May. The outbreak has surpassed 100 deaths, with WHO reporting about 600 suspected cases and 139 deaths. It has spilled over to Uganda, with two laboratory-confirmed cases and a Kampala death; all patients had traveled from Congo. Transmission stems from wildlife exposure (bushmeat) and human-to-human contact, compounded by traditional funeral rites and misinformation. The region’s vast forests and socio-economic pressures hinder control. The U.S. has imposed travel restrictions; a U.S. citizen infected in Congo was treated in Germany.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ流行の継続を引き起こす要因
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。稀なBundibugyo株による流行で100超の死亡、600件の疑い例、ウガンダへの越境感染、米国の渡航制限と国際的な影響が確認されている。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが列挙した地域のうち、ウガンダ(Uganda, Kampala)も確認例があるが、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。記事の主題はコンゴでの流行。ワクチンなし・治療法なしの稀なBundibugyo株による重大な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Bohaterska misja sześciu zakonnic w obliczu epidemii eboli
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The heroic mission of six nuns in the face of the Ebola epidemic.
article.articleSummary: Six nursing and missionary nuns who died in 1995 after contracting Ebola are commemorated for staying at patients’ beds to the end; Pope Francis declared them venerable in 2021, with their canonization process ongoing. Ebola remains one of Africa’s most dangerous epidemic threats. On 19 May 2026, the WHO Director-General warned about the scale and speed of an Ebola outbreak affecting the Democratic Republic of Congo. As of that date, 131 deaths had been reported and 513 suspected cases. Across Africa, over the past 50 years, Ebola-related hemorrhagic fever has claimed more than 15,000 lives. The report underscores ongoing risk and the need for vigilance in affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行に直面した6人の修道女の英雄的な使命
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、貿易制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準で5つ全て該当。2026年5月19日時点でDRC内でエボラ疑い患者513名・死亡131名が報告されており、現在進行形のアウトブレイク。
triage.notes: 記事は歴史的背景（1995年の修道女らの殉職）とともに、現在進行形の2026年5月19日のDRCエボラアウトブレイクを報告している。WHOトップが警告を発出し、疑い患者数・死亡数が明記されている。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Με ταχύ ρυθμό εξαπλώνεται ο Έμπολα στο Κονγκό - 671 ύποπτα κρούσματα και 160 θάνατοι
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is spreading rapidly in Congo - 671 suspected cases and 160 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola is spreading rapidly in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), with 671 suspected cases and 160 deaths attributed to Ebola, per the Ministry of Health. Of these, 64 infections and 6 deaths have been laboratory-confirmed. The World Health Organization had previously logged about 600 suspected cases and 130 deaths, cautioning that actual numbers may be higher due to underreporting. The outbreak centers in Ituri province in northeastern DRC, near Uganda and South Sudan, and began about two months ago. It is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC since 1976 and is linked to the rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, which currently lacks vaccines or specific therapies, hindering containment. Ebola spreads through close contact and bodily fluids. Uganda reports two Congolese nationals affected (one died; the other tested negative recently and remains under treatment). Past large outbreaks include over 11,000 deaths during the 2014-2015 West Africa epidemic.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴで急速に拡大 - 671人の疑い例と160人の死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirus系統によるエボラ流行で、DRCを中心に671疑い例・160死亡、ウガンダへの越境感染確認、対象国外への拡大リスク高く、国際的公衆衛生脅威と判定される。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドにはUganda、Sudan、Angolaが含まれるが、記事サマリーではDRCのIturi州が主要な発生地で、ウガンダには越境感染の報告（コンゴ国籍者2人）があるのみ。対象国リストではDRC(203312)のみ該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirus系統は稀で、ワクチンや特異的治療法がないため管理困難との記述から manageability は Yes と判定。

article.sourceUrl: https://www.hk01.com/社會新聞/60352452/伊波拉病毒-專家指依賴旅客主動申報非百分百可靠-倡主動監察
article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉病毒｜專家指依賴旅客主動申報非百分百可靠　倡主動監察
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus — Experts say relying on travelers to self-report is not 100% reliable; call for proactive surveillance.
article.articleSummary: May 22, 2026 — The Democratic Republic of the Congo reports an Ebola outbreak with indications of further spread, prompting a red outbound travel alert in Hong Kong. Liu Yulong, chair of the Science Committee on Infectious Diseases, cautions that self-reporting by travelers is not 100% reliable and advocates proactive surveillance. War-induced displacement has shifted transmission toward the DRC's northeastern region; Hong Kong prevention should distinguish travelers from that area, as other regions pose lower risk. Two groups may travel to Hong Kong: financially capable multinational businesspeople and medical personnel, who could use Hong Kong as a transit hub; cases include an American patient who was infected and treated in Germany. No vaccine or therapy exists for Bundibugyo ebolavirus; traditional public health measures remain essential. While current public health staffing is adequate, interception requires active daily checks of travelers from outbreak areas—every 24 hours, asking about their health.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス｜専門家は旅客の自主申告が100%信頼できないと指摘、積極的な監視を提唱
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラアウトブレイクが報告され、香港への赤色渡航警告が発令されており、複数のIHR基準を満たす。国際的な拡大リスクが明確であり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: DRCにおけるエボラアウトブレイク報告を主題としており、香港（China に含める）への赤色渡航警告発令により国際的な関心が高まっている。アメリカやドイツは二次的な文脈（患者の治療地）であり、実際のアウトブレイク発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Una multitud enfurecida prende fuego a tiendas de campaña de un hospital para tratar el ébola en República Democrática del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An enraged mob sets fire to a hospital's tents to treat Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: An enraged mob set fire to tents at Rwampara General Hospital in Ituri, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, the outbreak’s epicenter. Medical staff received military protection as police restored order after relatives of a young man who reportedly died from Ebola were blocked from taking his body for burial. A health worker was injured; six patients were being treated in the tents, with others possibly fleeing amid chaos. WHO advises safe, dignified burials with PPE. As of Thursday, the outbreak had caused more than 130 deaths in the DRC among about 600 suspected cases; WHO cited 139 deaths, while the Congolese health minister counted 159. Two Ebola cases were detected in Uganda, and border restrictions were imposed. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which no vaccine exists yet and development could take up to nine months. The M23 rebels confirmed a first Ebola case in South Kivu.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ治療病院のテントが暴徒によって放火される
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認事例（DRCで130～159例、ウガンダで2例）があり、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダでの検出、国境制限実施）と社会不安（医療施設への暴動）の両方が存在。IHR基準3項目該当。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも2事例が検出されているが、記事の主題イベントはDRCのIturi州Rwampara General Hospitalでの暴動であり、実質的な患者数・死亡数の大部分はDRCに限定。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ワクチン未開発）による急速な拡大可能性と医療システムの機能障害リスクが高い。WHO、各国保健当局の対応継続中。

article.articleHeadline: Princesa tailandesa em coma há 3 anos tem nova piora grave, infecção abdominal incontrolável assusta o palácio e transforma a sucessão real em um enorme ponto de interrogação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Thai princess in a coma for 3 years has a new severe deterioration, uncontrollable abdominal infection alarms the palace and turns the royal succession into a huge question mark.
article.articleSummary: Thailand's Princess Bajrakitiyabha Mahidol, eldest daughter of King Maha Vajiralongkorn, has been in a coma since December 2022 after a collapse during military dog-training in Pak Chong district, Thailand. In the latest palace bulletin, doctors report an uncontrollable abdominal infection that has spread to multiple organs, treated at the Chulalongkorn Red Cross Hospital. The princess's general condition remains deteriorating, with unstable vital signs, critically low blood pressure, severe cardiac arrhythmias, and abnormal coagulation. She remains on advanced life support, with machines sustaining lung and kidney functions as clinicians monitor the infection's progression. An August 2025 update noted a grave bloodstream infection. The health crisis renews speculation about the Thai royal succession, with attention on potential heirs such as Prince Dipangkorn Rasmijoti (21).

triage.headline_ja: タイの王女が3年間の昏睡状態から新たな悪化、制御不可能な腹部感染症が王宮を懸念させ、王位継承を大きな不確定要因に転換
triage.triage_reason: 個人の医学的事例であり、公衆衛生危機ではない。感染症の集団発生や流行の兆候がなく、IHR基準およびWPRO基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 本報告は一個人（タイ王女）の医学的事例に関するもので、感染症の公衆衛生的な集団発生や流行ではない。王族の健康問題として政治的関心は存在するが、シグナル検出の対象外である。

article.articleHeadline: Bé trai 13 tuổi mắc zona thần kinh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 13-year-old boy contracts herpes zoster.
article.articleSummary: As of May 22, 2026, Hanoi, Vietnam: a 13-year-old boy named Đức developed herpes zoster (shingles) with red papules that progressed to vesicular clusters and itching on the torso, following chickenpox at age three. Risk factors include reduced immunity, stress, chronic illness, or immunosuppressive therapy; early chickenpox or fetal exposure also increase risk. He was treated as an outpatient with antiviral therapy, analgesics, antihistamines, and local care; after five days, lesions crusted and itching markedly improved. In the community, herpes zoster incidence is about 3–5 cases per 1,000 people per year, mainly in older adults; in children the rate is 4–7 times lower. Shingles results from reactivation of varicella-zoster virus in dorsal root ganglia after dormancy. Symptoms begin with burning pain or paresthesias before a dermatomal rash. Clinicians advise varicella vaccination, proper nutrition, sleep, activity, and avoiding contact with those with active chickenpox or shingles.

triage.headline_ja: 13歳の男の子が帯状疱疹を発症
triage.triage_reason: 帯状疱疹は予防可能な既知疾患であり、単一症例の報告で重症度も軽微。IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準いずれも該当せず、社会的関心も低い。
triage.notes: 帯状疱疹は成人患者の報告に対しては多くの国で日常的な臨床診断。本記事は小児患者の個別症例であり、疾病サーベイランス上の異常を示さない。既知の医学的管理で良好に転帰している。

article.articleHeadline: Video: ÉBOLA: ¿QUÉ TAN PELIGROSO ES EL VIRUS QUE YA DEJA MÁS DE 1OO MUERTOS? I RADAR24 por Diario Gestión
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Video: EBOLA: How dangerous is the virus that has already claimed more than 100 lives? I RADAR24 by Diario Gestión.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Africa has claimed more than 100 lives, prompting heightened global concern. In Uganda, protests turn violent as crowds attempt to storm a hospital to reclaim bodies of Ebola victims, signaling intense fear and demand for containment. A flight was diverted to the United States amid an Ebola alert, and a medical professional was isolated after lethal exposure, illustrating ongoing transmission risk. The World Health Organization warns of a deadly spread, prompting several cross-border responses: the United States tightens border controls, and Mexico activates an epidemic-risk alert for Ebola and Hantavirus. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ebola pressures lead to the cancellation of World Cup preparations. The discussion includes expert input from an immunologist, and underscores evolving international public health vigilance around imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: ビデオ：エボラ：既に100人以上の死亡者を出しているウイルスはどれほど危険か？ I RADAR24（ディアリオ・ヘスティオン紙）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラ出血熱の多数死亡例（100人以上）、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施という極めて深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威が認識される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにおいて、エボラ出血熱の発生地はアフリカ、ウガンダ、DRCと記述されている。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。ウガンダ、米国、メキシコは発生地域に含まれるが、サマリー上では対象国リストに該当しないため verified_locations から除外。エボラは最優先度の感染症であり、100人以上の死亡、国際的対応の発動、複数国での国境管理強化が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: എബോള വൈറസ് ബാധ ഭീതി, ഇന്ത്യ-ആഫ്രിക്ക ഉച്ചകോടി മാറ്റിവെച്ചു
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fear of Ebola virus infection, India-Africa summit postponed.
article.articleSummary: As of May 22, 2026, Ebola is spreading in West Africa, raising health security concerns. A highly dangerous new Ebola variant is reported by the World Health Organization in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan, with the agency declaring a global health emergency. In response, India postponed the India–Africa Summit slated for Delhi after discussions with the African Union, citing potential virus transmission and broader health-security challenges with leaders and delegates from more than 50 African nations. Travel restrictions and airport screenings have been tightened in India, and the Foreign Ministry issued guidelines to protect Indian nationals abroad. Officials said diplomatic talks with the AU and other channels will continue, and the summit will be rescheduled once conditions stabilize, in line with WHO guidance.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス感染の懸念、インド・アフリカサミット延期
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、新型変異株で異常、西アフリカ発生で国際拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。WHOによる全球的健康上の危機宣言があり、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから実際のエボラ発生地はDRC・ウガンダ・南スーダンであり、インドはイベント地ではなく影響を受けた国（サミット延期）と判断。Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはスーダン・アンゴラ・ウガンダが含まれるが、対象国リストに無いため除外。インドは対象国リストに含まれ、記事の主題国であるため included。DRCは明記され対象国リストに含まれるため included。2026年5月の架空日付だが、評価内容は有効。WHO全球健康上の危機宣言による国際的な影響の大きさが顕著。

article.articleHeadline: الأمم المتحدة تتدخل لاحتواء تفشي إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United Nations intervenes to contain an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of May 22, 2026, Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo persist, with Ituri province identified as the main hotspot and Bunia city a key focus. The United Nations says the peacekeeping mission is backing government efforts to contain the rapid spread amid a deteriorating humanitarian situation and ongoing security challenges. There are concerns about spread to North Kivu after infections were confirmed in Goma, Butembo, and Katwa. The UN is providing logistical support to move supplies and equipment to affected areas, including more than 4,600 kilograms of medical supplies transported from Nairobi, and deploying aircraft and vehicles to support medical evacuation and contact tracing. Response operations are hampered by displacement, insecurity, and restricted humanitarian access, further complicating control measures.

triage.headline_ja: 国連がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行の抑制に介入
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病は高い致死率を伴う予想外の流行であり、複数州での拡大、国際的対応の展開、渡航制限リスクを示す。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（Ituri州、North Kivu州）での現在進行中のエボラ流行に焦点。Nairobiは国連支援物資の輸送地点として言及されているが、発生地ではない。複数州での確認感染、人道危機の悪化、セキュリティ制約により対応が複雑化している。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola spreads silently through Congo's mines and conflict-hit regions
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri and North Kivu) driven by the Bundibugyo strain. WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern (PHEIC) due to lack of approved vaccine or treatment, and transmission in a conflict‑affected, poorly equipped region with high mobility. At Nyankunde Hospital, initial erroneous testing delayed detection; within weeks there were 25 suspected cases, four deaths, staff illnesses including an American surgeon treated in Germany, and the hospital lacking isolation facilities and PPE. By May 20, 2026, Congo reported 671 suspected cases and 160 suspected deaths across Ituri and North Kivu, including 64 laboratory-confirmed infections. About half the cases and deaths are from Mongbwalu, a mining town 111 km from Nyankunde. Possible sources include bush meat and wildlife; bats in old gold mines are noted as reservoirs. The outbreak highlights ongoing risk in Congo’s miner regions amid conflict and weak surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴの鉱山と紛争地域を静かに広がる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO によるPHEIC宣言、国際的な患者移送実績、160人の疑い死者を含む大規模発生。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo strain by Ituri/North Kivu. WHO PHEIC declared. 671 suspected cases, 160 suspected deaths, 64 lab-confirmed. International patient transfer (American surgeon to Germany) confirms cross-border spread risk. Conflict-affected region with weak health infrastructure and high mobility increases uncontrollable transmission risk. Gold mining areas with bat reservoirs pose sustained zoonotic source.

article.articleHeadline: "Θερίζει" ο Έμπολα τη ΛΔ Κονγκό: 160 νεκροί και 671 ύποπτα κρούσματα - iefimerida.gr
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola ravages DR Congo: 160 dead and 671 suspected cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri province) has 671 suspected cases and 160 deaths reported so far; 64 infections and six deaths confirmed by laboratory tests. WHO had previously logged about 600 suspected cases and 130 deaths attributed to Ebola, noting underreporting likely undercounts. In neighboring Uganda, two nationals from the DRC have been involved; one died, the other tested negative two days ago and remains under treatment. African CDC says current outbreak began in Ituri, NE near Uganda and South Sudan, about two months ago; this is the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC since 1976. The outbreak is linked to the rare Bundibugyo strain, for which there are no vaccines or specific therapies, complicating containment. Ebola spreads via close contact with infected individuals or their bodily fluids. By comparison, the 2014-2015 West Africa epidemic killed over 11,000. As of May 22, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴ民主共和国を襲う：160人の死亡と671人の疑い患者
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。稀有なBundibugyo株による大規模アウトブレイク（160死亡、671疑い患者）であり、ワクチン未開発のため高リスク。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はDRC（Ituri州）のエボラアウトブレイクであり、DRCが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。隣国ウガンダへの波及（2人のDRC国民が感染、1人死亡）も言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに未含有のため除外。稀有なBundibugyo株でワクチン・特異的治療法がない点、過去最大規模の2014-2015西アフリカエボラ流行（11,000以上死亡）との比較により、国際的懸念の高さが強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: 민주콩고 에볼라 확산...사망자 장례 통제에 병원 '방화'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spreads in the Democratic Republic of the Congo... hospital arson over funeral restrictions for the deceased.
article.articleSummary: Ebola reemerges in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with Ituri Province’s Lwampara area identified as a hotspot as authorities enforce strict safe-burial procedures amid transmission. A locally classified suspected Ebola patient, a former footballer, died in Ituri; relatives demanded the body, claiming typhoid, leading to clashes, police warning shots, and arson of Ebola-treatment tents and hospital facilities. Ebola transmission occurs via contact with infected blood, bodily fluids, and contaminated objects, underpinning funeral restrictions to reduce risk. The DRC health ministry reported 670 suspected Ebola cases and 160 related deaths as of May 21, 2026. Uganda announced a temporary suspension of flights to/from DR Congo to block cross-border introductions. The situation underscores ongoing spread within eastern DRC and cross-border concerns.

triage.headline_ja: 民主コンゴでエボラ拡散...故人の葬儀規制を巡る病院への放火
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、国際的移動制限実施）。WPRO基準5つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱の再出現で死亡者160名、670疑い患者、国境を越えた感染懸念あり。ウガンダが渡航制限を実施済み。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱はIHR(2005)の指定感染症。2026年5月時点でDRC東部で670疑い患者、160死亡が報告。葬儀慣行と感染制御の葛藤が社会的紛争（放火事件）を誘発。ウガンダが既に渡航制限を実施し、国際的懸念が高まっている。記事ではウガンダも言及されているが、主要イベント発生地はDRCであり、ウガンダは予防的措置段階と判断。

article.articleHeadline: 정부, 에볼라 확산 민주콩고 여행금지 지역 확대 | 연합뉴스
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Government expands travel-ban areas in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as Ebola spreads.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo led to a government Level 4 travel alert as of 2:00 PM on May 22, 2026. Travel-ban areas now cover North Kivu, South Kivu, and Ituri Provinces, expanding to three regions due to increasing Ebola deaths in Ituri. Traveling to or remaining in these areas without special passport authorization is punishable under passport-law provisions. The escalation reflects efforts to curb transmission in eastern DRC. The article does not provide case counts or laboratory confirmation details, and there is no mention of border import/export cases; authorities advise adherence to the travel restrictions and ongoing monitoring of the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 政府、エボラ感染拡大でコンゴ民主共和国の渡航禁止地域を拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス病はコンゴ民主共和国で拡大し、政府が渡航禁止レベル4を発令し複数州をカバーしており、国際的脅威と渡航制限が明示されている。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は高い致死率と感染力を持つ出血熱。コンゴ民主共和国東部（North Kivu、South Kivu、Ituri州）での拡大と政府による渡航禁止措置の拡大は、国内制御困難および地域的脅威を示唆している。症例数や検査確認の詳細は記事に記載されていないが、政府の厳格な対応レベルから深刻性が推定される。

article.articleHeadline: เข้ม! 3 มาตรการเฝ้าระวัง 'อีโบลา' คนเดินทางจากพื้นที่เสี่ยง
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tighten Up! 3 Ebola Surveillance Measures for Travelers from High-Risk Areas.
article.articleSummary: Royal Gazette (May 20, 2026) designates Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda as Ebola Virus Disease high-risk areas, with measures effective May 21, 2026. Following WHO's declaration of a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), Thailand tightens border surveillance for travelers from outbreak zones. The Ministry of Public Health, via the Department of Disease Control, steps up screening at international entry points: travelers from affected areas must pre-register. Foreign nationals use Thailand Digital Arrival Card (TDAC); Thai citizens use the Thai Health Pass (thaihealthpass.com). Screening includes symptom checks, fever assessment, and collection of travel history, with 21-day post-arrival monitoring to detect potential infection and prevent cross-border spread.

triage.headline_ja: 強化！高リスク地域からの旅行者向けエボラ出血熱の3つの監視措置
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当し、WHOによるPHEIC宣言後のタイにおける国境監視強化という国際的対応がなされており、シグナルとして優先度が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCおよびウガンダでのエボラ流行に対するタイの国境対応について述べており、DRCとタイの2国が検証対象。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。WHO PHEIC宣言後の公衆衛生対応であり、IHR基準およびWPRO基準の両方で最高段階の懸念レベルを示している。

article.articleHeadline: Κονγκό: Αυξάνεται με ταχύ ρυθμό ο αριθμός των μολύνσεων ατόμων από τον ιό Έμπολα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: The number of people infected with the Ebola virus is rising rapidly.
article.articleSummary: As of May 22, 2026, Ebola Virus Disease outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo are accelerating, with authorities reporting 671 suspected infections and 160 deaths to date. The Ministry of Health notes 64 infections and six deaths have been laboratory-confirmed as Ebola. The World Health Organization cautions that the true caseload is likely much higher due to underreporting. This marks the 17th documented Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo since the virus was first identified in 1976. The outbreak is attributed to a rare Ebola strain for which there are neither vaccines nor specific treatments, complicating containment efforts. Ebola is highly transmissible, spreading through close contact with symptomatic individuals or their bodily fluids. Urgent public health measures are essential to slow transmission and identify cases, with ongoing laboratory confirmation guiding response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラウイルスの感染者数が急速に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当、WPRO基準5つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク、高い致命率、人間-人間感染、治療法なし、国際拡大リスク。フルRRA進行を要する。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の第17回目の公式記録されたアウトブレイク。ワクチンなし、治療法なしの稀な株。現在の感染確認数64例、死亡6例だが、過少報告の可能性。WHO警告あり。致命率約24%（160死亡/671疑い例）。ヒト-ヒト感染が主な伝播経路。コンゴ民主共和国はエボラの常在地域だが、本アウトブレイクは加速度的に拡大中。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola risk remains low in the U.S., Illinois
article.articleSummary: Ebola risk remains low in the United States and Illinois, with no confirmed U.S. Ebola cases linked to current outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. Outbreak areas are remote. The CDC has rolled out enhanced measures: airport screenings, traveler monitoring, contact tracing, and increased hospital preparation. In Illinois, Rush University Medical Center and Lurie Children's Hospital are designated elite special pathogen treatment centers, with enhanced training and protocols to safely treat high-risk infections like Ebola. Health officials say exposure is highly unlikely; however, individuals who traveled to DRC, Uganda, or Sudan within the last 21 days may have been exposed. Casual contact does not spread Ebola. The risk to locals remains low; authorities emphasize no cause for alarm absent travel exposure or direct link to an outbreak area.

triage.headline_ja: 米国およびイリノイ州のエボラリスク、依然として低い
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の複数国での発生報告があり国際的な拡大リスクが存在するため、経過観察が必要。ただし米国での確認事例がなく、公式には低リスク評価とされているため、現段階ではフルRRAへの優先度は中程度。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにはコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダが含まれているが、対象国リストではコンゴ民主共和国(203312)のみが該当する。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。記事では複数国でのエボラ発生が報告されているが、米国での確認事例がなく、当局による「低リスク」評価が明示されている点から、現時点ではWATCH判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Biotech Stock Gainers: CODX Extends Rally, SBFM Surges, GOVX Ebola Strategy, RGNX Awaits Catalysts
article.articleSummary: Co-Diagnostics Inc. (CODX) extended its rally, rising 55% to $3.71 on May 22, 2026, after reporting completion of its assay development strategy for Bundibugyo virus (BDBV), linked to an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. Akari Therapeutics (AKTX) climbed ~50% on breakthrough preclinical data showing AKTX-101 synergizing with KRAS inhibitor Adagrasib in KRAS-mutant pancreatic cancer models; IND-enabling studies are underway with Phase 1 expected by mid-2027. Sunshine Biopharma (SBFM) jumped ~40% following Canadian approval of a generic Amoxicillin formulation, with shipments to pharmacies planned for August 2026. GeoVax Labs (GOVX) rose ~23% amid Ebola outbreak concerns, and its MVA-based vaccines target filoviruses; GEO-MVA for mpox/smallpox is expected to enter a Phase 3 in Q4 2026. Other tickers like CRBP and PLYX also advanced.

triage.headline_ja: バイオテク株上昇銘柄：CODX上昇継続、SBFM急騰、GOVX エボラ戦略、RGNX 触媒待ち
triage.triage_reason: 記事は複数のバイオテック企業の株価変動を報じる市場ニュースであり、感染症イベント自体の詳細な疫学情報や公衆衛生上の影響を扱っていない。Bundibugyo virus関連の製品開発進展が言及されているものの、発生地域の詳細、感染者数、死亡例、管理状況などの重要な疫学的情報が記事に含まれていない。
triage.notes: 本記事は金融・株式市場ニュースであり、Bundibugyo virus、Ebola、Mpox、Smallpoxが言及されているが、実際の感染症イベントの疫学的詳細（患者数、死亡数、発生状況など）が記載されていない。バイオテック企業の製品開発やワクチン開発計画に焦点が当てられている。感染症関連シグナルとしては情報不足。Uganda は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Congo: Centru de tratament pentru Ebola, incendiat de localnici, pe fondul creşterii nemulţumirii faţă de epidemie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: Ebola treatment center set on fire by locals amid rising discontent over the Ebola epidemic.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo intensifies as a treatment center in Rwampara, Ituri Province, was set on fire by locals angered after being barred from retrieving the body of a man who apparently died of Ebola. The incident underscores tensions between strict burial protocols and local customs, with authorities stressing that all corpses of suspected Ebola victims must be buried according to regulations. The WHO notes the outbreak is almost certainly larger than official counts, while the country reports 160 suspected deaths and 671 suspected cases across two provinces; neighboring Uganda reported two cases including a death. Ituri borders Uganda and South Sudan, raising regional concern. Over 920,000 people are internally displaced in Ituri. There is no vaccine or treatment for the Bundibugyo strain currently available, with experts estimating six to nine months until vaccines emerge. Humanitarian staff request more supplies and personnel amid ongoing conflict, including attacks by rebels in the region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：エボラ流行に対する地元住民の不満の高まりの中で、エボラ治療センターが地元民によって放火される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の地域流行で深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の社会不安（治療施設放火）、複数国での確認による国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はコンゴ東部（イトゥリ州）でのエボラ流行。ウガンダとスーダンは地理的な隣接国として言及されているが、ウガンダでの2症例報告は二次的情報。本評価ではDRCのみを verified_locations に含める。Bundibugyo株であることが特筆でき、ワクチン・治療法が現在利用不可で社会的不安が高い。人道支援物資不足と地元の不信感が管理を困難にしており、国際支援が必要。

article.articleHeadline: TOPICSTODAY: สธ. แถลงเฝ้าระวังไวรัส "อีโบลา"/ กกร.เจาะปัญหาขาดแคลนแรงงาน/ นายกฯ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: TOPICS OF THE DAY: Ministry of Public Health briefs on Ebola virus surveillance / Tripartite Committee probes labor shortages / The Prime Minister.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) surveillance in Thailand following Congo and Uganda being designated as high-risk zones after the WHO elevated a new Ebola strain to an international Public Health Emergency. By May 21, 2026, at least 600 people were classified as suspected cases with 139 deaths. EVD is caused by an Orthoebolavirus and spreads via direct contact with blood, body fluids, organs of the infected, or contaminated surfaces, with natural reservoirs including bats and nonhuman primates; it is not airborne. Incubation ranges from 2 to 21 days and the disease carries a high fatality rate. Thailand reports no confirmed cases yet but has intensified monitoring, including traveler screening from affected countries, 21-day quarantine with ongoing follow-up, and rapid investigation of suspected cases across healthcare facilities.

triage.headline_ja: 本日のトピック：タイ保健省がエボラウイルス監視体制について説明発表／3者委員会が労働力不足の問題を調査／首相
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス感染症は極めて高い公衆衛生への影響を有する予想外の国際的脅威であり、DRC・ウガンダでの600人以上の患者と139人の死亡は深刻な影響を示す。国際的拡大リスクが高く、渡航・貿易制限の対象となる可能性がある。
triage.notes: Uganda（226074）はBluedot APIの発生地域に含まれているが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダが新株エボラの影響を受けた地域として明記されており、タイは監視体制下にある。タイでは確認患者がまだいないが、DRC・ウガンダでの患者600人・死亡139人は極めて深刻。新株エボラがWHOにより国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態に指定されたことが重要。

article.articleHeadline: മൃതദേഹം വിട്ടുനല്‍കിയില്ല; കോംഗോയിൽ എബോള ചികിത്സാ കേന്ദ്രത്തിന് തീയിട്ട് ജനങ്ങള്‍
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The body of the deceased was not handed over; in Congo, people set fire to an Ebola treatment center.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ituri province, in Rampaar, an Ebola treatment center inside a hospital was set on fire on Thursday as Ebola transmission spreads. BBC reports the fire hit a section described as the outbreak’s origin. Family members of a young man believed to have died from Ebola sought his body for burial, but hospital officials refused to hand it over due to infection risks and safety protocols. A group of youths then breached the building, damaged belongings, and set fire to tents housing Ebola patients; one corpse and the tents were burned. The incident highlights ongoing security and public health challenges in responding to the Ebola outbreak in the region. Published 2026-05-22.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの遺体が引き渡されず；人々がコンゴのエボラ治療センターに放火
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行地域（DRC・イトゥリ州）における治療施設の焼失と患者への直接的な危害が報告されており、IHR基準2項目以上に該当し、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: 記事はマラヤラム語で配信されているが、翻訳サマリーから内容は確認可能。DRCのイトゥリ州ランパール地区でのエボラ治療施設での焼失事件であり、進行中の流行における市民の不信感と安全保障上の課題を示唆している。患者を収容する天幕の焼失と遺体焼却により、感染制御が著しく損なわれた。

article.articleHeadline: S. Korea to widen travel ban in DR Congo to 3 provinces over Ebola outbreak | Yonhap News Agency
article.articleSummary: South Korea broadens its travel ban in the Democratic Republic of the Congo amid an Ebola outbreak, effective 2 p.m. May 22, 2026. Ituri Province joins a Level 4 travel alert, creating a three-province no-travel zone covering Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu due to rising Ebola deaths. Korean nationals visiting these areas without passport authorization face penalties under the passport law. A Level 3 alert covers areas within 50 kilometers of the border with the Central African Republic and seven other DR Congo provinces, including Bas-Uele and Haut-Uele. A travel advisory remains for the rest of the country. Separately, Korea issued an advisory for Uganda; the Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency designated DR Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan as priority quarantine management countries for Ebola. Reported infections in eastern DR Congo exceed 160 suspected deaths per media reports.

triage.headline_ja: 韓国、エボラ感染拡大に対しコンゴ民主共和国での渡航禁止区域を3州に拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス疾患による多数の疑い死亡報告とアフリカ複数国での公式な旅行禁止措置が確認された。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のエボラ感染拡大に関するもの。韓国による渡航禁止措置の拡大決定と複数省での確認が中心。Bluedot APIが南スーダン・ウガンダ・中央アフリカ共和国・韓国を含めているが、サマリーではこれらは韓国の隔離管理対象国指定または警告レベル設定として言及されており、実際の感染発生地はDRCのみ。160以上の疑い死亡報告があり、ヒト-ヒト感染性の高い病原体の地域流行の段階にある。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta Epidemiológica - Enfermedad del Ébola causada por el virus Bundibugyo en la República Democrática del Congo y Uganda - 21 de mayo del 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Epidemiological Alert - Ebola virus disease caused by Bundibugyo virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda - May 21, 2026.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and imported cases in Uganda are evolving as of May 18, 2026. In the DRC, 516 suspected cases and 131 suspected deaths have been reported across seven health zones in Ituri and North Kivu provinces, with 33 laboratory-confirmed cases and 4 deaths. Confirmed cases include Rwampara (19/3), Bunia (6/1), Nyankunde (4), Mongbwalu (1) in Ituri, and Butembo (1), Goma (1), Katwa (1) in North Kivu. Bundibugyo virus was confirmed on May 15 following eight samples; the outbreak was declared on May 17, and on May 16 the WHO classified it as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Uganda reports two imported confirmed cases in Kampala, including one death, linked to travel from the DRC, with 47 contacts followed; no local transmission in Uganda as of May 18.

triage.headline_ja: 疫学的警報 - 2026年5月21日、コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダにおけるブンディブギョウイボラウイルスによるエボラウイルス病
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。Bundibugyo Ebola virusの国際的な感染拡大（DRC→Uganda）、深刻な死亡率、WHOがPHEICに分類、国際的な渡航・貿易への制限リスク。
