triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola virus（EBOV-Bu）は稀な亜種。DRCで516疑い例、33確認例、4死亡。Ugandaへの輸入例2例報告（1死亡）。WHOがPHEICに分類（2026年5月16日）。記事サマリーではUgandaでの2輸入確認例言及があるが、実際の流行地はDRCのため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとする。

article.articleHeadline: Santé : Les États-Unis renforcent les contrôles aux frontières face à l'épidémie d'Ebola - LePotentiel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health: The United States strengthens border controls in response to the Ebola outbreak - LePotentiel
article.articleSummary: US health and border authorities on May 21 announced strengthened screening for travelers from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), Uganda, and South Sudan due to a Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the DRC with spillover into Uganda. Travelers who stayed in these countries within 21 days before arrival must transit through Washington Dulles Airport (IAD) for health screening; IAD is the entry point for these travelers. CDC and CBP coordinate to prevent introduction of Bundibugyo Ebola into the United States. The outbreak, identified in Bunia, NE DRC, in early May, is the 17th Ebola outbreak since 1976. As of May 19, 2026, DRC and Uganda reported 536 suspected, 105 probable, 34 confirmed cases and 134 suspected deaths; two Uganda cases (one death) in travelers from DRC. Bundibugyo is one of four orthoebolaviruses; no vaccine; treatment is supportive. Public risk remains low; travel advisories and airline coordination continue.

triage.headline_ja: 健康：エボラ出血熱の流行に対応し米国が国境管理を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）し、WPRO基準でも複数該当。コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでの確認された多数事例と国際的な対応強化が見られる。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにはコンゴ民主共和国、ウガンダ、南スーダン、米国が言及されているが、対象国リストではコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のみ該当。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。ブンディブギョエボラの確認事例（DRC 34例確認、ウガンダ2例、計134死亡疑い例）が報告されており、国際的な感染リスク管理が実施されている。2026年5月19日時点のデータで、第17回目のエボラ流行である。

article.articleHeadline: Local expert urges active monitoring over Ebola declarations
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) with signs of spread trigger a red outbound travel alert from Hong Kong. The Bundibugyo strain lacks a vaccine; traditional public health measures remain essential. Uganda reports concurrent outbreaks. On May 19, Hong Kong intensified health screening for passengers from Africa. Congo’s conflict-driven displacement is expanding transmission into the northeast; surveillance should treat travellers from that area differently from those from other parts. Anticipated travellers include businesspeople and medical personnel, with an infected American national moved to Germany and some Chinese operators transiting via Hong Kong. Healthcare workers have been affected. Authorities emphasize that accurate travel-history reporting is crucial and advocate 24-hour daily health checks rather than sole reliance on self-reporting.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ宣言に関して積極的な監視を呼びかける地元の専門家
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱はコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダで発生、ワクチンなしの株、複数国への拡大・医療従事者への感染、香港での検疫強化とドイツへの患者搬送による国際的拡大リスクが明確。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの同時発生も言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。香港での検疫強化と中国への関連（中国のオペレータが香港経由で移動）により、Chinaを含める。ドイツへの患者搬送は対象国外のため考慮していない。Bundibugyo株でワクチンが利用不可能である点が重症度を増す。

article.articleHeadline: Hrozba jménem ebola: Kvůli tomuto se bojí Česko!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Threat Named Ebola: This Is Why the Czech Republic Is Afraid!
article.articleSummary: As of May 22, 2026, an American internist and pediatrician, described as deeply religious, arrived in Prague under extreme security and is hospitalized at Bulovka University Hospital to monitor for Ebola symptoms. In Congo, the Ebola outbreak has about 600 suspected cases and 148 deaths; as of Thursday, 51 laboratory-confirmed cases and 4 deaths. Cases have reached provinces far from the original focal point, and Ebola has spread to neighboring Uganda. The WHO declared an international public health emergency over the weekend. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain; there is no vaccine and no reliable treatment. Transmission occurs through contact with body fluids, and case-fatality is estimated at roughly 25% to 50% of those infected.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスという脅威：チェコ共和国がこれを恐れている理由！
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4つすべてに該当。コンゴでのエボラアウトブレイク（148死亡、51確認症例）がウガンダに拡大し、WHOが国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言。ヨーロッパ（チェコ）での疑い症例も報告され、国際的な懸念が高まっている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、実際のエボラ発生地はコンゴ（DRC）およびウガンダであることが確認される。チェコ（Prague）での報告は疑い症例の監視段階であり、確認されたアウトブレイクではない。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。WHOが国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言済み。Bundibugyo strain、ワクチンなし、致死率25～50%という高いリスク。

article.articleHeadline: Bộ Y tế thông tin diễn biến phức tạp của dịch bệnh do virus Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health reports on the complex developments of Ebola virus disease
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreaks driven by the Bundibugyo strain are unfolding in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. As of May 18, 2026, 516 suspected cases and 131 deaths have been reported across seven health zones in Ituri and North Kivu, the 17th Ebola outbreak since 1976. On May 5, WHO reported four health-care worker deaths in Ituri; by May 16, Uganda had two lab-confirmed imported cases from the DRC (one in Kampala) with one death, and no clear epidemiological link between cases. In Ituri, 8 lab-confirmed cases, 246 suspected, and 80 suspected deaths were documented. WHO declared Bundibugyo Ebola outbreaks in DRC and Uganda a public health emergency of international concern on May 17. Unusual features include community deaths, healthcare worker infections, a high positivity rate (8/13), and cross-border spread. Vietnam reports no cases as of May 21, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省がエボラウイルス病の複雑な展開を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでDRCとウガンダのエボラウイルス病アウトブレイクが述べられている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に追加していない。ベトナムについては記事で「症例なし」と明記されているため除外。WHO PHEIC宣言（2026年5月17日）により、国際的なシグナルとして確定。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak: Disease fears force postponement of India-Africa Forum Summit in Delhi
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks in parts of Africa prompt postponement of the India-Africa Forum Summit in New Delhi. As of 2026-05-22, no Ebola case has been detected in India. The government intensified airport surveillance for passengers arriving from high-risk African nations and reviewed preparedness measures with all states and Union Territories, alongside issuing a nationwide health advisory. The Ministry of External Affairs said the summit, originally scheduled for next week in New Delhi, was postponed after consultations with African Union leadership to ensure full participation and engagement while staying mindful of the evolving public health situation. The decision reflects heightened vigilance during ongoing Ebola outbreaks in Africa and aims to balance diplomatic engagement with public health risk management.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行：病気への懸念がインド・アフリカフォーラムサミットのニューデリでの延期を強制
triage.triage_reason: アフリカでのエボラ出血熱流行が報告されており、インドではまだ確認例がないものの、政府が空港監視と準備体制の強化を実施している。情報は限定的であり、国内感染の直接的な報告がないため、今後の展開を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが示した発生地域リストには「New Delhi」「Africa」が含まれていますが、記事サマリーによれば、実際のエボラ流行はアフリカで発生しており、インドではまだ確認例がありません。インドは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含めます。アフリカは対象国リストに含まれないため除外しています。IHR基準3つ以上該当し、WPRO基準も複数該当していますが、インド国内での実際の患者報告がないため、PICKUP判定ではなく WATCH 判定としました。外交イベント延期という社会的影響があるため、今後の情報収集を推奨します。

article.articleHeadline: Chennai airport to review Ebola response protocols
article.articleSummary: Chennai airport, India, is reviewing Ebola preparedness as the WHO declares the ongoing outbreak a public health emergency. The Airport Health Organisation (APHO) will hold an emergency coordination meeting at Chennai airport with international airlines, immigration officials, CISF personnel, state health authorities and other stakeholders. Revised SOPs from the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare require airlines operating international services into Chennai to distribute self-declaration forms to all arriving passengers, including those transiting through African countries affected by Ebola. Cabin crew must ensure forms are completed before landing and make mandatory in-flight announcements on Ebola symptoms and reporting requirements. Crew are instructed to alert APHO if passengers exhibit fever, vomiting, diarrhoea, rashes, weakness or bleeding manifestations. Airlines should stock masks, gloves, PPE kits, sanitisers and universal precaution kits onboard. Chennai serves as a major international gateway with links to the Middle East, Southeast Asia and Africa.

triage.headline_ja: チェンナイ空港、エボラ対応プロトコルの見直しを実施
triage.triage_reason: インドのチェンナイ空港でエボラ対応プロトコルが改正され、WHO緊急宣言との連動が確認される。公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的な拡大リスクが明確であり、IHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はインドのチェンナイ空港が国際線乗客に対するエボラ対応プロトコルを改正し、WHOの公衆衛生緊急事態宣言に対応している。アフリカ経由の乗客スクリーニング、機内スクリーニング体制、搭乗員の対応基準の強化が実施されている。インド政府保健家族福祉省から改定SOPが発出されており、公式な政府対応の段階にある。チェンナイは中東・東南アジア・アフリカへの主要国際ゲートウェイであり、渡航に関連する規制措置の実施が確認される。

article.articleHeadline: Korea to widen travel ban in DR Congo to 3 provinces over Ebola outbreak - The Korea Times
article.articleSummary: On 2026-05-22, Korea widened its travel ban in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to three provinces amid an Ebola outbreak. Effective 2 p.m. Friday, a Level 4 travel alert was issued for Ituri Province, expanding no-travel zones to Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu. Korean nationals visiting these areas without exceptional passport-use authorization may face penalties under the passport law. A Level 3 alert advises departure from areas within 50 kilometers of the Central African Republic border and seven other DR Congo provinces, including Bas-Uele and Haut-Uele. A special advisory remains for the rest of the country. Seoul also issued a Uganda advisory after the Korea CDC designated DRC, Uganda and South Sudan as priority Ebola quarantine-management countries. Eastern DR Congo Ebola infections have risen rapidly, with more than 160 suspected deaths. A fire at an Ebola treatment center in Rwampara, Congo, prompted disinfection.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の発生を受けコンゴ民主共和国の3州への渡航禁止を拡大—韓国
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準4項目中3項目に該当（深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。またWPRO基準複数項目で警戒値を示す。エボラ出血熱は最高警戒病原体であり、160以上の疑い死亡例と急速な感染拡大が報告されている。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は IHR(2005)の最高警戒病原体。東部DRCでの急速な感染拡大（160以上の疑い死亡例）、複数州への拡大、国際的な渡航制限措置の実施、ウガンダ・南スーダンへの拡大リスク、医療施設での火災による感染制御上の懸念など、複合的なリスク要因を認める。Bluedot APIの発生地域にはルワンダが含まれているが、記事サマリーではルワンダでの実際の患者発生は報告されていないため verified_locations から除外。韓国によるレベル4渡航警告は事態の深刻性を示す。

article.articleHeadline: 乌干达暂停往返刚果（金）航班　严防埃博拉疫情输入
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda suspends flights to and from the Democratic Republic of the Congo to prevent the importation of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Uganda suspends flights to and from the Democratic Republic of the Congo to prevent Ebola importation. On 21 May, Uganda's Ministry of Health announced strengthened border controls as a new Ebola outbreak emerges in DRC. Measures include suspending all flights between Uganda and DRC within 48 hours; reducing cross-border movement; suspending cultural festivals and markets; halting cross-border public transport for four weeks (except cargo and food); tightening border patrols with cross-border movement limited to officially designated border posts; strict Ebola prevention SOPs at border areas. Kampala has reported two imported Ebola cases from DRC, including one death whose body was returned to DRC; the other patient remains isolated in a Kampala hospital. About 127 close contacts are in centralized quarantine; no domestic confirmed cases yet. The public is urged to follow health guidance and report suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダがコンゴ民主共和国との往来便を一時停止、エボラ疫情の流入を防止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当し、エボラウイルス感染症の国際拡大リスク、複数国への影響、渡航制限措置がある。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、高リスク病原体による緊急対応が必要。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス感染症は最高レベルの危険病原体。DRCで新規アウトブレイクが発生し、既にウガンダへの輸入症例（2例、死亡1例）が確認されている。ウガンダ政府が即座に航空便停止、国境管理強化などの強硬措置を実施している点は、感染拡大の懸念を示唆している。対象国リストに両国が含まれており、フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: शव नहीं मिला तो हॉस्पिटल फूंका! इस अफ्रीकी देश में Ebola ने कोरोना वाला कहर मचाया है- VIDEO
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: With no body found, the hospital was set on fire! Ebola has unleashed COVID-like havoc in this African country - VIDEO
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak persists in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), centered in Ituri Province near Bunia at Ravampapa General Hospital. Following the death of a young man presumed to have Ebola, protests outside the hospital escalated into violence, with stones thrown and isolation tents torched; police used warning shots, and health workers were placed under army protection after an injured staff member. The World Health Organization reports 600 suspected Ebola cases with 139 deaths among them, while Congo’s health minister claims 159 deaths have been recorded. Local accounts describe the deceased as a popular figure; family members doubt Ebola as the cause, suggesting typhoid fever. WHO recommends safe and dignified burials handled by trained teams in PPE. Two Ebola cases have been reported in neighboring Uganda. Ongoing transmission risk and community tension characterize the outbreak context.

triage.headline_ja: 遺体が見つからないため病院が放火された！このアフリカの国ではエボラがコロナのような大惨事をもたらしている - ビデオ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常/予想外な暴力事件、複数国への国際的拡大、社会不安による医療妨害）。WPRO基準も5つすべて該当し、エボラの流行継続と重症度、国境を越えた拡大リスク、社会不安による管理困難が明確。」
triage.notes: ウガンダでも2例報告されているが、記事の主題はDRCのイツリ州ブニア市におけるエボラ流行。社会不安により病院施設が破壊され、医療提供が著しく阻害されている状況。ローカルコミュニティがチフス熱とエボラを混同している可能性があり、対応の複雑性を増している。緊急のRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 米国、エボラ流行地域からの入国者をダレス空港に集約しスリーニング実施
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States consolidated entrants arriving from Ebola-affected regions at Dulles International Airport and implemented screening.
article.articleSummary: CDC orders enhanced screening at Washington, D.C.’s Dulles International Airport for travelers who recently visited Ebola-affected regions—Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan within the past 21 days. The rule applies to flights departing after May 20, 2026, 11:59 p.m. ET, with airlines rebooking such travelers to Dulles. Virginia Department of Health says officials are in active contact with federal authorities and that general public risk remains very low. At Dulles, enhanced screening includes a travel-history questionnaire, temperature checks, observation for symptoms, and collection of contact information for tracing; asymptomatic passengers may continue to their final destination with an instruction sheet for symptom monitoring. The measure applies to U.S. citizens, nationals, and lawful permanent residents. Separately, CDC already restricts entry for travelers without a U.S. passport who visited these countries in the prior 21 days.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ流行地域からの入国者をダレス空港に集約しスクリーニング実施
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）。エボラウイルス病は高致死率の指定感染症であり、複数国での流行が確認されている。米国が主要空港でスクリーニング体制を強化する対応を取っており、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIで検出された米国・ウガンダ・スーダンの各地域は、スクリーニング対象の流行地域の言及であり、実際のイベント発生地ではない。記事の主題は米国での検疫措置であるが、対象国リストに米国が含まれていないため、DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。ウガンダ・スーダンは対象国リストに非掲載のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Việt Nam đã tăng cường giám sát Ebola tại cửa khẩu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vietnam has stepped up Ebola surveillance at border crossings
article.articleSummary: Vietnam steps up Ebola surveillance at border crossings as of May 20, 2026, after the WHO-designated Bundibugyo Ebola as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Global figures show 600 suspected Ebola cases and 139 suspected deaths; the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ituri and North Kivu provinces report 51 confirmed cases. In Uganda, two laboratory-confirmed infections with one death in Kampala; both patients traveled from DRC, with at least four healthcare workers dying from Ebola-like symptoms. Vietnam reports no suspected entries to date. While risk is deemed low, vigilance remains due to increasing international travel. Measures include intensified surveillance at borders, hospitals, and communities; review of diagnostic and treatment capacity; preparation of chemicals, PPE, and staff training. Diagnostic testing is assigned to Pasteur Institute Ho Chi Minh City and the National Institute of Hygiene and Epidemiology, capable of genome sequencing. Case definitions rely on clinical symptoms plus travel history from outbreak regions; rapid-response teams should be reactivated. Ebola transmission involves animal-to-human and human-to-human spread via blood/secretions; high mortality, with healthcare workers at elevated risk.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムが国境での エボラ出血熱 監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱のWHO公衆衛生上の国際的に懸念される事象指定、DRC・ウガンダでの確認事例、およびベトナムを含む複数国での監視強化はIHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: Ho Chi Minh CityおよびKampalaは発生地域リストに含まれるがサマリー記事では、ベトナムは「疑い症例なし」と述べられており、実際の発生地はDRC（Ituri、North Kivu）とUgandaである。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。Bundibugyo Ebolastype指定によるPHEIC指定が重要なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: La selección de fútbol de la República Democrática del Congo canceló sus entrenamientos debido a un brote de ébola - 7dias.com.do
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo national football team canceled its training sessions due to an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: May 22, 2026: The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) Ebola outbreak led the national football team to cancel training. The squad had been preparing in Kinshasa, about 2,000 kilometers from Ituri, the outbreak’s epicenter; Kinshasa has not reported cases. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak documented in the DRC since the virus was first detected in 1976. The World Health Organization declared an international public health emergency over the outbreak, though global risk is considered low. Transmission occurs by direct contact with bodily fluids of infected people or animals, causing fever, severe vomiting, diarrhea, and internal hemorrhages. The report situates the outbreak amid preparations for the 2026 FIFA World Cup in the United States, Mexico, and Canada, underscoring travel and gathering-related exposure concerns.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のサッカー代表チームがエボラ出血熱の流行により練習をキャンセル
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上に該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常性、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、WHO国際保健上の緊急事態宣言、高い社会的関心。
triage.notes: WHO国際保健上の緊急事態(PHEIC)宣言。DRCで17回目のエボラ流行。キナシャはIturi州から約2,000km離れており、現在のところ確認例なし。2026年FIFAワールドカップ開催国（米国、メキシコ、カナダ）への渡航リスク懸念あり。記事は国家間の感染症流行と国際スポーツイベントの接点を指摘している点で高い社会的関心が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: รัฐบาล คัดกรองเข้ม คนเดินทางจาก 'คองโก-ยูกันดา' เสี่ยงโรคติดต่ออันตราย อีโบล
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Government tightens screening for travelers from Congo and Uganda who are at risk of the dangerous infectious disease Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) screening tightened for travelers from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda, effective May 21, 2026, after the Royal Gazette announcement and WHO’s Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) status. Thailand enhances border controls with pre-registration via the Thailand Digital Arrival Card (TDAC) for foreigners and Thai Health Pass for Thai nationals, plus on-arrival symptom checks, fever screening, and 21-day monitoring. The Civil Aviation Authority of Thailand (CAAT) coordinates with the Ministry of Public Health, airlines, and border agencies to implement three measures: pre-travel health communications, screening at origin, and verification of traveler registration with symptom assessment and surveillance support for border control staff. Preparedness drills address suspected cases onboard aircraft and post-arrival scenarios. The government stresses health-system readiness, urges adherence to official guidance, and calls for calm.

triage.headline_ja: 政府、コンゴ・ウガンダからの渡航者に対する厳格なスクリーニングを強化 - エボラ出血熱などの危険な感染症リスク対策
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限対応）し、PHEIC指定されたエボラウイルス病の確認事例がDRCおよびウガンダで発生している。タイは対象国であり、国境措置強化は国際的懸念を示唆している。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはUganda（226074）も含まれていたが、対象国リストに該当しないため除外。DRCとThailandのみ verified_locations に含める。WHOがPHEIC指定した状況であり、タイが国境措置を強化していることから、単なる対応措置ではなくシグナル候補として扱う。

article.articleHeadline: В ДР Конго протестующие сожгли центр лечения лихорадки Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the DRC, protesters burned an Ebola treatment center.
article.articleSummary: In eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, residents of Rwamparé burned an Ebola treatment center after relatives of a deceased patient were denied the body, per Associated Press. The Ituri Province, where the incident occurred, is the outbreak’s epicenter of a new Ebola strain. Authorities warn that bodies of the deceased may be contagious, and burial rules clash with local customs, fueling protests and concerns about the health system’s effectiveness. Since the outbreak began, at least 160 people have died and 671 suspected cases have been detected across two provinces. The United Nations reports cross-border transmission to neighboring Uganda, including one death and one infection. The violence and burial practices highlight tensions around outbreak response, access to care, and cultural considerations amid a rising Ebola crisis in the region.

triage.headline_ja: DRC（コンゴ民主共和国）でエボラ熱治療センターが抗議者により焼かれた
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラ出血熱の新規株による集団発生で、既に160人以上の死亡、国間伝播を確認。社会的混乱と管理上の重大な懸念あり。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでUgandaへの国間伝播が記載されているが、Ugandaは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。DRCが主要発生地域であり、新規エボラ株による集団発生、160人以上の死亡例、治療施設への暴力行為、文化的慣行との衝突が社会的混乱と管理能力低下を示唆。緊急性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو تعلن ارتفاع ضحايا إيبولا وسط مخاوف من تفش واسع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo reports rising Ebola deaths amid fears of a widespread outbreak.
article.articleSummary: East Democratic Republic of Congo faces rising Ebola deaths amid fears of a wider outbreak. Health authorities report 671 suspected cases and 160 suspected deaths, with 64 confirmed cases and 6 confirmed deaths to date. The WHO warns the true toll may be higher due to under-reporting. In neighboring Uganda, two imported confirmed cases from Congo were reported; one died, the other’s second test was negative. The outbreak began in Ituri Province in northeastern Congo near Uganda and South Sudan, the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC since 1976. The circulating strain is Bundibugyo, which has no licensed vaccine or approved treatment. Ebola spreads by direct contact with infected individuals or bodily fluids; the disease has caused more than 11,000 deaths in West Africa in 2014–2015.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱の犠牲者増加を報告、広範囲の流行への懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱は最高リスク病原体であり、複数国への越境症例、確認死亡例、ワクチン未開発株での流行は重大な国際的脅威。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は IHR リスト疾患であり、複数国への越境確認（ウガンダへの輸入症例）、ワクチン未開発の Bundibugyo 株、報告件数の過小報告の可能性が指摘されている。ウガンダでも確認症例があるが、記事の主題はコンゴでの発生。スーダンとアンゴラは発生地域に列挙されているが、サマリーに明示的な流行記述がないため verified_locations から除外。フルRRA優先度：最高段階。

article.articleHeadline: WHO declares deadly outbreak of Ebola virus "an international health emergency". BBC News - ExBulletin
article.articleSummary: As of 22 May 2026, WHO declares Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo a public health emergency of international concern (PHEIC). The outbreak in eastern Ituri province has about 246 suspected cases and 80 deaths; eight laboratory-confirmed cases. The strain is Bundibugyo virus, for which no approved drug or vaccine exists. Initial symptoms include fever, muscle aches, fatigue, headache, and sore throat, progressing to vomiting, diarrhea, rash, and bleeding. Cases are confirmed in Bunia, Mongwalu, and Rwampara, with a Kinshasa case confirmed in a patient returning from Ituri. The virus has spread beyond DR Congo, with two confirmed cases in Uganda and a Ugandan man (59) who died after testing positive. The outbreak is not a pandemic, but WHO warns of potential larger local and regional spread; no approved treatment or vaccine; public health measures are ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: WHOが致命的なエボラウイルスアウトブレイクを「国際的保健上の緊急事態」として宣言
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WHO公式のPHEIC宣言、複数国への地域的拡大（DRC、ウガンダ、ルワンダ）、高い死亡率（80/246疑い例）、有効な治療法・ワクチン不在。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）のPHEIC宣言。記事サマリーでウガンダ・ルワンダにも言及されているが、主要な発生地はDRC（イトゥーリ州）。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。WHO公式宣言により社会的・政治的関心は非常に高い。フルRRA進行推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Incendiadas dos carpas hospitalarias en Rwampara, en RDC, donde eran tratados pacientes de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two hospital tents burned in Rwampara, DRC, where Ebola patients were being treated.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo: Two Ebola treatment tents were burned at Rwampara Hospital in Ituri province, northeast DR Congo, amid a severe epidemic. ALIMA reports six patients were being treated in those tents and all remain under hospital care. The incident underscores ongoing risks to safe care and the destruction of essential equipment in a context described as highly critical; ALIMA teams remain mobilized in coordination with authorities to limit impact. Separately, sources cited by Actualité.cd indicate a patient suspected of Ebola died after arriving at Rwampara Hospital the same day, with the family attempting to retrieve the body as staff urged restraint. Overall, the northeast outbreak totals about 500 cases and more than 130 suspected deaths, with Mongbwalu and Rwampara among the hardest-hit areas, and transmission also reaching Bunia, Nyakunde, Butembo, and Goma in Ituri and North Kivu.

triage.headline_ja: DRC（コンゴ民主共和国）のルワンパラでエボラ患者を治療していた2つの病院用テントが焼失
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の活発な流行（約500症例、130人以上の疑い死亡）において、治療施設への直接的な破壊が発生し、患者ケアの継続性が脅かされている。IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外の事態、国際的拡大リスク）をすべて満たす。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、国際的関心が高い疾患である。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはDRC内の複数州（Ituri、North Kivu）および医療施設（ルワンパラ、ムオングワル、ブタンボ、ゴマ、ニャクンデ、ブニア）が特定されている。記事ではRwandaも地理的に近接している地域として記載されているが、サマリーのメイン流行地はDRC northeast地域であり、サマリー上でRwandaでの実際の症例報告はない。したがって verified_locations はDRCのみとした。施設破壊による治療中断リスク、患者ケアの混乱、および死亡例の報告から、感染制御とウイルス拡散リスクが高まっている状況が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: エボラ出血熱が流行...13大会ぶりW杯出場のコンゴ民主共和国、国内合宿を中止 | ゲキサカ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola hemorrhagic fever outbreak spreads... Democratic Republic of the Congo, which is set to appear in the World Cup for the first time in 13 editions, cancels its domestic training camp
article.articleSummary: Ebola hemorrhagic fever outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has a death toll reported to exceed 100. The Democratic Republic of the Congo Football Association (FECOFA) canceled a domestic World Cup pre-camp in Kinshasa scheduled for May 26 due to the outbreak and the United States’ 21-day travel ban on entrants who have stayed in Congo. Despite the outbreak, Congo’s World Cup squad remains unaffected as all players compete abroad. A June European tour proceeds: Belgium vs Denmark on June 3 in Belgium and Spain vs Chile on June 9 in Spain. Kinshasa-based journalists report visa restrictions to the United States, complicating coverage; the article provides no laboratory confirmation or specific symptoms. Current date reference: 2026-05-22.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱が流行...13大会ぶりW杯出場のコンゴ民主共和国、国内合宿を中止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目中3項目以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響：100名超の死亡、予想外の出来事、国際的拡大のリスク）。WPROスクリーニングでも複数基準該当。対象国DRCでの確認イベント。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはキンシャサ（DRC首都）でのエボラ出血熱流行を主題としており、100名超の死亡が報告されている。米国の渡航禁止措置、スポーツイベント中止など国際的影響が確認される。Bluedot APIの発生地域にはUS、チリ、スペイン、デンマーク、ベルギーが含まれているが、これらはW杯関連の友好試合開催地であり、エボラ出血熱の発生地ではない。実際の感染症イベント発生地はDRCのみであるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Συναγερμός για τον Έμπολα: 160 θάνατοι στο Κονγκό - Εφιαλτικές καταστάσεις, πυρπολήθηκε νοσοκομείο
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alarm over Ebola: 160 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo - Nightmarish conditions, a hospital was torched.
article.articleSummary: As of May 22, 2026, Ebola virus disease is spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri province near Uganda and South Sudan. The Ministry of Health reports 671 suspected cases and 160 deaths linked to the outbreak, with 64 infections and 6 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases. A hospital treating Ebola patients was torched by protesters after a family disputed a death attributed to Ebola, highlighting security challenges. The World Health Organization notes about 600 suspected cases and 130 deaths as of Wednesday, with likely higher true figures due to underreporting. Cross-border spread is evident: Uganda has identified two cases (one deceased, the other now negative on latest tests and still hospitalized). The outbreak is caused by the rare Bundibugyo strain, for which no approved vaccines or specific therapies exist, hindering containment. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC since 1976; the deadliest occurred in 2014–2015 with over 11,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: エボラに警戒：コンゴ民主共和国で160人が死亡 - 悪夢のような状況、病院が放火される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当。Bundibugyo株のエボラ出血熱が複数国で確認され、ワクチン・治療法なし、セキュリティ上の課題が存在する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダとスーダンが地理的参照として言及されているが、確認されたケースはDRCとウガンダのみ。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations からは除外。Bundibugyo株は稀でワクチン・治療法がなく、セキュリティ上の課題（病院放火）が確認されている。国際的拡大の可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: 민주콩고 에볼라 확산세...의심 670건·사망 160명
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spread accelerates in DR Congo... 670 suspected cases, 160 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola re-emerged in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) with 670 suspected cases and 160 related deaths reported by the local health ministry as of May 21, 2026. The outbreak is spreading into rebel-held areas of South Kivu, including Bukavu, where new confirmed cases were reported. Public health measures include tightening funeral procedures to curb transmission, which sparked protests and arson at treatment tents. Uganda has temporarily suspended flights to and from the DRC to prevent cross-border importation of cases. The report notes ongoing transmission and cross-border risk; laboratory confirmation details are not provided in the excerpt, and infection sources remain unclear. The information is sourced from Reuters, with Xinhua corroborating Bukavu’s new case.

triage.headline_ja: 民主コンゴでエボラ拡散加速...疑い例670件・死亡160名
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の新規発生流行で、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目満たす。既に死亡例160名、疑い例670件が報告されており、ウガンダへの越境リスクも実現している国際的危機。
triage.notes: ウガンダは発生地域に含まれるが、記事サマリーではウガンダへの越境リスク対応（飛行禁止）のみ記述されており、ウガンダ国内での確認症例は報告されていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。エボラウイルス病は致死率が高く、葬儀手続きの厳格化に対する社会的抵抗（抗議・放火）が確認され、管理の課題が明らかである。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : quel est le risque de propagation du virus au-delà de la RDC ?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: What is the risk of the virus spreading beyond the DRC?
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has grown since first cases were reported on May 15. By the latest update, the World Health Organization counted 139 deaths and about 600 probable cases, underscoring rapid transmission in the region. The article assesses the risk of the virus spreading beyond the DRC, noting ongoing transmission in eastern provinces and the challenges of containment. Health authorities are monitoring cross-border exposure and potential international implications as the outbreak evolves. The report highlights the central question of whether the virus could cross national borders, emphasizing the need for vigilant surveillance, case confirmation, and sustained public health measures to limit spread.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：RDCを超えたウイルス伝播のリスクは？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク、国境超越リスク）に該当し、エボラ出血熱という重篤な感染症での進行中の流行である。即座にフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 2026年5月15日に最初の症例報告から急速に拡大。139人の死亡、約600人の患者数。東部州での継続的伝播、国境監視中。WHO関与。エボラ出血熱はIHR附属書2及びWPRO基準のすべての要素を満たす高優先度の公衆衛生上の脅威。

article.articleHeadline: Bộ Y tế họp bàn ứng phó với vi rút Ebola, hơn 130 ca tử vong tại châu Phi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health holds a meeting to discuss the Ebola virus response, with more than 130 deaths in Africa.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (Bundibugyo ebolavirus) outbreaks are ongoing in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri) and Uganda. As of May 18, 2026, the DRC reported 516 suspected cases and 131 deaths, with four health workers among fatalities by May 5; Uganda confirmed imported cases including a death on May 15 (a Congo-arrived patient) and a second Kampala case on May 16. WHO declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, noting high transmission risk in parts of Africa but lower global risk. The current outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo; there is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo (vaccines exist for other Ebola species). Vietnam reports no cases yet, but risks of importation persist, prompting enhanced border surveillance, rapid-response readiness, and strengthening of diagnostics (Real-time PCR and sequencing) with kits due within 7–10 days. Common symptoms include fever, fatigue, headache, myalgia, sore throat, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, rash, and possible hemorrhage; incubation 2–21 days.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省がエボラウイルス対応について会議を開催、アフリカで130人以上の死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2の4基準中3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WHO宣言されたPHEIC。対象国DRCで516疑い症例・131死亡、ウガンダで確定症例発生、ベトナムでも監視強化。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにはウガンダ(226074)が含まれているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。DRCはIturi州での516疑い症例・131死亡が記事の主題。ベトナムは輸入症例リスク対応中（未確定症例）だが、国家的対応と強化監視体制が確立されているため含める。WHO PH EICとして2026年5月17日に宣言済み。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（新種系統）によるアウトブレイク。

article.articleHeadline: Συναγερμός για την επιδημία Έμπολα στο Κονγκό: 671 ύποπτα κρούσματα και 160 θάνατοι
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alarm over the Ebola outbreak in the Congo: 671 suspected cases and 160 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) persists, centered in Ituri province in the northeast near Uganda and South Sudan. The headline cites 671 suspected cases and 160 deaths, while the WHO reported about 600 suspected cases and 130 deaths earlier, noting underreporting likely inflates totals. In Uganda, authorities say no new infections beyond two Congolese nationals; one died, the other tested negative recently and remains in treatment. The African CDC (ACDC) says the outbreak began about two months ago and marks the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC since 1976. The strain is Bundibugyo, a rare variant for which there are no vaccines or specific treatments, complicating containment efforts. No vaccine or targeted therapy exists for this outbreak, underscoring urgent public health challenges across border regions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行に警戒：疑い例671件、死亡160人
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。致死的な稀なBundibugyo株による多数の死亡例、国境地域での拡大傾向、ワクチン・治療法の欠如が確認され、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（Ituri州）が主たる発生地で、ウガンダは接境地域での限定的な症例報告（確認済み2例）に留まる。スーダンは言及されていない。Bundibugyo株はエボラの稀な亜種で、利用可能なワクチン（Ervebo等）の有効性が未確認のため、対応の複雑化が指摘されている。国際的な注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Επιδημία Έμπολα στο Κονγκό: 671 ύποπτα κρούσματα και 160 θάνατοι | Η Εφημερίδα των Συντακτών
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic in the Congo: 671 suspected cases and 160 deaths | The Editors' Newspaper
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) progresses with 671 suspected cases and 160 deaths reported to date. The Ministry of Health confirmed laboratory verification for 64 infections and 6 deaths attributable to Ebola. The World Health Organization had earlier logged about 600 suspected cases and 130 deaths, noting the true numbers are likely higher due to underreporting. Neighboring Uganda reports no new infections beyond two Congolese nationals; one patient has died, and the other was negative for Ebola two days ago and remains under treatment. The report underlines ongoing transmission risk within the DRC and cross-border spillover concerns as of May 22, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ流行：671件の疑い患者と160人の死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は国際的に極めて重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、複数国での発生と継続的な伝播リスク、高い死亡率が確認されている。
triage.notes: ウガンダについては記事サマリーで言及されているが、実際の症例はコンゴからの入国者のみで、ウガンダ国内での新規感染は報告されていないため、verified_locationsに含めない。DRCはWPRO対象国リストに含まれていないが、エボラ流行は世界的に最優先の公衆衛生上の脅威であり、CEPRのEBS活動では対象外国の発生イベントでもIHR基準に基づいてPICKUPの判定が適切である。

article.articleHeadline: 埃博拉警报！美升级入境管制 班机改降加拿大
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Alert! U.S. Tightens Entry Controls; Flights Diverted to Canada.
article.articleSummary: As of May 22, 2026, the Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo virus strain has prompted US border measures. The CDC requires travelers who have visited the Democratic Republic of the Congo, South Sudan, or Uganda within the last 21 days to enter United States exclusively through Washington Dulles International Airport for health screening; foreign nationals with outbreak-area travel are suspended from entry. A France-origin flight bound for Detroit was diverted to Montreal after not meeting the new rule; the asymptomatic passenger has returned to Paris. US Secretary of State Rubio stated the primary goal is to ensure Ebola does not enter United States and to assist affected regions in preventing spread. A plan to establish 50 temporary clinics in Africa is proposed. The WHO has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, with 139 deaths and 600 suspected cases; actual numbers may be higher.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ警報！米国が入境管制を強化 便がカナダに変更
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。WHO PHEIC宣言済み、複数国にまたがる深刻なエボラ流行。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではアフリカ地域（DRC、南スーダン、ウガンダ）でのエボラ流行を報じているが、対象国リスト内ではDRCのみが該当。米国、カナダ、フランスでの検出・影響は報道されているが、対象国に含まれないため除外。WHO PHEIC宣言、139名死亡、600疑似患者数の報告あり。境界管制の強化により国際的な渡航影響が既に顕在化。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak: Air France Flight to US Diverted to Montreal After Passenger From Congo Boards Flight 'In Error' | 🌎 LatestLY
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda linked to Bundibugyo virus, with WHO reporting 528 cases and 132 suspected deaths. No vaccine or medicine exists for this strain. WHO declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern. U.S. entry restrictions require travelers who have been in Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan in the past 21 days to enter the United States through Washington Dulles International Airport for enhanced screening. A Congolese traveler who boarded an Air France flight in Paris was denied entry to the U.S., and the Detroit-bound AFR378 was diverted to Montreal; the traveler was assessed as asymptomatic by Canadian authorities and has since returned to Paris. The flight continued to Detroit. The restrictions aim to reduce cross-border spread amid ongoing outbreak concerns.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ発生：コンゴからの乗客が誤乗車した後、エールフランス便がモントリオールに迂回
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の国際的発生、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。WHO公式の国際的懸念事項宣言済みで、複数国での確認・多数死亡・ワクチン/治療薬なし、国際航空便迂回による社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでウガンダとスーダンも言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCはリスト内の対象国であり、記事の主要な発生地であるため含める。WHO PHEIC宣言、複数確認症例、高い死亡率、ヒト-ヒト感染可能性、ワクチン/治療薬の欠落、国際的な渡航制限実施などから、フルRRA進行は必須。

article.articleHeadline: Regions tighten livestock monitoring ahead of Idul Adha amid disease risks - Archipelago - The Jakarta Post
article.articleSummary: Indonesian authorities tighten livestock monitoring ahead of Idul Adha (May 27, 2026) to curb infectious and zoonotic diseases. In Pekanbaru, Riau, Distankan inspectors assessed 3,754 sacrificial animals with no disease signs; mid‑May totals show 758 FMD cases in the province, with 532 recoveries, under ongoing treatment. Riau officials emphasize preventing FMD spread and ensuring animals meet halal requirements. In Pekalongan, Central Java, teams inspect sacrificial trading sites; many animals come from other regions, with heightened FMD vaccination for local herds. Surabaya, East Java, DKPP and veterinary students run a nine‑day operation across 31 districts; by day three, 61 sites checked and one animal suspected of scabies isolated. West Java reports nearly 14,000 animals inspected; FMD and LSD cases noted (628 FMD, 79 LSD from Jan 1–May 13) amid a regional vaccination program. Nationwide slaughter is projected at ~2.3 million animals, with a 3.82% rise in demand (~86,727 more head).

triage.headline_ja: イドゥルアッダ前にインドネシア各地が家畜監視を強化—病気リスクの中での取り組み
triage.triage_reason: 複数の対象国地域で口蹄疫（FMD）、ルンピースキン病（LSD）、疥癬の同時多発が確認され、イドゥルアッダという大規模な家畜流通イベント前での発生という予想外の状況。公衆衛生への影響（ヒト感染リスク）と国際的な拡大リスクが懸念される。
triage.notes: イドゥルアッダ（2026年5月27日）の約1週間前という時間的プロキシミティが重要。リアウ州で758件のFMD症例、西ジャワで628件のFMD・79件のLSD症例、スラバヤで疥癬の疑い例など、複数疾患の多地点同時発生。全国的に約230万頭の家畜が屠殺対象となり、需要増加（3.82%上昇）が予測されている。動物由来感染症（zoonotic disease）がヒト感染へ波及するリスク、および地域間の家畜流通による急速な地理的拡大リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Air France flight to US diverted to Montreal due to Ebola travel curbs
article.articleSummary: Ebola travel curbs forced an Air France flight from Paris to Detroit to divert to Montreal after a passenger from the Democratic Republic of Congo triggered precautionary checks. U.S. authorities barred entry for non-U.S. passport holders who have been in the DRC, South Sudan, or Uganda within the past 21 days, with a 30-day travel ban announced by the CDC and Department of Homeland Security on May 18. The diversion was prompted by the US Customs and Border Protection finding the traveller during entry checks. In Montreal, health officials assessed the passenger, who showed symptoms, and he was sent back to Paris. The remaining passengers continued to Detroit after safeguards. The MRC Centre for Global Infectious Disease Analysis in London has estimated that the outbreak’s total cases could exceed 1,000.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ対策規制によりエアフランス便がモントリオールへ迂回
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的拡大リスク、複数国への影響（DRC、スーダン、ウガンダでの発生と北米への旅行者移動）、米国による21日以内訪問者への入国禁止措置など、IHR基準2つ以上（unusual_unexpected、international_spread）に該当し、フルRRAに進む必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は北米（カナダ、米国、フランス）での旅行規制措置と乗客チェックを述べているが、実際のエボラ発生地はDRCのみが確認されている。記事サマリーではDRCでの発生とその拡大リスク（推定1000例超）が述べられており、対象国リストではDRCのみ該当する。スーダン・ウガンダは記事内で言及されているが、具体的な発生の詳細は記載されていない。フルRRA実施時には、これら周辺国での発生状況の確認が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Россиянам перечислили категории граждан, которые находятся в группе риска Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russians were told the categories of citizens who are at risk of Ebola
article.articleSummary: Ebola risk groups include elderly people and diabetics, according to Ugandan physician Elijah Kiiza, who has treated hemorrhagic fever cases. Kiiza says older adults typically have weaker immunity and are more susceptible to Ebola, while diabetics are also at higher risk. He notes that symptoms manifest quickly in these groups; by contrast, in children they may appear about one and a half weeks after infection. He also warns that pregnant women face Ebola-related health risks. Amid a new outbreak, U.S. authorities have barred entry for foreigners who have been in the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan within the past 21 days. Russian health official Alexander Gintsburg, head of the Gamaleya Research Institute, reassured that Ebola does not threaten Russians. Published May 22, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア人に対し、エボラ出血熱のリスク群に属する国民のカテゴリーが列挙された
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の記事であり、対象国（DRC、ウガンダ）での発生が言及されているが、本記事の主題は「リスク群の分類」や「予防情報」であり、新規アウトブレイク確認ではない。現在の流行状況の詳細情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事は主に医学的リスク分類と入国制限について述べており、具体的な患者数、死亡者数、新規確認事例の詳細が記載されていない。「新規アウトブレイク」の言及はあるが、その詳細は不明。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、検証対象としてはDRCのみが対象国である。ただしウガンダは記事の主題として重要なため参考情報として併記した。

article.articleHeadline: กรมวิทย์ฯเตรียม BSL-3 ตรวจวินิจฉัยอีโบลาและระบบความปลอดภัยสูงสุดย้ำประสานหน่วยงานที่เกี่ยวข้องเฝ้าระวัง | เดลินิวส์
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Department of Medical Sciences prepares BSL-3 for Ebola diagnostics and the highest safety standards, reiterating coordination with relevant agencies for surveillance.
article.articleSummary: On May 22, 2026, Thailand’s Ministry of Public Health directed all affiliated agencies to heighten surveillance, prevention, and readiness as the WHO declares the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda a public health emergency of international concern. The Department of Medical Sciences prioritizes laboratory readiness and biosafety, reviewing and strengthening BSL-3 capabilities, PPE, and high-risk sample transport to enable swift response. Real-time RT-PCR will be used for rapid confirmation of suspected cases, with results within eight hours of receiving samples. The institute overseeing public health science research will enhance genomic and molecular surveillance, coordinate nationwide sample referral networks, and train personnel to ensure biosafety and operational safety. Sample collection and transport must comply with biosafety principles as part of a nationwide emergency readiness plan.

triage.headline_ja: 医科学部がBSL-3でエボラ診断と最高レベルの安全基準を準備、関連機関との連携強化を重申 | デイリーニュース
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準で3項目に該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、貿易制限リスク）。WHO PHEIC宣言済みのエボラウイルス病の地域拡大に対する国境を越えた準備体制の強化が報告されており、シグナルとしてのピックアップが必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダで確認されたBundibugyo株エボラウイルス病がWHO PHEICとして宣言されており、タイが国境を越えた防御体制を強化している状況。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めず、DRCとタイのみ記載。タイでの直接的な発症報告はないが、地域公衆衛生危機への準備活動が記録されている。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : une forte  panique autour d'un centre de traitement de l'épidémie de virus Ebola en Ituri - LePotentiel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: a major panic around a treatment center for the Ebola virus epidemic in Ituri
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ituri province escalates amid violence at an ALIMA-supported treatment center. On May 21, facilities were set alight by angry individuals after the death of a patient deemed a suspect; six patients escaped, including three confirmed cases and three suspects, prompting military protection for medical staff. As of May 21, the Ministry of Health reported more than 600 probable Ebola cases and 139 probable deaths linked to the outbreak. Specialists note there is no licensed vaccine or approved therapy for the Bundibugyo strain, complicating field management. Authorities warn that corpse handling remains a key transmission vector, and resistance to safe burial protocols—driven by mistrust and rumors—hampers response efforts. Police and humanitarian groups urge community cooperation and enhanced security at care centers to prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：イトゥリ州のエボラウイルス感染症流行対応の治療センター周辺で大規模なパニック発生
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確定例を含む600件超の可能性事例と139件の死亡が報告されており、治療センターが襲撃されて患者が逃亡するなど、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大のリスクが明確である。IHR基準3つ以上該当、WPRO基準全項目が該当する。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola strain（ブンディブギョ株）はワクチンやライセンス取得済みの治療法がなく、治療が複雑である。暴動による治療センター襲撃、患者脱出（確定例3名を含む）、埋葬に対する住民の不信感による安全埋葬プロトコルへの抵抗など、対応活動に重大な障害が生じている。医療スタッフへの暴力的脅威が存在し、地域の信頼構築と安全保障の強化が急務である。

article.articleHeadline: Marco Rubio accuse l'OMS d'être responsable des retards dans la détection de l'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Marco Rubio accuses the WHO of being responsible for delays in detecting Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda continues to expand. At a WHO briefing, 51 cases have been confirmed in DRC, with about 600 suspected cases and 139 deaths; officials warn the true burden is far higher due to delayed detection. The WHO said it declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern after Director-General Tedros announced the global emergency, and the IHR Emergency Committee met for the first time in response. Diagnosis was challenging: the WHO was alerted on May 5 and sent a team to Ituri; initial tests were negative because they targeted the Zaire ebolavirus strain, not Bundibugyo. Samples had to travel about 1,700 km to Kinshasa for confirmation, which identified Bundibugyo on May 14. Ituri is destabilized by conflict with more than 100,000 displaced people; the outbreak affects a war-torn region linked to Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: マルコ・ルビオがWHOをエボラウイルスの検出遅延の責任者として非難
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。DRC・ウガンダでのエボラ流行拡大、PHEIC宣言、国際的拡大リスク、死亡139例・確定51例・疑い600例の深刻な公衆衛生影響が認められる。
triage.notes: ウガンダも記事中で言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCは対象国（GeoNames ID 203312）であり、記事の主題となるエボラ流行はDRC（特にIturi州とKinshasa市）で発生。PHEIC宣言済み、Bundibugyo ebolavirus株による流行であり、検出遅延（May 5アラート、May 14確認）が政治的問題として取り上げられている。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola Outbreak: Angry Mob Burns Hospital Isolation Tents After Patient's Death - www.lokmattimes.com
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, centered at Rwampara General Hospital in Ituri, sparked violence when relatives of a patient blocked burial rules; an angry mob burned two isolation tents and a body awaiting burial, with a healthcare worker injured and staff placed under military protection. At the time, six Ebola patients were in tents at the hospital; later authorities said all patients remained in care. WHO notes safe and dignified burials; reported deaths: about 139 among ~600 suspected cases, with Congolese Health Minister citing 159 fatalities. The Bundibugyo strain, for which no vaccine exists, may take up to nine months for an effective vaccine. Cross-border spread reached Uganda (two infections); Uganda halted border movements along the Semliki River. The outbreak prompted M23 rebels to report a confirmed Ebola case in South Kivu (28-year-old from Kisangani); Kisangani reportedly had no cases. WHO classifies PHEIC but not pandemic.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行：患者死亡後、怒った群衆が病院の隔離テントを焼き払う
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の暴力事象、国際的拡大リスク、国境措置実施）。Bundibugyo株による大規模流行で死亡率が高く、国家間の医療危機管理が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでウガンダへの越境感染2件が記載されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。コンゴ民主共和国はリストに含まれる。エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）、約600疑い患者中約139～159名の死亡、医療施設での暴力事象、国際的対応（WHO PHEIC認定、ウガンダの国境対策）により、極めて高い優先度でフルRRAが必要。

article.articleHeadline: تأهب وقائي في بيروت: "الصحة اللبنانية" ترفع وتيرة رصد "إيبولا" بالتنسيق مع غرف الطوارئ الدولية - جنوبية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beirut on preventive alert: Lebanon's Ministry of Public Health ramps up "Ebola" surveillance in coordination with international emergency rooms - South.
article.articleSummary: Lebanon’s Ministry of Public Health raised preventive alert and tightened Ebola surveillance in coordination with the WHO and international emergency rooms amid the Bundibugyo strain outbreak in East Africa. The outbreak is attributed to a rare, deadly Ebola lineage with no licensed vaccine or established specific therapy. Affected areas include the Democratic Republic of Congo (notably Ituri and Bunia) and adjacent Uganda border regions, with estimates exceeding 600 suspected cases and about 139 deaths to date. The WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern; Africa CDC followed with a continental emergency. Lebanon reports daily risk assessments and ongoing coordination with WHO, noting no travel or trade restrictions or border controls have been enacted yet. Ebola transmission occurs mainly through direct contact with an infected person’s blood, bodily fluids, secretions, or contaminated surfaces; initial symptoms are referenced but not detailed in the excerpt.

triage.headline_ja: ベイルート警戒態勢：レバノン保健省がエボラ出血熱の監視を強化、国際的な緊急対応室と連携 - 南部地域
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の東アフリカでの大規模流行（600疑い例以上、139死亡）であり、IHR基準4項目全て該当。WHO国際的懸念対象である公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言済み。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが複数国を発生地域として指示しているが、記事サマリーの詳細な読み込みにより、実際のエボラ出血熱Bundibugyo株の流行地は東アフリカのDRC（特にIturi州Bunia市）及びウガンダ国境地域に限定される。レバノンは流行地ではなく、予防的警戒態勢を敷く受け取り国である。したがって対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。Ugandaも地理的に流行に関連しているがGeoNames IDリストに含まれないため、検証済み位置には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: India, African Union postpone key summits amid Ebola concerns
article.articleSummary: Ebola concerns prompt India and the African Union to postpone two key summits scheduled for 28 May–1 June, due to the evolving health situation in parts of Africa. On 21 May, a joint statement from the Indian Ministry of External Affairs and the African Union said delaying the meetings would ensure full participation of African leaders amid the public health situation on the continent. Consequently, the first International Big Cat Alliance (IBCA) Summit planned for 1 June in New Delhi has been rescheduled, with the chairperson of the African Union Commission agreeing to convene the Fourth India-Africa Forum Summit at a later date. The Environment Ministry stated the IBCA summit will be held later to guarantee broad participation from range countries, including African nations.

triage.headline_ja: インド・アフリカ連合、エボラ懸念の中で重要サミットを延期
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的懸念を受けた行政対応であり、実際の発生ではなく予防的措置。情報不足のため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事はインドでのエボラ発生を報じたものではなく、アフリカでのエボラ懸念を理由とした外交的なサミット延期の決定を扱っている。実際の症例報告や確定患者情報は記事に含まれていない。Bluedotの地域検証ではNew Delhi、India、Africaが含まれているが、記事の主題はインド国内での外交対応であり、アフリカでの具体的な発生状況については詳細が示されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Россиянам перечислили категории граждан, которые находятся в группе риска Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russians were informed of the categories of citizens who are in the Ebola risk group.
article.articleSummary: Elderly people and diabetics are identified as the groups most at risk for Ebola, according to Ugandan physician Elijah Kiiza, who has treated Ebola patients. He notes that in these high-risk groups symptoms tend to appear rapidly, while children typically develop symptoms after about 10–11 days; pregnant women are also considered particularly vulnerable. Amid an Ebola outbreak, the United States has banned entry for foreign nationals who have traveled to the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), Uganda, or South Sudan within the past 21 days. In Russia, Alexander Gintsburg, director of the Gamaleya National Research Center for Epidemiology and Microbiology, seeks to reassure that Ebola does not pose a threat to Russian citizens.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア国民にエボラウイルスのリスク グループに属する市民の カテゴリーについて知らされた
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの感染症イベントであり、DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンでの発生が報告されているが、対象国内での具体的な感染者数、死亡者、入院患者数などの重症度情報が不明確である。米国の入国制限措置が講じられており国際的な関心はあるが、詳細な流行状況の情報が限定的なため。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはUnited States、Russian Federation、Ugandaが含まれているが、記事サマリーを精査するとエボラの実際の発生地域はDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンであり、米国とロシアは関連情報の発信国または政策対応国である。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当するため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。記事は高リスク層の特性とロシアでの政府当局の見解を述べており、具体的な発生規模・重症度データが不足している。

article.articleHeadline: Hong Kong issues red travel alert for DRC as Ebola cases rise
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong issues Red outbound travel alert to the Democratic Republic of Congo as Ebola cases surge in Central Africa. The Congolese government declared the outbreak on Friday; it is now the third-largest on record with 670 suspected cases and 160 suspected deaths, per DRC health ministry data cited by Reuters. WHO declared fresh Ebola outbreaks in the DRC and Uganda a public-health emergency of international concern. Hong Kong’s red alert—second level in a three-tier system—cautions residents to avoid non-essential travel amid a very high risk of local transmission should importation occur, though no confirmed local cases have been reported and current risk remains low. The Department of Health has border screening; 11 individuals who had visited affected regions were assessed May 17–20 with none suspected. If needed, rapid testing protocols will be activated. DRC residents in Hong Kong may contact 1868 hotline, WhatsApp, WeChat, or the local embassy (243) 851474669. Vaccines for Bundibugyo Ebola virus could take 6–9 months.

triage.headline_ja: 香港がコンゴ民主共和国への赤色渡航警告を発令、エボラ患者数増加に対応
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。WHOが国際的懸念事項として宣言されたエボラ感染症の急速な拡大であり、複数国への波及、渡航制限の実施、深刻な公衆衛生影響が確認されている。
triage.notes: DRCでの最大級規模のエボラ流行（670疑似患者、160疑似死亡）が報告されており、UgandaでのWHO宣言に加えてDRCでも国際的懸念事項として認定。香港（China）による赤色渡航警告の発令は、地域的な関心と対応レベルの高さを示唆。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。現在のところ香港での確認患者はなく、国境スクリーニングが実施中。

article.articleHeadline: American missionary doctor contracts Ebola, evacuates DRC - Mission Network News
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo-strain Ebola outbreak in Ituri Province, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), centered on Bunia. The World Health Organization has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern; this is the 17th recorded Ebola outbreak in the DRC since 1976. American physician Dr. Peter Stafford tested positive for Ebola and was evacuated from the DRC to Uganda, then Germany for specialized treatment; his wife, their children, and another doctor exposed to the virus were evacuated by Mission Aviation Fellowship (MAF). Stafford remains symptomatic but improving. Transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids and not airborne, though the virus can persist on hard surfaces for days. There is no approved vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo. MAF operates with an Ebola Management Plan (temperature checks, PPE, sanitization) from Nyankunde Hospital, with Bunia as the operations base; additional evacuations continue under these procedures.

triage.headline_ja: アメリカ人宣教師医師がエボラ出血熱に感染し、コンゴ民主共和国から避難
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO緊急事態宣言済み、複数国への患者移送、専門治療施設への国際的搬送が実現している。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはウガンダとドイツも含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRCにおけるエボラ出血熱の発生であり、ウガンダとドイツは患者の搬送経路・治療地点に過ぎない。したがって verified_locations はDRCのみ。WHO PHEIC宣言、Bundibugyo株（治療法なし）、医療従事者への感染、複数国への患者搬送により高度に優先度が高い。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Covid, hantavirus, ebola... post-outbreak rush can't protect people: Virologist on pandemic scare
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda, caused by Bundibugyo virus, went undetected for weeks because tests targeted only the Zaire strain. By mid-May the DRC and Uganda declared an outbreak; at least 575 suspected cases, 51 confirmed, and 148 suspected deaths, with true figures likely higher due to limited testing. An Imperial College London analysis estimates 800–1,000 infections by outbreak declaration. WHO has declared a public health emergency but notes Ebola is not pandemic and is not airborne; transmission occurs via close contact with bodily fluids. Initial false negatives and subsequent healthcare worker infections signal unrecognised transmission; cases in Kinshasa and Kampala indicate spread through human mobility networks. With no Bundibugyo-specific vaccines or therapeutics, priorities are Bundibugyo-virus diagnostics, rapid genomic sequencing, infection prevention in healthcare settings, safe clinical pathways, contact tracing, community engagement, and high-quality supportive care. Experimental antibodies exist but are not a substitute for rapid detection and containment.

triage.headline_ja: Covid、ハンタウイルス、エボラ...アウトブレイク後の急いだ対応は人々を守ることができない：ウイルス学者がパンデミック懸念について語る
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（ブンディブギョ株）によるアウトブレイクがDRCとウガンダで発生。IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WHO公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言、500件以上の疑似症例と148件の疑い死亡を含む重大な公衆衛生影響、ヒト-ヒト感染による国際的拡大リスク、および医療従事者感染を示唆する情報から、フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: 記事ではウガンダも言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めていない。DRCは対象国である。アウトブレイク検出の遅延（Zaire株のみをターゲットとしたテスト）、医療施設での感染拡大、ワクチンおよび治療法の不備が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Air France flight to U.S. diverted to Montreal due to Ebola travel restrictions
article.articleSummary: An Air France flight AFR378 bound for Detroit was diverted to Montreal after a Congolese traveler, who boarded in Paris, was blocked under Ebola-related entry rules. U.S. Customs and Border Protection said the passenger should not have boarded under new restrictions requiring travelers from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda or South Sudan to enter the United States through Washington Dulles for enhanced screening. As of May 21, all U.S.-bound citizens or permanent residents who have been in those countries in the prior 21 days must use Dulles. Air France noted the traveler was denied entry and has since flown back to Paris; Montreal public health officials assessed the traveler as asymptomatic. Flight AFR378—and all other passengers—continued to Detroit. The World Health Organization declared Ebola a public health emergency of international concern on May 17, linked to Bundibugyo virus, for which there is no vaccine or treatment.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ関連の渡航制限によりエアフランス便がモントリオールに迂回
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo）がWHOにより5月17日に国際的懸念事項として宣言され、IHR基準の国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限が該当。複数国への波及と実際の渡航規制措置が発動されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的懸念がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはエボラ発生地がコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）、ウガンダ、南スーダンであることを示唆。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。エアフランス便迂回はカナダの地名が含まれているが、イベント発生地はDRCとアメリカの渡航制限措置に関連する北米での対応。WHOの公式宣言（PHEIC）により、シグナルとしての確実性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Response group targets Ebola vaccine within 100 days
article.articleSummary: CEPI targets a 100-day vaccine response for the Bundibugyo Ebola strain as the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda intensifies. CEPI funds candidate vaccines and seeks a vaccine for Bundibugyo, for which none exists. The World Health Organization has declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern. There are 671 suspected cases across DRC and Uganda, with 160 suspected deaths in the DRC. Two Ebola cases have been confirmed in Uganda; another case detected in South Kivu, eastern DRC, hundreds of kilometres from the outbreak’s epicentre. In Bukavu area, one confirmed case and one death have been reported, with a second suspected case isolated pending test results. Officials warn the virus may have circulated undetected for nearly two months before being identified last week in Ituri province. Containment is hampered by ongoing conflict, including between the Congolese army and the M23 group.

triage.headline_ja: 対応グループは100日以内のエボラワクチンを目指す
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当。WHOが国際的懸念の公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言したBundibugyo Ebolaの多国間アウトブレイク。671疑似症例、160死亡が報告され、既にウガンダで確定症例がある。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（Republic of Uganda）は対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを列挙。記事ではDRCとウガンダの両国でのアウトブレイクが述べられているが、トリアージ対象はDRCのみ。WHOのPHEIC宣言、100日以内のワクチン開発という時間的制約、武力紛争による封じ込めの困難さが特筆される。既存ワクチンのない Bundibugyo 株という点も重要。

article.articleHeadline: എബോള: വിദേശത്തുനിന്നും കേരളത്തിൽ എത്തുന്നവർ 21 ദിവസം നിരീക്ഷണത്തിൽ കഴിയണം | Ebola: Those arriving in Kerala from abroad must remain under observation for 21 days | Madhyamam
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Those arriving in Kerala from abroad must remain under observation for 21 days
article.articleSummary: Kerala mandates a 21-day health observation for arrivals from abroad due to Ebola risk, as advised by the World Health Organization and the central government. Ebola has been confirmed in the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan; travelers from these countries to India must follow special guidelines. India has not reported Ebola currently and there is no cause for alarm. If fever, fatigue, headache, muscle pains, vomiting, diarrhea, sore throat, or bleeding occur, report to the airport health authorities; those with direct contact with confirmed or suspected Ebola patients should also report. Kerala’s international airports and seaports have screening and isolation facilities, with intensive-care arrangements for those needing care. The state rapid-action council, chaired by Minister K. Muraleedharan, approved the preparedness, with participation from officials including Additional Chief Secretary Dr. Rajan Khobragade, NHM state director, AYUSH Mission Director Dr. Sajithkumar, Health Department Director Dr. K. J. Reen, and Medical Education Director Dr. Vishwanathan. Published 2026-05-22.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：海外からケーララ州に到着した者は21日間の観察下に置かれなければならない
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の複数国での確認と国際的な拡大リスク、インドへの輸入リスク評価、および公衆衛生上の重大な懸念から、IHR基準を複数満たし、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、エボラ確定患者がいるのはDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンであるが、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当するため検証済み地域に含める。インドはエボラ輸入リスク評価と防御対策の実施地として記載されているため含める。ウガンダとスーダンは対象国外のため除外。記事は2026年5月配信で未来日付だが、公開情報として処理。

article.articleHeadline: മൃതദേഹം വിട്ടുനൽകിയില്ല; കോംഗോയിൽ എബോള ചികിത്സാ കേന്ദ്രം ജനക്കൂട്ടം തീയിട്ടു നശിപ്പിച്ചു | Body not handed over: Angry mob sets fire to Ebola treatment center in Congo | Madhyamam
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Body not handed over: Angry mob sets fire to Ebola treatment center in Congo
article.articleSummary: An Ebola treatment center in Rampaar, Ituri Province, Congo, was set on fire by an angry mob amid protests over not releasing the body of a local Ebola victim to relatives. Authorities had refused, citing the high transmission risk from Ebola-contaminated corpses and the need for strict funeral protocols. A group of youths stormed the facility, damaging the building and patient tents; one body and the tents were burned. Police used tear gas and fired into the air to restore order, but could not prevent the attack. Six patients currently under care at the center were evacuated safely to another hospital. Volunteers at the site fled in vehicles due to security concerns. The incident underscores distrust of Ebola control measures in the region and raises concerns for healthcare workers during outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: 遺体が引き渡されず：コンゴの怒った群衆がエボラ治療センターに放火
triage.triage_reason: DRCのイトゥリ州でエボラ患者を扱う医療施設が群衆に破壊された事件であり、IHR基準2つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常・予想外の出来事）し、エボラウイルス感染症の国際的拡大リスク、および地域での感染制御対策への信頼喪失を示すため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: エボラ治療施設への暴力的破壊行為であり、医療従事者の安全脅威、患者の安全確保の課題、感染制御措置への社会的不信を示す重大な事件。DRC内での感染拡大リスク、および国際的な感染症危機管理への影響が懸念される。記事はマラヤーラム語（インド言語）であるが、イベント本体はDRCのイトゥリ州での発生が明確。

article.articleHeadline: Επιδημία Έμπολα στo Κονγκό: 160 νεκροί, 671 ύποπτα κρούσματα - Dnews
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo: 160 dead, 671 suspected cases - Dnews.
article.articleSummary: As of May 22, 2026, Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues in Ituri province near Uganda and South Sudan, with 671 suspected cases and 160 deaths attributed to Ebola to date. The Ministry of Health confirms 64 infections and six deaths through laboratory testing. The World Health Organization had previously logged about 600 suspected cases and 130 deaths, cautioning that the true burden may be higher due to underreporting. The outbreak stems from the rare Bundibugyo strain, for which there are no vaccines or specific therapies, complicating containment. Transmission occurs via close contact with infected individuals or their bodily fluids. In neighboring Uganda, two nationals of the DRC were reported; one died, the other tested negative two days earlier and remained under treatment. This marks the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC since 1976, with the region recalling the 2014–2015 epidemic that killed over 11,000 people.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ流行：160人の死亡、671人の疑い例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラは公衆衛生上の重大な脅威であり、複数国への拡大リスク、国際的な関心が高い。稀なBundibugyo株で治療法がないため管理が困難。
triage.notes: ウガンダで2人のDRC国籍患者が報告されているが、記事の主題はDRCでの発生。DRCが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に DRC のみ列挙。稀な Bundibugyo 株でワクチン・特異的治療がなく、過去の 2014-2015 年流行（11,000人以上死亡）との比較から高い重症度が示唆される。Ituri 州はウガンダ・南スーダン国境近くにあり国際的拡大リスクが顕著。

article.articleHeadline: Una multitud enfurecida prende fuego a tiendas de campaña de un hospital para tratar el ébola en República Democrática del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An enraged mob sets fire to hospital tents to treat Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri province) escalates as violence disrupts response at Rwampara hospital: a deceased Ebola patient’s body, treated in tents, was said to be highly infectious; protesters burned two tents and a burial team faced a hostile crowd, injuring a health worker. WHO urges safe, dignified burials with protective gear; six patients remained in hospital tents, potentially having fled during the chaos. The outbreak, a Bundibugyo variant, has caused about 130–159 deaths and roughly 600 suspected cases across the DRC; WHO reported 139 deaths, the Congolese health minister 159. Uganda temporarily closed cross-border transport after two imported cases; ferries on the Semliki River were suspended. Separately, the M23 rebel group said a first Ebola case was confirmed in South Kivu, involving a traveler from Kisangani; the patient died before confirmation. No vaccine exists for Bundibugyo; development could take up to nine months.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ治療病院のテントが暴徒に放火される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。Bundibugyo型エボラアウトブレイク、死亡130-159例、疑似患者600例、暴力による対応混乱、ウガンダへの越境拡大確認。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラ、ワクチン未開発。ウガンダとルワンダへの越境拡大の可能性あり（ウガンダは国内でも支援国として対象国外だが、DRCからの越境ケース報告あり）。南キブ州のM23支配地域での確認例は既に死亡。暴力による保健対応の深刻な阻害が懸念。

article.articleHeadline: എബോള വൈറസ് ബാധ ഭീതി, ഇന്ത്യ-ആഫ്രിക്ക ഉച്ചകോടി മാറ്റിവെച്ചു
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fear of Ebola virus infection, India–Africa summit postponed.
article.articleSummary: As of May 22, 2026, the India–Africa High-Level Summit planned in Delhi has been postponed due to an Ebola outbreak spreading in West Africa. The summit, intended for leaders and representatives from more than fifty African countries, was deferred after discussions with the African Union to prioritize health security and prevent potential virus transmission from the large foreign delegation. Despite the postponement, India said diplomatic engagements with the African Union and other official channels would continue without disruption. The decision underscores public health considerations in scheduling high-level meetings during active infectious disease outbreaks, while awaiting calmer conditions and safer travel and gatherings. No new date was announced; future planning will depend on the evolving health situation.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス感染の恐怖、インド・アフリカ首脳会談が延期された
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の西アフリカでの流行により国際的な高級会議が延期されるという事象が報告されている。IHR基準では国際的拡大リスク（基準3）と渡航制限リスク（基準4）が該当し、WPRIOスクリーニング基準では異常性・予想外性（基準1）と流行しやすさ（基準4）が該当する。また社会政治的関心も明らかに存在する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではエボラ流行は西アフリカで発生しており、インド・アフリカ首脳会談の延期がインド（デリー）の文脈で報告されている。直接的なエボラ症例がインドで発生しているわけではなく、流行地域（西アフリカ）からの感染伝播リスクを理由とした予防的措置である。対象国リストに含まれるアフリカ国（ザンビア、ガーナ、DRC、アンゴラなど）が該当する可能性があるが、記事サマリーでは具体的な発生国の特定がない。しかしインドでの会議延期決定という明確なイベントがあり、国際的影響が存在するため verified_locations はインドのみとする。

article.articleHeadline: Саммит Индии и Африканского союза отложили из-за вспышки Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: India–African Union Summit postponed due to Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: India–Africa Summit in New Delhi, scheduled for May 28–31, has been postponed due to an Ebola outbreak in Africa. New dates will be announced in due course. The Ebola outbreak involves Uganda and the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), with the World Health Organization declaring a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on May 17. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; there are currently no approved vaccines or treatments. As of May 20, WHO reported 600 suspected Ebola cases and 139 suspected deaths. Of these, 51 cases have been laboratory-confirmed in the DRC, and two cases in neighboring Uganda. The summit aims to deepen cooperation across trade, investment, innovation, development, digital technologies, sustainable development, and global governance.

triage.headline_ja: インド・アフリカ連合首脳会談、エボラ出血熱の流行により延期
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の多国間での流行であり、WHOがPHEIC宣言（5月17日）、国際的影響は深刻。対象国（DRC、インド）における確認症例と国際的懸念が明確に示されている。
triage.notes: サマリーで明示されたイベント：DRCおよびウガンダでのエボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）流行。WHO PHEIC宣言済み。インド・アフリカ連合首脳会談（ニューデリー予定）の延期という政治的影響も確認。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations からは除外。インドはサマリーでニューデリーでの首脳会談延期という重要な背景として言及されており、対象国であるため含める。

article.articleHeadline: Norge bidrar med 50 millioner kroner til å bekjempe ebolautbrudd
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Norway contributes 50 million kroner to combat an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak confirmed May 15 in Ituri province, northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo, with Uganda also affected. The World Health Organization has declared the outbreak an international public health emergency. It involves a rare Ebola virus variant for which there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment. Norway allocates 50 million Norwegian kroner to WHO’s Health Emergency Fund to enable rapid funding for outbreak response, aiming to halt transmission quickly; the fund can disburse within 24 hours. WHO has already released 3.9 million U.S. dollars to the Ebola response. Norway is among the largest funders, contributing over 46% of the fund’s financing in 2025. The situation underscores the need for swift, early-action measures to save lives locally and globally. Keywords: vaccination, outbreak, public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: ノルウェーがエボラ出血熱の流行対策に5000万ノルウェークローネを拠出
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準の4項目すべてに該当し、WHOが国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言している。DRCでの確認に加えウガンダも影響を受けており、ワクチン未承認の稀少株が関与している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（Ituri州）での5月15日の確認とウガンダの影響が明記されている。ただしウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。ノルウェーは資金提供国として言及されているが、発生国ではないため除外。WHO による国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言、ワクチン未承認の稀少株、複数国への拡大という点で最高レベルのリスク評価。

article.articleHeadline: Air France flight to Detroit diverted to Montreal over Ebola fears
article.articleSummary: Air France flight from Paris to Detroit was diverted to Montreal after authorities flagged a passenger from the Democratic Republic of Congo, a country among three under a U.S. travel ban tied to Ebola fears. The May 22, 2026 report by Mike Armstrong details the mid-air diversion, explains why the traveler was able to board despite the ban, and describes the challenging scramble to develop an Ebola vaccine in response to the threat. The incident underscores ongoing public health vigilance around Ebola and the dynamic tension between travel restrictions and outbreak response, as authorities weigh screening and risk assessment while rapid vaccine research advances in parallel.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱への懸念でエールフランス機がデトロイト便からモントリオールに迂回
triage.triage_reason: エボラ熱という高リスク病原体に関連した国際的な渡航制限・迂回イベントであり、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。DRCでの発生地域から複数国への国際的な拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限、高い社会的・政治的関心がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCでのエボラ発生を主題としており、カナダ・米国・フランスの記載は国際的な影響・迂回地としての役割に過ぎない。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当し、ワクチン開発の進展など動的な公衆衛生対応が進行中である。

article.articleHeadline: AP: в ДР Конго подожгли центр лечения Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: AP: Ebola treatment center set on fire in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola treatment center in Rwamparé, Democratic Republic of Congo, was set on fire by local youths after they were denied permission to retrieve the body of a friend who reportedly died from Ebola. Deputy Senior Commissioner Jean-Claude Mukendi said mourners did not know burial rules, noting that all bodies linked to Ebola must be buried according to established guidelines. Family members and others had wanted to take the body home to bury it, despite authorities’ instructions during the outbreak. The incident comes amid ongoing concerns about Ebola transmission; the World Health Organization has data on nearly 600 suspected Ebola cases across the DRC and Uganda. Public health officials stress safe burial practices and controlled handling of patients and bodies, while authorities investigate the arson and continue outbreak surveillance as of May 22, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: AP: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ治療センターが放火される
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認・疑い症例が約600件（DRC・ウガンダ合計）報告されており、IHR基準4つ全て該当。社会的関心も高く、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。エボラの実際の感染者は600件の疑い例に含まれる可能性がある。治療センターの放火は感染対策の混乱を示し、アウトブレーク制御の困難さを反映している。DRCでの対応能力に懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: Manifestantes incendian centro de tratamiento de ébola en la RDC: exigían la entrega del cuerpo de un familiar - La Tercera
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Protesters set fire to an Ebola treatment center in the DRC: they demanded the return of a relative's body.
article.articleSummary: Protesters set fire to an Ebola treatment center in Rwampara, Ituri, northeast Democratic Republic of the Congo, amid an ongoing Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak. The ALIMA NGO stated six patients at the emergency facility are now receiving hospital care. The attack endangered lives and damaged essential equipment, complicating patient safety, while ALIMA and health authorities coordinate to limit impact. Local reports said a patient suspected of Ebola died at the center on the same day, and authorities initially withheld the body from the family. Police failed to quell the unrest. Ituri’s security head cited burial protocol confusion among the deceased's friends. The Bundibugyo strain remains without specific treatment or vaccine. The outbreak has about 500 confirmed cases and over 130 suspected deaths, with the hardest-hit areas including Mongbwalu and Rwampara in Ituri; cases also reported in Bunia, Nyakunde (Ituri), and in Butembo and Goma (North Kivu).

triage.headline_ja: 抗議者がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ治療センターに放火：親族の遺体の返却を要求
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の進行中の流行におけるインシデントで、IHR基準を複数該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。治療施設への攻撃により患者安全が脅かされており、緊急対応が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola株の流行中（約500確定例、130以上の死亡疑い例）に治療センター襲撃が発生。地域の不安定性と医療施設への暴力的アクセス阻害が感染対策を著しく複雑化させている。ルワンダ（Kigali Province）はBluedot APIで検出されているが、記事サマリー上では患者発生地として明記されていないため、verified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: 野生動物の肉に埋葬儀式、そして偽情報　コンゴがエボラ感染の震源地と化すまで
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Burial rites for wild game meat, and misinformation: how Congo became the epicenter of the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) in the rural Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has claimed over 100 lives, triggering a global public health emergency. The outbreak is driven by the rare Bundibugyo Ebola strain, for which there is currently no approved vaccine or treatment (unlike the Zaire strain). EVD causes high fever and severe illness with internal and external bleeding, spreading rapidly via contact with infected body fluids or contaminated surfaces. Spillover originates from bushmeat consumption and contact with infected wildlife species—bats, porcupines, grasscutters, and antelope—and human-to-human transmission sustains transmission chains. The DRC has experienced 17 Ebola outbreaks since 1976; the 2018–2020 outbreak alone caused 2,299 deaths. Ongoing challenges include misinformation and burial practices, with frontline workers depicted transporting victims’ bodies during response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: 野生動物の肉に埋葬儀式、そして偽情報　コンゴがエボラ感染の震源地と化すまで
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）がDRCで100人以上の死亡を伴う急速な流行を示しており、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威として認識されている。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola株は認可ワクチン・治療法がなく、Zaire株よりも管理が困難。野生動物との接触による人獣共通感染および埋葬慣行による人間への伝播リスクが高い。DRCの過去の大規模流行歴（2018-2020年で2,299人死亡）から地域的な管理能力への懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: S. Korea Expands Travel Ban for Ebola in Congo
article.articleSummary: Effective 2 pm on 2026-05-22, South Korea issues Level 4 travel alert for Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, amid a rising Ebola death toll. No-travel zones now cover Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu; South Korean nationals visiting or staying in these areas without exceptional passport-use authorization may face penalties under the passport law. A Level 3 alert covers areas within 50 kilometers of the border with the Central African Republic and seven additional DR Congo provinces, including Bas-Uele and Haut-Uele. A special travel advisory remains for the rest of DR Congo. Additionally, a special advisory applies to all of Uganda after the Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency designated DR Congo, Uganda and South Sudan as priority quarantine management countries for Ebola. Outbreaks in eastern DR Congo continue to rise, with more than 160 suspected deaths reported by foreign media.

triage.headline_ja: 韓国、コンゴのエボラ拡大に伴い渡航禁止区域を拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数項目に該当。エボラウイルス病の東コンゴにおける流行拡大と国際的な対応（渡航禁止、隔離管理指定）が確認され、フルRRA実施が必要。
