The outbreak, spreading from Ituri into South Kivu and toward Uganda, has the WHO assessing national and regional risk as high and global risk as low. In Goma and Bunia, checkpoints implement handwashing, masks, and temperature screening as authorities tighten measures. In the town of Rwampara, relatives clashed with health workers over burial practices, underscoring unsafe burials as a key transmission driver. Uganda suspends public passenger transport from DR Congo for four weeks to curb cross-border spread, given ongoing shared risk. Nearly 600 suspected cases and more than 130 suspected deaths have been linked to Congo and Uganda. Scientists are testing experimental vaccines and building isolation wards; CEPIs warns the true scale may be much larger than reported.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の症例がコンゴ民主共和国の反政府勢力支配地域で確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）の国際的リスク評価は高く、ウガンダへの越境拡大リスク、死亡例、治療法やワクチン不足が顕著。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはUganda（226074）も含まれているが、サマリーでは「Uganda suspends public passenger transport from DR Congo」と記述されており、ウガンダでの越境拡大リスク評価段階。実際の症例確認はDRCに限定されているため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。Bundibugyo株エボラはワクチン・治療法が未承認で、約600疑い例、130名以上の疑い死亡。WHO評価では国・地域リスクは高く、実際の規模がより大きい可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو.. تسجيل 160 وفاة والاشتباه بإصابة 671 شخصا بفيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: 160 deaths recorded and 671 people suspected of Ebola infection.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak is centered in Ituri province in the northeast, near Uganda and South Sudan. The ministry reports 160 deaths and 671 suspected infections; laboratory tests have confirmed 64 cases and 6 deaths. The World Health Organization cites nearly 600 suspected cases and more than 130 suspected deaths, noting the true numbers are likely higher due to underreporting. In neighboring Uganda, authorities report no new confirmed cases; two Congolese nationals linked to the outbreak—one has died, the other again tested negative and remains under treatment. The outbreak involves the rare Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain, for which there is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment, complicating containment. Ebola is highly contagious, spreading through direct contact with infected individuals or body fluids. This marks the seventeenth Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo since 1976; the country endured over 11,000 deaths in the 2014–2015 West Africa epidemic.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ共和国：160人の死亡が確認され、671人がエボラウイルス感染の疑いがある
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの集団発生でありIHR基準4つすべてに該当し、DRCは対象国に含まれている。重症度が高く（160死亡、671疑い例）、国際的に関心が集中する公衆衛生上の緊急事態。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola株はワクチンが存在しないため、公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。ウガンダでは隣国からの流入事例が報告されており、地域的な拡大リスクが存在する。DRCは2014-2015年西アフリカエボラ流行で11,000以上の死亡を記録しており、対応能力に懸念がある。

article.articleHeadline: Κονγκό: Ο Εμπολα έχει ήδη σκοτώσει 160 ανθρώπους | Η ΚΑΘΗΜΕΡΙΝΗ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: Ebola has already killed 160 people | Kathimerini
article.articleSummary: An Ebola virus disease outbreak is ongoing in the Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri province in the northeast near Uganda and South Sudan. The Ministry of Health reports 671 suspected cases and 160 deaths to date, with 64 infections and six deaths laboratory-confirmed. The World Health Organization noted nearly 600 suspected cases and 130 deaths, warning that actual numbers are likely higher due to underreporting. The outbreak is attributed to the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, for which there are no vaccines or specific therapies, hindering containment. Two Congolese nationals in Uganda have been reported; one died, the other tested negative two days earlier and remained under treatment. This marks the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC since 1976. Ebola transmission occurs through close contact with infected individuals or their bodily fluids. Past large outbreaks, notably 2014–2015, caused over 11,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：エボラが既に160人を殺害
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱は高致死性で国際的な懸念対象。DRCでの継続的な流行、ウガンダへの越境事例、ワクチン・治療法の欠如により、深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際的拡大リスクが明らかである。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC（Ituri州）での流行を主題としており、ウガンダとスーダンへの言及は越境例または隣接国情報。対象国リストにはDRCのみが含まれるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。671例の疑い患者と160人の死亡が報告され、検査確認例は64例、死亡6例。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株で、ワクチンなし。第17次流行。国際的な懸念は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: طوارئ فى العالم بسبب فيروس إيبولا.. رئيس الرابطة الطبية الأوروبية يوضح خطورته - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Global emergency worldwide due to the Ebola virus — President of the European Medical Association explains its danger — Youm7
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization declared a public health emergency of international concern over a new Ebola strain sweeping the Democratic Republic of Congo, with over 1,000 infections and a genetic profile distinct from Ebola Zaire. Vaccines in use do not treat this variant; experimental vaccines and therapies are being rapidly evaluated. Ebola is not airborne; transmission requires direct contact with infected bodily fluids, though animal-to-human spillover from fruit bats and wildlife occurs. Handling the bodies of the deceased is a major transmission risk. Early symptoms mimic influenza (fever, joint and muscle pain) in about 95% of cases, advancing to internal and external bleeding, and kidney and liver failure, especially in immunocompromised individuals. Preventive measures: rigorous hand hygiene, avoiding unclean surfaces, and staying away from infected or abandoned areas. Travelers to affected regions should seek prompt medical care for flu-like symptoms; vaccine development for the new strain is ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: 世界的緊急事態エボラウイルスのため — ヨーロッパ医学協会会長がその危険性を説明 — ユーム7
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の新種株、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言した新規エボラ株の発生であり、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 新規のエボラ株（Zaire株とは遺産プロファイルが異なる）による1,000件以上の感染と既存ワクチン無効性が報告。WHOによるPHEIC宣言済み。ヒト-ヒト感染リスク高く（体液との直接接触）、死体処理時の感染リスクも指摘。旅行者への警告あり。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Kembali Mengganas di Afrika, Apa Itu Virus Ebola dan Bagaimana Penyebarannya?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Rages Again in Africa: What Is the Ebola Virus and How Is It Transmitted?
article.articleSummary: As of May 22, 2026, Ebola virus disease outbreaks are resurging in Africa, with hundreds of cases and over 100 deaths reported in the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ituri Province and Uganda. The World Health Organization has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern due to rapid spread and potential for wider transmission. In Congo, at least 500 cases and 131 deaths are reported in Ituri, with cases reaching dense urban areas such as Goma; Uganda reports 2 cases and 1 death from travelers from Congo, with transmission suspected in Kampala. The strain involved is Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rarer form for which no vaccine or widely available specific treatment exists. Ebola spreads via direct contact with bodily fluids (blood, sweat, vomit, saliva, urine, feces) of living or deceased patients, placing family members and healthcare workers at highest risk.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスがアフリカで再び猛威を振るう：エボラウイルスとは何か、どのように伝播するのか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当：深刻な公衆衛生影響（600以上の症例、130以上の死亡）、異常・予想外の再発、国際的な拡大リスク（ウガンダへの越境、WHOがPHEIC宣言）、渡航・貿易制限のリスク。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: ウガンダは記事に「2症例、1死亡、コンゴからの旅行者」と記述されているが、主要な発生地はDRCのイトゥリ州およびゴマ。対象国リストに含まれるウガンダは越境事例のため、主要発生地のDRCのみを verified_locations に含める。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ワクチンなし）、WHOがPHEIC宣言済み、ヒト-ヒト感染確認、医療従事者と家族への高リスクが記事に明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: Vészhelyzet Afrikában: Nemzetközi riasztást adott ki a WHO a mutálódott Ebola miatt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Emergency in Africa: WHO issues an international alert over the mutated Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: As of May 22, 2026, the WHO has declared an international public health emergency over an Ebola outbreak in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri Province, with cross-border spread to Uganda. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or therapy, unlike the Zaire strain. About 246 suspected cases and 80 deaths have been reported in Ituri, fueled by crowded mining towns such as Mongwalu and Bunia and by ongoing conflict that hampers response. A confirmed case has been identified in Goma, currently under control of the M23 rebel group. Traditional burial practices are key transmission drivers. Border controls are avoided; Rwanda tightened borders, the US CDC is deploying experts, and some exposed Americans are being evacuated to Germany. Bundibugyo’s fatality is around 30%; overall Ebola mortality can reach 50%. It is not yet declared a pandemic.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカの緊急事態：WHOが変異型エボラウイルスについて国際警報を発令
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルスの新規アウトブレイク（ワクチン・治療法なし）、複数国への越境感染、死亡率30%、国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言により、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC東部（イトゥリ州・ゴマを中心）でのエボラアウトブレイクを主題としており、ウガンダへの越境感染、米国の関与も記載されているが、実際の発生地はDRC。ワクチン・治療法がないBundibugyo株による初の大規模アウトブレイクであり、紛争地域での対応困難性、伝統的埋葬慣行による高い伝播リスクが特筆される。WHOによる国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: Congo, epidemia Ebola mette a rischio i Mondiali: perché l'Italia ha chance di ripescaggio
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo: Ebola epidemic puts the World Cup at risk — why Italy has a chance to secure a playoff spot.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri, raises World Cup concerns as Congo prepares for the 2026 tournament in Canada, Mexico, and the United States. Kinshasa training was moved to Belgium; the Congo squad for Group K against Portugal, Colombia and Uzbekistan comprises 26 players based abroad. MSF warns of three major risks: rapid case expansion (over 200 cases at outbreak declaration; the previous outbreak totaled 64), conflict in northeast DRC hindering access to care, and the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, which is rare and poorly understood. The outbreak has already prompted travel measures: the United States has temporary entry restrictions for people who have been in risk zones, and Mexico issued an epidemiological alert with a 21-day quarantine for Congolese players and a ban on their fans. If the situation worsens, Congo’s World Cup participation could be jeopardized, potentially triggering a repechage scenario.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：エボラ出血熱の流行がワールドカップを危険にさらす — イタリアがプレーオフスポットを確保する可能性がある理由
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施中）。エボラ出血熱の流行は重篤な懸念事項であり、既に米国やメキシコが入国規制を実施している。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはDRC以外の米国、カナダ、ベルギー、ポルトガル、ウズベキスタン、コロンビア、メキシコが記載されているが、これらは主として渡航制限やワールドカップ参加国として言及されているもので、実際のエボラ出血熱発生地はDRC（Ituri州・Kinshasa）に限定される。記事内で既に渡航制限（米国の一時的入国規制、メキシコの検疫措置）が実施されており、社会政治的関心も高い。MSFが警告する要因（200例以上の症例、紛争地域での対応困難、Bundibugyo ebolavirus株）も管理可能性の低さを示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: Majka namerno ostavila decu u šumi, širi se ebola, Tramp steže obruč oko Kube: Šta se desilo juče u svetu?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A mother deliberately left her children in the woods, Ebola is spreading, Trump tightens the noose around Cuba: What happened yesterday around the world?
article.articleSummary: Ebola confirmed in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with a new case in South Kivu hundreds of kilometers from the Ituri outbreak epicenter. The patient, a 28-year-old man from a rural area near Bukavu, died and was buried safely. Health authorities warn the virus had circulated undetected for about two months before the outbreak was officially registered last week, highlighting gaps in surveillance as Ituri and South Kivu confront cross-provincial transmission risks. The development signals ongoing Ebola activity in eastern DRC and underscores the need for rapid epidemiological investigations to delineate transmission chains and containment strategies. The report provides no additional clinical details or laboratory specifics beyond the confirmed case.

triage.headline_ja: 母親が意図的に子どもを森に置き去りにした、エボラが拡大中、トランプがキューバに包囲網を強化：昨日の世界で何が起きたのか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラウイルス病は指定感染症で、DRC東部での地域間感染リスク、2ヶ月間の未検出流行、監視体制の弱さが確認されている。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は極めて高リスク。South Kivu（イトゥリから数百km離隔）での新規確認例は地域間伝播を示唆。2ヶ月間の検出漏れは監視の重大な隙間。DRC東部での継続的活動を反映。フルRRA実施が緊急で必要。

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ оценила риск распространения Эболы в мире  --  НИАТ "Ховар"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO assessed the global risk of Ebola transmission — NIA "Khovar".
article.articleSummary: As of May 22, 2026, the World Health Organization reports high Ebola transmission risk at national and regional levels in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda, while global risk remains low. At a Geneva Emergency Committee meeting, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus cited about 600 probable Ebola cases and 139 deaths; northern DRC has 51 confirmed infections, though the outbreak’s true scale is likely larger. An American who worked in DRC contracted Ebola and was evacuated to Germany, illustrating imported case risk. The outbreak involves Bundibugyo ebolavirus (Bundibugyo strain); there is no vaccine yet, with experimental therapies in development. A virus-specific vaccine could take up to nine months. Congo’s outbreak is its 17th; earlier outbreaks in 2025 (34 deaths) and 2018–2020 (~2,300 deaths) are noted, with Africa-wide Ebola deaths around 15,000 over 50 years. A WHO emergency declaration was previously issued for Ebola in Africa.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがエボラの世界的な感染リスクを評価 — NIA「ホヴァル」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当し、複数国での確認例、死亡例、国際的な患者移動が報告されている。エボラは高優先度対象疾患。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC及びウガンダでの高リスク、北部DRCで51例の確認感染例、約600例の疑い例、139例の死亡が報告されている。米国人労働者がDRCで感染し、ドイツに搬送された国際的な患者移動が確認されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。WHO緊急委員会がジュネーブで開催され、高い国際的関心が示されている。

article.articleHeadline: TEMOIGNAGE. "Un isolement profond" : une infirmière française contaminée lors de l'épidémie d'Ebola en 2014 raconte son combat contre le virus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Testimony. "A Profound Isolation": a French nurse infected during the 2014 Ebola outbreak recounts her battle against the virus.
article.articleSummary: MSF nurse Lucie recounts Ebola's grip on West Africa in 2014, when Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone recorded about 11,000 deaths and some 28,000 contacts, as she treated patients in Conakry and Monrovia before falling ill herself. Her infection sparked guilt and fear of harming colleagues and contacting families, amid severe fatigue, high fever, abdominal pain, and isolation after repatriation to France's Bégin hospital near Paris, where an experimental treatment was used. Three months after recovery she returns to the field, traveling to Sierra Leone, driven to help, while a new Ebola surge presses Central Africa, notably Democratic Republic of Congo. The outbreak involves a new Bundibugyo strain with no vaccine or approved treatment, and is unfolding in a politically unstable region with limited response capacity. Lucie now balances motherhood (two daughters) and humanitarian duties.

triage.headline_ja: 証言。「深い孤立」：2014年のエボラ流行時に感染したフランス人看護師が、ウイルスとの戦いについて語る
triage.triage_reason: 記事は2014年の過去の西アフリカエボラ流行の個人的な証言であり、現在進行中のイベント報告ではない。ただし、サマリーで「中央アフリカで新たなエボラ急増が進行中、特にDRCで、新しいBundibugyo株で、ワクチンや承認された治療法がない」と言及されており、現在の新規流行の可能性があるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが複数の過去の流行地域（Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone, Angola）を列挙しているが、記事サマリーの主題は2014年の歴史的回顧証言。ただし、サマリーの終盤で「新たなエボラ急増が中央アフリカで進行中、特にDRCで、新しいBundibugyo株、ワクチンなし、承認された治療法なし」と明記されており、DRCでの現在進行中の新規流行の可能性がある。この点で IHR基準2つ該当、WPRO基準4つ該当だが、記事本文が提供されず、詳細な確認ができないため WATCH とした。続報で現在のDRCにおけるエボラ流行の詳細情報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: "백신도 치료제도 없다"...정부, 콩고 에볼라 확산에 '여행금지' 발령 - 매일경제
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "There is neither a vaccine nor a treatment"... The government has issued a travel ban in response to the Congo Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: On May 22, 2026, the Korean Foreign Ministry issued a Level 4 travel advisory (travel ban) for Ituri Province in the Democratic Republic of the Congo due to an Ebola outbreak, expanding the existing bans to include Ituri alongside North Kivu and South Kivu, totaling three prohibited travel regions. Officials report Ebola confirmed cases and a large number of suspected cases in Ituri and North Kivu, with fatalities exceeding 100. The circulating virus is the Bundibugyo strain, for which there are no approved vaccines or treatments. The World Health Organization has declared the situation a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). Travel restrictions require special passport authorization to visit or remain in the affected areas; unauthorized entry or stay may be punished under passport law.

triage.headline_ja: 「ワクチンも治療薬もない」...政府、コンゴのエボラ拡散に『渡航禁止』発令
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス感染症（PHEIC宣言済み）で100人超の死亡、国際的拡大リスク、複数国の渡航禁止措置を誘発。対象国DRCで実際に発生している公式な危機管理イベント。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱。WHOによるPHEIC宣言済み。South Kivu Province、Ituri Province、North Kivu Provinceで確認。記事サマリーはDRCでの発生を主題とし、韓国政府による渡航禁止措置は二次的な反応。Republic of Koreaは発生地ではなく対応国であるため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Πάνω από 150 οι νεκροί και 671 ύποπτα κρούσματα από τον ιό Έμπολα στη ΛΔ Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over 150 dead and 671 suspected Ebola cases in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: As of May 22, 2026, Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), centered in Ituri province in the northeast along the Uganda border, continues to grow. Health authorities report 671 suspected cases and 160 deaths believed to be due to the virus to date; 64 infections and 6 deaths have been laboratory-confirmed. The World Health Organization previously cited nearly 600 suspected cases and 130 deaths, warning that the true numbers are likely higher. Across the border in Uganda, authorities report no new infections beyond two Congolese nationals; one patient has died, the other tested negative two days earlier and remains under treatment. The outbreak is linked to the rare Bundibugyo strain, for which there are no vaccines or specific therapies, complicating containment. Ebola spreads via close contact and bodily fluids; this is the 17th outbreak in the DRC since 1976.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルスにより150人以上死亡、671件の疑似患者
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも全5項目該当。エボラ出血熱は最高リスク感染症であり、確定例・死亡例の存在、ワクチン・治療法の欠如により即座のフルRRA対応が必須。
triage.notes: ウガンダにおいて国境を越えた2例（コンゴ国籍者）の報告があるが、サマリー上での主要発生地はDRCであり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。Bundibugyo亜種、ワクチン・治療法の欠如、国際的な懸念の高さから最優先の対応が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak Alert Leads To India-Africa Summit Delay
article.articleSummary: On 2026-05-22, Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda were declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) by WHO, prompting postponement of the Fourth India-Africa Forum Summit (IAFS IV) in New Delhi (May 28–31). After consultations between India's government, the African Union Chair, and the African Union Commission, organizers said it would be rescheduled to a later date to bolster Africa-led public health preparedness, including support to Africa CDC. India reaffirmed solidarity and readiness to contribute to Africa-led efforts. Separately, Delhi's Indira Gandhi International Airport issued a health advisory for travelers arriving from Ebola-affected countries (DRC, Uganda, South Sudan): report fever, vomiting, weakness, diarrhoea, headache, unexplained bleeding, muscle pain or sore throat; notify authorities, and seek care within 21 days of arrival, per IHR.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ発症警戒によるインド・アフリカ首脳会談延期
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病のDRC・ウガンダでのアウトブレイクがWHOにより国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）と宣言され、国際的な影響（首脳会談延期）と渡航制限措置（空港での健康勧告）が発生している。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはニューデリー（India）が含まれているが、記事サマリー上でインドは実際のエボラ発症地ではなく、DRC・ウガンダでのアウトブレイクに対応してニューデリーで開催予定だった首脳会談が延期されたという対応国である。verified_locationsはDRC（実際の発症国）とIndia（イベント対応国）のみとした。ウガンダはスクリーニング対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: รัฐบาลคุมเข้มอีโบลา ยกระดับคัดกรองผู้เดินทางจากพื้นที่เสี่ยง | เดลินิวส์
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Government tightens Ebola controls, steps up screening of travelers from high-risk areas.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) has been designated a dangerous infectious area for foreign entries, with the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda declared high-risk zones, effective May 21, 2026 following a May 20 Royal Gazette publication. The designation comes after WHO’s Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) status was invoked due to ongoing Ebola transmissions and cross-border risk. Thailand tightens traveler screening from these regions, including fever checks, travel history, and 21-day symptom monitoring. Foreign travelers must pre-register via Thailand Digital Arrival Card (TDAC) and Thai citizens via Thai Health Pass (thaihealthpass.com). The Civil Aviation Authority of Thailand coordinates with the Ministry of Health and airlines to inform passengers, screen at origin, verify registrations, and support frontline staff. Drills cover suspected cases onboard or on arrival. The government emphasizes readiness, interagency coordination, and public adherence to health guidance without panic.

triage.headline_ja: 政府がエボラを厳しく管理、高リスク地域からの旅行者のスクリーニングを強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病はPHEIC指定済みで、DRCとウガンダでの継続的な感染伝播、国境を越えるリスク、タイを含む複数国への潜在的拡大リスク、国際的な旅行制限措置が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダも高リスク地域として言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外した。DRCでの継続的な感染伝播が主要な懸念であり、タイが防御措置を実施している事実から、両国を verified_locations に含めた。WHO PHEIC指定済みで、国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態として認識されている。

article.articleHeadline: Local health officials weigh in on central Africa Ebola outbreak, assess risk to Hawaii
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda involves the rare Bundibugyo strain; transmission is not airborne but via contact with bodily fluids such as blood. Hawaii's Department of Health is actively tracking potential exposures and remains in regular contact with the CDC; there are no known links to Hawaii and no current risk to the islands. If a Hawaii resident who recently traveled to DRC develops symptoms, they would be evaluated. Local experts say the situation does not affect daily life at present, but Hawaii will continue monitoring. Gov. Josh Green notes spikes occur roughly every three to five years and emphasizes ongoing vigilance. The DOH would disclose if risk to Hawaii emerges or a Hawaii case is identified.

triage.headline_ja: ハワイの保健当局が中央アフリカのエボラ出血熱の流行についての見解を示し、ハワイへのリスクを評価
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準では「異常・予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当する可能性があるが、DRC/ウガンダでの発生は確認されるものの、対象国の対象者への直接的な脅威が記事サマリーでは明確でない。情報が限定的であるため経過観察段階が適切。
triage.notes: DRCでのエボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の発生は確認されるが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ハワイへの現在のリスクは低いとされているが、Bundibugyo株は稀で、国際的拡大の潜在性がある。継続監視の判断が適切。

article.articleHeadline: 에볼라 확산 민주콩고 여행금지 지역 확대
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Spread of Ebola: Travel-ban areas expanded in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: On May 22, 2026, the government expanded travel restrictions in the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Ituri Province, issuing a Level 4 travel advisory (travel ban) effective at 2:00 PM local time. Unauthorized visits or stays in the affected area may incur penalties under passport regulations unless an exceptional travel authorization is granted. The Ituri region has reported Ebola-confirmed cases and a large number of suspected cases, with official reports indicating more than 100 fatalities. The outbreak has prompted the World Health Organization to declare Ebola a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The measures aim to curb cross-border spread and reinforce surveillance and containment as health authorities respond to ongoing transmission in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の拡大: コンゴ民主共和国で渡航禁止地域が拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は重大な公衆衛生の脅威であり、100名以上の死亡者、WHOによるPHEIC宣言、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限措置が確認される。
triage.notes: コンゴ民主共和国(DRC)はIturi州でエボラ出血熱の確定例および疑い例が報告されている。WHOがPHEIC(国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態)を宣言していることが記事で確認される。100名以上の死亡者が報告されており、重篤度が高い。政府による渡航禁止措置(Level 4)が発令され、国際的な関心が極めて高い状況。

article.articleHeadline: 挪威捐助541萬美元助WHO抗疫！應對剛果與烏干達伊波拉疫情 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Norway donates USD 5.41 million to help WHO combat the Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda - Minshi News Network
article.articleSummary: Norway pledged about 50 million Norwegian kroner (approximately $5.41 million) to the WHO Contingency Fund for Emergencies to aid Ebola outbreak responses in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. Announced on May 22, 2026, the donation aims to strengthen local prevention measures and health resources, enabling rapid international intervention in the outbreak’s early phase and helping prevent cross-border spread of a highly infectious and deadly virus. The funds will support frontline efforts, including surveillance and medical capacity, in regions facing Ebola threats. The report notes the action as a demonstration of international responsibility and does not provide Ebola case or death counts, laboratory confirmation details, or specific infection sources.

triage.headline_ja: ノルウェーがWHOに541万米ドルを寄付、コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダのエボラ出血熱対策を支援
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の発生がDRC（対象国）で確認されており、IHR基準の「異常性」「国際的拡大リスク」、およびWPRO基準の「重症度」「流行性」「管理可能性」で複数該当。国際的な資金支援が動員されており、社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはノルウェーの寄付発表に焦点を当てており、具体的な患者数・死亡数・実験室確認の詳細は記載されていない。ウガンダは記事に言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。ノルウェーは発生地域に含まれているが、記事の主題はDRCとウガンダでの流行対応支援であり、ノルウェーでの発生ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: В африканской стране протестующие подожгли центр лечения больных Эболой
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Protesters in an African country set fire to an Ebola treatment center.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), protesters attacked an Ebola treatment center operated by ALIMA near the Rwampara hospital, amid demands for the return of the body of a young man who died of Ebola. Luka Mambelé, vice-president of the A2RC party, said tensions rose after relatives tried to forcibly take the body from the hospital; health authorities reportedly refused access. The assault sparked a fire that destroyed two medical tents. At the time of the attack, six patients were being treated in ALIMA facilities and are now hospitalized. Humanitarian groups warn that reduced aid from the United States and the World Health Organization has strained Ebola response capacity, with field hospitals lacking staff and resources to curb transmission. No laboratory confirmation details or new case counts are provided. Published May 22, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカの国でデモ隊がエボラ出血熱治療センターに火をつけた
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱という高リスク疾患について、DRCで治療施設への攻撃により医療提供体制が混乱し、WHOなどの支援削減により対応能力が低下していることが報告されている。IHR基準において深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際的拡大リスクが該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも管理可能性の問題が指摘されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCでのエボラ治療施設への攻撃が主題となっており、Rwampara hospital付近での事象が報告されている。ルワンダ（Kigali Province）はBluedot APIの発生地域に含まれているが、サマリーの主題はDRCであり、ルワンダでの実際の感染症イベントの発生を示す記載はないため、verified_locationsからは除外。WHOと米国からの支援削減に伴う対応能力低下が指摘されており、国際的な懸念事項として存在。

article.articleHeadline: Buntut Wabah Ebola, AS Larang Warga Afrika Masuk Wilayah Amerika
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fallout from the Ebola Outbreak, U.S. Bans Africans from Entering American Territory
article.articleSummary: As of May 22, 2026, the United States CDC announced entry suspensions for foreign nationals who have been in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan within 21 days before arrival. The 30-day ban will be followed by a decision on extension or repeal. US citizens and green card holders may still enter but must undergo stricter screening, with green card holders directed to Washington Dulles International Airport for processing. WHO last week declared Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda a public health emergency of international concern, describing them as a threat to other countries. Congo authorities report 131 Ebola deaths; the Congo outbreak had previously ended in October 2025.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行の余波で、米国がアフリカからの入国を禁止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。WHO PHEIC宣言、複数国での発生確認、米国による国際的な入国規制施行、社会的・政治的関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンでのエボラ発生が言及されている。ウガンダはAfrican regionの国だが、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。南スーダンも対象国外のため除外。DRCのみが対象国リスト内にあり、複数の死亡者（131名）が確認されている。WHO PHEIC宣言済み、米国CDC による入国制限措置が実施されている。リスク評価は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: '에볼라 확산 비상' 민주콩고, 139명 사망
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 'Ebola outbreak emergency' Democratic Republic of the Congo, 139 dead.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak emergency in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri Province in the northeast. As of May 21 local time, roughly 600 confirmed Ebola infections have been reported, with 139 deaths. The World Health Organization notes this is the 17th Ebola cluster in the Central African region, and many cases occur in areas difficult to access due to armed groups. PPE-clad healthcare workers are moving a patient at a hospital as part of the response. The article does not specify laboratory confirmation details, infection source, or information on imported/exported cases. This ongoing outbreak in conflict-affected northeastern DRC highlights the need for rapid containment and protection of health workers.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ拡散緊急事態 民主共和国、139名死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、重篤な死亡例を伴う大規模エボラアウトブレイクであり、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクが明白。WPRO基準5項目すべても該当。
triage.notes: 600件以上の確定患者、139名の死亡を報告。紛争地域での発生により対策が困難。WHOが17番目のエボラクラスターと記録。国境を接する周辺国への拡大リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Aid Cuts Fuel Global Health Gaps as Outbreaks Surge
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo-type Ebola driving Congo’s current outbreak has no approved vaccine or treatment. As of May 17, Congo reported 8 confirmed, 246 suspected, and 80 suspected deaths; by May 21, suspected cases reached 600 and deaths 139, with WHO declaring a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17. Outbreak control is hindered by collapsing surveillance and isolation capacity, linked to drastic aid cuts; U.S. funding to Congo fell from $1.4B in 2024 to $430M in 2025 and $21M in 2026 (a 98.5% drop across two years). About 60% of health facilities in outbreak zones closed last year; halted water-project improvements threaten safe water for ~1.2 million people. Globally, 108 LMICs plan core-service cuts up to 70%; 50 countries reduced health worker numbers or halted training. Andes hantavirus on a South American cruise ship and yellow fever/Oropouche virus activity in the Americas are also noted.

triage.headline_ja: 援助削減が世界的な保健ギャップを加速、感染症アウトブレークが急増
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。ブンディブギョ型エボラ（治療法・ワクチンなし）によるコンゴの大規模アウトブレーク、WHO国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）宣言、複数国での同時多発感染症流行、援助削減による対応能力の劇的な低下が国際的影響リスク増大。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはCanary Islands、Playa de las Américas、United States、Spainが含まれるが、記事サマリーの主要な感染症イベント（Bundibugyo-type Ebola outbreak）はコンゴで発生しており、対象国リストに含まれる DRC のみを verified_locations に採用。黄熱病、Oropouche、ハンタウイルスの記述も含まれるが、具体的な国名は記事サマリーでは「Americas」「South American cruise ship」と曖昧であり、対象国の確認ができないため除外。WHO PHEIC宣言によるシグナル重要度は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ini Kiat Mencegah Infeksi bagi Pemotong Hewan Kurban
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tips to Prevent Infection for Those Who Slaughter Sacrificial Animals
article.articleSummary: Jakarta dermatologist Dr. Arini Astasari Widodo advises that people who slaughter sacrificial animals and cut meat for Eid al-Adha should use protective measures to prevent skin problems and infections. In Jakarta, she recommends PPE including waterproof or work gloves, boots, and long-sleeved clothing, and avoiding direct contact between blood or animal fluids and exposed skin. If minor hand wounds exist, cover them with waterproof bandages before work. Contact with dirt, blood, or fluids can irritate the skin and may cause bacterial infections such as impetigo, cellulitis, folliculitis, or skin abscess; zoonotic diseases are possible but rare, especially with open wounds and poor hygiene. Tetanus vaccination before duties is advised. After slaughter, wash hands and clean contaminated areas; treat irritation with running water, mild soap, dry, and moisturize. Seek medical care for redness, itching, swelling, pus, severe pain, or fever, or if bleeding cannot be controlled.

triage.headline_ja: 祈牲動物の屠畜者のための感染症予防のコツ
triage.triage_reason: 破傷風に関する予防教育記事であり、実際の集団発生やアウトブレイク事例ではない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準の該当がなく、社会的関心も限定的である。
triage.notes: 記事は実際の感染症イベント（症例報告や集団発生）ではなく、医学専門家による予防情報・啓発記事である。Eid al-Adhaの祭儀に関連した季節的な予防措置に関するコンテンツ。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Health authorities race to develop vaccines and treatments for deadly Bundibugyo Ebola strain
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo involves about 600 suspected cases and 139 suspected deaths, with a case fatality rate up to 40%. No approved vaccines or treatments exist for the Bundibugyo strain. Experimental options under evaluation include a Bundibugyo-specific vaccine, rVSVΔG/BDBV-GP (same platform as Ervebo); manufacture potentially in six-to-nine months, with discussions ongoing. A second candidate based on ChAdOx1 technology is being produced by Serum Institute of India under CEPI/Oxford, potentially ready in 2–3 months, though animal studies are pending. MBP134, a pan-ebolavirus antibody from Mapp Biopharmaceutical backed by BARDA, is being coordinated for potential use in exposed individuals. A Bundibugyo-specific antibody, BDBV289-N, showed up to 100% protection in 2018 monkey studies. Remdesivir shows in vitro activity against Bundibugyo, possibly stronger than Zaire. Diagnostics include BioFire’s Ebola panel and Altona RealStar RT-PCR; WHO notes limited testing capacity and rising case numbers.

triage.headline_ja: 保健当局がバンディブギオエボラ株に対するワクチンと治療法の開発を急いでいる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。ブンディブギオエボラは新興・致死的病原体であり、ワクチン・治療法不在の中でのアウトブレイクは国際的懸念事項である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCの東部でのバンディブギオエボラアウトブレイク（約600疑似症例、139疑似死亡、CFR最大40%）を主に扱っている。インドはSerum Institute of Indiaがワクチン候補を製造している文脈でのみ言及されており、実際の発生地ではないため除外した。ワクチン・治療法の急速開発が国際的努力である点が特に重要。

article.articleHeadline: Украинцев призывают воздержаться от поездок в ДР Конго из-за вспышки Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ukrainians urged to refrain from traveling to DR Congo due to an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ukraine's Foreign Ministry urged its citizens to refrain from traveling to certain regions of the Democratic Republic of Congo amid an Ebola outbreak. The advisory followed WHO confirmation of the outbreak on May 17, with transmission reported in Ituri and South Kivu provinces. As of May 16, 80 fatalities have been attributed to Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare Ebola variant with no approved treatments or vaccines. Isolated cases have also been identified in Uganda. In May 2026, WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern over the new outbreak. The most extensive Ebola epidemic occurred in 2014–2016 in West Africa, with more than 28,000 cases and over 11,000 deaths. The Ukrainian MFA provides emergency contacts (embassy hotline, 24/7 line) and advises travelers and nationals in DRC to follow local authorities and official embassy updates.

triage.headline_ja: ウクライナ市民に対しエボラ流行のためコンゴ民主共和国への渡航を控えるよう勧告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、予想外性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHOが国際的保健上の緊急事態を宣言しており、複数国での確認症例あり。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（Zaire型ではない稀なエボラ亜種）による2026年5月の新規発生。WHOが2026年5月にPublic Health Emergency of International Concernを宣言。ウガンダでも散発症例確認。治療法・ワクチン未承認。死亡者80名。発生地域にはIturi州およびSouth Kivu州が含まれる。

article.articleHeadline: En vidéo - Pourquoi l'épidémie d'Ebola en RDC est-elle si préoccupante? - Le Temps
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Video - Why is the Ebola outbreak in the DRC so concerning?
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has caused more than 130 deaths. The World Health Organization has raised the outbreak to the second-highest alert level. The current outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo variant, a rare, less-documented strain that causes hemorrhagic fever and is transmitted via direct contact with bodily fluids of infected persons, living or dead; patients are contagious once symptoms appear, and viral load rises in later stages. There is no effective vaccine against Bundibugyo; available vaccines and treatments mostly target the Zaïre variant, so care relies on supportive measures such as rehydration. The security situation in eastern DRC, especially Ituri region with armed conflict and displacement, hampers access, case isolation, and contact tracing. Despite concerns, experts say the risk of a global pandemic remains low.

triage.headline_ja: ビデオ - コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行はなぜ懸念されているのか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱による130人以上の死亡、稀な変異株（Bundibugyo）、ワクチン対策の限界、セキュリティ上の制約により対応困難であり、国際的な支援と懸念が高まっている。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo変異株は稀で文書化が少なく、既存のワクチン（主にZaïre変異株対応）が効果的でない点が懸念される。東部DRCの不安定な治安状況（Ituri地域の武装勢力と避難民）が疫学的対応を著しく阻害している。WHOが第2段階の警告レベルに引き上げたことが国際的関心の高さを示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: From Congo's Mines and Conflict Zones, Ebola Spreads in Silence | Today News
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo strain drives an outbreak in Ituri and North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo, centered at Nyankunde Hospital in Ituri. Erroneous testing delayed detection of the first Bundibugyo case this month; within two weeks, 25 suspected cases at Nyankunde, four deaths, and multiple staff infections, including an American surgeon evacuated to Germany in stable condition. Nyankunde lacks isolation rooms and adequate PPE while serving about 200,000 people in a conflict-affected region. By May 20, 2026, Congo reported 671 suspected cases and 160 suspected deaths across Ituri and North Kivu, including 64 laboratory-confirmed infections; about half of deaths and nearly half the cases originate from Mongbwalu, 111 km away. This is the 17th outbreak since 1976, prompting WHO to declare a public health emergency of international concern due to no approved vaccine or treatment and weak infrastructure. Possible sources include bush meat and bats in mining areas; the exact source remains unidentified.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの鉱山地域と紛争地帯からエボラが静かに拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイクでWHOが国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言。死亡者160名、確認症例64名、感染医療従事者、医療施設不足など深刻な状況。
triage.notes: エボラ・ブンディブギョ株による17番目のアウトブレイク。Ituri州Nyankunde病院が中心。671人の疑い患者、160人の死亡が報告。医療施設の隔離室・PPE不足、紛争地域での対応困難、ワクチン・治療法不在がリスク要因。米国人外科医がドイツに搬送。WHO公衆衛生緊急事態宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: Panică și revoltă în Congo: localnici au incendiat un centru de tratament pentru Ebola. Care a fost cauza
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Panic and unrest in Congo: locals set fire to an Ebola treatment center. What was the cause?
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in Ituri province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Rwampara, triggered protests that burned an Ebola treatment center after youths were denied permission to remove the body of a friend suspected of infection. Witnesses described damage and possible burning of the body; aid workers retreated. Authorities cite funeral restrictions and low understanding of infection-control measures as drivers; burials for suspect cases are now managed by officials. ALIMA said operations resumed. Official tallies report 160 deaths and 671 suspected cases across two provinces, though experts warn the true burden is higher; Bundibugyo strain has no vaccine or treatment yet, with solutions expected in 6–9 months. The outbreak has spread to South Kivu; initial source remains unidentified. Ituri borders Uganda and South Sudan and houses over 920,000 displaced. Global impacts include postponed events and U.S. travel restrictions for recent travelers to Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan. Ebola transmits via infected fluids and causes fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and hemorrhages. WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでパニックと反発：地元民がエボラ治療センターに放火。原因は何か
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症の国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威。WHOが国際的な保健上の懸念事項を宣言しており、IHR基準4つすべてに該当。複数国での感染確認と国際的な渡航制限の実施。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが列挙した発生地域にはRwanda、Uganda、South Sudanも含まれているが、記事サマリーの主要な感染発生地は DRC（Ituri および South Kivu provinces）である。WHO が PHEIC（Public Health Emergency of International Concern）を宣言済み。ワクチンおよび治療法がまだ開発段階（6-9か月見込み）であり、管理可能性が低い。治療センターへの社会的反発と焼き討ち事件は対応の複雑性を示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: พบนักเดินทางจากประเทศต้นตอ "อีโบลา" สะสม 126 คน  ยันไม่พบผู้ป่วยสงสัยในไทย
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 126 travelers from the Ebola-origin country; no suspected Ebola cases found in Thailand.
article.articleSummary: Thailand reports 126 travelers from the Ebola-origin country; no suspected or confirmed Ebola cases detected. In Africa, Bundibugyo ebolavirus circulation as of May 17: about 254 cases and 160 deaths linked to Ebola. Ebola is a filovirus; spreads primarily via contact with infected bodily fluids; not easily transmitted through air; outbreaks predominantly remain in Africa. Incubation 2–21 days; symptoms include high fever, headache, fatigue, myalgia, vomiting, diarrhea, and possible hemorrhage; severe cases may cause multi-organ failure. Fruit bat is the reservoir; transmission requires close contact. Reproduction number averages around 1.95 depending on control measures. Four of Ebola’s human-associated species exist; Bundibugyo currently has no vaccine or treatment, though vaccines are under development, potentially requiring about nine more months.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスの原発地からの旅行者126人が蓄積；タイでは疑い患者なし
triage.triage_reason: アフリカでのBundibugyo ebolavirus流行（254例、160死亡）により公衆衛生への深刻な影響が存在し、タイへの国際的な拡大リスクが確認されている。IHR基準で複数該当（深刻性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではアフリカでのBundibugyo ebolavirus流行が主題となっており、254例、160死亡が報告されている。タイは国際的な監視対象国として記載されている（126名の旅行者監視中、現在疑い患者なし）。アフリカの発生地（DRC等）は対象国リストに含まれるが、記事の主題はタイの国内サーベイランスであるため、verified_locationsはThailandのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: UN agencies step up Ebola response in Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to expand, with 139 deaths and about 600 suspected cases. Ituri remains epicentre (Rwampara, Mongbwalu, Bunia), while cases are emerging in North Kivu towns Goma, Butembo and Katwa; a new case is reported in Bukavu, South Kivu, linked to travel from Tshopo. Uganda has two confirmed cases. The outbreak is caused by the rare Bundibugyo strain, for which there are currently no vaccines or approved treatments. UN agencies and partners mobilize a rapid response: MONUSCO provides logistics, four light vehicles, one helicopter, two ambulances and two armored vehicles to Bunia; motorcycles from Goma/Beni support rapid response and contact tracing. WHO regards PHEIC; surveillance, entry screening and remote coordination are being strengthened. WFP transports aid and food; UNICEF has mobilized nearly 50 tonnes of supplies. Funding needs exceed $214 million for DRC and over $10 million for Ebola response.

triage.headline_ja: 国連機関、コンゴでのエボラ対応を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。また、エボラ出血熱の多地点多国での発生、死亡者多数、ワクチン・治療法なしという極めて高いリスク要因を備えている。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaとRwandaが含まれるが、記事サマリーではUgandaで2確認症例が記述されており、これはDRC関連の事象である。DRCが主要な発生地であり、ワクチン・治療法のない稀なBundibugyo株による深刻な多地点アウトブレイク。WHOがPHEICと評価。多国間での資金ニーズが$214M以上と記述されている極めて深刻な状況。

article.articleHeadline: John Johnson: Ébola en la RDC: sin tratamiento contra el virus Bundibugyo | El Diario Montañés
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: John Johnson: Ebola in the DRC: no treatment for the Bundibugyo virus | El Diario Montañés
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri province: Mongwalu, Bunia; Rwampara; North Kivu including Goma) has no approved specific treatment. Two vaccines exist but none are approved for Bundibugyo; Ervebo (rVSV-ZEBOV) can be used in ring vaccination to limit spread, and a second vaccine targets exposure risk but is approved only against the Zaire Ebola virus. Monoclonal antibodies approved after Congo trials (2018–2020) are species-specific for other Ebola viruses, not Bundibugyo; no antiviral with proven efficacy. Without a cure, care is supportive—fluids, oxygen, symptom management. Diagnosis is hampered by limited Bundibugyo-specific PCR cartridges, delaying confirmation, contact tracing, and isolation. Response emphasizes early case isolation, 21-day contact follow-up with quarantine if symptoms—plus strict infection prevention and safe burials. Community engagement is essential in insecure areas. More than 50 deaths since April; outbreak declared May 15; WHO raised alert May 17; Uganda reports first death May 14. MSF notes this is the seventeenth Ebola outbreak in DRC.

triage.headline_ja: ジョン・ジョンソン：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ：ブンディブギョ病毒に対する治療なし
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo型）の多数の死亡例、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダへの波及確認）、治療法なしという公衆衛生への深刻な影響、および異常性が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国（イトゥリ州、北キビュ州）でのBundibugyo型エボラウイルス流行を主として報告。ウガンダでの死亡報告も言及されているが、サマリーの主題はコンゴ民主共和国の流行である。ルワンダは発生地域に含まれているが、サマリー上では明確な患者発生の報告がないため verified_locations から除外。治療法なし、50人以上の死亡、WHO警告レベル引き上げ（5月17日）、診断の遅延が指摘されており、制御可能性に懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: ดีอาร์คองโกวุ่น! ชาวบ้านบุกเผา "ศูนย์รักษาผู้ป่วยอีโบลา" ยัวะร.พ.ไม่คืนศพให้ญาติ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo in turmoil! Villagers storm and burn an Ebola treatment center, angry with the hospital for not returning the bodies to the relatives.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo centers on the Rwampara hospital near Bunia, Ituri province. After family and friends of a young man believed to have died from Ebola were blocked from taking the body for burial, a large crowd stormed and burned a section of the Ebola treatment center, injuring hospital staff and burning two tents. Police fired warning shots to disperse the mob; security personnel protected healthcare workers. WHO urges safe, dignified burials by trained teams to curb transmission. Earlier, six patients in hospital tents were feared to have escaped, but aid group ALIMA says all patients remain under hospital care. The country reports at least 139 Ebola deaths and more than 600 suspected infections; the ministry later raised deaths to 159, with two additional infections detected in Uganda. Local mistrust and misinformation about Ebola are highlighted by officials.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で混乱！村民がエボラ出血熱治療センターを襲撃・放火、病院が遺体を遺族に返却しないことに怒り
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常で予想外、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。死亡139人以上・疑い患者600人以上の大規模流行で、ウガンダへの拡大も確認。社会政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にウガンダが含まれているが、記事サマリーではウガンダでの確認は「2感染者」のみの言及で、主流行地はDRCのイトゥリ州ブニア近郊。DRCでの大規模流行（死亡139～159人、疑い患者600人以上）が主題であるためverified_locationsはDRCのみ。医療施設への暴力的な攻撃と遺体管理の問題により、感染対策の実施可能性が低下する重大なリスクが存在。

article.articleHeadline: Thêm nhiều nước hạn chế đi lại tới khu vực bùng phát virus Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More countries restrict travel to the Ebola outbreak area.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo’s Ituri province has intensified, with INSP reporting 160 deaths among 671 cases as of May 22, and the WHO declaring a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Uganda has ordered a four-week suspension of cross-border passenger transport to/from DR Congo and halted flights, citing ongoing importation risk; two Congolese nationals who crossed into Uganda are recorded as one infection and one death, though Uganda reports no community transmission after a case tested negative twice. The United States is directing travelers with recent residence in DR Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan to enter via Washington Dulles for enhanced screening, including symptom questionnaires, fever checks, and contact-tracing information. South Korea expanded travel bans to Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, issued travel warnings for border regions near the Central African Republic and Bas-Uele and Haut-Uele, and Bahrain joined a one-month entry ban for travelers from these three countries.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス流行地域への渡航を制限する国が増加
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国で継続的に流行し、複数国が渡航制限を実施。WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言し、IHR基準4つすべてに該当。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域には多くの誤った国が含まれている（Virginia、Republic of Korea、United States、Sudan、Central African Republic、Bahrain、Ugandaなど）。これらは記事内で渡航制限を実施している国として言及されているが、実際のエボラウイルス流行の主体はDRC（特にIturi州）である。記事サマリーから確実にウイルス流行が確認されている国はDRCのみが対象国リストに該当する。

article.articleHeadline: Uçakta Ebola paniği: ABD rotası Kanada ile değiştirildi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Panic on a Plane: US Route Diverted to Canada.
article.articleSummary: May 22, 2026 — A Paris-to-Detroit flight diverted to Montreal after US CBP refused boarding for a passenger amid Ebola risk and entry restrictions. The diversion followed CDC and DHS temporary measures to curb Ebola entry from East and Central Africa. Under the new rules, foreign travelers who have been in Uganda, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, or South Sudan within the past 21 days and lack US citizenship face a 30-day entry ban. All foreign passengers from outbreak regions are now allowed to land only at Washington Dulles International Airport in Virginia, where screening resources are centralized. WHO Director-General reported about 600 suspected Ebola cases and 139 suspected deaths in the region; confirmed cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo number 51, Uganda has two; a US citizen working in the DRC tested positive and was evacuated to Germany for treatment.

triage.headline_ja: 飛行機内のエボラ騒動：米国の航路がカナダへ迂回
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的な拡大リスク、複数国への感染者報告、および米国・カナダなど先進国での入国制限措置という異例の対応がIHR基準を複数満たす。公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的な波及が認められる。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドにはUSA・Canada・Francなど多くの国が列挙されているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRC・Uganda・South Sudanでのエボラ発生であり、これが米国への渡航制限とカナダへの航路迂回の原因となっている。DRCのみが対象国リストに該当。2026年5月という将来の日付に注意。

article.articleHeadline: В ДР Конго родственники умершего от Эболы подожгли мобильный госпиталь
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, relatives of the Ebola victim set fire to a mobile hospital.
article.articleSummary: As of May 22, 2026, in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo's Ituri province, residents of Rwamparé set fire to a mobile Ebola treatment center amid an outbreak of a new Ebola strain. The protest followed doctors' refusal to release the body of a deceased relative, citing infection risks and burial-rule conflicts with local customs. The incident underscores tensions around outbreak response and perceived health-system weaknesses. Authorities report at least 160 Ebola-related deaths and 671 suspected cases across two DR Congo provinces. Neighboring Uganda has reported one death and one infection linked to spillover. The report notes a new Ebola strain but provides no details on transmission pathways or laboratory confirmation, and does not mention vaccination or other control measures.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラで死亡した患者の親族が移動式病院に放火
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの新規株による outbreak で死亡者160名・疑い例671名が報告されており、国際的な懸念（ウガンダへの感染事例）も確認されている。IHR基準3項目が該当し、シグナルとしての価値が高い。
triage.notes: 記事は新規エボラ株の確認を述べているが、検査室での確認詳細やワクチン接種状況は記載されていない。コンゴ民主共和国内Ituri州での地理的発生が明確。ウガンダは spillover による個別症例の報告であり、verified_locations には含めない（対象国リストに Uganda は含まれていない）。社会不安（病院放火）と医療システム信頼の喪失は outbreak 対応に悪影響をもたらす重大な要素。

article.articleHeadline: Ебола се шири во Демократска Република Конго: разгневени демонстранти запалија центар за лекување - Trn.mk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: angry protesters set fire to a treatment center.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-22, Ebola is spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with protests at a treatment center hindering response efforts. WHO says true infection numbers are likely higher than official counts. Congo reports 670 suspected cases and 160 suspected deaths, with 61 laboratory-confirmed infections. Two cases are confirmed in Uganda, and spread concerns persist in eastern Congo areas controlled by rebels. In Rwampara, Ituri Province, unrest broke out after a deceased patient’s family challenged the death cause, with demonstrators setting fire to a humanitarian clinic and police firing warning shots. Bundibugyo Ebola virus has no licensed vaccine or treatment; experts estimate six to nine months for development. International aid includes UK £20 million and US $23 million, with plans for up to 50 clinics in Congo and Uganda. Uganda suspends cross-border transport; US increases traveler screening for people from Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴ民主共和国で拡大：怒った抗議者が治療センターに放火
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当し、重篤な公衆衛生上の影響、予想外の事態（治療センター放火による対応阻害）、複数国への国際的拡大（ウガンダ確認例、スーダン・ルワンダでの懸念）、渡航制限措置（ウガンダの国境輸送停止、米国のスクリーニング強化）が明確である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの地理的記述を精査した結果、主要なエボラ発生地はコンゴ民主共和国（Bundibugyo地域、イトゥリ州Rwampara等）であり、ウガンダは2例の確認患者がいるため二次的な懸念地域だが、記事の主軸はDRC内での感染拡大と対応阻害である。Bluedot APIが列挙した他国（米国、英国、スーダン、ルワンダ、ウガンダ）は、支援国または懸念地域としての言及に過ぎないため、verified_locationsからは対象国リスト内のDRCのみを含める。ワクチン・治療薬の欠如、6～9ヶ月の開発見積もり、国際的な財政支援・多国間協力の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Κονγκό: Ραγδαία εξάπλωση του Έμπολα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: Rapid spread of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo, authorities report a spreading Ebola outbreak centered in Ituri province near Uganda and South Sudan. The Health Ministry has logged 671 suspected cases and 160 deaths, with 64 infections and 6 deaths laboratory-confirmed. The World Health Organization cited about 600 suspected cases and 130 deaths, cautioning that true numbers are likely higher due to underreporting. In Uganda, the Health Ministry said no new infections beyond two nationals from DRC; one died, the other tested negative days ago and remains under treatment. The African CDC says the outbreak began about two months ago in Ituri. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC since 1976 and is linked to the Bundibugyo strain, for which there are no vaccines or specific treatments, complicating containment. Ebola is highly transmissible through close contact and bodily fluids; over 11,000 deaths were reported during the 2014-2015 epidemic.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：エボラの急速な拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模流行で深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダ・南スーダン近辺）、渡航・貿易制限リスクが明確。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはウガンダ・南スーダンも含まれるが、記事サマリーの主題はDRCのイトゥリ州での流行。ウガンダ・スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。DRCはシグナル識別対象国（GeoNames ID 203312）。ワクチンなし、2014-2015年流行では11,000名以上の死亡。国際的な懸念が高く、WHO見解も記載されている。

U.S. citizens and green card holders may enter but face enhanced screening, and affected travelers must be redirected to Washington-Dulles International Airport (IAD) per the Department of Homeland Security. The World Health Organization has declared the DRC and Uganda Ebola outbreaks a public health emergency and a threat to other states.
