triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ出血熱の流行により3つのアフリカ諸国からの外国人の入国を禁止：CDC
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。コンゴ民主共和国およびウガンダでのエボラ出血熱の流行により、WHOが公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言し、米国が渡航制限を実施。国際的拡大リスクおよび渡航制限リスクが明確。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが抽出した発生地域にはWashington D.C.（米国）、ウガンダ、スーダンが含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題となる実際のエボラ出血熱の流行地はコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダ。対象国リストではコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のみが該当するため、verified_locationsに含める。記事はワシントンでの渡航制限決定について述べているが、感染症イベント自体はアフリカ大陸で発生している。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak alert: Former CDC chief warns of major spread risk
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda threatens wider regional spread to Tanzania, southern Sudan, and Rwanda, as cases rise in Congo and Uganda. Local reports tally 536 suspected, 105 probable, 34 confirmed cases, and about 134 suspected deaths. The WHO on May 17, 2026 confirmed cases in Ituri Province (DRC) and Kampala, warning of local and regional spread risk. Former CDC Director Robert Redfield warned it could become a very significant pandemic due to late detection, noting detection typically occurs at 5–10 cases but this outbreak exceeded 100 cases before identification. The US began enhanced screening at Washington Dulles for travellers from affected countries on May 20, 2026 (11:59 pm), IST May 21. In India, Delhi IGI Airport issued an Ebola alert for arrivals from affected countries; no India cases reported. Ebola spreads by direct contact with body fluids or contaminated materials; airports serve as checkpoints.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行警告：前CDC所長がアフリカ・インドでの大規模拡散リスクを警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当：深刻な公衆衛生影響（疑い例536、確定例34、死亡134）、異常性（検出遅延100症例超で異例）、国際的拡大リスク（地域内および国際スクリーニング実施）、渡航制限リスク（米国・インドで検疫強化）。WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべても該当し、社会的・政治的関心が高い（前CDC所長の警告、複数国の検疫措置）。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから実際の流行国を確認：DRC（Ituri Province）、ウガンダ（Kampala）で確定症例あり。インドはデリー空港での検疫対応のみで症例報告なし。タンザニア、スーダン、ルワンダは脅威国として言及されるも確定症例未報告のため除外。米国は検疫対応国のみで流行国でないため除外。Bluedot APIの発生地域には米国・インド・スーダン・ルワンダ・タンザニアなど多くの地域が含まれているが、実サマリー内容に基づき検証した。

article.articleHeadline: US diverting travelers from Ebola-hit region to one airport for screening
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-22, the CDC announced that travelers who were in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) or neighboring Uganda or South Sudan within the past 21 days must enter the United States via Washington Dulles International Airport for enhanced screening. The rule, effective for departures after 11:59 pm local time, is enforced via US Customs and Border Protection; airlines will rebook such travelers to Dulles. At Dulles, travelers undergo a travel-history questionnaire, symptom observation, temperature checks, and provide contact-tracing information. If asymptomatic, they may continue to final destinations with symptom-monitoring instructions. The policy covers US citizens, US nationals, and lawful permanent residents; non-US passport holders with prior travel to those countries face entry restrictions already. State health officials say public risk remains very low. WHO has declared the outbreak an international emergency; regional risk is high, global risk low.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ感染地域からの乗客を1つの空港に集約してスクリーニング実施
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で国際的な拡大リスク（渡航制限）と予想外性が該当し、WHOが国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言した確立されたエボラ流行事例である。対象国（DRC）における公衆衛生上の重大な懸念があり、フルRRA実施の対象となる。
triage.notes: 記事は米国での対応策について述べているが、実際の流行発生地はDRCである。Bluedot APIがワシントンDCを含めているのは米国での対応に関する言及であるため、感染症イベント発生地として検証されるのはDRCのみ。ウガンダおよびスーダンは近隣国として言及されているが、記事サマリーでは具体的な症例報告がないため除外。WHO による国際保健上の緊急事態宣言により、既知かつ深刻なエボラ流行事例として位置付けられる。

article.articleHeadline: В ДР Конго жители подожгли центр лечения Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the DRC, residents set fire to an Ebola treatment center.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, an Ebola treatment center in the town of Rwampara was set on fire by unidentified youths after authorities refused to hand over the body of a deceased relative. The attackers sparked the blaze after being blocked from retrieving their friend's body, believed to have died of fever. Local officials said the youths did not understand Ebola burial rules, while government representatives emphasized that, during an outbreak, strict procedures apply and all bodies must be buried under special regulations. The incident occurs amid ongoing Ebola risk assessments: the WHO has warned that national and regional risk remains high for the DRC and neighboring Uganda, while the global risk remains low. No confirmation of infections or deaths from this incident is provided in the report.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ治療センターが住民に放火される
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスを対象とした事象であり、IHR基準において公衆衛生への影響（serious_impact）と異常性（unusual_unexpected）が該当。治療施設の破壊は感染症対応能力を低下させる深刻な脅威。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCのRwampara町でのエボラ治療センター放火事件に焦点を当てている。ウガンダは言及されているがWHOの警告のみで、サマリー上での主要な発生地域ではないため除外。治療施設の機能停止により、オンゴーイングアウトブレイク対応が著しく阻害される可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: В Конго протестующие сожгли центр лечения лихорадки Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, protesters set fire to an Ebola treatment center.
article.articleSummary: In Ituri Province, DR Congo, authorities report an outbreak of a new Ebola strain. Since the outbreak began, at least 160 people have died and 671 are suspected cases across two provinces. The dead bodies can be contagious. Protests erupted as local residents set fire to an Ebola treatment center, driven by opposition to burial rules that clash with traditional rites and concerns about the health system’s effectiveness. The UN corroborates a cross-border risk, reporting one death and one new infection in neighboring Uganda. No information on laboratory confirmation or infection sources is provided in the report. The situation underscores social tensions around outbreak control measures and the ongoing risk of spread to surrounding regions as of 2026-05-22.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで抗議者がエボラ出血熱治療センターに放火
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の新規株による集団発生で160人以上の死亡、671人の疑い例があり、既に国境を越えてウガンダへの拡大が報告されている。公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、異常な社会的緊張が複数の基準に該当。
triage.notes: 発生地域にウガンダが含まれているが、記事サマリーでは「隣国ウガンダでの1死亡と1新規感染」と限定的に述べられており、主要な発生地はDRコンゴである。DRコンゴは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダ（対象国外）での事例は副次的。治療センターへの放火による感染対策の破綻リスク、埋葬慣習をめぐる社会的対立が制御可能性を低下させている。

article.articleHeadline: Хаос во Конго: Демонстранти запалија центар за лекување додека еболата повторно се шири - Бриф
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chaos in Congo: Protesters set fire to a treatment center as Ebola spreads again - Brief.
article.articleSummary: Protests and violence in the Democratic Republic of Congo fuel renewed concern as Ebola spreads again. Angry demonstrators set fire to a treatment center for patients with Ebola, signaling distrust of health authorities and international organizations. The incident compounds chaos and fear on the ground. Health authorities warn that destroying medical facilities could seriously impede the fight against the virus and may accelerate transmission. Medical teams are operating in extremely challenging conditions, with portions of the population resisting cooperation amid misinformation and distrust. Ebola is a dangerous virus transmitted through direct contact with infected individuals and bodily fluids, and the mortality rate can be very high if not responded to promptly. International organizations urge calm, protection of medical personnel, and strengthened measures to curb further spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでの混乱：デモ参加者が治療センターに放火、エボラが再び拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラの再流行に加え、医療施設への破壊行為、深刻な信頼喪失、医療対応の阻害という複合的な危機。IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱という最高リスク疾患に加え、医療施設への暴力行為、社会不安、地域住民の医療不信という社会的・政治的要因が深刻な複合危機を形成。対応能力の低下により感染拡大が加速するリスクが指摘されている。国際支援の必要性が明確。

article.articleHeadline: 前 미 CDC 소장, 에볼라 팬데믹으로 확산 우려
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Former U.S. CDC director warns of spread into an Ebola pandemic.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks spreading from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) threaten to reach Tanzania, southern South Sudan, and Rwanda, warned former U.S. CDC director Robert Redfield on May 20. Most current cases are in DRC and Uganda. CDC data as of May show 536 suspected cases, 105 high-probability contacts, 34 laboratory-confirmed cases, and about 134 suspected deaths. Redfield characterized the outbreak as an international public health emergency in waiting, citing delayed detection after case counts exceeded 100. This May-initiated outbreak is the 17th in the region in 50 years; the previous outbreak ended in December. A U.S. healthcare worker exposed in the DRC was evacuated to Germany. The U.S. State Department issued a travel advisory, enforcing enhanced screening on arrival for U.S. citizens and green-card holders who visited the DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan within 21 days.

triage.headline_ja: 米国前CDC所長、エボラパンデミックへの拡大を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の多国間での急速な拡大、死亡者を伴う深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的な感染拡大リスク、旅行制限が既に発令されており、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC、ウガンダ、タンザニア、ルワンダ、南スーダンでの発生が言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRC(203312)のみ。米国、ドイツは対象国外のため除外。エボラ出血熱の急速な拡大、複数国への脅威、米国務省の旅行警告発令、米国医療従事者の感染など、極めて高いリスク。前CDC所長による「国際公衆衛生緊急事態の兆候」との警告は、シグナルピックアップの根拠を強化する。

article.articleHeadline: Κονγκό: Οργισμένο πλήθος έβαλε φωτιά σε σκηνές νοσοκομείου με λοιμώξεις από Έμπολα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: An Angry Crowd Set Fire to Hospital Tents Housing Ebola Patients.
article.articleSummary: An angry crowd in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo set fire to isolation tents at Ruabara General Hospital near Bunia, Ituri province, after relatives of a young man who allegedly died from Ebola were blocked from retrieving his body for burial. Six patients remained in hospital tents in the courtyard, with fears they could flee during the chaos. Police fired warning shots to disperse demonstrators; a healthcare worker was injured by stones. The deceased, locally respected, lived amid widespread disbelief about Ebola, with some residents doubting the outbreak and accusing NGOs and hospitals of fabricating it for profit. WHO emphasizes safe, dignified burials carried out by trained teams in PPE. Alima, which manages the facility, said all six patients have been located and are receiving care inside the hospital. Ebola has killed more than 130 people in eastern Congo during this outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：怒った群衆がエボラ患者が収容された病院のテントに火をつけた
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の暴力事件、国際的拡大リスク）。WPRO基準でも複数該当し、現在の流行状況が社会的・政治的関心を喚起している。
triage.notes: 記事は東部DRC（イトゥリ州、ブニア市）でのエボラ患者隔離施設への暴力行為を報道。130人以上の死亡者がいる活発な流行の中での医療サービス崩壊リスク、地域住民のエボラ否定主義と医療不信が深刻な課題。隔離患者の逃亡リスク、医療従事者への暴力、感染制御体制の脆弱性が複合的に存在。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola alarm: India and Africa are connected with 99 weekly flights
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak status: WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) with over 600 suspected cases and 130 deaths. India issued travel advisory on May 21 advising passengers from high-risk countries—DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan—who present fever, weakness, headache, muscle pain, vomiting, diarrhea, sore throat, or unexplained bleeding, or those with blood/body fluid exposure or contact with suspected/confirmed cases, to report to Airport Health Officers; travellers developing symptoms within 21 days must self-isolate and seek medical help. India maintains a broad Africa–India network totaling 99 weekly frequencies; Uganda Airlines operates direct Mumbai service thrice weekly, with 7,000 Uganda–India passengers in Q1. Major carriers include Ethiopian Airlines (9,071 seats each way, 38 weekly frequencies to Mumbai, Delhi, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai), Kenya Airways (Nairobi–Mumbai), EgyptAir (Cairo–Delhi/Mumbai), and Air Tanzania (Dar es Salaam–Mumbai). IndiGo flies Mumbai–Nairobi non-stop; Air India and Air Mauritius serve Mauritius; Mauritius has no current Ebola cases. Uganda connects via Dubai/Doha/Jeddah/Sharjah; DRC via Addis Ababa/Nairobi; South Sudan limited. India’s preparedness includes SOP development; overall Africa exposure is <0.5% of India’s international capacity.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ警報：インドとアフリカは99便の週間フライトで結ばれている
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言、600件以上の疑い例と130人の死亡が報告されており、IHR基準を複数満たす。インドを含む対象国への実質的な旅行リンクと輸入リスクが確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC・ウガンダでのエボラ流行とそのインドへの輸入リスクに焦点を当てている。WHOのPHEIC宣言、600件以上の疑い例・130人の死亡、インドの旅行勧告発令（5月21日）、週99便の航空ネットワーク（ウガンダ航空が週3便でムンバイ接続、7,000人/Q1）が重要。インド自身のアウトブレイク報告はないが、高リスク国からの輸入ケース監視体制が展開されている。DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンが記事で主要な発生地として言及されているが、対象国リストではDRCとウガンダのみが該当。

article.articleHeadline: كواليس كأس العالم: إصابة نيمار وأزمة فيروس الكونغو وقرار فيفا بزيادة المنتخبات
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Behind the Scenes of the World Cup: Neymar's injury, the Congo virus crisis, and FIFA's decision to increase the number of national teams.
article.articleSummary: Brazilian star Neymar da Silva suffers a mild right-leg muscle injury during Santos training ahead of the 2026 FIFA World Cup; Santos’ team doctor says there is mild swelling, not alarming, with recovery progressing and a potential return within a week to join Brazil's camp. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, health authorities in the east report a new Ebola outbreak, prompting the national team to cancel its Kinshasa training camp amid dozens of suspected cases and related deaths. Separately, AS reports ongoing discussion about expanding the 2030 World Cup to 64 national teams, a proposal favored by FIFA President Gianni Infantino to broaden inclusion.

triage.headline_ja: ワールドカップの舞台裏：ネイマールの負傷、コンゴウイルス危機、FIFAの代表国増加決定
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は極めて高い重症度と致死率を有する。コンゴ民主共和国東部での新規アウトブレイク報告は、異常・予想外の事象であり、複数の疑い例と死亡報告があることから、IHR基準2項目以上に該当する可能性が高く、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはBrazilも含まれているが、記事サマリーではBrazilでのエボラ発生は報告されていない。Brazilの言及はネイマール選手の負傷とブラジル代表チームのキャンプに関する内容のみであるため、verified_locationsから除外した。DRC東部での新規アウトブレイク報告で疑い例と死亡が報告されており、感染症危機管理として緊急対応が必要な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: 671 Verdachtsfälle und 160 Tote im Ostkongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: 671 suspected cases and 160 deaths in eastern Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo remains escalating. As of May 22, 2026, the DRC Ministry of Health reports 671 suspected Ebola cases and 160 suspected deaths. The World Health Organization had earlier estimated roughly 600 suspected cases and over 130 suspected deaths, noting the true number is likely higher due to underreporting. Laboratory confirmation has been achieved for 64 infections and 6 deaths. The article does not provide specific information on transmission chains, infection sources, or details about imported/exported cases. The data reflect an ongoing outbreak in the region, with ongoing surveillance by health authorities and international agencies.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：東コンゴで671件の疑似症例と160人の死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模流行で、DRCで671件の疑似症例・160人の死亡が報告されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、および渡航・貿易制限のリスクが明確に認められる。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は高致命率・高伝播性ウイルス感染症。記事では671件の疑似症例と160人の死亡が報告されており、実験室確認済み感染者64名・死亡6名となっている。東コンゴでの地理的位置付けが明記されており、WHO推定では真の感染者数は過小報告の可能性があるとされている。国際的な公衆衛生上の高リスクイベント。

article.articleHeadline: WORLD IN BRIEF: UN court upholds workers' right to strike, Rubio labels Cuba security threat, US tightens Ebola screening and other stories - Businessday NG
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo with spillover into Uganda; Bundibugyo strain has killed at least 139 people and infected hundreds. In response, the United States has ordered Americans returning from the DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan in the past three weeks to enter via Washington Dulles International Airport for enhanced Ebola screening; non-citizens recently traveling from affected countries are barred from entering the United States. The outbreak has already spread into neighbouring Uganda, raising fears of wider regional transmission. The brief notes broader health security implications alongside other geopolitical news in the day’s global brief. No further clinical details are provided.

triage.headline_ja: 世界短信：国連裁判所が労働者のストライキ権を支持、ルビオがキューバを安全保障上の脅威と指摘、米国がエボラスクリーニングを強化その他
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2の4基準中3項目に該当。エボラウイルス病の多国家流行で139人以上の死亡、ウガンダへの越境拡大、米国による入国制限措置実施により、国際的な懸念と行動が発生している。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo strain（ブンディブギョ株）による確認流行。DRC、ウガンダ、スーダンが発生地域として記事に明記されているが、対象国リスト内ではDRCとウガンダのみ該当。米国の入国制限措置が講じられており、国際的関心が高い。ただし米国での実際の症例発生は記事から確認できない。

article.articleHeadline: 160 وفاة جديدة والاشتباه بإصابة 671 شخصا بفيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 160 new deaths and 671 people suspected of being infected with the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 160 Ebola-related deaths and 671 suspected infections, with 64 confirmed cases and 6 lab-confirmed deaths. The World Health Organization notes nearly 600 suspected cases and over 130 suspected deaths, cautioning that true numbers are likely higher due to underreporting. In neighboring Uganda, health authorities say no new infections beyond two previously confirmed Congolese nationals; one patient has died, while the second’s test was negative for the second time and remains under treatment. Africa CDC indicates the outbreak began in Ituri province in northeastern DRC, bordering Uganda and South Sudan, marking the seventeenth Ebola outbreak in the country since 1976. The outbreak involves Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare strain with no vaccine or specific treatment, complicating containment. Ebola is highly contagious via direct contact with infected individuals or bodily fluids; the 2014–2015 West Africa epidemic killed more than 11,000 people.

triage.headline_ja: 160人の新規死亡とエボラウイルスへの671人の感染疑い
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当する。エボラ出血熱の多数の死亡・感染報告、予想外の新規発症、DRC・ウガンダでの国際的拡大の兆候、渡航制限のリスクが高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUganda、Sudan、Angolaが含まれるが、記事サマリーではDRCが主なイベント発生地であり、ウガンダは国境を接した隣国での監視対象。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ワクチン・特異的治療なし）という稀な株系で、封じ込めが複雑化。西アフリカ流行（2014-2015）の死者数も言及され、国際的な懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Вспышка Эболы. Нападение на больницу в ДР Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak. Attack on a hospital in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri Province, near Bunia) intensified after locals attacked a tent treatment center inside a hospital. Relatives of a young man who died demanded his body for traditional burial; clinicians insisted the patient had Ebola and that remains must be buried under strict protocols, prompting arson and injuries to a humanitarian worker. Locals distrust Ebola and some believe the outbreak is fabricated by aid groups; in sparsely populated areas, traditional beliefs hinder risk communication. Since the outbreak began about two weeks earlier, some 130 deaths have been reported in DRC. The strain circulating reportedly has no vaccine, though a treatment effective against most strains has existed since 2019, helping reduce mortality to about 6%. Cases and deaths have been detected outside DRC; the outbreak is not a global pandemic, but the WHO has declared an international public health emergency.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行。コンゴ民主共和国の病院への攻撃
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO国際保健上の緊急事態宣言済み。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）はWPRO対象国リストに含まれていないが、IHR基準及びWPROスクリーニング基準で全項目該当、かつWHOが既に国際保健上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言している極めて重大なシグナル。記事では DRC 内での発生が確認されており、同時に DRC 外でのケース・死亡例も報告されている。医療施設への攻撃と地域社会の信頼喪失により管理可能性が著しく低下している。

article.articleHeadline: ایبولا وائرس کی وباء پاکستان سمیت دنیا بھر میں خطرے کی گھنٹی بج گئی
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus outbreak has rung alarm bells worldwide, including Pakistan.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus outbreak has triggered global alarm; the World Health Organization has labeled it a public health concern with international implications. Pakistan’s Ministry of Health has initiated preemptive measures, instructing the National Institute of Health to ensure preparedness and keep laboratory kits available, and directing Border Health Services to stay alert. Airports will screen travelers arriving from Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo. Clinicians are reminded that Ebola hemorrhagic fever symptoms can resemble dengue, underscoring cautious clinical assessment. Officials say Pakistan’s situation is fully under control and there is no domestic cause for alarm. In Africa, around 300 suspected Ebola cases have been reported with about 80 deaths. The U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention has deployed a response team to both affected African countries to assist with containment and investigation.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスの流行は世界中を含むパキスタンでアラームを鳴らしている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、予想外の新規発生、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、アフリカでエボラウイルス流行が発生しており、DRCおよびウガンダでの発生が明記されている。パキスタンは予防的対応国として言及されているが、実際の患者発生地域ではないため verified_locations から除外。米国も言及されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。WHO公式認識、CDCの対応チーム派遣、複数国での国境警戒強化など国際的公衆衛生への脅威として機能している。300以上の疑い患者、約80人の死亡との報告あり。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak: South Korea Expands Congo Travel Ban To 3 Provinces
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo prompts South Korea to widen travel restrictions to Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu. A Level 4 alert for Ituri takes effect from 2 pm Friday, May 22, 2026, with penalties under passport law for travel to or staying in these zones without authorization. No-travel zones now cover Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu. A Level 3 alert urges Koreans to leave areas within 50 km of the Central African Republic border, including Bas-Uele and Haut-Uele among eight DRC provinces. A special advisory remains for the rest of the DRC; Uganda is under a separate advisory after KDCA designated DRC, Uganda and South Sudan as priority quarantine management countries. So far, more than 160 suspected Ebola deaths have been reported in eastern DRC; the Foreign Ministry will monitor and revise warnings as needed.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク：韓国がコンゴへの渡航禁止をさらに3州に拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の東部DRCでの発生は深刻な公衆衛生への影響を示し、複数国（DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン）での懸念、国際的な渡航制限の実施、及び国家レベルの対応が明確。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはSouth Korea、Sudan、Central African Republicなども含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題は東部DRCでのエボラアウトブレイク。韓国やスーダンは二次的な対応国（渡航制限、警告レベル設定）であり、実際の感染症イベント発生地はDRCのみ。160人以上の疑い死亡報告あり、複数州にわたる拡大が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: രോഗം ബാധിച്ചവർ ചോരവാർന്ന് മരിക്കുന്നു; പുതിയ എബോളയ്‌ക്ക് മുന്‍പത്തേക്കാള്‍ തീവ്രത
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Infected people are bleeding to death; the severity is greater than the previous Ebola.
article.articleSummary: New Ebola virus variant identified in Congo on May 14, named Bundibugyo. Initial tests misattributed the cases to the older Ebola strain; later confirmation shows a distinct, more severe virus. Last week 65 deaths; by the second week the death toll reached about 130, with concerns it may double in coming weeks. About 400 people have been infected, with spread from the initial village to surrounding communities. Common symptoms include fever, headache, muscle pains, vomiting, diarrhea, and bleeding from the body. The Congo government has opened three Ebola treatment centers. The World Health Organization has deployed experts to Congo. Authorities have tightened border checks and restricted movement in affected zones to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 感染者が出血して死亡；新型エボラの重篤度は従来よりも高い
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。新型エボラウイルス変種の発生で死亡率が高く（65→130例/1週間），国際的拡大リスクが高く，複数の公衆衛生対応が開始されている。
triage.notes: 新型エボラウイルス変種（Bundibugyo）の発生。短期間での死亡数急増（65→130例），感染者約400人，複数地域への拡大，WHO専門家派遣，国境検査強化等から緊急の対応が必要。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: 4 điểm bất thường của đợt dịch Ebola khiến 131 người tử vong
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Four unusual features of the Ebola outbreak that killed 131 people.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri) and Uganda. By May 18, Congo reported 516 suspected cases and 131 deaths; Uganda had two cases by May 16, with one death. On May 17, WHO declared the Bundibugyo-related Ebola in Congo and Uganda a public health emergency of international concern. Vietnamese Ministry of Health held an emergency virtual meeting on May 22 to monitor Ebola and strengthen prevention. Four unusual features: clusters of deaths in community and among health workers; unclear scale and epidemiologic links; high proportion of positive samples and rapidly rising suspected cases in Ituri; cross-border transmission across shared borders. Vietnam’s risk is low but not zero; no cases by May 21. Transmission is zoonotic from wildlife and human-to-human via blood, secretions, or contaminated items; WHO does not call for broad airport screening outside affected areas. No Bundibugyo-specific vaccine or treatment exists.

triage.headline_ja: 131人の死亡をもたらしたエボラアウトブレイクの4つの異常な特徴
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目全て該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスク）。WHO緊急宣言済み、複数国での確認、死亡率の高さ。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、実際の発生地はDRCおよびウガンダ。Ugandaは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。Vietnamは保健省が緊急会議開催し監視体制を強化している国として記事の主題に含まれるため verified_locations に含める。Bluedot APIが付与した'Republic of Uganda'（226074）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外した。WHO PHEIC宣言済み、Bundibugyo型エボラウイルス、516疑似症例、131死亡、国間越境感染あり。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola e minacce biologiche, Cascio: "La Sicilia sia piattaforma di sorveglianza mediterranea
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola and biological threats, Cascio: "Sicily should be a platform for Mediterranean surveillance."
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo keeps Italy engaged with WHO and the EU's health-security framework. The Italian Health Ministry says national and regional risk remains high in the affected area but low globally. It is not a pandemic emergency, but a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) requiring surveillance, contact tracing, isolation of suspected and confirmed cases, protection of health workers, and strengthened infection prevention and control. The episode sits alongside unresolved questions about unclassified illness signals in Burundi, where five deaths have occurred and diagnostic tests for Ebola, Marburg, Rift Valley fever, yellow fever, and Crimean–Congo hemorrhagic fever were negative. Key elements to containment are rapid operational capacity, coordination, territorial integration, laboratories, trained personnel. Italy's Pandemic Plan 2025-2029 allocates over €1.1 billion to prevention, labs, stockpiles, and governance. Sicily, by geography, could serve as a Mediterranean surveillance platform.

triage.headline_ja: エボラとバイオハザード、カッシオ：「シチリアは地中海監視プラットフォームであるべき」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク、国際的関心）。DRCでのエボラ流行の継続報道であり、WHOとEUの枠組みでの対応が進行中。PHEIC指定済みのため、シグナルとしてピックアップ対象。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラBundibugyo株の流行とブルンジでの不明疾患（5例の死亡、ウイルス検査陰性）に関するもの。イタリア・シチリアの記述は監視プラットフォーム化の提案であり、実際の発生地ではないため除外。ブルンジは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。現在PHEIC指定済みで、WHO・EU枠組みでの対応が継続中。

article.articleHeadline: Uçakta Ebola paniği: ABD rotası Kanada ile değiştirildi | Amerika Haberleri
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola panic on a plane: U.S. route changed to Canada | US News
article.articleSummary: CBP prevented a passenger from boarding and diverted the flight to Montreal to reduce Ebola risk. Under new rules, foreign nationals who have been in Uganda, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, or South Sudan in the past 21 days and do not hold a U.S. passport face a 30-day entry restriction. Additionally, planes carrying foreign passengers from outbreak zones may only land at Washington Dulles International Airport in Virginia, where screening is centralized. As of May 22, 2026, the World Health Organization reported about 600 suspected Ebola cases and 139 suspected deaths in the region. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, 51 cases have been confirmed; Uganda has two confirmed cases. An American citizen working in the DRC tested positive and was evacuated to Germany for treatment.

triage.headline_ja: 飛行機でのエボラパニック：米国の航路がカナダに変更された | 米国ニュース
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病は国際的に拡大するリスクが高く、複数国（DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン）での確認、複数国での入国制限措置、国際航空便の運航制限措置が実施されており、IHR基準の複数項目（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）に該当する。WPROスクリーニング基準では重症度（死亡例の報告）および管理可能性（国際的な対応措置の実施）が該当する。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIは複数の国を発生地域として付与しているが、記事サマリーを精査すると、実際のエボラ症例確認国は DRC（51確認例）、ウガンダ（2確認例）、南スーダンであり、米国およびカナダはこれらの地域からの乗客を受け入れる際の航空便制限措置の対象国である。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。本シグナルは対象国外での発生主体であるが、IHR基準とWPRO基準の双方で全項目該当するため、公衆衛生上の重要性が極めて高いと判断され、PICKUP推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Was Sie über das tödliche Virus wissen müssen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: What You Need to Know About the Deadly Virus
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Central Africa centers on the cross-border region where the Democratic Republic of the Congo, South Sudan, and Uganda meet. The first proven death occurred on 24 April, and infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have continued to rise. The current outbreak involves the Bundibugyo Ebola variant, for which there is no licensed vaccine; case fatality without treatment is estimated at 30–50%. Ebola symptoms begin with fever, weakness, headache, and muscle pains, advancing to severe inflammation, internal bleeding, circulatory collapse, and organ failure. Transmission is via direct contact with body fluids, not airborne, necessitating strict isolation and hygiene for healthcare workers. The region's dense cross-border movement, armed conflict, and weak health systems hinder contact tracing. By contrast, the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak killed more than 11,000. The WHO is delivering aid and tracing contacts; global pandemic risk remains very low.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：この致命的なウイルスについて知っておくべきことが何か
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルスの多国間爆発的感染（DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン）で、高い致死率（30-50%）、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性があり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響が懸念される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国での感染数の増加が明記されており、同国が対象国に該当するため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダ（226074）、南スーダン（366755）、アンゴラ（3351879）は対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。Bundibugyo変異体にはワクチンなしであり、感染者数の増加傾向、武装紛争による医療支援の困難性、密集した越境移動など、制御困難性が高い。WHO による支援が進行中だが、地域の脆弱な保健システムと紛争環境により国際的支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Bộ Y tế họp khẩn về giám sát và phòng chống dịch Ebola tại Việt Nam 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health Holds Emergency Meeting on Ebola Surveillance and Prevention in Vietnam 2026
article.articleSummary: Ebola is a highly contagious, acute hemorrhagic fever with case fatality up to 90%. Vietnam’s Ministry of Health says the risk of Ebola entry is low but surveillance and preparedness must be intensified. At a May 22 emergency meeting chaired by Deputy Minister Nguyen Thi Lien Huong, authorities reviewed national surveillance and prevention measures with hundreds of transmission points connected nationwide. The Bundibugyo strain is driving the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri Province) and Uganda. As of May 16, Congo reported 8 laboratory-confirmed cases, 246 suspected cases, and 80 suspected deaths; by May 18, suspected cases rose to 516 with 131 deaths. Uganda reported 2 cases and 1 death by May 16, both linked to Congo. On May 17, WHO declared Bundibugyo Ebola in Congo and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. In Vietnam, border screening for travelers from Congo/Uganda is intensified; transmission occurs from wildlife to humans and via contact with infected fluids. Vaccines and targeted therapies exist for some Ebola strains, but not for Bundibugyo specifically.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナム保健省、2026年のエボラウイルス感染症の監視と予防に関する緊急会議を開催
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHOがPublic Health Emergency of International Concern（PHEIC）を宣言した大規模なエボラ流行であり、複数国での確定症例と死亡例を伴う。
triage.notes: WHOはPHEIC宣言済み。Bundibugyo株はコンゴ東部（Ituri Province）とウガンダで流行中。ベトナムは監視・準備態勢強化で対応。ウガンダは発生地域に含まれるが、記事の主題はコンゴ・ウガンダ流行についての警告報告と、ベトナムの対応に焦点があるため、verified_locationsに含める。

article.articleHeadline: คุมเข้ม 'อีโบลา' ยกระดับคัดกรองผู้เดินทางจากพื้นที่เสี่ยง 'คองโก-ยูกันดา' - The Bangkok Insight
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tighten Ebola controls; step up screening of travelers from high-risk areas Congo and Uganda - The Bangkok Insight
article.articleSummary: Following the WHO’s designation of Ebola virus disease (EVD) as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda were designated Ebola-infected zones, effective 21 May 2026. Thailand tightens border controls and traveler screening for arrivals from these high-risk areas. The Ministry of Public Health, via the Department of Disease Control, will strengthen entry-point surveillance; pre-registration is required: foreigners use the Thailand Digital Arrival Card (TDAC), Thais use the Thai Health Pass. Screening includes symptom checks, fever assessment, history-taking, and 21-day post-arrival monitoring. The Civil Aviation Authority of Thailand coordinates with the Ministry of Public Health, airlines, and agencies to implement three measures: pre-travel health information, origin-based screening with registration verification, and data support for border control. Drills for suspected cases on aircraft or after arrival are planned. The government affirms health-system readiness and cross-agency collaboration to protect health and reassure citizens.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ対策を強化、コンゴ・ウガンダなどの高リスク地域からの渡航者スクリーニングを段階的に強化 - The Bangkok Insight
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（公衆衛生上の深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHOがPHEICを宣言したエボラウイルス病で、複数国に確認されており、タイが緊急対応を実施している。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（ID 226074）はBluedot APIで指定されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外した。DRCとタイのみを検証済みロケーションとして列挙。WHO PHEIC宣言により、国際的な関心と対応が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: สธ.ยันรับมือได้! สั่งสังเกตอาการ คนจากคองโด-อูกันดา แล้ว 126 ราย สกัดอีโบลาเข้าไทย
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MOH insists it can cope! Orders monitoring of symptoms for people from Congo and Uganda; now 126 people; Ebola kept out of Thailand.
article.articleSummary: Ebola monitoring intensifies as Thailand designates the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda as Ebola-affected areas from 21 May 2026. Over the prior 21 days, 126 travelers from Congo and Uganda arrived, with 5 travelers (all in Bangkok) recorded on 21 May. All entrants undergo screening and Health Declaration via TDAC; airlines must share passenger data; high-risk travelers are tracked for 21 days. Globally, as of 17 May 2026, ~250 suspected cases and ~160 deaths related to Ebola have been reported. The current outbreak is Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment; Saïr strain has vaccines. Incubation 2-21 days; early symptoms resemble flu, progressing to hemorrhagic manifestations; mortality 40-80%; transmission requires close contact with body fluids, not airborne. Thailand operates a three-tier system: monitoring, quarantine for high risk (Siriraj facility with 60 rooms, 90 people), and isolation for active cases; airlines may bear outbreak-control costs if they knowingly enable spread.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省が対応可能と主張！コンゴ・ウガンダからの入国者126人の症状を監視指示 エボラをタイに阻止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（公衆衛生影響：死亡・症例報告有、異常：エボラ流行、国際拡大リスク：複数国発生、渡航制限：実施中）。WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当。タイでの検疫体制構築と国際的な対応が開始されている。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラの流行地域（DRC・ウガンダ）からタイへの流入リスク対応を報道。Bundibugyo株でワクチン・治療法なし、致死率40-80%という高リスク。タイでの検疫・監視体制が既に稼動しており、国家的対応が実施中。ウガンダはGeoNames対象外のため verified_locations に含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Болест на Шагас или американска трипанозомоза и рисковете за пътуващите в Латинска Америка
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chagas disease or American trypanosomiasis and the risks for travelers to Latin America.
article.articleSummary: Chagas disease (American trypanosomiasis), caused by Trypanosoma cruzi, is endemic in 21 Latin American countries and transmitted mainly by triatomine bugs that defecate near bites. With rising travel and migration, infections are detected in Europe, North America and Asia. For short tourist stays, risk is low, but extended stays in poor accommodations increase exposure. A 2024 systematic review found anti-T. cruzi antibodies in 3.5% of Latin American migrants living outside traditional foci; highest 21.5% among Bolivians. Nonvector transmission includes blood transfusion, organ donation, and mother-to-child; food- and drink-borne spread is rising in the Amazon basin, with beverages like açaí, sugarcane juice, guava, and bacaba potentially contaminated. In Brazil, over 70% of acute Amazon cases are foodborne. Acute illness starts 1–2 weeks after infection: fever, malaise, facial edema, hepatosplenomegaly; 30–40% progress to chronic cardiac or digestive disease. Benznidazole and nifurtimox are effective in acute/congenital disease; prevention includes insecticide-treated nets and pasteurized drinks.

triage.headline_ja: シャーガス病（アメリカ睡眠病）とラテンアメリカへの旅行者向けのリスク
triage.triage_reason: シャーガス病はラテンアメリカで風土病であり、旅行者や移民への感染拡大が報告されている。ただし、記事は主に教育・啓発的な内容であり、新規の疾患流行イベントや急速な感染拡大の報告ではない。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: IHR基準は2つ以上該当するが、記事サマリーは旅行者向けの注意喚起・教育的内容であり、新規の流行事件や急速な感染拡大の報告ではない。ボリビアは対象国外のため除外。食中毒経路やアマゾン地域での増加傾向は注視の価値があるが、現段階では継続的な経過観察が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Около 300 россиян в Африке рискуют заразиться Эболой на банановых плантациях
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Around 300 Russians in Africa risk contracting Ebola on banana plantations.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is described as one of the world's most dangerous viruses, with mortality cited at around 25%, and an incubation period of up to two weeks. Initial symptoms resemble influenza-like illness: fever, weakness, body aches, potentially progressing to a severe form with internal bleeding. The article notes that on May 17, the WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern over outbreaks in Congo and Uganda. It highlights that about 300 Russians in Africa are at risk of contracting Ebola on banana plantations. Despite the disease’s extreme danger, with lethality sometimes exceeding 50% (approaching 90% in some cases) and no specific treatment, the article claims certain disease features hinder mass spread: from the early days a patient is in grave condition and cannot easily infect others. Russians are advised that the threat will not reach Russia, nor will Ebola trigger a new global pandemic.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカのバナナプランテーションでエボラに感染するリスクを抱える約300人のロシア人
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。WHOが2026年5月17日にコンゴおよびウガンダでのアウトブレイクに関して国際的懸念事項として公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言しており、国際的な拡大リスクと渡航制限の可能性が明確。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴとウガンダでのWHO宣言が明記されているが、対象国リストにはウガンダ（GeoNames ID 226074）が含まれていないため、verified_locationsにはコンゴのみを記載。ロシア人労働者の曝露リスクが具体的に言及されており、社会的・政治的関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: Corea del Sur amplía la prohibición de viajar a la República Democrática del Congo por el ébola | AGENCIA DE NOTICIAS YONHAP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: South Korea expands travel ban to the Democratic Republic of the Congo due to Ebola | Yonhap News Agency
article.articleSummary: South Korea's Ministry of Foreign Affairs expands its travel ban to the Democratic Republic of the Congo amid an Ebola outbreak, raising the Level 4 travel advisory to Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. From 2:00 p.m. on May 22, 2026, Korean citizens are prohibited from visiting or staying in these provinces without extraordinary passport authorization under the Passport Act. A Level 3 alert also advises evacuation from areas within 50 kilometers of the Central African Republic border and seven other DRC provinces, including Bas-Uele and Haut-Uele. Travel is not advised for the rest of the DRC. Earlier, Seoul issued a no-travel advisory for Uganda after the KDCA designated DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan as priority areas for Ebola quarantine management. In eastern DRC, Ebola infections are rising, with suspected deaths exceeding 160."

triage.headline_ja: 南コリア、エボラに関するコンゴ民主共和国への渡航禁止を拡大 | 聯合ニュース通信
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的拡大リスク、複数国への影響、IHR基準3つ以上該当、および政府レベルの対応（渡航禁止措置）が確認される。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC（コンゴ民主共和国）でのエボラ発生と、それに対する南コリアの公式対応（渡航禁止措置の拡大）を主題としている。Seoulが記事ソース（南コリアのニュース機関）として含まれているため、発生地域リストにSeoulが含まれているが、実際の感染イベント発生地はDRCである。疑い死亡数が160を超える可能性があり、東部DRCで感染が増加中とされている。

article.articleHeadline: Світ на межі нової смертельної епідемії: хвороба без лікування і вакцини
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World on the brink of a new deadly epidemic: a disease with no treatment and no vaccine.
article.articleSummary: As of May 22, 2026, the World Health Organization declared an international public health emergency over an outbreak of the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola virus in Africa. There is no approved vaccine or specific treatment, with mortality potentially up to 50%. The Democratic Republic of Congo, particularly Ituri Province, has laboratory-confirmed new cases and hundreds of additional suspected hemorrhagic fever cases and dozens of deaths, suggesting the true burden may be higher. The virus has begun crossing borders, with new infections in Uganda (Kampala) and in Kinshasa after travel from the outbreak area; at least one death has been reported in Uganda. Healthcare workers are among the infected, signaling possible nosocomial transmission. Ongoing humanitarian crisis, population displacement, and regional instability compound risks. While not a pandemic, the situation meets WHO PHEIC criteria; the Director-General will convene a special committee to determine further action.

triage.headline_ja: 世界は新たな致命的流行の危機に直面：治療法とワクチンのない病気
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラウイルス（ブンディブギョ株）の国際的な多国間拡大、高い致死率（最大50%）、医療従事者への感染、WHOが国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言している点から、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダでの事例が言及されているが、ウガンダ（226074）はBluedetotの対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを記載。WHOが国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態(PHEIC)を宣言している点が最も重要。

article.articleHeadline: 민주콩고서 에볼라 확산세...반군 점령 지역으로도 확산
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo... also spreading to rebel-held areas.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 670 suspected cases with about 160 related deaths, and testing capacity remains stretched, suggesting true counts are higher. The disease is spreading into rebel-held areas previously under M23 control, including North Kivu’s Bukavu region and Ituri Province. A 28-year-old man who traveled from Kisangani to Bukavu died and was confirmed Ebola post-mortem; M23 has sent over 200 suspected samples to Goma in North Kivu for confirmation. Local residents have resisted response measures, complicating containment; protests erupted when authorities could not promptly recover the body of an Ebola-linked death in Lwampara, Ituri, prompting a fire at a treatment tent. Separately, the foreign ministry issued a Level 4 travel advisory for Ituri, expanding the travel ban to North Kivu, South Kivu, and Ituri with penalties for noncompliance.

triage.headline_ja: 民主コンゴでエボラ拡大...反政府勢力支配地域にも拡散
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の拡大、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。エボラ出血熱は国際的に重大な関心事であり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は重大な国際的脅威。670件以上の疑い患者と約160人の死亡が報告されている。反政府勢力支配地域への拡大、住民の対応措置への抵抗、検査能力の限界等により管理が困難な状況。複数省庁による渡航制限レベル4の発令が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola i Kongo-Kinshasa: sjukhustält sattes i brand | Sveriges Radio
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Kongo-Kinshasa: a hospital tent was set on fire
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Kongo-Kinshasa (DRC) saw a hospital tent housing isolated Ebola-infected bodies set alight by local villagers. The disturbance followed when friends and family of a young man who died of Ebola were not allowed to take the body from the isolation tent for burial. The incident underscores the difficulties facing Congolese authorities and aid organizations as they work to halt the outbreak. Published May 22, 2026, the report points to community turmoil around burial procedures and infection-control measures, illustrating how such incidents can complicate outbreak response. No laboratory-confirmed case counts or deaths are provided in the article. The report reflects ongoing challenges in outbreak management.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ・キンシャサのエボラ: 病院用テントが火をつけられた
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の発生事案であり、IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生影響（serious_impact）と異常性（unusual_unexpected）が確認される。また、社会的・政治的関心も高く、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国東部でのエボラ発生とそれに関連する社会的混乱（隔離遺体の埋葬をめぐる紛争、病院用テント火災）を報告。具体的な確認症例数や死亡数は記載されていないが、発生事実と対応困難性は明確。WPROスクリーニング全5基準に該当し、IHR基準も2基準以上の該当があることからPICKUP判定。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: الأمم المتحدة: بعثة حفظ السلام الأممية في الكونغو تساهم في مكافحة فيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: United Nations: The UN peacekeeping mission in the Democratic Republic of the Congo contributes to the fight against the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues as the United Nations peacekeeping mission supports government efforts to counter rapid spread and humanitarian deterioration. Ituri province remains epicenter, with densely populated towns Bunia, Rombara, and Monbwalo. The UN says peacekeepers are delivering logistics to Bunia to accelerate the response. Two UN cargo planes have transported supplies from Nairobi and Kinshasa to Bunia for UN partners, while over 4,600 kilograms of medical supplies were moved from WHO’s Nairobi regional warehouse by airlift. Four light vehicles and a helicopter support Ituri’s surveillance and field operations; ambulances and armored vehicles are being moved from Goma to Bunia for medical evacuations and access. Concerns rise over spread to North Kivu, with cases in Goma, Butembo, and Katwa; surveillance and screening are being strengthened, and remote coordination used as needed. The situation is worsened by displacement, insecurity, and access constraints.

triage.headline_ja: 国連：コンゴ民主共和国の国連平和維持活動がエボラウイルス対策に貢献
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の複数地域での継続流行、国際的支援の必要性、公衆衛生への重大な影響が認められ、IHR基準4つすべてに該当。WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべて該当するため、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC（Ituri州、North Kivu州、Kinshasa等複数地域）でのエボラ流行を主題としており、Nairobiはサマリー中のWHO地域備蓄庫の言及のみで、イベント発生地ではない。したがってKenyaは除外。DRC対象国IDは203312。発生地域フィールドに含まれるKenyaはverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemija ebole: U Kongu registrovano već 160 smrtnih i  671 sumnjivi slučaj opasne bolesti!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic: In Congo, 160 deaths and 671 suspected cases of the deadly disease have already been recorded.
article.articleSummary: As of May 22, 2026, Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, Ituri, continues to rise with 671 suspected cases and 160 suspected deaths, according to the Ministry of Health. Laboratory confirmation verifies 64 infections and 6 deaths. The World Health Organization reports 600 suspected cases and more than 130 suspected deaths, noting the true burden is higher due to underreporting. In neighboring Uganda, health authorities report no new infections besides two confirmed Congolese cases; one patient has died, the other has twice tested negative and remains under treatment. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugjo strain of Ebola, for which there is no vaccine or specific therapy. It began in Ituri, a northeast province bordering Uganda and South Sudan; this is the 17th Ebola outbreak in Congo since 1976. Ebola spreads via direct contact with infected individuals or bodily fluids. The 2014-2015 West Africa outbreak killed over 11,000 people.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行：コンゴで既に160人の死亡と671人の疑い患者が記録されている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱は重篤な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、国際的な拡大リスクが高く、複数国での確認と渡航制限のリスクがある。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはウガンダ、スーダンも含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はコンゴでの流行であり、ウガンダでは隣国からの輸入症例2例のみ、スーダンについては明確な記載がないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。ワクチンなし、Bundibugjo株、国境地帯での発生による域内拡大リスク高。

article.articleHeadline: Centru de tratament pentru Ebola, incendiat în RD Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola treatment center burned in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Bundibugyo variant) centered in Ituri province near Bunia; violence at Rwampara General Hospital led to burning of isolation tents as relatives tried to claim a body; security forces deployed and medical staff protected. WHO reports 139 deaths among about 600 suspected cases; Congolese health minister cites 159 deaths. Uganda reports two imported cases and has suspended cross-border travel and Semliki ferry services. The Bundibugyo variant has no vaccine yet; WHO warns vaccine development could take up to nine months. The M23 rebel group claims first Ebola case in South Kivu (28-year-old traveler from Kisangani; died before confirmation), raising access concerns. The outbreak disrupts public life including football training in Kinshasa; distrust and misinformation hinder response; authorities emphasize safe, dignified burials and continued surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ治療センターが焼き払われる
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の多国間にまたがる発生で、600件の疑い例、139～159件の死亡、ウガンダへの越境感染が確認されており、IHR基準の3項目（重篤性、異常性、国際的拡大）に該当する。また安全保障上の課題（施設への暴力）と医療アクセスの懸念が存在し、スクリーニング基準も複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境感染が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。発生地域はDRC内の複数州（Ituri、South Kivu、Kinshasa）。Bundibugyo亜種で、現在ワクチンがない状況。施設への暴力、セキュリティ上の課題、医療不信が対応を複雑化させている。

article.articleHeadline: فيروس إيبولا..حصيلة الإصابات والوفيات خلال آخر 50 عامًا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus: The toll of infections and deaths over the last 50 years.
article.articleSummary: As of 22 May 2026, the World Health Organization has declared an Ebola outbreak in Central Africa a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), with authorities rapidly tracing contacts as suspected cases rise. The global risk remains low, but the outbreak is described as a 'serious international concern' and potentially one of the largest in recent history, driven by accelerating deaths and rising case counts. The United States has imposed travel restrictions for arrivals from the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan. Previous Ebola waves have crossed continents, but most historic cases have centered in West and Central Africa. The article notes ongoing surveillance and the possibility that this outbreak could develop into one of the largest waves to date, highlighting the need for vigilance and public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス：過去50年間の感染者数と死亡者数の累計
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。WHOが国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念事項（PHEIC）を宣言し、複数国での発生、米国の渡航制限、歴史的規模の可能性がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで中央アフリカでのエボラ発生を記述しており、具体的には民主共和国コンゴ、ウガンダ、南スーダンが言及されている。対象国リスト内ではDRC（203312）のみが該当。WHOによるPHEIC宣言、米国の渡航制限、死亡者数の増加、過去50年で最大規模の可能性があるという記述から、公衆衛生上の緊急性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع إصابات "إيبولا" في الكونغو إلى 671 حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in Congo rise to 671.
article.articleSummary: As of May 22, 2026, Ebola cases in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo rise to 671 suspected infections and 160 suspected deaths, with 64 laboratory-confirmed infections and 6 confirmed deaths. The World Health Organization reports nearly 600 suspected cases and more than 130 suspected deaths, noting true numbers are likely higher due to underreporting. In neighboring Uganda, two confirmed cases have been reported; one patient has died, while the second patient tested negative for the virus twice and remains under treatment. The outbreak began in Ituri province in northeast Congo, which borders Uganda and South Sudan, and marks the 17th Ebola outbreak in Congo since 1976.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴにおけるエボラ感染者数が671例に上昇
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクのすべてが該当（4/4）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性が該当。高い社会政治的関心と国際支援必要性あり。
triage.notes: ウガンダで2例の確定症例が報告されているが、記事の主題はコンゴでの発生であり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。コンゴはDRCとして対象国に含まれる。Ituri州での発生で、ウガンダ・南スーダンと国境を接しており国際拡大リスクが高い。WHOが報告し、実数はさらに高い可能性とのこと。

article.articleHeadline: Rytų Konge toliau auga Ebolos infekcijų skaičius
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola infections continues to rise in Eastern Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of May 22, 2026, Ebola outbreaks continue to rise in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri province near Uganda and South Sudan. The DRC Ministry of Health reports 671 suspected Ebola cases and 160 suspected deaths, with 64 infections and 6 deaths laboratory-confirmed. The World Health Organization lists about 600 suspected cases and 130 suspected deaths. Experts say the true case count is higher due to underreporting. In neighboring Uganda, there have been no new infections beyond two cases among Congolese; one patient died, while the second patient tested negative twice and remains in treatment. The outbreak involves the rare Bundibugyo Ebola virus lineage, for which there is neither vaccine nor approved treatment, complicating containment. Ebola is highly contagious via contact with bodily fluids. This marks the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC since 1976; the 2014-2015 West Africa epidemic caused over 11,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 東部コンゴでエボラ感染者数が引き続き増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルスによる進行中の大規模アウトブレイク（671例の疑い患者、160例の疑い死亡、確認例64例）で、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダで既に2例）、ワクチン・治療薬が存在しない稀なBundibugyo株という異常性がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCのIturi州を中心とした発生を述べており、これが主題である。ウガンダは隣国であり2例の輸入症例（Congolese患者）を報告しているが、当該国での実質的なアウトブレイクではないため verified_locations には含めない。Bundibugyo株はワクチン・承認済み治療がないため管理難易度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Emergency Press Briefing on the Ebola Outbreak in DRC and Uganda - Africa CDC
article.articleSummary: Ebola Disease (Bundibugyo virus) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda; Africa CDC holds second emergency press briefing for a status update and urgent actions. Date: 23 May 2026. Time: 18:00–19:00 East Africa Time (GMT+3); equivalent times for Southern, Central, and West Africa. Location: virtual via Zoom; link supplied. Speakers: Africa CDC Director General Dr. Jean Kaseya; DRC Minister of Public Health, Hygiene, Social Welfare Hon. Dr. Roger Samuel Kamba; Uganda Minister of Health Dr. Jane Ruth Aceng Ocero; South Sudan Minister of Health Hon. Luke Thompson Thoan. Moderator: Prof. Yap Boum II. Languages: English and French. Media Q&A: questions via email to Communications@africacdc.org or live on Zoom; livestream on Africa CDC platforms. Background: DG's engagements with Uganda President Yoweri Museveni and strategic talks with health ministers of DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan, including a visit to Bunia epicenter. Focus: latest insights and urgent outbreak response actions.

triage.headline_ja: DRCおよびウガンダのエボラ感染症アウトブレイクに関する緊急プレスブリーフィング - Africa CDC
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo virus）の国際的アウトブレイクであり、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。DRCとウガンダの2国での確認、高い重症度と死亡リスク、国際的拡大の可能性、および渡航・貿易制限のリスクがある。Africa CDCによる緊急対応会議が開催され、政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV)は高い致死率を持つエボラウイルス種。発生地域にはウガンダとスーダンも含まれているが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。Africa CDCが二度目の緊急プレスブリーフィングを開催し、複数国の保健相級が参画。Bunia（DRC北東部）が震源地として確認されている。フルRRA実施を強く推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Norway contributes NOK 50 million to the WHO Health Contingencies Fund following Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak confirmed 15 May in Ituri Province, north-eastern DR Congo, with potential spread to Uganda; WHO has declared a public health emergency of international concern. The outbreak involves a rare Ebola strain with no approved vaccine or specific treatment. Conflict, large population movements and weak government control hinder contact tracing and response, increasing transmission risk within DR Congo and to neighboring countries. More than 26 million people face acute food insecurity in the region, with undernutrition, displacement and weakened health services raising mortality risk. WHO and Africa CDC are coordinating a regional response; Congolese authorities are leading control efforts. Norway contributes NOK 50 million to the WHO Health Contingencies Fund to enable rapid 24-hour resource releases, with USD 3.9 million already disbursed. Norway remains the largest funder, accounting for over 46% of 2025 financing, alongside broader NOK 657 million humanitarian health support in 2025.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱発生に続きノルウェーがWHO保健危機基金に5000万NOK拠出
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱はワクチンなしの希少株、国際的保健上の緊急事態宣言済み、DRC・ウガンダでの地域的拡大リスク高く、紛争・人口移動による制御困難。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC（イトゥリ州）でのエボラ発生を主題としており、ウガンダへの『潜在的拡大』と『地域的対応』に言及している。ノルウェーはファンド拠出国であり発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外。WHO緊急事態宣言済みで、ワクチンなしの希少株、紛争による接触者追跡困難という懸念要因多数。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため PICKUP 判定。

article.articleHeadline: Border districts move to stop spread of Ebola
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo prompts Uganda to strengthen border surveillance in the West Nile sub-region. Ten of 13 districts bordering DRC and South Sudan—Arua City, Zombo, Koboko, Yumbe, Maracha, Pakwach, Moyo, Adjumani, Nebbi, and Arua border—are designated priority areas. Screening is concentrated at official border crossings, with numerous informal routes remaining unscreened, raising concerns about porous borders. The Ministry of Health has dispatched surveillance teams and neurologists to bolster activity. Koboko district plans two screening points at Birijaku and Oraba, with committees reinstated for implementation and community sensitisation. Locals advocate screening at Lia, Odramacaku, and Vurra. Buliisa intensifies screening at Wanseko Ferry Crossing and Butiaba Landing Site; Bundibugyo adds six border points; Kagadi screens at Ndaiga, Kitebele, Kabukanga; Kisoro border in Mupaka urged stronger SOPs. A 30-day ban on large gatherings; PPE shortages reported; isolation centres prepared in Kagadi.

triage.headline_ja: 国境地域がエボラ感染拡大阻止に向けて動く
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的なスピルオーバーリスク（DRCからウガンダへ）、異常な事象、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、国家レベルの対応活動が確認される。IHR基準3項目以上該当、WPRO基準複数項目該当。
triage.notes: DRCにおけるエボラウイルス病の流行がウガンダの国境地域に対して直接的な脅威となっている。ウガンダは対応を実施しているが、本記事の主題は「DRCからのスピルオーバーリスク」であるため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含める。Colorado、Norway、United Statesなどは誤った地域判定と考えられる。記事はウガンダの防衛的措置についての報道だが、イベントの原因・主題はDRCのエボラ流行である。

article.articleHeadline: Rubio poděkoval Česku za přijetí Američana, který byl v kontaktu s ebolou
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rubio thanked the Czech Republic for admitting an American who had been in contact with Ebola.
article.articleSummary: An American physician, tied to a Christian missionary group Serge, who worked at Nyankunde Hospital in Ituri Province, eastern Congo, was transported during the night to Prague and placed in isolation at Bulovka University Hospital after it was suspected he may have contracted Ebola in Congo. The move followed a request from the U.S. embassy that he could remain in the Czech Republic through the Ebola incubation period. The patient, 44 years old according to NBC, shows no symptoms of illness. The Czech authorities and U.S. officials describe the gesture as gratitude, reflecting cooperation in outbreak response. Nyankunde and Ituri Province are experiencing ongoing Ebola activity. The case underscores monitoring for potential imported infections and the need to observe incubation-period management while awaiting any clinical changes or confirmations.

triage.headline_ja: ルビオがエボラウイルスに接触した米国人の受け入れについてチェコに感謝
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス疑い患者の国際移送であり、IHR基準（国際的拡大リスク、異常性）に該当し、対象国DRCでの継続的な流行活動を背景に、医療施設での隔離管理と国際協力の必要性が示唆されている。
triage.notes: 患者は現在チェコで隔離中で症状なしだが、DRCのイトゥリ州ニャンクンデ病院でのエボラウイルス曝露歴がある。記事の主要な疾患発生地はDRCのイトゥリ州であり、チェコは医療受け入れ国。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。

article.articleHeadline: كوريا الجنوبية توسع حظر السفر إلى جمهورية الكونغو الديمقراطية ليشمل 3 محافظات بسبب تفشي فيروس إيبولا | وكالة يونهاب للانباء
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: South Korea expands travel ban to the Democratic Republic of the Congo to include three provinces due to Ebola outbreak | Yonhap News Agency
article.articleSummary: South Korea expands its travel ban to the Democratic Republic of the Congo amid an Ebola outbreak in eastern DRC, adding Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu to a Level 4 travel warning as of 2:00 PM on May 22, 2026. Korean citizens traveling to these provinces without special authorization face penalties under passport laws. A Level 3 advisory also targets areas within 50 kilometers of the Central African Republic border and seven other provinces, including Bas-Uele and Haut-Uele. A separate special travel warning remains for the rest of the country. The Korean Disease Control and Prevention Agency (KDCA) has designated DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan as priority countries for quarantine management related to Ebola. The eastern DRC outbreak has reportedly caused more than 160 suspected deaths according to foreign media reports.

triage.headline_ja: 南米コリアが民主主義共和国への渡航禁止を3州に拡大、エボラウイルスの流行を理由に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱は高い公衆衛生影響を持つ指定感染症であり、複数国が対応を強化している。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は致死率の高い重篤感染症。記事は東部DRCでの流行による160人以上の疑い死亡を報告。複数国（韓国、ウガンダ、南スーダン）が隔離管理の優先国に指定するなど、国際的な対応が進行中。DRCは対象国リストに含まれる。記事でカテゴリル・アフリカ共和国、ウガンダ、南スーダンも言及されているが、主題は東部DRCの流行であるため verified_locations はDRCのみとした。
