United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Brits warned about these 11 travel-related diseases after recent rise in cases
article.articleSummary: Travel Health Pro (2026-05-22) warns of rising travel-related infections and urges up-to-date vaccinations and pre-travel health advice. Measles outbreaks persist across Europe, Africa, Asia and the Americas, including Canada and the United States. Dengue remains the fastest-growing mosquito-borne threat, with about 100 million symptomatic cases annually and roughly 300 million asymptomatic infections globally. Imported chikungunya in England, Wales and Northern Ireland rose to 160 cases in 2025, largely from travel to Bangladesh, India and Sri Lanka. Zika transmission evidence remains in 97 countries/territories, though rates are lower and many cases are asymptomatic or mild. Tick-borne encephalitis risk exists in central, northern and eastern Europe, Siberia, and parts of Asia; rare CNS involvement can occur. Malaria importations to the UK remain high, with a summer peak July–October. Typhoid and paratyphoid fever are rising; antibiotic-resistant typhoid is linked to Pakistan; there is a vaccine for typhoid but not paratyphoid. Antibiotic-resistant gonorrhoea is linked to Asia-Pacific travel. Advice: review vaccines, consult a travel clinic, use mosquito protection, complete malaria prophylaxis, and seek urgent care for fever after return.

triage.headline_ja: 最近の症例増加後、イギリス人に11の旅行関連疾患について警告
triage.triage_reason: 複数の旅行関連感染症の増加が報告されており、スクリーニング基準複数該当。ただし対象国はインドのみで、具体的な発生数や重症度の詳細が不足しているため、PICKUP前の経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は旅行関連感染症の多地域での増加を報告。Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域には多くの非対象国（UK、Spain、Canada、US等）が含まれるが、サマリーの主題は旅行者による輸入症例。対象国リスト内ではインド、バングラデシュ、スリランカ、パキスタン、中国が言及されているが、サマリーで実際の発生イベントが主題として記述されているのはインドのみ。Bangladesh、Sri Lanka、Pakistanは旅行先として言及されているが、それらの国での流行についての詳細記載がないため除外。継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak: Flights diverted, borders tightened -- how countries are taking precautions
article.articleSummary: 575 suspected Ebola cases, 51 confirmed, and 148 suspected deaths reported as the outbreak widens. Uganda confirms two infections, including one death, linked to travel from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC); no confirmed US cases. An Air France flight bound for Detroit was diverted to Montreal after a Congolese passenger boarded in Paris in breach of entry rules, which require admission through Washington, DC. The US now mandates travelers from Ebola-affected countries to enter via Washington Dulles for health screening, with airlines rebooking through Dulles and conducting enhanced screening (detailed travel history and exposure-risk questions). Uganda suspends Congo transport links for four weeks amid Ituri province’s outbreak, with two Congolese nationals crossing the border causing one infection and one death. Ferries and cross-border buses halted; cargo and food transport exempt. WHO defines Ebola as a severe, often fatal disease, transmitted from wild animals to humans and via direct contact with blood, bodily fluids, or contaminated materials.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染症流行：便の迂回、国境警備の強化 -- 各国が講じる予防措置
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。DRCおよびウガンダでの確認症例・死亡があり、国際的な航空旅客ルート上での拡大リスク（パリ発米国便への搭乗者発生）、複数国での渡航制限実施の報告あり。フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事では DRC Ituri州での流行中心が報告され、ウガンダでの確認症例も DRC からの渡航関連。米国、カナダ、フランスへの言及は航空旅客による二次拡大リスクの文脈であり、これらの国での確認症例なし。対象国リストの中では DRC のみが実発生地として該当。米国への患者侵入は防止されている状況。

article.articleHeadline: Tochi Okwor: Nigeria Must Stay Alert Over Ebola Threat
article.articleSummary: Nigeria reports no confirmed or suspected Ebola cases but has elevated alert status as Ebola spreads in Central and East Africa (DRC and Uganda). NCDC's acting director Tochi Okwor describes a dynamic risk assessment leading to immediate actions: tighter port health checks, review of isolation centers, laboratory readiness, and emergency response plans. Surveillance nationwide has been strengthened, and health workers are urged to maintain a heightened index of suspicion since early Ebola symptoms resemble malaria or typhoid and can progress to internal or external bleeding. Testing capacity is being bolstered by reinforcing selected laboratories near major airports and land borders, alongside national reference labs in Abuja and Lagos, using a risk-based approach for rapid testing if a case arrives. The interview also honored late Dr. Ameyo Stella Adadevoh for 2014 efforts.

triage.headline_ja: トーチ・オクウォル：ナイジェリアはエボラの脅威に対して警戒を維持する必要がある
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの地域的脅威（DRC・ウガンダでの流行）に対し、ナイジェリアが公衆衛生上の重要な対抗措置を講じており、IHR基準およびWPRO基準を複数満たす。国家レベルでの警戒強化と国際的に関連する感染症対策が進行中。
triage.notes: 記事はナイジェリアがDRCおよびウガンダでのエボラ流行に対応して警戒態勢を強化していることを報告している。現在確認症例はないが、予防的措置（港湾衛生検査強化、隔離施設の見直し、検査体制の整備、緊急対応計画の更新）が実施されており、公衆衛生上の対応準備が動的に進行中。エボラ、マラリア、チフスの同時に述及があるが、主要な関心事はエボラウイルスである。

article.articleHeadline: В Конго протестующие сожгли клинику для зараженных Эболой
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, protesters burned a clinic for people infected with Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of May 22, 2026, protesters in the Democratic Republic of Congo set fire to an Ebola treatment center at Rwampara Hospital, destroying two ALIMA medical tents. Six patients inside at the time were evacuated to the hospital building and remain under care. The attack followed demands for the immediate return of the body of a young man who died of Ebola, with relatives attempting to seize the remains despite safety protocols. The incident underscores persistent hostility toward health facilities amid a severe humanitarian crisis and funding shortfalls cited by the U.S. and World Health Organization. Ebola virus disease spreads through direct contact with infected bodily fluids, not via airborne routes. Transmission can occur through care without protection, traditional funeral rites, or bushmeat consumption (monkeys and fruit bats). This highlights ongoing public health challenges in the region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ患者の治療クリニックが抗議デモで焼き打ちされた
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。進行中のエボラ流行下での医療施設破壊による患者管理の混乱と感染拡大リスク。
triage.notes: 進行中のエボラ流行下で医療施設が破壊されたことにより、患者管理体制の混乱、感染拡大リスク、および地域内の感染症対応能力の低下が懸念される。WHO/米国による支援と資金不足の指摘により、国際的な対応関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: Fire breaks out at Ebola treatment center in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Fire broke out on May 21, 2026, at an Ebola treatment center at Rwampara General Hospital in Bunia, Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo. The Ebola outbreak, first reported in Ituri, has since extended to North Kivu and South Kivu within DR Congo. In addition, two confirmed Ebola cases have been reported in neighboring Uganda. The new cases in Uganda are being monitored by authorities as part of the outbreak. The incident underscores ongoing risks as health teams respond to the outbreak. The Chinese Embassy in the DRC has reminded Chinese citizens in the country to take precautions against the epidemic. The report was published on May 22, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ治療センターで火災が発生
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的な拡大リスク）。エボラ出血熱の継続的な流行が複数県に拡大し、隣国ウガンダへの越境確認例がある。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのブニア（イトゥリ州）のエボラ治療施設での火災を主題としている。サマリーは複数県（イトゥリ、北キブ、南キブ）における継続的な流行と、ウガンダでの確認例に言及しているが、ウガンダでの発生地の詳細がサマリーに明記されていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。火災は施設運営の混乱をもたらし、対応能力への懸念を深める要素である。中国大使館の注意喚起は国際的関心の高さを示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو.. تسجيل 160 وفاة والاشتباه بإصابة 671 شخصا بفيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: 160 deaths recorded and 671 people suspected of Ebola virus infection.
article.articleSummary: As of May 22, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 160 Ebola deaths and 671 suspected infections, with 64 laboratory-confirmed cases and 6 laboratory-confirmed deaths. The World Health Organization cites nearly 600 suspected cases and over 130 suspected deaths, noting the true numbers are likely higher due to underreporting. In neighboring Uganda, no new infections have been added to two Congolese nationals previously confirmed; one patient has died, while the other tested negative for Ebola for the second time and remained under treatment. Africa CDC says the outbreak began in Ituri Province in northeast DRC, bordering Uganda and South Sudan. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC since 1976, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare strain with no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. Ebola is highly contagious and deadly, with the 2014–2015 West Africa epidemic killing over 11,000.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：160人の死亡とエボラウイルスへの671人の疑い患者を記録
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルスによる確認・疑い患者が多数、死亡者あり、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダで確認例）、高い致死性により公衆衛生への深刻な影響が明らかで、ワクチンなし・治療法なしの希少株による。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCでの発生を主題としており、ウガンダでの2例（1人死亡、1人陰性）は二次的。対象国リストではDRC(203312)のみ該当。スーダンは発生地域に含まれるが、記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダのみが主題のため除外。希少なBundibugyo ebolavirus株であること、ワクチン・治療法の欠如、17番目の大規模アウトブレイクであることが懸念の大きさを示す。

article.articleHeadline: Congo: familiares enfurecidos incendeiam centro de tratamento do Ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: Furious relatives set Ebola treatment center on fire.
article.articleSummary: May 22, 2026, Rwampara in Ituri province, DR Congo: residents set fire to an Ebola treatment center after being refused access to the body of a relative who died of the virus. The family wanted the funeral, but authorities insisted on burial protocols due to high contagion. A medical team was pelted and at least one humanitarian worker injured; the deceased’s body burned in a tent. The young footballer was popular; parents claimed typhoid killed him, arguing there was no Ebola risk, but doctors confirmed infection and warned that traditional rites involving contact would raise contagion risk. Local beliefs and distrust of Ebola complicate communication. Authorities report 160 suspected deaths and 671 suspected cases across two provinces; the UN recorded two cases in neighboring Uganda. WHO has declared an international health emergency, with mortality around 6% where treatment is available, and the outbreak spreading, though not a COVID-19–like pandemic.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：激怒した遺族がエボラ治療センターに放火
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。複数国での確認、WHOが国際保健上の緊急事態宣言、高い死亡率を持つエボラウイルスの確認事例。
triage.notes: WHOが国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言。エボラウイルス感染者の確認、160人の疑い死亡、671人の疑い患者が報告。ウガンダでも2例の確認がされているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。治療センターへの暴力的な抗議、地域の信頼欠如による公衆衛生対応の複雑化が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: UN agencies step up Ebola response in eastern DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri epicentre with Rwampara, Mongbwalu and Bunia). In DRC, 139 deaths among about 600 suspected cases; Uganda reports two cases. North Kivu affected, with confirmed cases in Goma, Butembo and Katwa; a new Bukavu case linked to arrival from Tshopo near Ituri. The Bundibugyo strain is involved; no vaccines or medicines exist to treat it. WHO declares a public health emergency of international concern. UN agencies accelerate response with emergency medical supplies, PPE and logistics; MONUSCO provides four light vehicles, one helicopter; two ambulances and two armoured vehicles are en route from Goma to Bunia. WFP facilitates transport and logistics, seeking over $214 million for operations and over $10 million for Ebola response. UNICEF reports about 50 tonnes of supplies; Emergency Rapid Response team heads to Bunia; over 2,000 community health workers are in place, with more needed in hard-to-reach areas.

triage.headline_ja: 国連機関が東部コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ対応を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO が国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言。ウガンダへの越境拡大も確認。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにはウガンダとルワンダへの言及がありますが、サマリーの主題はDRC（特に東部のIturi地域）でのエボラの流行状況であり、DRCが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含めました。ウガンダとルワンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外しました。Bundibugyo株であり、ワクチンと治療薬が存在しないことが懸念されています。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in Congo, tagli USAid sotto accusa: "Indeboliscono il tracciamento". 139 vittime | Il Fatto Quotidiano.it
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo, USAID cuts under fire: "They undermine contact tracing." 139 victims | Il Fatto Quotidiano.it
article.articleSummary: As of May 15, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri province, Bunia) and neighboring Uganda has 33 laboratory-confirmed cases, about 600 suspected cases, and 139 deaths. The epidemic began with a nurse who developed symptoms in Bunia in late April and died soon after; an alert for a high-mortality unknown disease followed on May 5. WHO declared Ebola a public health emergency of international concern for DRC and Uganda. Delays in detection are attributed to reduced Western funding and dwindling USAID programs (83% cut announced March 2025), undermining surveillance, vaccines, diagnostics, and rapid response. MSF’s Chiara Montaldo warns that weakened treatment centers will hinder care; she notes coordination gaps, referencing hantivirus as an example. MSF collaborates with Alima, World Vision, UNICEF, WFP, and local Red Cross for meals, cadaver management, and community information. A coordinated cross-border response is urgently needed.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ熱、USAID削減が非難される：「接触者追跡が弱体化」。139人の死亡 | Il Fatto Quotidiano.it
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：139名死亡、予想外：検出遅延、国際的拡大リスク：ウガンダでも確認、国際対応の必要性）。WPRO基準も全5項目該当。WHO既に国際的保健上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（Republic of Uganda）は記事に隣接地域として言及されているが、記事サマリーではコンゴでの発生が主題であり、ウガンダでの確定的な発生報告は明記されていない。したがって対象国リストに含まれるDRCのみを verified_locations に列挙。WHO既に PHEIC 宣告済み。MSF等国際機関による対応活動進行中。資金削減による監視体制の弱体化が重大な懸念事項として指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Protesters attack Ebola treatment center, burn shelter in eastern DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri province, Bunia) declared May 15. By May 22, authorities report about 600 suspected cases and 139 probable deaths, with the disease expanding from Ituri to North Kivu and South Kivu. Two imported cases involving Congolese citizens were reported in neighboring Uganda. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain; last Sunday the WHO declared it a global health emergency. Protests at Rwampara Hospital outside Bunia erupted as families demanded the bodies of relatives, disputing death attribution to Ebola, and set fire to tents sheltering patients; police used teargas and warning shots. Africa CDC Director-General Jean Kaseya urged strict adherence to preventive measures and affirmed ongoing regional response, amid security challenges and prior mistrust of medical workers during past outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: 抗議者がエボラ治療センターを攻撃し、東部コンゴ民主共和国でシェルターを焼却
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（600疑い例、139死亡例）、複数国への国際拡大（ウガンダへの輸入例）、WHO緊急事態宣言により、シグナルとして即座にフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC（イトゥリ州）での エボラ流行と隣国ウガンダへの輸入例を報告。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations からは除外。DRCのみを対象国として登録。WHO緊急事態宣言済み、セキュリティ上の課題と社会不安が継続。

article.articleHeadline: BBC Audio | Global News Podcast | Crowd sets Ebola hospital tents on fire in DRC
article.articleSummary: An angry crowd in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo set fire to part of Rwampara Hospital after the death of a suspected Ebola patient. Relatives stormed the facility and attempted to remove the body when health workers refused to release it. Medical staff at Rwampara Hospital are under military protection to prevent further violence. The report highlights security risks surrounding suspected Ebola cases in the DRC, noting no laboratory confirmation in this instance and no broader outbreak status disclosed. The incident illustrates challenges around patient management, crowd control, and disease-related tensions in the region as of 2026-05-22.

triage.headline_ja: BBC Audio | Global News Podcast | 群衆がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ病院テントに放火
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（IHR該当疾患）の疑い事例に関連した医療施設への暴力事件であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響（患者管理の崩壊、医療従事者の安全脅威）と国際的拡大リスク（DRC・ルワンダ国境地域）が認識される。スクリーニング基準複数該当かつ社会的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはRwanda（49518）も含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題は DRC 東部（Rwampara Hospital）での事件であり、ルワンダでの患者発生や流行は記述されていない。したがって verified_locations は DRC のみに限定した。エボラ疑い患者による医療施設の崩壊的状況は、感染制御の観点から高リスク。

article.articleHeadline: Epidémie d'Ebola : Séoul étend son interdiction de voyage à une 3e province de la RDC | AGENCE DE PRESSE YONHAP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: Seoul extends its travel ban to a third province in the DRC
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) prompts Seoul to extend its travel ban to a third province. The northeastern Ituri province is now under Level 4, the highest alert, creating a total ban for South Korean nationals; Nord-Kivu and Sud-Kivu were already prohibited. Those traveling there without special authorization face criminal penalties. A 50-kilometer border belt with the Central African Republic and seven additional provinces, including Uele and Kasaï, are maintained at Level 3, with a withdrawal advised in the near term. A further Uganda-specific warning was issued after Korea’s KDCA placed quarantine-priority measures on Ebola for Uganda, alongside DRC and South Sudan. Reported cases in the DRC are rising quickly, with more than 160 deaths cited by foreign media as of May 22, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行：ソウルがRDCの3番目の州への渡航禁止を拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、大規模な国際的懸念を示すエボラウイルス病の多地域流行。死亡者160名以上、複数国での拡大リスク、各国による渡航制限措置が実施されている。
triage.notes: RDCの複数州（Ituri、Nord-Kivu、Sud-Kivu、Kasaï Oriental、Haut Uele）でのエボラ流行が確認されている。韓国の渡航禁止拡大により国際的な関心が高い。ウガンダとスーダンもリスク地域として言及されているが、記事の主題はRDCの流行とそれに対する各国の対応措置にある。

article.articleHeadline: Thailand Tracks 126 Travellers from African Ebola Zones as Border Controls Tighten
article.articleSummary: Thailand tightens border controls with 21-day screening for arrivals from Ebola-hit Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda; as of 2026-05-22, no suspected or confirmed Ebola cases have been detected in Thailand. Over the past three weeks, the Department of Disease Control (DDC) has tracked 126 travellers from Ebola-hit countries, with airports and land checkpoints on high alert after a Royal Gazette decree designated DRC and Uganda as dangerous communicable disease zones. The measures echo the WHO's declaration of the current outbreak as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Authorities monitor the Bundibugyo strain, which has caused about 254 cases and 160 deaths in Africa. The virus carries high mortality but currently lacks an approved vaccine or targeted therapy; transmission requires direct contact with bodily fluids or exposure to infected animals, and is slower than respiratory viruses. No imported/exported cases detected in Thailand.

triage.headline_ja: タイ、アフリカのエボラ流行地域からの旅行者126人を追跡・国境管理を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限）。WHO PHEIC宣言済みのエボラ感染症で、タイが積極的な国境対策を実施中。フルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: DRCおよびウガンダでのエボラ発生（Bundibugyo strain、約254症例、160死亡）により、タイが国境管理を強化。WHO PHEIC宣言済みイベント。タイでは現在確認症例なし。ウガンダはBluedot APIで識別されているが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Wettlauf gegen die Zeit - Kapazitäten problematisch
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: A race against time — capacity issues.
article.articleSummary: One week after the Ebola outbreak was announced in the Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, hundreds of suspected cases and rising confirmed infections fuel fears of spread to neighboring countries. Experts, healthcare workers, and volunteers are racing against time to rapidly establish isolation and treatment capacity at multiple locations. Maximilian Gertler, an epidemiologist with Charité Berlin and Doctors Without Borders (MSF), stresses the urgent need to set up isolation and treatment facilities quickly. Gertler, who has repeatedly participated in Ebola deployments in Africa, underscores the critical goal of containment to prevent further transmission and possible export of cases to adjacent nations.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ: 時間との競争 — 収容能力に問題
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の急速な感染拡大、隣接国への国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスクが高い。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の発生が確認されており、コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州で感染者数が増加中。医療従事者を含む専門家が急速な隔離・治療施設の確保に動いており、隣接国への感染拡大リスクが懸念されている。ドイツ（ベルリン）への言及は専門家の所属機関情報であり、発生地ではないため対象国リストに含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Delhi issues Ebola advisory for African arrivals; India-Africa Forum Summit postponed amid outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Africa triggers Delhi airport advisory on 2026-05-22. Indira Gandhi International Airport issues a public health advisory for passengers arriving from or transiting through Ebola-affected countries—Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda and South Sudan—to report symptoms and seek medical attention. Symptoms include fever, vomiting, weakness, diarrhea, headache, unexplained bleeding, muscle pain or sore throat; travellers who had direct contact with blood or body fluids of suspected or confirmed Ebola patients should inform authorities. Anyone developing symptoms within 21 days of arrival should disclose travel history and seek immediate care. Latest outbreak data cited: DRC reports 513 suspected Ebola cases and 131 suspected deaths, with some fatalities not yet confirmed as Ebola-related. The advisory emphasizes screening and compliance with International Health Regulations. Separately, Jordan banned entry from DRC and Uganda; India-Africa Forum Summit-IV, planned May 28–31 in New Delhi, was postponed due to the evolving health situation.

triage.headline_ja: デリーがアフリカから到着する者に対するエボラ勧告を発行；流行の中、インド・アフリカ・フォーラム・サミットが延期される
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行がアフリカで発生（DRC・ウガンダ・南スーダン）し、インドの首都デリーでも防疫措置が取られており、IHR基準3項目該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。さらにWPRO基準で重症度と流行性が認識されている。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが提供する発生地域にはスーダン・ウガンダ・ジョルダンが含まれているが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。記事サマリーの主題はDRCでのエボラ流行とインドの防疫対応であり、DRCとインドのみを検証地域として列挙。DRCは513例の疑い患者と131人の死亡を報告。インドはデリー空港での勧告発出とインド・アフリカ・フォーラム・サミット延期により対象。

article.articleHeadline: Rubio poděkoval Česku za přijetí amerického lékaře, který byl v kontaktu s ebolou
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rubio thanked the Czech Republic for welcoming the American doctor who had been in contact with Ebola.
article.articleSummary: An American physician evacuated from the Ebola outbreak is in isolation in the Czech Republic. The 46-year-old man, affiliated with the Christian missionary organization Serge, previously worked at Nyankunde Hospital in Ituri Province, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, where an Ebola virus disease outbreak has occurred. He is currently asymptomatic, according to Bulovka University Hospital in Prague. U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio thanked Czech Prime Minister Andrej Babiš and Prague healthcare professionals for caring for the evacuee. The move has sparked discussion about whether the Czech Republic should accept a patient with suspected Ebola. The article notes the patient’s contact with Ebola in Congo and his current treatment setting in Prague.

triage.headline_ja: ルビオ大臣、エボラウイルス接触歴のあるアメリカ人医師の受け入れについてチェコに感謝
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的な拡大リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当。エボラウイルス患者の医療疫学的リスク、国際的な患者移送、社会政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでエボラ発生地はコンゴ民主共和国（東部イツリ州ニャンクンデ病院）と明記されており、患者はコンゴから医療疫学的リスク軽減のためチェコに医療搬送された事例。チェコは患者の隔離・治療受け入れ国だが、発生地はDRCのみ。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。チェコは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Cómo World Relief lucha contra el ébola con la ayuda de 300 iglesias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How World Relief fights Ebola with the help of 300 churches.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is ongoing in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with North Kivu and Ituri Province bearing the brunt. Reported deaths approach 1,800 and infections exceed 2,500. World Relief is partnering with roughly 300 churches across North Kivu, Djugu Territory, and Ituri Province to curb transmission by installing handwashing stations and holding faith-based outreach on Ebola prevention, identification, and response. Through sermons and training of church leadership, communities receive education and care-seeking messages. Public health actions hinge on aggressive contact tracing, followed by quarantine until contacts are symptom-free or treated. Security challenges from armed conflict, including attacks on healthcare workers and looted Ebola centers, hinder surveillance efforts. Samaritan’s Purse has opened an 18-bed Ebola treatment center in Komanda, northeast DRC, with extensive staff training. The WHO recently declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern.

triage.headline_ja: ワールド・リリーフが300の教会の支援を得てエボラと闘う方法
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（重症度が高い、異常で予防不可能、国際的懸念事項として宣言、貿易制限リスク）。WPRO基準も5つ全て該当。WHO公衆衛生上の国際的懸念事項（PHEIC）宣言済みのエボラウイルス疾患の継続的な流行。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは進行中のエボラウイルス疾患の流行をコンゴ民主共和国（北キブ州、イトゥリ州）で詳細に記述。死亡報告数は約1,800、感染者数は2,500を超える。WHO最近宣言によりPHEIC（公衆衛生上の国際的懸念事項）として指定。武力紛争による医療施設への攻撃などの安全保障上の課題がある。

article.articleHeadline: Gorączka krwotoczna Ebola niepokoi Polaków. Sanepid wydał jasny komunikat
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola hemorrhagic fever worries Poles. The Sanitary Inspectorate has issued a clear statement.
article.articleSummary: Poland’s Sanitary Inspectorate (GIS) states no extra sanitary measures will be introduced in Poland amid Ebola hemorrhagic fever outbreaks in Africa and hantavirus cases aboard the MV Hondius. National risk to Poles remains low, and Poland is prepared to quarantine if needed; no immediate changes to Polish procedures. Ebola outbreaks are currently localized to the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Sudan, and Uganda; transmission is via contact with bodily fluids, not airborne, with case fatality potentially up to 90%. On MV Hondius, eight hantavirus infections and three deaths are reported; Poland has no confirmed cases of the ship’s hantavirus variant, with four people under surveillance. The captain, Jan Dobrogowski, will undergo quarantine on return; he is asymptomatic and repeatedly tested negative. Travelers to affected regions are advised to stay vigilant and seek care if symptoms emerge; no panic or new restrictions in Poland.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がポーランド国民を懸念させる。衛生検査局が明確な声明を発表
triage.triage_reason: アフリカでのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（DRC、スーダン、ウガンダ）は重篤な疾患であるが、ポーランド当局が「ポーランドへのリスクは低い」と評価し追加措置を導入しないとの判断を示唆。DRCは対象国に含まれるが、当該国の公式リスク評価と情報不足により、フルRRAの前段階での継続監視が適切。
triage.notes: 記事の主要な焦点はポーランドにおけるリスク評価とポーランド当局の対応（措置不要判断）。実際のアウトブレイクはDRC、スーダン、ウガンダで発生しており、ポーランドは二次的な関心地。MV Hondius上のハンタウイルス感染は地理的に不明確だが、ポーランドが対象国でないため除外。DRCのみ対象国リストに該当。IHR基準では深刻度と国際的拡大の可能性が該当するが、当該地域の当局による管理対応が確立されており、外部支援の必要性は記事で示唆されていないことから、WATCH判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Allarme Ebola, nuove restrizioni negli aeroporti Usa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola alert, new restrictions at US airports.
article.articleSummary: Global travel alert issued by the U.S. State Department as Ebola outbreaks worsen in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan. Effective May 21, Americans and permanent residents who have been in any of these countries within the previous 21 days may only re-enter the United States through Washington Dulles International Airport, with enhanced health screenings. The administration warned that the spread could prompt changes or cancellations of international flights linked to Central Africa. The new restrictions have already produced a concrete effect: an Air France flight bound for Detroit was diverted to Canada after authorities identified a passenger from the Congo who, under the new rules, would have to enter the United States exclusively via Dulles. The outbreak has caused hundreds of cases and dozens of deaths in the region, fueling growing concern.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ警報、米国の空港での新しい制限措置
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス感染症の国際的な拡大が深刻で、複数国での発生、米国での入国制限、航空便の迂回など、国際的な公衆衛生上の重大な影響を示している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンでのエボラ発生が言及されているが、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。South Sudan(スーダン)は対象国リストに含まれるがサマリーで「Republic of the Sudan」として特定されておらず、South Sudanという別国家であるため除外。米国での航空便運用への直接的な影響と入国制限措置は国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念を示している。

article.articleHeadline: В ДР Конго протестующие подожгли центр лечения лихорадки Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In DR Congo, protesters set fire to an Ebola treatment center.
article.articleSummary: Protesters in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo set fire to an Ebola treatment center, destroying two wards after a death from Ebola. Relatives attempted to seize the body; officials refused access, prompting objects to be thrown and the blaze. Six patients were in the Alliance for International Medical Aid wards at the time and are now receiving care in the hospital. The World Health Organization declared Ebola outbreaks in the DRC and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 15. By May 20, 139 suspected Ebola deaths had been reported, with further cases anticipated. Epidemiologist Gennady Onishchenko noted that about half of patients exhibit a hemorrhagic rash and bleeding from gums and nose; the incubation period ranges from 2 to 21 days. Russia expressed concern and offered assistance.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱治療センターが抗議者により放火される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。WHO が5月15日に国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念事項として宣言済みの多国間エボラ流行。治療施設の破壊により対応体制が損害を受け、国際的な支援と懸念を招く事象。
triage.notes: Bluedot API は Uganda と Russian Federation を発生地域に含めるが、記事サマリーでは DRC がエボラ流行の主要な発生地であり、Uganda は WHO による同時宣言の言及に留まる。DRC のみを verified_locations に含める。治療施設破壊は疫学的対応体制の著しい損害であり、既存の PHEIC 宣言と併せて高リスク事象と評価される。

article.articleHeadline: La familia de un paciente con ébola incendia un hospital congoleño
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The family of an Ebola patient sets fire to a Congolese hospital.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in Ituri province near Bunia, Democratic Republic of the Congo, with about 130 deaths two weeks after the outbreak was declared. A provisional Ebola treatment unit at Rwampara hospital was attacked by locals who objected to burial protocols; the family attempted to recover a relative’s body for traditional funeral rites, but staff refused due to contagion risk, and the body was burned. The deceased, once a promising footballer, was alleged by his parents to have died of typhus, though doctors insist he had Ebola and that traditional funerals entail contact that heightens transmission risk. Local beliefs and mistrust hinder risk communication. The outbreak is spreading rapidly in Africa, with infections and deaths identified outside the continent. The WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern; the circulating strain lacks a vaccine, though treatment reduces mortality to about 6% with care.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者の家族がコンゴ病院に火を放つ
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の急速な流行拡大（約130人の死亡、2週間以内に複数国への拡大）、WHO による PHEIC 宣言、および国際的な感染リスクが確認された。IHR 基準 4 つすべてに該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: Kigali Province（ルワンダ）は発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーでは DRC のイトゥリ州ブニアが主な発生地点として記載されており、ルワンダでの実際の患者発生確認は明記されていないため、verified_locations には DRC のみを含める。記事は社会的混乱（火焔攻撃）を報じており、医療施設への信頼喪失が感染制御を困難にする懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Подожгли центр лечения больных Эболой - ВИДЕО
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: They torched an Ebola treatment center - VIDEO.
article.articleSummary: Protests in the Democratic Republic of Congo over the death of a young man from Ebola led to the torching of an Ebola treatment center in Rwampara, with two hospital tents burned. ALIMA-treatment tents housed six patients at the time, who were subsequently moved to the hospital. Health authorities linked the outbreak to Ituri province and its spillover toward neighboring Uganda. The flare-up was first signaled on May 5, and nine days later the pathogen was identified as Ebola Bundibugyo virus. By May 20, the World Health Organization reported nearly 600 suspected cases and 139 suspected deaths across DRC and Uganda. Humanitarian groups have warned that reductions in aid from the United States and WHO are straining resources, leaving field facilities with insufficient staff and supplies for containment.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の治療センターが放火されるー動画
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準では4基準中3つ以上に該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスク）。また、WPROスクリーニング基準でも5基準中4つ以上該当（異常性、重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo型）の多国間流行は最高優先度のシグナルである。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはRwanda、Uganda、United Statesが列挙されているが、記事サマリーでは DRC と Uganda で確認された流行が主題である。サマリーはUgandaへの「spillover」を言及しているが、実際の症例・死亡は DRC と Uganda にとどまることが示唆されている。最終的な verified_locations は DRC のみ対象国リストに該当。ただし Uganda での確認も記述されているため、評価ではウガンダへの流行拡大を「国際的拡大」と判断した。高リスク病原体（エボラ）、複数国での確認、医療施設への暴力的影響、国際援助削減による管理リスク上昇が複合的に存在。

article.articleHeadline: У Конго натовп спалив центр лікування Еболи | Головне в Україні
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A mob in Congo burned an Ebola treatment center | Top News in Ukraine
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo, residents in the city of Rwampara burned an Ebola treatment center after authorities blocked their attempt to retrieve the body of a man who likely died from Ebola. The incident occurred amid an ongoing outbreak response, resulting in the facility being damaged and at least one deceased body stored there burned. Congolese authorities report 671 suspected Ebola infections and 160 suspected deaths across two provinces. The World Health Organization has warned that the outbreak is larger and spreading rapidly beyond official counts. As of May 22, 2026, the event underscores challenges in outbreak control, community tensions around burial practices, and safety-rule adherence during Ebola response efforts. It also highlights the fragility of outbreak interventions in affected communities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの群衆がエボラ出血熱治療センターを焼き払う
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の活発な流行（671疑い例、160疑い死亡）、公衆衛生上の重大な影響、異常な社会的動向（医療施設への火放ち）、国際的懸念の可能性があり、IHR基準2つ以上該当、WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当のため。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）での治療センター焼き払い事件とエボラ流行を主題としており、ルワンダは発生地域リストに含まれるが、サマリー本文ではDRCが主要な発生地である。WHOが公式統計を上回る流行を警告しており、紛争影響下での対応能力の懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Wettlauf gegen die Zeit - Kapazitäten problematisch - WELT
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Race Against Time — Capacity Constraints Are Problematic — WELT
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, near Uganda and South Sudan, poses a massive logistical challenge one week after the outbreak was officially announced. The vast, underdeveloped country requires on-the-ground organization; Doctors Without Borders (MSF) is moving protective gear, generators, cooling devices, and staff to establish new centers in Bunia, Butembo, and Goma, with Ebola kits pre-positioned in Kinshasa, Bordeaux, and Brussels for rapid deployment. Some sites report capacity limits as suspected cases surge, risking lack of isolation and further transmission. The ICRC warns that the outbreak is spreading in frail health systems and across borders, making swift action and community collaboration essential. Contact tracers identify infection chains and track contacts for 21 days; Congolese Red Cross volunteers conduct door-to-door health education, supported by radio programs on symptoms and seeking care.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：時間との競争 — 対応能力に問題あり — WELT
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の急速拡大、国境を越える拡大リスク、国際支援と移動制限の可能性）。WPRO基準でも5つ全て該当（異常性、高重症度、長期曝露、高い流行可能性、対応能力不足）。エボラ出血熱の多国間での確認と医療体制の逼迫は即時のフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーが明確にDRC内でのエボラ発生（Bunia, Butembo, Goma, Kinshasa周辺）を示しており、ウガンダおよび南スーダンとの国境近辺での拡大リスクに言及。ただしウガンダ・南スーダン・ウガンダは対象国外のため verified_locations に含めない。Bluedot APIが検出した複数地点（ブリュッセル、ボルドー等）は物資集積地・支援拠点であり、実際の感染発生地ではないため除外。医療容量の限界、国境を越える拡大の警告(ICRC)、及び複数地域でのMSF対応展開から、極めて高いリスク評価が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Video: "Ebola je izum tujcev," jezni domačini zahteval truplo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Video: "Ebola is the invention of foreigners," angry locals demanded the corpse.
article.articleSummary: An outbreak of Bundibugyo ebolavirus is unfolding in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri Province near Bunia, with chaos at Rwampara General Hospital as a crowd burned tents and a body after relatives were barred from taking it for burial. A health worker was injured; security forces intervened. WHO urges safe, dignified burials; Alima reports patients in hospital tents remain safe. The Ituri outbreak has killed more than 130 people; WHO cites 139 deaths among about 600 suspected cases, while the health minister later reported 159 deaths. Two cases have appeared in neighboring Uganda, prompting border controls limiting air, bus, and public transport, and Semliki River crossings. Bundibugyo is a rare Ebola strain with no vaccine yet; vaccine development could take up to nine months. Meanwhile, M23 rebels in eastern DR Congo confirmed a first Ebola case in South Kivu, linked to Kisangani in Tshopo Province."}

triage.headline_ja: ビデオ：「エボラは外国人の発明だ」と怒った地元住民が遺体を要求
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の希少株、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。エボラ出血熱の確認流行で死亡139～159例、6地域に拡大。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（希少株）の確認流行。DRC東部Ituri Province中心に約600の疑い例、139～159死亡。ウガンダへの2例流入により国際的拡大。葬儀をめぐる社会的混乱。ワクチン未開発（開発に9か月要予定）。エボラはIHR全基準該当疾患。

article.articleHeadline: Médico cristiano que casi muere de ébola regresa a África: 'Dios ha abierto las puertas'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Christian doctor who nearly died of Ebola returns to Africa: 'God has opened the doors'
article.articleSummary: Ebola survivor Dr. Kent Brantly, the Christian physician who nearly died treating patients in Monrovia, Liberia in 2014, plans to move with his wife (a registered nurse) and two children to Zambia to serve at Mukinge Mission Hospital, a 200-bed rural facility about 100 miles from the nearest supermarket. They will partner with Christian Health Service Corps and commit to at least two years of service. Brantly contracted Ebola while treating patients in Liberia; he received the experimental drug ZMapp and was treated for three weeks at Emory University Hospital in Atlanta, after which he was evacuated to the United States. The 2014–2016 West Africa Ebola outbreak killed about 11,325 people per WHO. Brantly was Time’s Ebola Fighters Person of the Year in 2014. He attributes the planned move to faith-guided service and compassion over fear, following a call five years after his initial diagnosis.

triage.headline_ja: エボラから生き残ったキリスト教医師が、神の導きとともにアフリカへ帰還「神が扉を開いてくれた」
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はエボラサバイバーの医師による過去の発症経歴（2014年）と将来の人道的活動計画についての個人的なニュースであり、新規の感染症イベント（発症、流行、アウトブレイク）を報道していない。歴史的事例の回想に過ぎず、現在の公衆衛生上の脅威を構成しない。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIは米国ジョージア州とリベリア、ザンビア、アンゴラの複数地域を検出しているが、記事の主題はエボラサバイバーの個人的な移住計画（2026年予定）である。2014年のリベリアでの発症は過去の出来事であり、新規イベントではない。verified_locationsはザンビアのみとした（将来の活動拠点）。

article.articleHeadline: 에볼라, 국내 발생 확률 낮지만 최악 시나리오 대응 필요
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Low probability of domestic occurrence, but worst-case scenario response is required.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus triggers WHO PHEIC for the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri) and Uganda (border areas), with domestic risk considered low but preparedness underway. As of May 16, Ituri reports 8 laboratory-confirmed cases, 246 suspected cases, and 80 suspected deaths; the DRC lists 536 suspected cases (134 suspected deaths) and 34 confirmed cases (8 deaths). The Bundibugyo virus, less lethal than Zaire ebolavirus, has no licensed vaccines or treatments. Past outbreaks include 2007 in Bundibugyo, Uganda (131 confirmed, 42 deaths) and 2012 in Isiro, DRC (38 confirmed, 13 deaths). MSF reports shortages of diagnostic kits delaying confirmations, contact tracing, and patient isolation. Two travelers from Ituri tested positive in Kampala on May 15 and 16, indicating international spread. Korea has begun enhanced entry screening for high-risk regions via Q-CODE; authorities emphasize preparedness and transparent risk communication to prevent panic.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：国内発生確率は低いが、最悪シナリオへの対応が必要
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による複数国でのアウトブレイク、WHO PHEIC発令、国際的な症例移動（Kampalaでの検出）、国境を越えた拡大リスク、および公衆衛生上の深刻な影響。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドにウガンダ（226074）が含まれているが、記事サマリーでは DRC（Ituri）と「国境地域」での言及にとどまり、ウガンダでの確定症例報告が明示されていないため、verified_locations から除外した。ただしウガンダでの確定患者（Kampalaの2症例）が記載されているため、再検討の余地あり。本トリアージではDRCのみを verified_locations に記載したが、追加情報確認でウガンダも追加される可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Shot: Около 300 россиян находятся в зоне риска заражения вирусом Эбола в Африке
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Shot: Approximately 300 Russians are at risk of contracting the Ebola virus in Africa.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus outbreak in Africa raises risk for about 300 Russians in Kenya and Tanzania, who are in regions designated as elevated epidemiological risk due to proximity to Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. The World Health Organization has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern in DRC and Uganda as the outbreak continues. Transmission occurs mainly via close contact with infected people, animals, and their materials, with potential bananas contaminated by flying-fox bats as a possible route. Uganda’s Ministry of Health has temporarily banned greetings involving physical contact after two confirmed Ebola cases in Uganda. The article notes concerns about whether Ebola could spread to Russia, noting no confirmed cases among Russians yet, with risk context driven by regional migratory and transport flows.

triage.headline_ja: ショット：約300人のロシア人がアフリカでエボラウイルスに感染するリスクがある
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（PHEIC認定）の国際的流行であり、IHR基準で「公衆衛生への深刻な影響」「国際的拡大リスク」「異常性」の3項目に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも「重症度の高さ」「流行の可能性」「管理可能性の懸念」が複数該当し、国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、実際のエボラウイルス流行の主要発生地はDRC（PHEIC認定）およびウガンダと述べられている。ケニアとタンザニアはロシア人の所在地として言及されているが、これらの国は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。DRCのみが対象国リストに該当する。WHOによるPHEIC認定、複数国への拡大、ヒト-ヒト感染のリスク、国際的な旅行・貿易制限の可能性があることから、全てのIHR基準を満たしている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Spread Rapidly in DR Congo After Early Cases Were Mistaken for Witchcraft
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered on Mongbwalu (the 17th Ebola outbreak in the country). Early cases reported mid-April; communities attributed illness to witchcraft and traditional rites, delaying detection. By mid-May, transmission had spread along mining and trading routes with repeated deaths (three to five daily) before recognition. The World Health Organization officially alerted on 5 May after the outbreak had already spread widely. Diagnosis was hampered by weak surveillance and testing capacity; samples from Bunia had to be sent to Kinshasa, and Bundibugyo strain-specific kits were not available. Hospital staff were infected due to insufficient PPE. Structural weaknesses—underfunded facilities, insecurity, and dependence on external aid—and bushmeat exposure are linked to recurring outbreaks, underscoring cultural beliefs and health-system gaps as drivers of delayed response and rapid spread.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱初期症例が魔術と誤解され、コンゴ民主共和国で急速に拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の発生、国際的拡大リスク、深刻な公衆衛生影響、および社会政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は最高リスク疾患。記事サマリーにより、DRC北東部でのエボラアウトブレイク（同国17番目）が明確に記述されている。初期症例が魔術と誤解され、検査能力の弱さ、医療施設の不十分なPPE、採掘・貿易ルートに沿った拡大、および繰り返すアウトブレイクのパターンが報告されている。WHOは5月5日に公式アラート。国際的支援と外部依存の必要性が明記されており、PICKUP判定は確実。

article.articleHeadline: สธ.ไทยยกระดับมาตรการคุม 'อีโบลา' ทุกสายการบิน พบเป็นสายพันธุ์ที่ไม่มียารักษา | เดลินิวส์
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Thai Ministry of Public Health tightens Ebola containment measures across all airlines; found to be a strain with no cure.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak prompts Thailand to tighten containment after Bundibugyo strain, which has no vaccine or cure. By May 17, 2026, 254 suspected EVD cases and about 160 deaths were reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda; no cases or suspects in Thailand yet. The World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, 2026. Thailand designates Ebola as a dangerous communicable disease in DRC and Uganda and enforces intensified entry screening, health declarations, and passenger-data sharing with airlines. A three-tier system is used: 1) surveillance; 2) quarantine at Bamrasnaradura Infectious Disease Institute; 3) isolation for symptomatic arrivals. Travelers from these countries are monitored for 21 days with daily fever checks; airlines may bear containment costs. By May 21, five travelers arrived in Bangkok from these countries; 126 from the two countries had entered Thailand in the prior 20 days.

triage.headline_ja: タイ保健省がエボラ対策を強化 全航空会社で検疫措置実施 治療薬のない株が検出
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において4項目すべてに該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、WHO PHEIC宣言済みの国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威である。また、対象国（タイ、DRC）での実施動向を示す重要なシグナル。
triage.notes: DRCとウガンダでBundibugyo株によるエボラアウトブレイクが発生中（254疑似症例、約160死亡）。タイではWHO PHEIC宣言後、空港での検査強化、21日間の監視体制を実施。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めていない。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: ماذا يحدث لجسمك عند إصابتك بفيروس إيبولا؟
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What happens to your body when you contract the Ebola virus?
article.articleSummary: Outbreaks of Ebola virus are reported in several African nations as of 2026-05-22, raising global health concerns. Russian epidemiologist Genady Onishchenko describes Ebola symptoms beginning with a high fever, weakness, and muscle pain, progressing to diarrhea, abdominal pain, and a dry cough with dehydration; about half of patients develop a hemorrhagic rash and bleeding from gums and nose, with liver and kidney dysfunction. The incubation period ranges from 2 to 21 days. Authorities warn against travel to West African countries Guinea, Nigeria, Senegal, and the Democratic Republic of Congo as cases rise. Air travel can spread the virus to new regions, as seen in past exports to the United States, Britain, Spain, and Italy. Dr. Yulia Yermolaeva cautions the outbreak could become more infectious; the 2013–2016 West Africa outbreak increased human infectivity. Russia has offered to deploy a specialist team to Uganda for investigations.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスに感染したときにあなたの体に何が起こるか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の複数アフリカ国での流行報告、国際的な渡航制限勧告、過去の米国・欧州への輸出歴、航空旅行による拡大リスク、国際支援の提供から、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは複数アフリカ国でのエボラ流行を報告しているが、具体的に確認される対象国はDRCのみ。ギニア、ナイジェリア、セネガル、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ロシアのウガンダへの専門家チーム派遣計画と過去の米国・欧州への輸出歴から国際的な関心と支援ニーズが確認される。

article.articleHeadline: Kayembe's World Cup prep affected by Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo drives changes to Kayembe’s World Cup prep. The outbreak has caused 139 deaths and over 600 cases; the first case of the current spread was reported in DR Congo, with 51 cases confirmed there, though WHO notes the epidemic’s scale is larger. Congo DR cancelled the Kinshasa training camp; the squad will train in Belgium, ahead of friendlies against Denmark (June 3) in Belgium and Chile (June 9) in Spain. The World Cup opener is set for June 17 against Portugal, with Colombia and Uzbekistan in Group K. A US 30-day public health rule blocks entry for anyone who has been in DR Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan in the prior 21 days. All players compete abroad, and FIFA says it is in close contact with the Congo DR Football Association to ensure medical and security guidance.

triage.headline_ja: カイエンベのワールドカップ準備がエボラ感染症の発生の影響を受ける
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス疾患はIHR基準で公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクの4基準すべてに該当。DRC内での確認された発生地域（キンシャサ）により検証済み。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに明記されているDRCでの発生（キンシャサでの139死亡、600例超）が主要な疫学的事象。米国の渡航制限措置、ウガンダおよび南スーダンの言及は副次的な監視関連情報と判断される。DRC（対象国リスト203312）のみを verified_locations に含める。Bluedot APIが列挙した米国、スーダン、チリ、ポルトガル、スペイン、ベルギー、デンマーク、ウズベキスタン、コロンビアについては、記事サマリーでこれらの国での発生確認がなく、ワールドカップイベント関連の言及に留まるため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Сотни россиян оказались в зоне риска заражения Эболой в Африке
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hundreds of Russians are at risk of contracting Ebola in Africa.
article.articleSummary: Around 300 Russian nationals are at risk of Ebola infection in Africa, specifically in Kenya and Tanzania. These countries border the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, where the Ebola outbreak is active. Transmission occurs mainly through close contact with infected individuals or their bodily fluids, and bananas could pose a risk as fruit bats that carry the virus leave traces on fruit. As of May 22, 2026, the DRC has reported more than 500 cases with about 130 deaths, while Uganda has two cases and one death. On May 17, the World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern over the Congo and Uganda outbreak. Russia plans to send specialists to Uganda to assist in the response.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでエボラ出血熱に感染するリスクにさらされたロシア人が数百人
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は深刻な影響（500例以上、130死亡）、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク（ロシア国民の感染リスク）、渡航・貿易制限リスクを有する。WHOがPHEIC宣言を発表し、国際的関心は極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではケニア・タンザニアに言及されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsから除外。DRCはリスト内に含まれ、記事で積極的な流行地として特定されているため含める。ウガンダも記事で流行地として言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。WHOのPHEIC宣言（2026年5月17日）により、国際的関心は最高レベル。

article.articleHeadline: Hewan Kurban Masuk Jakarta Diperiksa Ketat, Antisipasi Antraks dan PMK
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sacrificial Animals Entering Jakarta Are Strictly Inspected to Prevent Anthrax and Foot-and-Mouth Disease
article.articleSummary: On May 22, 2026, Jakarta's Department of Food Security, Maritime, and Fisheries tightens inspection of sacrificial livestock entering the capital to prevent anthrax and foot-and-mouth disease (FMD). Anthrax is highlighted as a zoonotic risk to humans via meat consumption. Along with FMD and the spreading Lumpy Skin Disease (LSD) noted elsewhere, all animals bound for Jakarta must carry a Health Certificate for Animals (SKKH). Real-time monitoring relies on iSIKHNAS, the National Animal Health Information System, to track source regions and shipments. The majority of incoming livestock come from Central Java, East Java, and West Java, with additional imports from West Nusa Tenggara, East Nusa Tenggara, Bali, and Lampung. Vaccination against FMD and anthrax is mandatory under a national program. Veterinary teams will re-check animals; any suspected illness leads to laboratory confirmation at the provincial labs under DKI authorities.

triage.headline_ja: ジャカルタに入る犠牲獣は厳格に検査され、炭疽とPMKを防ぐ
triage.triage_reason: 複数の人獣共通感染症（炭疽、口蹄疫、ルンピースキン病）がインドネシアで同時に活動しており、国家的な防御対策が実施されている。公衆衛生への深刻な影響と異常性が認められ、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性、重症度、流行性、管理可能性）に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 3つの重要な動物感染症が同時に検出・対応中：炭疽（人への食肉媒介リスク）、口蹄疫、ルンピースキン病。インドネシアの複数州（西ジャワ、バリ、ランプン、西ヌサテンガラ等）で発生が報告されている。国家レベルの検査・ワクチン接種体制が展開中。2026年5月の記事日付が将来日付であることに注意（データセット内の時系列確認が必要）。

article.articleHeadline: النرويج تقدم 5.4 مليون دولار لمنظمة الصحة العالمية عقب تفشي فيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Norway provides 5.4 million dollars to the World Health Organization following an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Norway contributed 50 million Norwegian kroner (about $5.41 million) to the World Health Organization's Ebola Emergency Fund on May 22, 2026, in response to an Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo and neighboring Uganda. In the DRC, the outbreak has killed more than 130 people and is ongoing, with roughly 600 suspected cases reported; authorities caution that the true number is likely higher due to underreporting and that transmission is expected to continue. In Uganda, two Congolese nationals were among the previously confirmed cases; one has died, while the second patient’s tests have twice returned negative as of the most recent Wednesday and remains under treatment. The update highlights international funding to bolster outbreak response, surveillance, and laboratory confirmation in affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: ノルウェーがエボラウイルス流行を受けて世界保健機関に540万ドルを提供
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国およびウガンダでのエボラ流行は深刻な公衆衛生影響（130人以上の死亡、約600人の疑い患者）があり、国際的支援（WHOへの資金提供）が必要な国際関心事項である。IHR基準4項目すべてが該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダはサマリーで言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。エボラ流行は進行中で継続的な伝播が予想されている。国際的な資金支援と対応強化が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola im Kongo: Ebola - Wettlauf gegen die Zeit - Kapazitäten problematisch
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Congo: Ebola - A Race Against Time - Capacity Constraints Are Problematic
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo faces severe logistical and capacity constraints amid fragile security. Doctors Without Borders (MSF) deploys Ebola-experienced staff and trains local teams to establish new centers in Bunia, Butembo and Goma, while transporting PPE, beds, tents, generators, and cooling equipment from emergency stocks in Kinshasa, Kisangani, and Europe (Bordeaux, Brussels). The region, bordering Uganda and South Sudan, is large and underdeveloped, complicating operations; isolation capacity is already strained, risking untreated patients and secondary transmissions. MSF coordinates with the ICRC as cases surge and cross-border movement increases. Contact tracers map infection chains, register contacts, and monitor them daily for 21 days after last exposure. Congolese Red Cross volunteers conduct door-to-door health education, supplemented by radio programs urging rapid care-seeking. One week after the official outbreak announcement.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ：時間との戦い - 収容能力の問題
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の発生がDRCで確認され、IHR基準4項目全てに該当。国際的な拡大リスク（ウガンダ・南スーダンとの国境）と渡航制限の可能性が高く、重大な公衆衛生上の脅威である。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはBrusselやBordeauxが含まれているが、サマリーから判断すると、これらは備品・装備の保管地点であり、エボラの実際の発生地はDRCのみ。ウガンダ・南スーダンとの国境での感染拡大リスクが明示されており、国際的な懸念が高い。MSFやICRCなど国際機関が既に対応に当たっている。

article.articleHeadline: 백신도 치료제도 없다...변종 에볼라, 코로나처럼 번지나 [바이탈]
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: There is no vaccine or treatment... Will an Ebola variant spread like COVID-19? [Vital]
article.articleSummary: WHO declared an International Public Health Emergency (PHEIC) for Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. Transmission is by direct contact with blood or body fluids, not airborne, making a COVID-19–like pandemic unlikely, though spread is increasing. The outbreak involves Bundibugyo ebolavirus; vaccines and therapeutics currently target the Zaire ebolavirus, so no approved countermeasures exist for Bundibugyo. Early figures reported 246 suspected cases and 80 deaths on May 17, rising to about 600 suspected cases and 139 deaths by May 20, with cross-border spread and risk of seeding in large cities. Initial symptoms include fever, fatigue, myalgia, and headache, followed by vomiting, diarrhea, and bleeding. In Uganda, around 500 Korean expatriates/residents are present. The US is reviewing new antibody therapies, but no Bundibugyo-specific treatments are confirmed."

triage.headline_ja: ワクチンも治療薬もない…変異エボラが、コロナのように拡大するのか？【バイタル】
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、WHO PHEIC宣言がされたシグナル。WPROスクリーニング基準でも全て該当。
triage.notes: WHO PHEIC宣言済み。記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダでのエボラ発生を主要な主題としている。対象国リストにはDRCは含まれるが、ウガンダは含まれない。DRCは明確に verified_locations に入る。ウガンダに500人程度の韓国人が居住しているというコンテキストは記事中で言及されているが、感染発生の主要地はDRCとウガンダであり、対象国リストの制約により、DRCのみを verified_locations に列挙するべきであるが、指示の5.対象国リストに「1269750=India」があるため、記事内容とのマッチングが必要。記事主題はDRCとウガンダのエボラ発生のため、記事内容に基づく verified_locations はDRCのみとすべきである。

article.articleHeadline: مسؤول أممي يعلن تخصيص 60 مليون دولار لتسريع جهود مواجهة فيروس إيبولا في الكونغو - الوطن
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UN official announces $60 million allocation to accelerate Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) worsens as a UN official announces $60 million to accelerate relief efforts. The eastern DRC outbreak, centered in Ituri, has prompted WHO to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) amid hundreds of suspected infections and deaths, with some cases extending into Uganda. The outbreak is linked to the rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus lineage, for which there is no licensed vaccine or therapy, raising containment concerns. WHO notes the virus may have circulated for about two months before detection, with over 600 suspected cases and more than 130 suspected deaths reported. The funding aims to speed humanitarian aid and outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス対策を加速するため国連が6000万ドルの配分を発表－コンゴ民主共和国
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO PHEIC宣言済みのエボラアウトブレイク。ワクチン/治療法未承認のBundibugyo系統で管理困難。
triage.notes: WHO PHEIC既に宣言済み。ワクチン・治療法未承領域のBundibugyo ebolavirus。アウトブレイク検出前の約2ヶ月間の潜伏流行を指摘。隣国ウガンダへの波及報告あるが、サマリー上の重点はコンゴ民主共和国。緊急資金配分（6000万ドル）が国連レベルで発表済みで国際的関心極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Протести в ДР Конго: Подпалиха център за лечение на ебола (ВИДЕО)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Protests in DR Congo: They torched an Ebola treatment center (Video).
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak continuing in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo's Ituri Province. As of 22 May 2026, 64 laboratory-confirmed cases and 671 probable cases, with over 1,260 contacts being tracked. At least 160 deaths are suspected to be linked to the outbreak; on a single day, 13 new confirmed cases and 78 suspected cases were reported in Ituri. Protesters torched the Ebola treatment center at Rwampara, Bunia, destroying two ALIMA tents; six patients were evacuated to a hospital. The first case, a health worker with onset 24 April, died in Bunia; on 15 May, laboratory confirmation identified Bundibugyo ebolavirus as the cause, for which there is no specific treatment or vaccine. An American working in DRC tested positive and is treated in Berlin. Uganda reports two lab-confirmed cases, including one death in Kampala, with transport and border measures tightened. WHO declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, though global risk remains low.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国での抗議行動：エボラ治療センターが放火される（動画）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の多数死亡例を伴う確認済み流行、複数国への拡大、WHO緊急事態宣言により、フルRRA対象として判定。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus流行として極めて重大。DRCのIturi州での確認例735例以上、死亡数160以上の報告。ウガンダへの国際的拡大確認（2例確認、1死亡）。WHO PHEICレベル宣言済み。治療センター破壊による対応能力への直接的脅威。ベルリンでの報告例は対象国外のため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Revoltă într-un focar de Ebola din Congo. Un centru medical a fost incendiat de localnici * Newsweek România
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Riots in an Ebola outbreak in Congo. A medical center was set on fire by locals.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo intensified after locals in Rwampara set fire to a medical center treating Ebola patients, following authorities' refusal to hand over the body of a man suspected to have died from the virus. The arson underscores growing tensions between communities and health teams working to curb transmission in a region already beset by conflict, insecurity, and weak health infrastructure. Ebola-deceased bodies remain highly contagious, and authorities tightly manage funerals with specialized staff, a policy that can provoke anger among families and communities. Medical teams are striving to halt the outbreak as thousands flee violence. Authorities had not yet reported casualties or the extent of damage from the blaze. Access to treatment continues to be hampered by insecurity and hostility toward authorities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ熱流行地での暴動。地元住民が医療センターに放火
triage.triage_reason: エボラ熱の流行が東部DRCで進行中であり、IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生への影響、国際的拡大リスク、予想外の対応困難性が該当。WPROスクリーニング基準では異常/予想外な事象、管理不可能性が明らかであり、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: ルワンダの地名（Kigali Province）がBluedot発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーではイベントは東部DRC（Rwampara地域）での発生として記述されており、ルワンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。DRCはリストに含まれるため verified_locations に記載。エボラ熱の流行に加え、医療施設への放火、地域住民の敵意による対応困難化など、複合的なリスク要因が存在する。

article.articleHeadline: Пассажира из охваченной вирусом Эболы страны по ошибке пустили на авиарейс
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A passenger from an Ebola-stricken country was mistakenly allowed to board a flight.
article.articleSummary: Passenger from the Ebola-stricken Democratic Republic of the Congo boarded an Air France flight bound for Detroit, Michigan; due to travel restrictions, the aircraft was diverted to Montreal after US Customs and Border Protection confirmed the passenger had boarded by mistake. The CDC, in coordination with DHS, said the measures aim to reduce Ebola transmission risk and protect public health. New rules tighten entry for non-U.S. citizens who traveled to Uganda, DRC, or South Sudan within the previous 21 days, for 30 days. Beginning Thursday, DHS will require that all flights bound for the United States carrying foreign travelers who have been in those countries in the last 21 days land at Washington Dulles International Airport in Virginia. WHO Director-General reported nearly 600 Ebola cases with suspected deaths and 139 suspected deaths, with 51 confirmed cases in the DRC and two in Uganda. An American who worked in the DRC tested positive and was transported to Germany.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスが蔓延している国からの乗客が誤ってフライトに搭乗させられた
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルスの国際的な拡大リスク、米国への入国制限の実施、複数国での確認例、および渡航制限の発動が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事の発生地域にはカナダ、米国、ドイツ、ウガンダ、スーダンが含まれているが、実際のエボラ発生地はDRCが主であり、対象国リスト内ではDRCのみが該当する。米国、カナダ、ドイツは対応国ではあるが事例発生地ではない。WHOの報告によると約600例のエボラ症例が報告されており、確認例はDRC内の51例とウガンダの2例。米国人がDRCで感染し、ドイツで治療を受ける状況が記述されている。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: WP: Cокращение западной помощи спровоцировало вспышку Эболы в Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WP: The reduction of Western aid provoked an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of May 21, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo is experiencing an Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo strain, with nearly 600 cases and 139 deaths reported by WHO, up from three days earlier when the outbreak was declared a health emergency. The absence of approved vaccines or therapeutics for Bundibugyo Ebola hinders containment. The outbreak's escalation follows significant reductions in Western funding: U.S. aid for the Congo fell from about $1.4 billion in 2024 to $430 million in 2025, with $21 million planned for 2026; WHO funding also tightened. The International Rescue Committee notes 60% of its facilities in the epicenter closed last year due to funding cuts, mainly from the United States as well as the UK and Germany. The U.S. State Department counters with $23 million in bilateral assistance and support for 50 treatment centers; critics, including CARE and Marco Rubio, call the WHO response late.

triage.headline_ja: WP: 西側からの援助削減がコンゴのエボラ出血熱の集団発生を招いた
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目も全て該当。Bundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱で約600症例・139死亡が報告されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスクが明確であり、緊急対応が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱で公式に600症例近く、139死亡が報告されている（2026年5月21日時点）。発症から3日間で健康上の緊急事態として宣言された。承認されたワクチンや治療法がないため封じ込め困難。西側援助の大幅削減（米国の対コンゴ援助が2024年14億ドルから2025年4.3億ドルに減少、2026年は2,100万ドル予定）が背景にあり、現地の医療施設60%が閉鎖されている。記事では米国・英国・ドイツからの援助削減を指摘しており、国際的な関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو: 160 وفاة و671 حالة اشتباه بفيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: 160 deaths and 671 suspected Ebola virus cases.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 160 Ebola deaths and 671 suspected cases, with 64 confirmed infections and 6 deaths by laboratory tests. WHO notes about 600 suspected cases and over 130 probable deaths, with true totals likely higher due to underreporting. In neighboring Uganda, no new infections; the latest cases involve Congolese nationals, one of whom died while the other tested negative twice and refused treatment. The outbreak began in Ituri Province, NE Congo, and is the 17th Ebola outbreak there since 1976. It involves the Bundibugyo strain, a rare variant lacking a vaccine or specific treatment, complicating containment. Ebola is highly contagious, spreading through direct contact with patients or bodily fluids; the 2014–2015 West Africa epidemic killed more than 11,000.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：160人の死亡とエボラウイルスの671の疑い例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。エボラ出血熱の確認死亡160例、疑い例671例は深刻な公衆衛生影響。隣国ウガンダへの国際的拡大リスク。Bundibugyo株はワクチン未対応で管理困難。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダでの新規感染なしと述べられているため、DRCのみをverified_locationsに含める。アンゴラについては記事サマリーに言及なし。Bundibugyo株のワクチン欠如と高い伝染性が管理困難性を高める。WHO統計では実際のケース数・死亡数がさらに高い可能性が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Za Američana po kontakte s ebolou prišla vďaka z USA. Rubio poďakoval Babišovi aj pražským lekárom
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An American who had contact with Ebola received aid thanks to the United States. Rubio thanked Babiš and Prague doctors.
article.articleSummary: An American Secretary of State Marco Rubio thanked Czech Prime Minister Andrej Babiš and Prague doctors after an American physician with potential Ebola exposure was brought to Prague for monitoring. In the night from Wednesday to Thursday (May 21), the 46-year-old physician, affiliated with the Christian missionary organization Serge, was transported to Prague after the U.S. embassy requested that he remain in the Czech Republic for the remainder of the incubation period. He is isolated at Bulovka University Hospital and, according to the hospital’s Thursday statement, shows no Ebola symptoms. NBC identifies the man as having worked at Nyankunde Hospital in Ituri Province, eastern Congo, where an Ebola outbreak has occurred. The Czech Republic accepted the physician for monitoring; there are currently no reported illnesses, and the situation centers on potential exposure rather than confirmed infection.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスへの接触後、アメリカ人医師への感謝。ルビオ国務長官がバビシュ首相とプラハの医師に謝意を表明
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの潜在的曝露事例ですが、確定感染ではなく症状なしの監視段階であり、国際的拡大の直接的リスクは低い。ただしエボラウイルスの危険性と国境を越えた患者輸送の事例から継続観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行地域で曝露した米国人医師がプラハで監視されている事例。患者は現在症状なく、確定感染ではなく潜在的曝露の監視段階。チェコ共和国での実際の発生ではなく、患者受け入れ・監視の報道であるため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含める。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果金和乌干达埃博拉疫情持续蔓延 多国加强防控措施
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Zaire ebolavirus outbreaks in Congo and Uganda continue to spread; several countries strengthen containment measures.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreaks are spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri and North Kivu) and Uganda as of May 19, 2026. In DRC, 131 suspected-deaths and 513 suspected cases have been reported; investigations continue. Uganda has two laboratory-confirmed cases, including one death, with travel history from DRC and no clear link between cases. In Goma, an Ebola isolation and observation point is under renovation; health workers measure temperatures and students practice handwashing. Africa CDC has declared an Africa Public Health Emergency; WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. There is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo ebolavirus. Several countries are strengthening border surveillance, medical containment, and emergency readiness.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴとウガンダのエボラ疫情が継続的に蔓延、複数国が防御措置を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、Bundibugyo ebolavirus の国際的な多国家発生、WHO による国際的懸念事項の公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言、および複数国における国境監視強化が確認される。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ザイールウイルスではなくバンディブギオウイルス）の複数国での検出。DRC での 513 疑い例・131 疑い死亡、ウガンダでの 2 例の確定例（1 死亡）が報告されている。WHO が PHEIC 宣言済み。Africa CDC も Africa Public Health Emergency を宣言。ウガンダは対象国に含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみ列挙。

article.articleHeadline: В Конго подожгли центр лечения пациентов с лихорадкой Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, a treatment center for patients with Ebola fever was set on fire.
article.articleSummary: May 22, 2026: In Congo, a treatment center for Ebola patients was set on fire by young men. Deputy Senior Commissioner Jean-Claude Mukendi reported that the attackers had previously tried to take the body of a friend who had died, presumably from Ebola. He noted that the group did not know the burial rules for an infected person. The report provides no information about injuries or fatalities from the fire, nor about any laboratory confirmation, or the broader status of the Ebola situation in the region. No details on arrests or investigations are provided. No further information is available in the article.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ患者の治療センターが放火された
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス疾患という重大な病原体の検出である一方、記事は放火事件の報告に限定され、疾病の流行状況、患者数、死亡者、感染の拡大の有無など疫学的情報が極めて限定的である。情報不足のため、現段階ではWATCHに分類し、続報を注視すべき。
triage.notes: 記事は治療施設への放火というセキュリティインシデントを報告しているが、エボラウイルスの感染状況に関する具体的な疫学データ（患者数、死亡数、検査確認の有無、地域的広がり）が全く記載されていない。この情報不足により、IHR基準2項目以上の確実な判定ができない。WPROスクリーニング基準は異常性と流行性で2項目該当するが、重症度や長期曝露の情報が不足している。同地域のエボラウイルス疾患の流行状況に関する追加報告を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 嚴堵伊波拉 疫區航班強制改降IAD機場 法航被拒入境 | 聯合新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Strict Ebola blockade: Flights from Ebola-affected areas forcibly diverted to IAD Airport; Air France denied entry.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak in Central and East Africa affects the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan, with at least 130 deaths locally. WHO says regional transmission risk is high, while global risk remains low. In the United States, CDC reports no confirmed Ebola cases and the overall threat to the public is low. A DHS border-control measure signed by Secretary Markwayne Mullin on May 20 directs that any international flight with passengers who have visited the outbreak regions within the past 21 days must divert to Washington Dulles International Airport (IAD) for enhanced entry screening and centralized processing. Over the next three weeks, such travelers arriving at IAD will undergo fever screening, exposure-history inquiries, and follow-up registration. The policy led Air France Paris–Detroit to divert to Montreal after a Congo passenger was found onboard; the plane did not land at IAD. MWAA supports CDC-led screening.

triage.headline_ja: 厳格なエボラ対策：エボラ流行地域からの航便をIAD空港に強制的に転向；エールフランスが入国を拒否される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で2つ以上該当（異常・予想外な対策実施、国際的拡大リスク評価）、対象国DRCでのエボラ確定発生、国際的な渡航制限措置の実施、WPROスクリーニング基準で複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事は中央アフリカ・東アフリカのエボラ流行（DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン）に関するもので、米国・カナダ・フランスはいずれも対象国ではないが、対象国DRCでの実在の流行イベントを報告。WHOが地域的感染リスク高と評価、米国CDC/DHS が国際航便の強制転向等の措置を実施。エボラは高リスク疾患であり、国際的な対応が行われているため PICKUP 判定。

article.articleHeadline: กรมวิทย์ฯ เตรียม BSL-3 ตรวจวินิจฉัย อีโบลาสายพันธุ์ใหม่ รู้ผลไวใน 8 ชม.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Department of Science to set up a BSL-3 lab to diagnose a novel Ebola virus strain; results in 8 hours.
article.articleSummary: Thailand’s Department of Medical Science will set up or strengthen BSL-3 laboratory capacity to diagnose a novel Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, with results delivered within 8 hours of receiving a sample. This follows the WHO’s designation of Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The plan includes enhancing laboratory readiness, biosafety systems, PPE, and high-risk sample transport; expanding genomic surveillance; preparing diagnostic kits; and coordinating a nationwide network for specimen referral. Additional focus is on strengthening laboratory personnel readiness to ensure rapid, accurate confirmation of cases and timely public health responses. triage.headline_ja: タイ医学科学部門がBSL-3実験室を設置し、新種エボラウイルス株を診断 8時間以内に結果判定
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WHO PHEIC宣言されたBundibugyo Ebola outbreakにタイが対応準備をしている重要なシグナル。
triage.notes: タイが実施する検査体制強化・診断能力の確立はWHO PHEIC宣言後の重要な対応。DRCとウガンダでの発生が確認されているBundibugyo Ebolavirus の地域への波及リスク対応。タイは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Protesters set Ebola hospital on fire in DRC, demanding return of relatives' dead bodies
article.articleSummary: Protesters attacked Rwampara General Hospital near Bunia in Ituri province, DRC, torching Ebola isolation tents after being denied the body of a young man suspected to have died of Ebola. WHO burial protocols require bodies not be released; safe and dignified burials by trained teams. Two isolation tents and the body were destroyed; a healthcare worker injured; security forces deployed; six patients in isolation; all accounted for per Alima. The outbreak involving Bundibugyo Ebola continues; WHO calls it a public health emergency of international concern, with nearly 600 suspected cases and about 139 deaths per WHO; Congolese authorities report higher deaths. Cases detected in Uganda, prompting suspension of cross-border transport, and concerns about spread to M23-controlled areas. Misinformation and disbelief fuel anger.

triage.headline_ja: DRCのエボラ病院で抗議者らが火を放つ、親族の遺体返却を要求
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外の事象、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO公式の国際懸念事項宣言、複数国での検出、約139人の死亡、医療システムへの脅威が明確。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも症例が検出されているが、記事の主題はDRCのIturi州Buniaでの事象。医療施設への攻撃、遺体処理をめぐる社会的混乱、現地のミスインフォーメーションが対応を複雑化させている。Bundibugyo Ebola virus の継続的流行で、WHO が PHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を正式宣言している。

article.articleHeadline: Coupe du monde 2026. Les États-Unis suspendent la délivrance de visas pour la RD Congo en raison de l'épidémie d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Cup 2026. The United States suspends visa issuance for the Democratic Republic of the Congo due to the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda leads the United States to suspend all visa issuance for Congolese nationals as of May 18, 2026 (announcement published May 21 by the U.S. Embassy in Kinshasa). By May 19, the outbreak had caused 131 deaths. With World Cup 2026 approaching (kickoff June 11 in North America), the Congolese national team canceled a training camp in DRC to avoid transmission. The World Health Organization has declared Ebola a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. U.S. CDC measures include enhanced screening and surveillance for travelers from Ebola-affected areas, and entry restrictions for non-U.S. passport holders who have traveled in Uganda, the DRC, or South Sudan in the past 21 days, plus identification and management of potentially exposed travelers. The immediate risk to the U.S. public is considered low. FIFA is monitoring the situation.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年ワールドカップ。米国、エボラ流行を理由にコンゴ民主共和国への査証発給を停止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の流行、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）。WHOがPHEIC宣言、死亡131件、複数国での確認、国際的な対応措置が発動している。
triage.notes: ウガンダとスーダンも地域フィールドに含まれているが、記事サマリーではコンゴとウガンダでの確認のみ明示されている。スーダンは米国の入国制限対象地域として言及されているが、実際の発生地域として明記されていないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含める。WHOのPHEIC宣言、米国の査証停止、CDCの強化スクリーニング等、複数国による国家レベルの対応措置が発動されており、PHEI基準を満たす重大イベント。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola risk minimal for World Cup fans, logistics challenges remain
article.articleSummary: As of May 22, 2026, Ebola risk for World Cup fans is low despite an eastern Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak with about 600 suspected cases and more than 130 deaths, and the WHO has declared a public health emergency of international concern. The 48-team World Cup, co-hosted by the United States, Canada and Mexico, runs June 11–July 19. DR Congo’s squad faced disruptions, with pre-tournament events canceled in Kinshasa and plans shifted to Belgium; the team arrives in Houston around June 10–11. U.S. authorities have barred entry to non-U.S. passport holders who have been in DR Congo, Uganda or South Sudan in the past 21 days, forcing Congo staff to depart. Enhanced screening at Washington Dulles is planned and could slow travel. Ebola is not airborne; transmission requires direct contact with a very ill person and thorough contact tracing. Fans should practice good hygiene and avoid close contact if unwell.

triage.headline_ja: ワールドカップ観客へのエボラリスク最小限、物流上の課題は残存
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WHO公式声明（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）により、WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当。国際的スポーツイベント（ワールドカップ）開催地での感染症リスク評価は高い社会的・政治的関心を有するため、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事はDRコンゴでのエボラ発生を主題としており、U.S.・Canada・Mexicoはワールドカップ開催国として言及されているが、これらでのイベント発生ではないため除外。WHO PHEIC宣言済みの確認ケース（約600疑似例、130以上死亡）。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo crowd burns Ebola isolation tents after burial dispute - Malawi24
article.articleSummary: In Ituri province near Bunia, DR Congo, a crowd set fire to isolation tents at Rwampara General Hospital after authorities blocked relatives from removing the body of a man believed to have died of Ebola. The incident reflects mistrust of the Ebola response; some residents doubt the virus' reality. Witnesses reported stones were thrown, tents used to isolate suspected cases burned, and police fired warning shots to disperse the crowd. One healthcare worker was injured. Security forces placed the hospital under military protection. The deceased was a well-known local figure; his mother told Reuters she believed he died of typhoid. Authorities said two tents and the body awaiting burial were destroyed. Rwampara General Hospital sits in a district where nearly all of Ituri's recent cases have been recorded; the current outbreak in eastern DR Congo has claimed more than 139 lives as of 2026-05-22.

triage.headline_ja: ザイール民主共和国でエボラ対応への不信が高まり、隔離テントが火焔に包まれる（埋葬紛争後）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、139人以上の死亡、予想外の住民反発、国際的拡大リスク）。WPRO基準でも5項目すべて該当。エボラ出血熱の活発な流行に加え、信頼崩壊による対応阻害が深刻なシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC（イトゥリ州ブニア地区）でのエボラ流行中に発生した隔離施設破壊事件を報道。当該国では2026年5月22日現在139人以上の死亡が確認されており、実在する流行危機。住民の信頼喪失と暴力的な対応阻害は、制御不能な感染拡大リスクを著しく高める。チフス併存の言及もあり、複合的な公衆衛生危機を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Власти США оценили угрозу распространения лихорадки Эбола в стране
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. authorities assessed the threat of Ebola virus disease spread in the United States.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) poses no apparent threat to the United States, according to CDC epidemiologists. There have been no confirmed EVD cases or even suspected infections in the United States, and the overall risk of domestic spread is deemed insignificant. To prevent importation, since May 18 the United States has imposed temporary entry restrictions: non-U.S. passport holders who have visited the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan in the prior three weeks are barred from entry. Returning U.S. citizens who visited those countries may fly only into Washington Dulles International Airport for mandatory medical screening. The World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17 due to the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, with about 600 cases and 138 deaths reported.

triage.headline_ja: 米国当局、米国内でのエボラ出血熱の拡大脅威を評価
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）し、WHOがPHEIC宣言した国際的重大感染症事象。DRC・ウガンダでの活動的な流行と米国への輸入防止措置が講じられている点が重要。
triage.notes: WHOは2026年5月17日にPHEIC宣言を発出。DRC及びウガンダにおけるEVDの活動的流行（約600例、138死亡）が報告されている。米国への輸入防止対策（5月18日から入国制限）が実施中。ウガンダ、スーダンは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。米国の対応は監視対象だが、米国内での感染は確認されておらず、FRワード「無見かけ上脅威」評価。

article.articleHeadline: Уганда остановила полеты в Конго из-за Эболы - Новости на Вести.ru
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda halted flights to Congo due to Ebola
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and neighboring Uganda has intensified, prompting Uganda to suspend all direct flights with DRC, which borders for 877 km. In the DRC, 160 deaths have been recorded across two provinces, with 671 confirmed infections. The flare is centered near Bunia in Ituri Province, where the first death occurred on 24 April 2026; a nurse died as part of the outbreak. The etiologic agent is Ebola virus Bundibugyo, for which there is no vaccine or treatment. The World Health Organization declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on 17 May 2026. A Ugandan doctor notes elderly people and diabetics are at higher risk. Russian officials say no spread risk to Russia, though isolated importations cannot be ruled out; a field hospital was set on fire after a body-release dispute.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダがエボラのためコンゴへのフライトを停止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。WHO PHEIC宣言済み。フルRRA実施が必要。
