triage.notes: 記事はDRCにおけるエボラ発生とウガンダの対応が主題。ウガンダは対象国に含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。ロシアは推測レベルの言及に過ぎず記事主題ではないため除外。WHO PHEIC宣言（2026年5月17日）により国際的重要性が確認されている。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ワクチン・治療法なし）による160死亡、671確認感染例という重症度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Ebola en RDC : 3,5 millions de dollars mobilisés pour éviter une catastrophe régionale | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Ebola in DR Congo: 3.5 million dollars mobilized to avert a regional catastrophe | mediacongo.net
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo triggers a regional response with $3.5 million mobilized by Africa CDC: $1 million to bolster DR Congo emergency operations and rapid field deployment, plus $2.5 million from South Africa to support DR Congo and Uganda. Eight Africa CDC experts are deployed to Bunia, Ituri Province, including field epidemiologists, digital health specialists, risk communication, and community engagement experts, aiming to contain transmission and strengthen local trust. Africa CDC will intensify regional coordination, including a high-level Kampala meeting May 22–23, 2026, with Uganda, DR Congo, and South Sudan to bolster cross-border preparedness and response. As of May 20, 2026, DR Congo reports six Ebola deaths (four in Ituri, two in North Kivu), 64 confirmed cases, and 1,261 contacts identified.

triage.headline_ja: ニュース | コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：地域的な大惨事を回避するため350万ドルを動員 | mediacongo.net
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラ出血熱という極めて高リスク疾患であることに加え、地域的な感染拡大リスク、国際的な対応協調、及び高い社会的・政治的関心が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは主にコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱事例が報道されており、ウガンダ・南スーダンは地域的対応調整の枠組みに含まれるが、実際の症例・死亡者報告はDRC内のイトゥリ州とキブ州北部に限定されている。Bluedot APIが複数国を付与しているが、verified_locationsはDRCのみとする。2026年5月20日時点で確定症例64例、死亡6例が報告されており、Africa CDCによる展開と地域高級会合（カンパラ、5月22-23日）が実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: エボラ治療の病院で怒った群衆がテントに放火　コンゴ民主共和国 - BBCニュース
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Angry crowd at Ebola treatment hospital sets fire to tent in the Democratic Republic of the Congo - BBC News
article.articleSummary: An Ebola treatment hospital in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo faced arson when an angry crowd set fire to a tent used to treat Ebola patients on May 21, as authorities grapple with a growing outbreak. The incident followed the burial-bereavement dispute where family and friends of a young man who apparently died from Ebola attempted to collect the body for burial but were refused, highlighting community tensions amid ongoing transmission. The episode underscores security and trust challenges in the Ebola response in the region, where healthcare facilities can become flashpoints during fear and grief. No confirmed case counts or deaths are provided beyond the implication of ongoing transmission.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ治療の病院で怒った群衆がテントに放火　コンゴ民主共和国
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の社会的混乱、国際的拡大リスク）。進行中のエボラ流行と関連した治療施設への暴力事件であり、フルRRA実施の対象。
triage.notes: 進行中のエボラ流行における医療施設への暴力事件であり、セキュリティと信頼の危機を示唆。感染症対応の実施可能性を脅かす重大な懸念事項。詳細な患者数・死亡数は記載されていないため、フルRRAにて流行規模の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: أوغندا تعلق رحلاتها الجوية إلى الكونغو الديمقراطية بسبب تفشي إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda suspends its flights to the Democratic Republic of the Congo due to an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Uganda suspended flights to the Democratic Republic of Congo amid an Ebola outbreak, while the World Health Organization has designated the Congo–Uganda Ebola situation as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, signaling international risk. Congolese authorities report 131 Ebola-related deaths and ongoing containment and patient care efforts. Across Africa, Tunisia activated its Ebola health protocol in coordination with WHO, focusing on traveler surveillance from affected areas (e.g., Congo), fever screening, and immediate isolation of suspected cases. The outbreak’s incubation period is relatively short and transmission occurs mainly through direct contact rather than respiratory spread. The earlier Congo Ebola outbreak officially ended in October 2025, but new flare-ups have rekindled regional and international concern in the African Great Lakes region. Source: Daily Monitor.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダがエボラ流行に伴いコンゴ民主共和国への航空便を停止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHOがPHEIC指定した国際的懸念事象。複数国での対応が確認され、フルRRA実施対象。
triage.notes: WHOによるPHEIC指定、複数国での航空便停止および防疫措置の発動が確認されている。サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダが主な発生地であり、チュニジアは防疫体制の強化段階として言及されているため対象から除外。オーストラリアは検出地域として列挙されているが、記事サマリーに具体的な発生情報がないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Učesnik Mundijala pobegao od ebole
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Cup participant escaped from Ebola.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s football squad canceled its Kinshasa training camp and moved preparations to Belgium amid an Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo, which has claimed more than 130 lives. The outbreak prompted relocation of the World Cup prep camp for the USA, Canada and Mexico (June 11–July 19) while Europe-based friendlies proceed as planned. DR Congo, qualifying for the 2026 FIFA World Cup for the first time in 52 years, secured the finals after Jamaica’s intercontinental playoff (0-0, 1-0 after extra time) and an earlier win over Nigeria on the continent. Warm-ups include Denmark on June 3 in Belgium and Chile on June 9 in Spain; the opening World Cup match is June 17 in Houston against Portugal. The United States has barred entry for non-U.S. citizens who recently visited Congo, Uganda or South Sudan within 21 days due to Ebola. Notable players include Joane Visa and Newcastle United stars such as Bakambu (Betis), MBembe (Lil), Van Bisake (West Ham), and Sadiki (Sunderland).

triage.headline_ja: ワールドカップ参加国がエボラから逃げた
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の発生（東部コンゴ、130名以上の死亡）は IHR Annex2 基準の4項目すべてに該当し、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念、渡航制限、および異常・予想外の拡大リスクがある。
triage.notes: 記事は東部コンゴのエボラ発生が主題。Bluedot APIは米国、スーダン、ウガンダなど複数国を列挙しているが、サマリーの主題はDRC内の発生地点（Kinshasa）であり、米国の入国制限は二次的影響。対象国リストに含まれるDRCのみを verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: New Ebola case confirmed in rebel-held area in DR Congos South Kivu province
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease has a new confirmed case in a rebel-held area of DR Congo’s South Kivu province (Miti-Murhesa, Kabare), announced by the M23 group. The patient, a 28‑year‑old man who traveled from Kisangani in Tshopo province, died before diagnosis and was buried per health protocols. More than 200 suspected cases have been sampled and sent to Goma for laboratory testing; one confirmed case remains under medical supervision in Goma, and contacts have been isolated. The outbreak began May 15 in Ituri and has since spread to North Kivu and now South Kivu. Two imported cases were reported in Uganda. The WHO has declared a global health emergency. Transmission occurs through direct contact with bodily fluids, contaminated materials, or corpses.

triage.headline_ja: DR コンゴのサウス・キブ州の反政府勢力支配地域で新たなエボラ症例が確認
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の多地域流行（イトゥリ州→北キブ州→南キブ州）、国際拡大（ウガンダへの輸入症例2例）、WHO による世界保健緊急事態宣言があり、IHR基準3項目以上該当、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべて該当。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の急速な地理的拡大、複数州での同時流行、国境越えの輸入症例、反政府勢力支配地域での発生による管理の困難性、WHO宣言により極めて高い優先度。ウガンダでの輸入症例報告があるが、記事の主題はDRC の発生であるため verified_locations は DRC のみ。

article.articleHeadline: จลาจลในคองโก ญาติฉุนไม่ให้รับศพผู้ป่วยอีโบลา จุดไฟเผาเต็นท์-ขว้างหินใส่หมอ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Riots in Congo as relatives refuse to receive the body of an Ebola patient; tents set on fire and stones thrown at a doctor.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), centered near Bunia in Ituri Province. As of May 22, 2026, Africa CDC confirms at least 160 deaths and about 670 suspected cases, with no approved treatments or vaccines available in the country. The outbreak—the third-largest in DRC history—has sustained transmission for months before detection. Protests erupted at a hospital when relatives refused to allow the body of a presumed Ebola patient to be moved for burial, leading to stone-throwing, arson of two triage tents, and one medical casualty. At the time, six patients were staying in tents inside the hospital and were later moved indoors. Authorities and relief workers deployed security forces; responders are tracing cases and contacts, while some relatives doubt the diagnosis, with a parent claiming typhoid fever caused the death. Ongoing public health measures emphasize adherence to precautions during funerals.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでの暴動 エボラ患者の遺体の受け取りを拒否する遺族。テントに火をつけ医者に石を投げる。
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラウイルス病（致死的な感染症）の大規模アウトブレイク（160人以上の死亡、670疑い例）で、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクが明らかである。社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病のDRC第3位の規模のアウトブレイク。医療施設での暴動、住民の不信感による対応困難、複数の感染経路（葬儀での接触）が確認されている。WHO通知対象の明確なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: दिल्ली एयरपोर्ट पर 'Ebola Virus' को लेकर अलर्ट, प्रभावित देशों से आने वाले यात्रियों पर बढ़ी निगरानी
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus alert at Delhi Airport, increased monitoring of passengers arriving from affected countries.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease alert at Delhi Airport, India, with heightened screening and enhanced monitoring of international arrivals from high-risk regions. Airports Authority of India and Airport Health Organization tightened checks at major entry points, including Indira Gandhi International Airport, and travellers from affected countries must report exposure or symptoms to health officials before completing immigration. Authorities emphasize routine checks but maintain extra vigilance for travelers from Eastern Africa, specifically the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan. India reports no Ebola cases to date but has issued health advisories and prepared surveillance. Globally, Ebola outbreaks persist in Africa, with about 139 suspected deaths and around 600 suspected cases; DR Congo accounts for 131+ deaths and 500+ suspected cases, and Uganda has had multiple outbreaks. The Bundibugyo strain is implicated; it is rare and currently lacks approved treatment or vaccine. WHO has declared PHEIC, underscoring the importance of contact tracing, isolation, and monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: デリー空港でエボラウイルスに関するアラート、影響を受けた国から到着する乗客の監視強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHO PHEIC宣言済みのエボラ流行に対するインドの対応報告。国際的拡大リスクと渡航制限の実装が明確。
triage.notes: 記事はインドの空港での対応を主題としているため、India を verified_locations に含める。サマリーで具体的に言及されているDRC、ウガンダ、スーダンのうち、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。WHO PheIC宣言済みで、グローバルなエボラ流行状況における国際対応の一部。

article.articleHeadline: POTPUNI HAOS! Demonstranti ZAPALILI centar za lečenje ebole - pacijenti HITNO evakuisani! (FOTO, VIDEO)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: TOTAL CHAOS! Demonstrators set fire to the Ebola treatment center - patients urgently evacuated! (PHOTO, VIDEO).
article.articleSummary: Demonstrators in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo's Ituri province set fire to two Ebola treatment tents at Rwampara hospital after a dispute over handling the body of a young man who died from Ebola. Family members fired projectiles, triggering the blaze; six patients treated in ALIMA tents were later moved to a hospital for care. The Ebola Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, for which there is no specific treatment or vaccine, is spreading locally and has prompted an international health alert. Congolese authorities report at least 160 deaths linked to the outbreak, with 13 new confirmed cases and 78 suspected in Ituri. The World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, though global risk remains low. Local politician Luka Mambelea warned of misinformation, with some residents doubting Ebola's existence.

triage.headline_ja: 完全な混乱！デモ参加者がエボラ治療センターに放火 - 患者が緊急避難！（写真、動画）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において、公衆衛生への深刻な影響（160人以上の死亡、確認症例拡大）、異常性（治療施設への放火による患者避難）、国際的拡大リスク（WHOが国際的懸念事項を宣言）の3つが該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度（死亡多数）、流行性（ヒト-ヒト感染性）、管理可能性（国際的対応が必要）が該当。フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）の活動中の流行と治療施設への直接的な破壊行為が同時に発生。地域住民の信頼喪失（エボラの存在を疑う者も）がさらなる管理困難を招いている。WHO PHEIC宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola virüsüne dikkat çeken uzmandan uyarılar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warnings from an expert drawing attention to the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: As of May 22, 2026, Dr. Müberra Hraloğlu of Biruni University warns that Ebola virus, from the Ortoebolavirus group, spreads mainly through contact with the body fluids of infected people, including blood, saliva, feces, and through contaminated clothing and medical equipment. Early symptoms resemble influenza, with fever, fatigue, muscle and throat pain; incubation ranges 2–21 days. As illness progresses, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, rash, organ dysfunction, and sometimes internal or external bleeding may occur. Fatality rates can reach about 50%, varying with virus type and access to health care; historical ranges were 25–90%. The Democratic Republic of the Congo outbreak has drawn global concern, with WHO on alert and many countries tightening border controls. Travelers are advised to maintain strict hygiene and avoid contact with patients and wild animals.

triage.headline_ja: エボーラウイルスに注意を促す専門家からの警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボーラ発生が報告され、IHR基準の「公衆衛生への深刻な影響」「異常性」「国際的拡大リスク」「渡航・貿易制限リスク」の4基準すべてに該当。WHO警戒、国境管理強化、致死率約50%という重大性からWPRO基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボーラ発生アウトブレイクの警告。致死率25～90%（平均約50%）、ヒト-ヒト感染、WHO警戒、国境管理強化が記述されており、IHR/WPRO両基準で高リスク。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: 60 Ekor Babi Milik Warga Canggu Mati, Diduga akibat Virus ASF
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 60 Pigs Owned by Canggu Residents Die, Suspected to be Caused by African Swine Fever Virus.
article.articleSummary: Sixty pigs owned by residents of Banjar Kayu Tulang in Canggu, Badung Regency, Bali, Indonesia, died suddenly since early April 2026, including several around 150 kg ready for harvest. African Swine Fever (ASF) is suspected as the cause; initial signs included loss of appetite and weakness before death. Carcasses have been buried, and Badung’s Agriculture and Food Service had not issued an official statement as of May 22, 2026. Farmer Ketut Widanta has paused pig farming pending ASF status. Some deaths also occurred among piglets, not only large pigs. The report provides no laboratory confirmation, infection source details, or information on imported/exported cases. The incident adds to ASF concerns in Bali with unclear confirmation and official guidance at present.

triage.headline_ja: チャングーの住民が飼育する60頭の豚が死亡、アフリカ豚熱ウイルスが原因と疑われている
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（バリ州）で60頭の豚がASFで死亡した疑い報告。動物への重大な公衆衛生影響、地域での異常事象、検査未確認だが疫学的懸念が高く、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性、長期曝露、感染性、管理可能性）複数に該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから実際の発生地はインドネシア（バリ州チャングー）で確定。2026年4月初旬から現在まで継続的な死亡報告がある点で長期曝露リスクあり。ただし農業省からの公式発表がなく、実験室確認なし。豚肉輸出国としてインドネシアの地位を考慮するとASF確認による貿易影響の可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: ഡി.ആർ.കോംഗോയിലെ എബോള ആശുപത്രിടെന്റിന് തീയിട്ട് പ്രതിഷേധക്കാർ;'എബോള ഒരു നുണയാണെന്ന് വിശ്വസിക്കുന്നവർ'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Protesters set fire to the Ebola hospital tent in DR Congo; 'those who believe Ebola is a hoax'
article.articleSummary: Two Ebola treatment tents were burned in DR Congo’s Ituri province after protesters clashed as relatives attempted to move the body of an Ebola victim; police restored order. WHO warned misinformation about Ebola fuels such incidents, with locals claiming the disease is a hoax. As of Thursday, DR Congo reported at least 160 deaths and 671 suspected cases amid a new outbreak that prompted WHO to declare a public health emergency. The resurgence is linked to Bundibugyo, a rare Ebola strain; it is among six strains and currently lacks a vaccine or specific treatment. Context: the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak infected over 28,600 people; this is Congo’s 17th Ebola outbreak. Transmission occurs via blood and body fluids, animal reservoirs, and consumption of infected meat; prevention centers on isolation, avoiding contact, and prompt supportive care.

triage.headline_ja: DR コンゴのエボラ治療テント病院が火をつけられた抗議者により；『エボラは嘘だと信じる者たち』
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも全5つ該当。WHOが公衆衛生緊急事態を宣言した現在進行中のアウトブレイク。
triage.notes: 2026年5月22日時点でDRC内で現在進行中のエボラアウトブレイク。死亡160名以上、疑い例671名。ウガンダも発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRCが主体でウガンダへの具体的な波及は述べられていないため verified_locations には含めない。Bundibugyo株はワクチン・治療法なし。病院施設攻撃やミスインフォメーション拡大により管理可能性が低下している。

article.articleHeadline: Nová ebola je jiná. Na vzácný kmen Bundibugyo neex... | FORUM 24
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A new Ebola is different. There is no cure for the rare Bundibugyo strain | FORUM 24.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri and North Kivu) is driven by Bundibugyo, a rarer strain with no approved vaccine or specific therapy. As of May 22, 2026, the WHO reports 600 suspected cases and 139 deaths; MSF cites over 500 suspected cases and over 130 deaths, while Imperial College London models suggest counts could exceed 1,000. The virus circulated for months before detection, with funerals likely fueling transmission. The outbreak has reached Uganda. Bundibugyo is less lethal than Zaire yet harder to diagnose; symptoms resemble malaria or typhoid, and PCR tests for this strain are in short supply, hindering isolation and contact tracing. Conflict and weak health systems in Ituri and North Kivu complicate response. Vaccines are not ready: WHO projects 6–9 months for a candidate; a second experimental vaccine could enter trials in 2–3 months but lacks animal data. Global risk remains low, but preparedness is inadequate.

triage.headline_ja: 新しいエボラは異なる。稀なブンディブギョ株に対する治療法がない
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、複数国での確認、高死亡率、ワクチン・治療法の不在により公衆衛生への深刻な影響が確実。WPRO基準も5項目全て該当。国際的な対応が急務。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダへの到達が言及されているが、サマリー上の主要な発生地はDRC（イトゥリ及び北キブ州）であり、ウガンダはシグナル検出段階では対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。600～1000以上の疑い患者、139以上の死亡が報告されており、ブンディブギョ株はザイール株より致死率は低いが診断が困難で、承認済みワクチンや特異的治療法が存在しないことが重大な懸念。月単位の循環検出遅延と葬儀による拡大、紛争と脆弱な保健システムにより対応が複雑化している。

article.articleHeadline: Molecular Diagnostic Tests (RT-PCR) for Ebola Virus Bundibugyo Strain - Africa CDC
article.articleSummary: On May 17, 2026, WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern for the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda; Africa CDC followed on May 18, 2026 with a Public Health Emergency of Continental Security. The outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; unlike Zaire ebolavirus, there are no vaccines or therapies, and only a limited number of diagnostics are approved or validated. Quality-assured diagnostics, used with other control measures, are urgently needed. Real-time RT-PCR remains the gold standard for Ebola diagnosis. Africa CDC’s Diagnostics Advisory Committee rapid review identified RT-PCR tests that have regulatory approval or are laboratory-validated and in use in the response; a table lists the recommended tests. Antigen rapid diagnostic tests do not meet the WHO Target Product Profile specifications and are not recommended. Biobanking emphasizes careful collection/storage of well-characterized blood specimens under biosafety/ethical conditions to support testing and validation.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスBundibugyo株の分子診断検査（RT-PCR）- Africa CDC
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当し、WHOによる国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）宣言がなされたエボラウイルス感染症の集団発生。治療法やワクチンが存在しない株による急速な拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: Uganda（ウガンダ）は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。WHOによるPHEIC宣言（2026年5月17日）とAfrica CDCによる大陸規模の公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言（2026年5月18日）があり、治療法やワクチンが存在しないBundibugyo ebolavirus株による急速な拡大が懸念される。緊急の診断・検査体制整備が急務であることが示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Behind the scenes of Ebola disease outbreak response | WHO | Regional Office for Africa
article.articleSummary: Two consignments totaling 11 tonnes of health emergency supplies were shipped from WHO’s Emergency Preparedness and Response hub in Nairobi to Bunia, Democratic Republic of the Congo, to support an Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus declared on 15 May 2026. The first five-tonne shipment departed on 20 May 2026, with a second six-tonne load delivered two days later. The cargo, loaded at Jomo Kenyatta International Airport by Milton Oloo, a cargo loading agent with 30 years’ experience, includes personal protective equipment, case management kits, and supplies to facilitate safe and dignified burials. These resources aim to save lives and protect health workers, families, and communities affected by the outbreak in DR Congo. Oloo emphasizes that careful handling and timely delivery express solidarity with those affected and help ensure the cargo reaches its destination safely.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ病の流行対応の舞台裏 | WHO | アフリカ地域事務局
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo virus株）のDRC における新規流行宣言（2026年5月15日）であり、IHR基準の「異常・予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当。WPRO基準でも「重症度」「長期曝露」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性（国際支援展開中）」が満たされ、シグナルとして識別。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが Nairobi（ケニア）を発生地域に含めているが、記事サマリーでは Nairobi は WHO の Emergency Preparedness and Response hub（支援物資の出荷地点）であり、実際のエボラ流行の発生地は Bunia, DRC である。したがって verified_locations には DRC のみを記載。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Kongolesische Ituri-Provinz: Ebola breitet sich aus - Nachbarländer in Alarmbereitschaft
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congolese Ituri Province: Ebola is spreading — neighboring countries on alert.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Ituri Province of the Democratic Republic of the Congo is escalating, with hundreds of suspected cases and a rising number of confirmed infections, raising fears of spread to neighboring countries. One week after the outbreak was announced, experts, healthcare workers, and aid teams are racing against time to contain transmission. Maximilian Gertler, an epidemiologist at Charité – Universitätsmedizin Berlin and MSF, emphasizes the immediate need to rapidly establish isolation and treatment capacity at multiple locations. The report underscores mounting caseloads and the urgent mobilization of public health resources to curb transmission in the region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州：エボラが拡大 - 隣接国が警戒態勢
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの発生が確認され、IHR基準4つすべてに該当。確定症例の増加、地域内での感染拡大、隣接国への拡大リスク、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威が明らかである。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはベルリンとドイツも含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はコンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州のエボラ発生であり、ベルリン・ドイツは言及専門家の所属地に過ぎない。したがってverified_locationsはDRCのみ。エボラウイルスはWHO指定の最高レベルの脅威であり、IHR基準とWPRO基準の両者で最高レベルのリスク評価。フルRRA進行が必須。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة التونسية تعلن تفعيل البروتوكول الخاص بفيروس "إيبولا"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Tunisian Ministry of Health announces the activation of the Ebola virus protocol.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-05-22, Tunisia's Ministry of Health activated its Ebola protocol in coordination with the World Health Organization after warnings of Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Tunisia expressed solidarity with Congolese health authorities and people, commending coordination led by the African Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC) with WHO and partners to contain the outbreak and curb spread. The Ministry emphasized there is currently no direct threat to Tunisia; surveillance continues in collaboration with international and regional partners. The protocol focuses on strict monitoring of travelers from affected areas, such as the Congo, screening for clinical signs like fever, and immediate isolation of suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: チュニジア保健省がエボラウイルスプロトコルの発動を発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で異常性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクの3項目に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数項目（異常性、流行易性、管理可能性）に該当。エボラウイルスの地域的脅威に対する公式な準備体制の構築であり、フルRRAに進める必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はDRCでのエボラ発生に対するチュニジアの準備体制であり、実際の患者発生地はDRCである。チュニジアは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。DRCでの発生報告に基づきチュニジアが国境警戒態勢を敷いた状況。WHO、Africa CDCとの国際的な協調が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola na RD Congo. Responsável da Médicos sem Fronteiras fala de situação muito grave
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC. MSF official says the situation is very grave.
article.articleSummary: One week after Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo was detected and confirmed by the World Health Organization, response remains strained as humanitarian organizations fight an aggressive virus with no available treatment while awaiting international help. The outbreak is estimated at 500–700 suspected cases and 130–160 deaths to date. Doctors Without Borders (MSF), active for two decades in Ituri Province—a conflict zone—faces major operational challenges. Widespread displacement and immense humanitarian needs have led communities to neglect the outbreak, a pattern MSF fears after the 2018 outbreak in the country.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ。国境なき医師団幹部が状況は非常に深刻と述べる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：130〜160死亡、異常かつ予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、WPRO基準も複数該当。国際支援が必要な状況。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の確認済み発生。500〜700疑い患者、130〜160死亡が報告されている。Ituri Province（紛争地帯）での発生で人道的対応が複雑化。国際支援が明示的に言及されている。

article.articleHeadline: Angry Mob Attacks Ebola Hospital In Congo Amid Mistrust Over Virus And Burial Dispute
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri province, near Bunia) has triggered violence after relatives of a man feared to have died from Ebola were blocked from retrieving his body for burial. At Rwampara General Hospital, where several patients were being treated, a mob set fire to tents used as isolation wards; two medical tents and a body awaiting safe burial were destroyed. Six patients remained inside at the time, and security forces restored order; one hospital worker was injured during stone-throwing. Widespread scepticism and belief that Ebola is an outsiders' invention fueled the unrest. The World Health Organization has classified the outbreak as a public health emergency of international concern, with hundreds of suspected cases and over 130 deaths reported. Uganda also detected infections and tightened border controls, prompting emphasis on safe and dignified burials to prevent further transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ病院が怒った群衆に襲撃される ウイルスと埋葬紛争をめぐる不信の中で
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。WHOが公衆衛生上の国際的懸念事項として分類した大規模エボラ感染症の集団発生で、複数国への拡大、国際的な公衆衛生の脅威が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCの東部イトゥリ州で主要な発生が確認され、ウガンダでも感染が検出されている。ただしウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。WHOが既に国際的懸念事項として分類、数百の疑い例と130以上の死亡が報告されており、病院襲撃による治療・予防活動の混乱が追加的リスク要因となっている。

article.articleHeadline: SHOT: в Африке около 300 россиян находятся в зоне риска заражения вирусом Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: SHOT: In Africa, about 300 Russians are at risk of contracting the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: About 300 Russian tourists are at risk of Ebola virus infection in Africa, according to the Telegram channel SHOT. Kenya and Tanzania are cited as the affected countries; both border the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, where Ebola outbreaks have been registered. The report links the risk to proximity to these outbreaks and ongoing transmission in the region. An Associated Press report earlier noted an arson attack on a DR Congo medical facility where Ebola patients were treated. The information underscores continued concerns about Ebola spread in East Africa and cross-border travel risk as of May 22, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: SHOT: アフリカで約300人のロシア人がエボラウイルス感染のリスクにさらされている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で「公衆衛生への影響は深刻か」「異常または予想外か」「国際的に拡大するリスク」の3つが該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・流行しやすさ・長期曝露が該当。エボラはIHR2005通知対象疾患であり、複数国にまたがる拡大リスクと国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはケニア、タンザニア、DRC、ウガンダでのエボラ発生を言及しているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRC (203312)のみ。ケニア・タンザニア・ウガンダは対象国外のため除外。エボラは確定/高疑い症例、死亡率の高い疾患であり、IHR通知対象。DR Congo由来の感染が複数国に拡大するリスク、国際旅行者への曝露リスク、医療施設への攻撃など複数の懸念要素があるためフルRRAへのピックアップが適切。

article.articleHeadline: Οργισμένοι συγγενείς καίνε  μονάδα αντιμετώπισης Έμπολα στο Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Angry relatives burn an Ebola treatment unit in Congo.
article.articleSummary: In eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, angry residents burned the Ebola treatment unit at a hospital near Bunia in Ituri province after officials refused to hand over a body, citing that Ebola corpses are highly infectious and require special burial protocols. The family sought to bury a popular local footballer; doctors said he was Ebola-positive, though the family claimed typhoid. A humanitarian worker was injured as the Ebola ward was attacked, and the young man's body was burned. About 130 deaths have been recorded in two weeks in this Ituri outbreak, a strain for which there is no vaccine. WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern; effective protocols and therapies exist since 2019, with mortality around 6% for most strains. Some locals doubt Ebola's existence, accusing NGOs of fabricating the outbreak for aid.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ治療ユニットが激怒した親族によって焼かれる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常事象・国際対応宣言・渡航制限リスク）。WHO PHEIC宣言済み、2週間で130死亡、治療施設への攻撃により対応能力が著しく低下している。
triage.notes: WHO PHEIC既に宣言。2週間で130死亡、ワクチン未開発の株。地域社会の信頼喪失（偽造陰謀説）と医療施設への暴力的攻撃により、アウトブレーク制御が著しく困難化している。緊急の国際支援と社会動員が必要。

article.articleHeadline: ماذا نعرف عن سلالة إيبولا التي تثير مخاوف في الكونغو الديمقراطية؟
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What do we know about the Ebola strain that is raising concerns in the Democratic Republic of the Congo?
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare Ebola strain, is spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo with spillover into Uganda. There is no licensed vaccine or approved therapy for this strain. Declared on 15 May 2026, the outbreak has prompted urgent discussions by WHO with vaccine makers to fast-track candidates for controlled trials. Unlike other strains, Bundibugyo may present with a skin rash early; fever, headache, and joint pains are common, with diarrhea and vomiting later; bleeding is less frequent, delaying suspicion. Initial diagnostics targeted Ebola Zaire; later Kinshasa labs confirmed Bundibugyo. Public health measures focus on border surveillance, isolation facilities, transparent risk communication, and safe patient transfer, avoiding home transport. Care is supportive, including fluid replacement. USAID budget cuts are cited as reducing readiness, while UK support and WHO emergency funds back response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で懸念を招いているエボラ出血熱の株について何が分かっているか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（稀なエボラ株）がDRC・ウガンダで発生しており、ワクチン・治療法なし、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクがすべて存在する。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境流入も記述されているが、対象国リストにウガンダは含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCのみを記載。Bundibugyo ebolavirus は稀な株で、既存ワクチン/治療法がないため重大なシグナル。WHO、USAID、英国の支援関与を示す高度な社会政治的関心あり。

article.articleHeadline: Can Ebola, the "worst" disease, be stopped from becoming a pandemic?
article.articleSummary: Ebola, specifically the Bundibugyo strain, is driving an outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and adjacent Uganda. Authorities report more than 100 suspected deaths and hundreds of infections linked to this highly lethal variant, for which no approved treatment exists. Protective public health measures are in place while teams investigate vaccines; however, a licensed vaccine is not expected to be readily available for months. The Channel 4 News Breakdown episode examines how far the strain has spread, the measures being taken to halt transmission, and the realistic timeline for vaccine development. As of 2026-05-22, scientists face the dual challenge of containing spread in cross-border settings and accelerating the evaluation of candidate vaccines that could curb mortality from this Ebola outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスは「最悪の」病気からパンデミックへの進行を止めることができるか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPRO基準5つすべてに該当。Bundibugyo株によるエボラアウトブレイクは、国際的な拡大（DRC-ウガンダ国境）、高い致死性、治療法の不在、ワクチン利用不可という深刻な脅威を示している。
triage.notes: ウガンダは発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーでは「adjacent Uganda」と記載され、主要な発生地域はDRCと明記されている。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。100名以上の死亡が疑い例で報告されており、Bundibugyo株は治療法なし、ワクチン利用まで数ヶ月要するという極めて深刻な状況。

article.articleHeadline: В ДР Конго местные жители подожгли больницу для пациентов с Эболой
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the DR Congo, locals set fire to a hospital for Ebola patients.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo: Locals set fire to a field treatment center for Ebola patients after relatives of a deceased patient were barred from taking the body. The attack occurred as six other patients were being treated at the facility; two hospital tents burned. No injuries were reported. CNN cited a local politician for the details. The incident underscores the fragility of Ebola response efforts in the DRC and the potential for violence around treatment sites during outbreaks. As of May 22, 2026, the event highlights ongoing challenges facing Ebola response in the region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ患者用病院が地域住民に放火される
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の患者治療施設への暴力的攻撃で、感染症対応体制の脆弱性と国際的影響が懸念される。重症度と管理可能性（外部支援必要性）の観点からシグナルに該当。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の流行地域における治療施設への直接的な暴力行為。感染症対応インフラの破壊が患者ケアと疾病制御に深刻な影響を与える。社会的不信と医療体制の不安定性が顕著。DRC内での継続中の流行状況が前提となっている。

article.articleHeadline: وكالة سرايا : الجائحة القادمة ..  إيبولا وهانتا يكشفان هشاشة العالم
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Saraya Agency: The Coming Pandemic... Ebola and Hantavirus Reveal the Fragility of the World
article.articleSummary: After more than four years since COVID-19, the global health system's readiness for pandemics remains debated. Ebola outbreaks in East Africa's Democratic Republic of Congo and hantavirus aboard a South Atlantic cruise ship are the focal points in FT, Guardian, and NYT analyses, all converging on one conclusion: the world remains reactive, not preventive. In the DRC, Ebola was detected weeks after onset as reporting collapsed in war zones; laboratories struggled with the Bundibugyo strain due to limited multi-strain tests and sample handling errors. The broader critique points to weakened early-warning systems, disrupted services, and reduced post–COVID-19 outbreak funding. Helen Clark argues for proactive prevention in hantavirus on the cruise near southern Argentina; the NYT stresses Africa's frontline workers and the Lagos 2014 case of Stella Adadevoh as a corrective example. Structural gaps in surveillance, funding, and fragile-settings response persist.

triage.headline_ja: サラヤ通信社：来たるべきパンデミック...エボラとハンタウイルスが世界のもろさを暴露
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。複数の対象国での検証済み。世界的な公衆衛生上の懸念を扱う分析記事。
triage.notes: 記事は複数の高リスク感染症（エボラ、ハンタウイルス、COVID-19）の同時発生リスク、および各地での検出遅延と対応システムの脆弱性を扱っている。DRCでのエボラ流行の検出遅延、ラボの多重検査能力の限界、南大西洋のクルーズ船でのハンタウイルス、ラゴスの2014年エボラ対応事例が言及されている。アルゼンチンはクルーズ船の位置情報のみ（南大西洋）であり、陸上でのイベント発生地ではないため verified_locations に含めない。ナイジェリア（ラゴス）は2014年の過去事例参照のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: WHO cảnh báo Ebola toàn cầu, Việt Nam chủ động ứng phó
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns of a global Ebola outbreak, Vietnam proactively responds.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak concerns WHO; Bundibugyo strain triggers a Public Health Emergency of International Concern in Congo and Uganda; transmission can occur through contact with blood, secretions, organs, or contaminated materials. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, from early May to May 18, hundreds of suspected cases and fatalities were reported; as of May 18, 516 suspected cases and 131 deaths, marking the 17th Ebola outbreak since 1976. Uganda also reports cases linked to travelers from Congo. WHO declared Bundibugyo Ebola in Congo and Uganda a global health emergency on May 17. Vietnam’s Ministry of Health, noting a low risk but no complacency, convened a national online briefing on May 22. Vietnam is enhancing border surveillance, preparedness, and response plans; expanding laboratory capacity with biosafety level 3 facilities to perform RT-PCR and genome sequencing, with diagnostic reagents expected within 7–10 days. Authorities urge calm and adherence to official guidance.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラウイルスの世界的流行を警告、ベトナムが積極的に対応
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。Bundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱がコンゴとウガンダでPHEICに指定され、複数国（コンゴ、ウガンダ）で確認、死亡例あり。ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性と国際的拡大リスクが極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ・ウガンダでのエボラ発生とベトナムの対応を主題としている。Bluedot APIがウガンダを発生地域として付与しているが、記事サマリーではウガンダは確認地域であり、ベトナムの対応がメイン。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRC（203312）とVietnam（1562822）。ウガンダ（226074）は対象国でないため除外。PHEICが宣言されており、公式な国際的な健康上の脅威である。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola za naszą granicą! Do szpitala w Niemczech trafiła rodzina zakażonego lekarza
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Beyond Our Border! The Family of the Infected Doctor Was Admitted to a Hospital in Germany.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak driven by the Bundibugyo strain is ongoing in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and neighboring Uganda, with 139 deaths and more than 600 people showing symptoms. There is no approved vaccine or specific treatment for this strain; the World Health Organization cautions that official numbers will rise and that the virus poses an international threat, though it has not reached pandemic criteria. An American physician, Dr. Peter Stafford, contracted Ebola during a surgical procedure in the DRC and has been transported to Germany for care; his wife Rebekah and four children are asymptomatic and test negative so far, while Stafford reports improvement. Earlier, on May 21, residents of Rwampara in Ituri Province burned an Ebola treatment center after authorities blocked taking a deceased colleague’s body; ALIMA says the situation is under control and aid teams continue operations.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがわれわれの境界の向こうに！ドイツの病院に感染した医師の家族が入院
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当（重症性：139死亡、予想外：国際的な患者移送、国際的拡大リスク明白、渡航制限のリスク有）。WPRO基準でも複数該当。国際的な公衆衛生脅威として認識される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーによれば、エボラ発生の主要な地理的焦点はDRCおよびウガンダであり、ドイツへの患者移送は二次的な事象。対象国リスト内ではDRCのみが該当。ウガンダは対象国に含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。Bundibugyo株による進行中のアウトブレイク、ワクチン未承認、国際的脅威としてのWHO評価により、シグナルとしてピックアップが妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Jelang Idul Adha 2026, Dispertan Gresik Pastikan Hewan Kurban di Lapak Rekomendasi Bebas PMK
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ahead of Eid al-Adha 2026, Gresik Department of Agriculture Ensures Sacrificial Animals at FMD-Free Recommended Stalls.
article.articleSummary: Ahead of Eid al-Adha 1447 Hijriah in Gresik, Indonesia, the Department of Agriculture’s livestock division inspected sacrificial-animal markets at Pondok Permata Suci (PPS). They confirmed no animals with foot-and-mouth disease (PMK) in the stalls and that 10,000 animals have been vaccinated against PMK. Head of the Gresik Agriculture Office, Eko Anindito, announced readiness to provide free vaccination on-site to stalls that are SKH-cleared. Buyers are advised to choose animals with a Surat Keterangan Kesehatan Hewan (SKH) and avoid PPPK signs—Penyakitan, Picek, Pincang, dan Kurus (illness, blindness, lameness, and thinness). Officials emphasized PMK vaccines are safe for consumption when meat is properly handled. Traders noted good demand and generally healthy appearances, with goats and other livestock in favorable condition.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年イード・アル＝アドハに向けて、グレシック農業局が推奨される口蹄疫検査を受けた供給先での犠牲動物の安全を保証
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアでの口蹄疫（FMD）に関する監視・予防活動の報告。現在のところ動物への感染確認なし、ワクチン接種が進められており、直接的な公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は認められないが、動物由来感染症の重要な監視対象として継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事はインドネシア（グレシック地区）でのイード・アル＝アドハに向けた口蹄疫予防対策の報告。現在のところ動物市場での感染は確認されておらず、むしろ動物衛生当局による積極的な監視・ワクチン接種活動が展開されている状況。動物衛生面での政府関心は高いが、現時点での公衆衛生的リスクは低い。ただし、口蹄疫は重要な動物由来感染症として引き続き監視対象。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch in der DR Kongo: Eindämmung könnte lange dauern
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the DR Congo: containment could take a long time.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, a rare Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak has 671 suspected cases and 160 suspected deaths as of May 22, 2026. Containment is hampered by difficult access, ongoing clashes between rebels and the army, and a remote region. A white aid tent in Rwampara, northeast DRC, intended for Ebola patient care, burned while teams prepared the deceased for proper burial, a key step to prevent transmission at funerals. There is no approved vaccine for Bundibugyo; vaccines for the traditional Ebola strain are ineffective here, making isolation of suspected and confirmed cases critical. Case fatality rate for Bundibugyo is 25–50%. The outbreak began weeks ago and remained undetected for some time. MSF’s Florent Uzzeni warns it could last months to years. WHO/UNICEF aid has arrived, but PPE is scarce; IRC notes US development cuts reducing operations from five to two districts in the region, amid broader debates with WHO.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ・アウトブレイク：封じ込めに長期間を要する可能性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。671疑似患者・160疑似死亡を伴う稀少なブンディブギョ型エボラ感染症の流行であり、ワクチン未承認、致命率25-50%、ルワンダへの地理的近接等により、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラは稀少で、既存ワクチンが無効。MSFおよびWHO/UNICEFが対応中だが、困難な地理的アクセス、武装勢力の衝突、PPE不足、米国開発支援削減等により管理が複雑化。ルワンダとの隣接地域（キガリ州）での検出により国境越境リスクが顕在化している。

article.articleHeadline: 苗栗麻疹個案＋1！泰國旅客入境確診 足跡曝光、匡列112名接觸者 - 生活
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Miaoli measles case +1! Thai traveler diagnosed on entry; exposure sites revealed, 112 close contacts identified - Life
article.articleSummary: Miaoli County, Taiwan reports one imported measles case: a woman in her 30s who traveled from Thailand, entering on May 12. She developed fever on May 15 and a measles rash on May 17; the Taiwan CDC confirmed infection on May 21. As of May 22, 112 close contacts—household members, service staff, and medical personnel—have been identified and are under health monitoring through June 8. The patient was infectious from four days before until four days after rash onset. Reported exposures include guest houses, dining establishments, a healthcare facility, and a large department store, with environmental cleaning completed at these sites. Contacts with overlapping footprints should self-monitor through June 3 and seek care if fever, rash, cough, runny nose, or eye symptoms occur. Vaccination with the two-dose MMR is urged for children under six and any unvaccinated peers; consult local health authorities for details.

triage.headline_ja: 苗栗麻疹個案＋1！泰國旅客入境確診 足跡曝光、匡列112名接觸者 - 生活
triage.triage_reason: 輸入麻疹症例の確認で異常・予想外の事象。112名の濃厚接触者が特定されており、ヒト-ヒト感染のリスク、複数の公共施設での曝露、国際渡航関連の感染症であり、IHR基準およびWPRO基準に複数該当する。

verified_locations.name: 不適用（Taiwan は対象国外）

triage.notes: Taiwan は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。ただし、タイからの輸入症例であり、タイは対象国に含まれるため verified_locations に記載。麻疹はWHO優先疾患であり、国際的な拡大リスク、複数の公共施設での曝露、112名の濃厚接触者の特定により、フルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: UN agencies intensify Ebola response as outbreak spreads in Eastern DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has recorded 139 deaths and 600 suspected cases, with Uganda confirming two cases. Ituri Province is the epicentre, with Rwampara, Mongbwalu and Bunia most affected; cases in North Kivu (Goma, Butembo, Katwa) raise cross-border concerns, and a case in Bukavu linked to travel from Tshopo. The outbreak is linked to the Bundibugyo strain, for which no approved vaccines or specific treatments exist. WHO has classified it as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. UN agencies and MONUSCO are intensifying the response, deploying logistics, ambulances, armored vehicles, four light vehicles, a helicopter and motorcycles for deliveries and rapid response. Over 2,000 community health workers are deployed; WFP, UNICEF, and OCHA coordinate, with more than $214 million needed for humanitarian operations, including over $10 million for Ebola-specific activities. Ongoing challenges include insecurity, displacement, restricted aid access, increasing transmission risk.

triage.headline_ja: 国連機関がエボラ出血熱対応を強化、東部コンゴ民主共和国で感染拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。ウガンダ、ルワンダへの越境感染確認、Bundibugyo型で治療法なし、WHOが国際懸念公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言済み。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでウガンダおよびルワンダでのケース確認が述べられているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCが主要な発生国。Bundibugyo型エボラで承認済みワクチン・治療法なし。WHOがPHEIC宣言。複数国境での越境リスク。保健衛星システム上の主要シグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Protesters Set Ebola Centre On Fire In Africa's DR Congo Amid Row Over Delay In Returning Victim's Body
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Ebola outbreak in Ituri province (Rwampara) intensified when residents attacked an Ebola treatment center after authorities refused to release a suspected victim’s body. The violence damaged at least two medical tents and a body awaiting safe burial; six patients inside the tents were reportedly safe and continued to receive care. Healthcare workers received military protection, and one staff member was injured. The outbreak has yielded hundreds of suspected cases and more than 130 confirmed deaths, with cross-border spread to Uganda where infections were confirmed and border screening tightened. The World Health Organization classed the event as a public health emergency of international concern, underscoring the importance of safe and dignified burials to prevent transmission. Local confusion over whether the death was Ebola or typhoid has fueled mistrust amid ongoing containment challenges in conflict-affected health facilities.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカのコンゴ民主共和国でエボラセンター炎上 被害者遺体返却遅延をめぐる怒りの中で
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラの確定死亡130人以上、国際的拡大（ウガンダへの越境感染）、WHOが国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態と分類。フルRRA必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダへの越境感染が記載されているが、ウガンダはGeoNames IDで対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCが対象国（203312）であり、実際の発生地はItturi州。エボラはWHOにより国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）として認定されている。紛争地での医療施設と住民不信が管理を複雑化させている。

article.articleHeadline: США разрешили сборной ДР Конго сыграть на ЧМ-2026 несмотря на ограничения из-за Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States allowed the DR Congo national team to play in the 2026 World Cup despite Ebola-related restrictions.
article.articleSummary: Despite an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with 513 confirmed cases and 131 deaths as of May 19, the United States has allowed the DR Congo national football team to compete at the 2026 FIFA World Cup in the United States. The travel ban restricting entry for foreigners who recently visited DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan remains in effect, but an exception was made for players and official delegates. Those who have recently been in DRC will undergo enhanced medical screening, testing, and possible quarantine; fans are not exempt. The team trains in Europe and Houston; Kinshasa training camp was canceled due to sanitary restrictions. DR Congo is drawn into Group K with Uzbekistan, Portugal, and Colombia; their opening match is June 17 in Texas against Portugal. FIFA says it remains in close contact with health authorities and the DRC federation.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ制限にもかかわらずコンゴ民主共和国代表の2026年ワールドカップ出場を許可
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で「異常/予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」「渡航制限リスク」の3基準に該当。WPRO基準でも「異常性」「重症度」「流行易性」「管理可能性」の複数基準に該当し、実際の感染症事例（513確認症例、131死亡）を伴う国際スポーツイベント開催という社会的・政治的関心が極めて高いシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年5月22日配信だが、記事中のエボラアウトブレイク統計は5月19日時点の513確認症例、131死亡を報告。コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行中に、米国でのワールドカップ開催に向けた国際渡航制限の緩和決定が記載されている。Kinshasa, Houston, Texas, Uzbekistan, Portugal, Colombia, Sudan, Uganda が関連地域として記載されているが、サマリー上でエボラ発生地はDRC（およびウガンダ、南スーダンへの旅行制限言及）であり、イベント主題はDRCに限定される。

article.articleHeadline: Recortes de financiación de EE.UU. han dificultado respuesta a mortal crisis del ébola, afirman los trabajadores humanitarios | CNN
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: US funding cuts have hampered the response to the deadly Ebola crisis, humanitarian workers say | CNN
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in northeast Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri Province with care at Mongbwalu hospital. First presumptive death linked to the outbreak on April 20; officially declared May 15 after delays in testing for the Bundibugyo strain. OMS reports more than 100 deaths and nearly 600 suspected cases; notes there is no vaccine or specific treatment and that the virus may have circulated for months before detection due to an unusual strain, weak rural health infrastructure, and ethnic conflict. U.S. funding cuts across WHO, USAID, and CDC, plus reduced aid to the DRC and Uganda, are blamed by humanitarian workers for hampering surveillance and response. IRC warns surveillance systems have weakened; CDC says ~100 staff in Uganda, ~30 in DRC, with hundreds mobilized. Samples required over 1,600 km to Kinshasa for confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: 米国の資金削減がエボラ危機への対応を困難にしている、人道支援労働者らが主張 | CNN
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。コンゴ民主共和国北東部（イトゥリ州）でのエボラアウトブレイク、100人以上の死亡、約600の疑似症例、ウガンダへの拡大リスク、国際的支援能力の低下により、重大な公衆衛生上の懸念が存在する。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはウガンダも含まれているが、サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国が主要な発生地であり、ウガンダは境界地域および対応拠点として言及されている。Bundibugyo株は稀な株であり、検査遅延、弱い農村保健インフラ、民族紛争により検出が遅れた可能性がある。米国の資金削減による監視・対応能力の低下が重大な懸念。

article.articleHeadline: S. Korea Tightens Travel Alerts for Congo, Uganda over Ebola Outbreak
article.articleSummary: South Korea has issued a Level 4 travel ban for Ituri Province in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, effective 2:00 p.m., and a Level 2.5 special travel advisory for Uganda at 10:00 a.m. amid an Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo strain. Under Level 4, Korean nationals in the designated area without exceptional passport authorization face penalties under the Passport Act. The Uganda advisory is for urgent, short-term risks and can last up to 90 days. More than 100 people have recently died in the two countries from the Bundibugyo strain, which currently has no vaccine or specific treatment. The report notes travel-focused risk management, with no laboratory confirmation details or transmission sources provided.

triage.headline_ja: 韓国、エボラ流行でコンゴ・ウガンダへの渡航警告を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。複数国での エボラ（Bundibugyo株）発生、100人以上の死亡、対象国DRCが直接的な発生地。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴのイトゥリ州とウガンダでのエボラ流行を報告しているが、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。ウガンダは対象国外のため verified_locations に含めない。Bundibugyo株は希少かつ高致死率で、100人以上の死亡・複数国での発生が確認されている。韓国による渡航警告レベル4の発出は国際的懸念の高さを示す。

article.articleHeadline: India-Africa Forum Summit Postponed Over Ebola Outbreak in DRC
article.articleSummary: As of May 22, 2026, an evolving Ebola outbreak centered in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has produced at least 139 confirmed deaths, with additional cases reported as the virus spreads, including to Uganda. In response to public-health concerns, India and the African Union agreed to postpone the Fourth India-Africa Forum Summit in New Delhi, originally slated for May 28–31, 2026. No new dates have been announced. Officials described the postponement as a precaution to ensure full participation by African leaders while allowing intensified outbreak response led by Africa CDC and coordinated vaccine access and treatment efforts. India has issued health advisories to African health authorities. Plenaries, bilateral meetings, and side events will be rescheduled; both sides emphasized commitment to holding the summit when conditions improve and continuing high-level engagement.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行を受けてインド・アフリカフォーラムサミット延期
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラ発症国の複数化（DRC、ウガンダ）と国際フォーラム延期決定により、強い社会政治的関心と国際対応の必要性がある。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドにはウガンダ（226074）も含まれているが、サマリーではDRCが「中心地（centered in）」であり、ウガンダは「追加報告地（including to Uganda）」と二次的な位置づけのため、対象国リストにウガンダが含まれないため除外。New Delhi記載はサミット延期開催地であり発症地ではないため除外。インドは国際会議延期の影響受国として verified_locations に含める。死亡数139名確認、複数国への拡大、国際フォーラム延期など複合的な深刻度あり。

article.articleHeadline: Wamenkes: Cakupan Imunisasi Aceh Baru 33 Persen, Kasus Campak Tembus 263 Orang |Republika Online
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deputy Health Minister: Aceh's Immunization Coverage Is Only 33 Percent, Measles Cases Reach 263 People | Republika Online
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-22, Aceh Province reports immunization coverage at 33%, well below the national target of 90% (national coverage 80.2% last year). Deputy Health Minister Dante Saksono Harbuwono tied low vaccination uptake to higher vaccine-preventable disease risk, noting 263 measles (campak) cases across Aceh this year, including 24 in Banda Aceh. Authorities will intensify public education on immunization, addressing parental concerns about side effects; post-vaccination fever is described as a normal immune response. He also rebutted halal-haram concerns, citing Aceh Ulama Council recommendation that immunization is permissible (mubah) under No. 12/2013. The aim is to bolster coverage to prevent further measles outbreaks and protect children in Aceh and Banda Aceh.

triage.headline_ja: 保健副大臣：アチェ州のワクチン接種率は33%に留まる、麻疹患者は263人に達する
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の症例報告数は限定的（263人）で、深刻な大規模流行の兆候に乏しい。ただし予防接種カバー率の低さ（33%）と国家目標との大きなギャップ、感染拡大リスクを指摘する当局者の声があり、今後の動向に注視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシア保健省副大臣の公式声明に基づいており、アチェ州での麻疹発生とワクチン接種率の低さを報告している。263人の症例は限定的だが、予防接種カバー率33%という異常に低い水準と国家目標90%とのギャップは懸念材料。今後のアウトブレイク拡大リスク評価のため経過観察が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Drama im Kongo: Helfer im Wettlauf gegen die Zeit bei erschöpften Kapazitäten
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola drama in the Congo: Aid workers race against the clock with exhausted capacities.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, with hundreds of suspected cases and rising confirmed infections, as of May 22, 2026. Responders from MSF race to expand isolation and treatment capacity across Bunia, Butembo, and Goma, amid logistical hurdles in sparsely served regions near Uganda and South Sudan. MSF is shipping PPE, generators, cooling devices, beds, tents, IV solutions, and personnel from Kinshasa, Uganda, and Europe, with ready-to-deploy Ebola response sets staged in Bordeaux and Brussels. Two main pillars: patient care and contact tracing; contact tracers monitor exposed individuals for 21 days, with fever triggering rapid isolation and treatment. Red Cross volunteers conduct household outreach and radio messaging to raise awareness. Capacity strains risk unisolated patients and further transmission; cross-border spread remains a key concern.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴにおけるエボラの危機：疲弊した能力下での支援者による時間との競争
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の継続的な流行によるPICKUP。IHR基準は全4項目に該当し、WPRO基準も5項目全て該当。対象国DRCでの発生確認、国際的な支援活動の展開、国境を越えた感染拡大リスク、複数カ国への感染拡大可能性が明確。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはベルギー、フランス、ウガンダ、スーダンなどが含まれているが、記事サマリーではこれらの国での発生は報告されていない。これらは支援元または国境周辺国として言及されているのみと判断。実際のエボラ発生地域はDRC（特にイトゥリ州、ブニア、ブテンボ、ゴマ）に限定される。DRCのみを検証済み所在地として列挙。

article.articleHeadline: AP: число смертей, предположительно, от Эболы в ДРК выросло до 160
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: AP: The number of Ebola deaths in the DRC has reportedly risen to 160.
article.articleSummary: 160 Ebola-related deaths and 671 suspected infections were reported in two provinces of the Democratic Republic of Congo as of May 21, per the Associated Press citing local authorities. The outbreak’s epicenter is Ituri Province, with initial signals observed on May 5. Uganda has suspended all direct flights to the DRC amid the outbreak. The World Health Organization has declared the Ebola situation in both the DRC and Uganda an emergency. In Russia, Health Minister Mikhail Murashko said there is no risk of spread to Russia, while the Foreign Ministry expressed concern; a Rospotrebnadzor team was dispatched to conduct an epidemiological investigation. The article does not detail the infection source or any imported/exported cases beyond the flight suspensions.

triage.headline_ja: AP報道：コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ関連死者数が160人に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。エボラウイルス病の確認された多地域アウトブレイク、複数国への波及、国際的な公衆衛生対応が進行中であり、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで主なアウトブレイク発生地はコンゴ民主共和国（Ituri州）。ウガンダについては「直行便を停止」との対応言及があるが、感染症イベントの実際の発生地としては明記されていないため verified_locations に含めない。ロシアは対応国（懸念表明、疫学調査チーム派遣）だが、実際の発生地ではないため除外。WHO緊急宣言、複数国への波及懸念、高い重症度と致命率から、最優先度のシグナルとして分類。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Wettlauf gegen die Zeit - Kapazitäten problematisch
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Race Against Time - Capacity Problems
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Ituri Province of the Democratic Republic of the Congo is driving an urgent, cross-border containment effort. One week after the outbreak was announced, hundreds of suspected cases and an increasing number of laboratory-confirmed infections raise fears of spread to neighboring countries. Despite the country’s extensive experience with the disease, capacity gaps hinder rapid response. Health experts, personnel and aid workers in Berlin, Bunia and Goma describe a race against time to establish isolation and treatment facilities across multiple sites. Maximilian Gertler, epidemiologist at Charité Berlin and MSF, stresses the need to quickly mount dedicated isolation and treatment capacity at various locations. The report underscores the critical role of swift case management to curb transmission while awaiting broader support.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ: 時間との戦い - 処理能力の問題
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。スクリーニング基準でも複数該当。DRCでのエボラアウトブレイクは高優先度シグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCのIturi州でのエボラアウトブレイクを主題としている。Bunia（Ituri州内）とGoma、ベルリン（ドイツ）の言及があるが、実際の感染症発生地は DRC に限定される。ドイツ拠点の専門家の言及は支援側の背景情報であり、感染症イベントの発生地ではない。推測被害者数『数百の疑い症例』と『増加する確定症例』が報告されており、国際的拡大への懸念が強調されている。これは高優先度のWHO通知対象。

article.articleHeadline: أوغندا تعلق رحلاتها الجوية إلى الكونغو الديمقراطية بسبب تفشي إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda suspends air travel to the Democratic Republic of the Congo due to an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Uganda suspended all direct flights with the Democratic Republic of the Congo due to an Ebola outbreak, per an official Ugandan statement cited by Daily Monitor. The World Health Organization has declared the Ebola situation in the DRC and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, warning the risk may spread further. Congolese authorities report 131 Ebola deaths as responders intensify efforts to contain transmission and provide care. Tunis activated its continental Ebola protocol in coordination with WHO, focusing on traveler screening from affected areas and immediate isolation of suspected cases. The virus is transmitted by direct contact, not airborne, and its incubation period is limited. The 2025 outbreak in the DRC ended officially in October, but new foci in the Great Lakes region raise concerns. The U.S. State Department urged designating a single airport for returnees from Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan due to Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダがエボラ流行を理由にコンゴ民主共和国への航空便を一時停止
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的な感染拡大リスク、WHOによるPHEIC宣言、複数国での対応措置、及び社会的関心の高さから、IHR基準3項目以上該当し、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはエボラ出血熱の国際的危機を明確に示している。DRCでの感染確認（131名の死亡報告）、WHOによるPHEIC宣言、ウガンダの航空便停止、チュニジアの検疫強化、米国務省の対応提言など、複数国での公式な対応措置が記載されている。対象国リストからはDRCのみが該当するが、国際的な拡大リスクは極めて高い。続報監視による情報更新が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: USA presmerujú cestujúcich z oblasti postihnutej ebolou na jedno letisko. Bude ním Washington Dulles
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States will redirect travelers from the Ebola-affected area to a single airport. It will be Washington Dulles.
article.articleSummary: US directs all travelers returning from Ebola-affected countries—Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan—to Washington Dulles International Airport for extended health screening, including a travel-history questionnaire, symptom monitoring, and temperature checks, with data collected for potential contact tracing. The policy applies to flights departing after May 20 at 23:59 local time and requires airlines to reroute travelers to Dulles. U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents, and green-card holders are covered; non-U.S. passport holders previously faced entry restrictions. The screening aims to detect Ebola symptoms; travelers without symptoms may continue to their final destinations but will receive guidance on monitoring health. CDC clarified details; CBP issued order. WHO has declared the ongoing Ebola outbreak in DRC and neighboring regions a Public Health Emergency of International Concern; global pandemic risk deemed low.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がエボラ影響地域からの渡航者をワシントン・ダレス国際空港に集約
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ感染症はPHEIC宣言済み、複数国への波及リスク、国際渡航規制、米国による公衆衛生上の重大措置実施がある。
triage.notes: 記事は米国の渡航規制措置を報じるものだが、エボラ感染症の実際の発生地はコンゴ民主共和国及び隣接国（ウガンダ、南スーダン）。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。WHOがPHEIC宣言済みの進行中のアウトブレイク。

article.articleHeadline: أوغندا تعلق رحلاتها الجوية إلى الكونغو الديمقراطية بسبب تفشي إيبولا - الوطني : البلاد
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda suspends its air travel to the Democratic Republic of the Congo due to an Ebola outbreak - Al-Watan: Al-Bilad.
article.articleSummary: Uganda suspended all direct air travel with the Democratic Republic of the Congo in response to an Ebola outbreak. The move, reported via the Daily Monitor and official authorities, accompanies a World Health Organization designation of the Ebola situation in DRC and Uganda as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, with warnings that the risk could reach other countries. Congolese authorities report 131 deaths as medical teams intensify efforts to contain the outbreak and care for patients. On the continental level, Tunisia activated its Ebola protocol in coordination with WHO, prioritizing traveler screening from affected areas (such as Congo) for fever and immediate isolation of suspected cases. The incubation period is short, and transmission occurs through direct contact rather than airborne spread. The previous DRC Ebola outbreak was declared over in October 2025, but new foci raise regional and international concern in the Africa Great Lakes region.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行に対応し、ウガンダがコンゴ民主共和国への航空路線を停止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WHOが「国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）」として指定。複数国での渡航制限・検疫強化が既に実施されている。
triage.notes: エボラの再流行であり、WHO PHEIC指定済み。131人の死亡報告あり。ウガンダでの発生も示唆されているが、記事サマリーではDRCが主要な流行地として述べられている。ウガンダ（GeoNames ID 226074）は対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。複数国での対応措置が既に実施されており、国際的関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Voo com destino aos EUA é desviado para o Canadá após suspeita de exposição de passageiro ao vírus Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Flight bound for the United States is diverted to Canada after a passenger's suspected exposure to the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: Flight AF378 from Paris to Detroit was diverted to Montreal after US authorities identified a passenger who may have been exposed to Ebola. The Congolese traveler, who recently visited East Africa, was refused US entry under restrictions targeting people from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, South Sudan, and Uganda. The incident follows an Ebola outbreak in Central Africa, with 51 confirmed cases in northern Congo and 2 in Uganda; at least 139 deaths and more than 600 suspected cases overall. The Bundibugyo strain, first identified in 2007, can kill up to 40% of those infected. Common symptoms include fever, body pains, fatigue, and sore throat; severe cases may cause liver and kidney failure and internal bleeding. The WHO has declared a public health emergency of international concern; a vaccine is not yet available. An American patient infected was treated in Germany; US screening for travelers from the affected countries has been enhanced.

triage.headline_ja: 米国行きの飛行機がエボラウイルス感染の可能性後、カナダへ迂回
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目に該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。エボラ確定症例と死亡、WHO PHEIC宣言、複数国での流行、国際航空機迂回事案など、すべてシグナル性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国での発生（確定51例、死亡139例以上）を主体としており、同国が対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダ（confirmed 2 cases）も言及されているが対象国リストに含まれていない。カナダ、米国、フランス、ドイツは迂回・対応国であり発生地ではないため除外。WHO PHEIC宣言済み、ワクチン未利用可能、致死率40%の高リスク病原体であり、国際航空機迂回事案は明らかに重大な関心事項。フルRRA推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Maskapai Kecolongan Terkait Wabah Ebola, Pesawat Belok Darurat
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Airline caught off guard by Ebola outbreak; plane makes an emergency turn.
article.articleSummary: Air France flight bound for Detroit was diverted to Montreal after US CBP flagged a passenger from the Democratic Republic of Congo on board amid new Ebola travel restrictions. The incident occurred May 20, 2026; CBP said the passenger should not have boarded and redirected the flight to deter Ebola entry to the United States. CBP is coordinating with the CDC to bolster health protections as part of tightened measures targeting the Ebola outbreak in east and central Africa. The United States has barred entry for non-US passport holders who have recently been in Uganda, DRC, or South Sudan within 21 days, for 30 days. Beginning May 22, DHS will require all US-bound flights carrying foreign travelers from Ebola-affected countries to land first at Washington Dulles International for health checks. WHO reports nearly 600 suspected Ebola cases and 139 deaths; 51 confirmed cases in the DRC, indicating ongoing outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行をめぐって航空会社が対応に追われる。飛行機が緊急着陸
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの国際的な拡大リスク、IHR基準3つ該当、WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当、DRC・ウガンダ・南スーダンでの流行確認、米国における渡航制限実施により社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが検出した地域（Washington DC、Detroit、Montreal、Quebec、Michigan等）は米国・カナダ側の防衛措置（飛行機着陸地点、対応拠点）であり、エボラの実際の発生地はDRC、Uganda、South Sudan。対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。WHO報告から約600疑い例、139死亡、DRCで51確認例が記載されており、アフリカ東中部での活動的流行が継続している。

article.articleHeadline: Нападнат и запален центар за заразени од ебола во ДР Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Center for Ebola patients in DR Congo attacked and burned.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak violence erupted at an Ebola treatment center in Rwampara Hospital, on the outskirts of Ituri’s capital Bunia, DR Congo. Angry families of Ebola victims demanded the bodies be buried, disputing reports that their relatives died of Ebola. The crowd set fire to several tents housing Ebola patients; police used tear gas and fired warning shots to disperse them. The incident underscores ongoing security challenges in eastern Congo, echoing past attacks on health facilities during Ebola crises in 2018 and 2020. The Ebola outbreak in Ituri was officially declared on May 15, with the latest flare occurring around May 22, 2026. Luk Malembe, a local official, called for increased community awareness about the disease amid these disruptions to care and infection control.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ患者センターが襲撃され放火される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。エボラ出血熱の新規流行宣言（5月15日）と暴力事件により医療施設機能が阻害され、感染制御が脅かされている。
triage.notes: イトゥリ州ブニア市のルワムパラ病院エボラ治療センターでの暴力事件。エボラ流行は2026年5月15日に正式宣言。医療施設への暴力行為により感染制御と患者管理が著しく阻害されている。過去2018年・2020年のエボラ危機での同様インシデント履歴あり。東部コンゴの安全保障課題が顕在化。

article.articleHeadline: Демонстранти во Конго запалија центар за ебола по спор со властите за тело на починат - Независен Весник
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Demonstrators in Congo set fire to an Ebola treatment center after a dispute with authorities over the body of the deceased.
article.articleSummary: Demonstrators in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo set fire to two Ebola treatment tents after a dispute over delivering the body of a man who died of Ebola at Ruumpara hospital. Local politician Luk Mambele, vice-president of the A2RPC party, said relatives attempted to forcibly take the body; authorities refused, prompting family members to hurl objects at Alliance for International Medical Action tents. Six Ebola patients were being treated there and were immediately moved to safer areas inside the hospital. The outbreak centers on the Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain, for which there is no specific treatment or vaccine. Authorities report about 160 deaths linked to this outbreak, with 13 confirmed and 78 suspect cases in Ituri Province. The World Health Organization has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, though the global risk remains low; the Congolese government condemned the attack. The incident highlights community misinformation about Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの抗議者がエボラ治療センターに放火、故人の遺体をめぐる当局との紛争後
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的懸念、渡航制限リスク）、WHO緊急宣言あり、WPRO基準も複数該当。安全保障上の懸念と感染症制御の脅威が並存しており、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: イトゥリ州での進行中のエボラアウトブレイク（Bundibugyo株）により、WHO PHEICが宣言されている。治療施設への放火は患者の安全を脅かし、社会的信頼の喪失を示す。約160名の死亡報告がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : 64 cas confirmés et 1.261 contacts recensés - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: 64 confirmed cases and 1,261 identified contacts - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo: as of May 20, 2026, 64 confirmed Ebola cases have been reported across Ituri and North Kivu. Ituri accounts for 60 cases; North Kivu 4; six confirmed deaths (Ituri 4, North Kivu 2). The tally includes 671 suspected cases and 160 suspected deaths since outbreak start, with 1,261 contacts under monitoring. The most affected areas are Mongbwalu, Rwampara, Bunia, Nyankunde and Bambu in Ituri, and Goma, Katwa, and Butembo in North Kivu. On May 20, 2026, 13 new confirmed cases were recorded (12 in Ituri, 1 in North Kivu), with no new confirmed deaths that day. An additional 414 contacts were identified (286 in Rwampara, 128 in Bambu). Of 35 samples analyzed that day, 12 were positive; 49 samples remain awaiting results. Laboratories report processing delays. Provinces remain under enhanced surveillance; population urged to report suspected cases via the green hotline 151.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ：64例の確定例と1,261人の接触者が確認 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確定例64例、死亡6例、1,261人の接触者監視中という重篤な公衆衛生事態であり、IHR基準「深刻な影響」「異常性」「国際拡大リスク」が複数該当。WPROスクリーニングでも重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性が該当し、フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIから返された発生地域にはルワンダ、イタリアなどが含まれているが、記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国のイトゥリ州とカサイ州北部（Nord-Kivu）での発生を述べており、verified_locationsはDRCのみに限定。ルワンダやイタリアでの確定例報告なし。検査遅延が報告されており、実際の症例数はさらに増加する可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Wettlauf gegen die Zeit - Kapazitäten problematisch | Foto: Andrew Kasuku/AP/dpa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Race against the clock — Capacity constraints are problematic | Photo: Andrew Kasuku/AP/dpa.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of Congo, triggers hundreds of suspected cases with rising confirmed infections and fears of cross-border spread to Uganda and South Sudan. One week after officials announced the outbreak, experts warn that rapid isolation and treatment capacity must be established across multiple sites, but fragile security and logistical hurdles slow progress. MSF is deploying experienced Ebola teams, stockpiling PPE, generators, cooling equipment, beds, tents, and other supplies from Kinshasa, Uganda, and Europe, and establishing new treatment centers in Bunia, Butembo, Goma, Kisangani, and surrounding areas. Contact tracers are tracing infection chains with 21-day follow-up of contacts; community education by the Congolese Red Cross via door-to-door visits and radio. The Red Cross and MSF stress the importance of rapid action to prevent transmission given already strained health systems.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：時間との競争 - 収容能力が問題
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱は極めて危険な感染症であり、複数地域での確認症例増加と隣国への越境拡大の明確なリスクが存在。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはウガンダとスーダンも記載されているが、サマリーでは「fears of cross-border spread to Uganda and South Sudan」と述べられており、これらは越境拡大の懸念地域であって発生地域ではない。実際の発生確認はDRC（イトゥリ州）のみ。MSFを含む国際的な対応が既に展開中であり、社会的・政治的関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, cosa sta succedendo in Congo e quali sono i rischi in Europa e in Italia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: What's happening in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and what are the risks in Europe and Italy.
article.articleSummary: Over 600 suspected Ebola cases and more than 130 deaths are reported from Bundibugyo ebolavirus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Ituri province, with spillover into Uganda. The World Health Organization has declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern. This Bundibugyo strain differs from the Zaire ebolavirus; it initially evaded diagnostics and there are no approved vaccines or targeted treatments for this variant. A U.S. missionary infected in Congo has been treated at Charité, Berlin, with his wife and four children transferred there under precautions. Transmission occurs only via direct contact with bodily fluids of infected individuals, living or dead; it is not airborne. Incubation ranges 2–21 days, and contagion begins with symptom onset. Italy has activated surveillance: port and airport temperature checks, traveler tracking for those from Ituri, mandatory reporting, and three weeks of symptom monitoring; Spallanzani in Rome and Sacco in Milan are on alert. EU risk is low.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴ民主共和国で何が起きており、ヨーロッパとイタリアでのリスクは何か
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WHO公式宣言のPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）であり、新型株・ワクチン未対応、複数国での発生・対応。フルRRA進行を要する。
triage.notes: WHO公式PHEC宣言済み。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（新型株）で既存ワクチン・治療法未対応。600+疑い患者、130+死亡。ウガンダへの二次感染あり。発生地域にはイタリア・ドイツ・米国が含まれているが、これらは医療体制が整備された先進国での医療従事者・患者受け入れ施設であり、本流行の「発生地」ではない。verified_locationsはDRC（202312）のみ対象国リストに該当。イタリア・ドイツは対象国外のため除外。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: 4 nhân viên y tế ở Congo tử vong do Ebola, Việt Nam cảnh báo dịch
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 4 healthcare workers in Congo die of Ebola, Vietnam warns of Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Four healthcare workers in Congo have died from Ebola in the Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak, with two cases and one death in Uganda linked to Congo. In Ituri since early May there have been many suspected cases; as of May 18 Congo reported 516 suspected cases and 131 deaths. The WHO declared a PHEIC on May 17. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, one of the Ebola strains in the Congo–Uganda spread. Vaccines and therapies exist for classical strains, but none for Bundibugyo. Vietnam has not recorded cases but tightened surveillance at borders and airports; travelers from Ebola areas should self-monitor for 21 days. Vietnam's Pasteur Institute Ho Chi Minh City and National Institute of Hygiene and Epidemiology have BSL-3 labs for PCR/sequencing and have ordered WHO diagnostics to arrive in 7–10 days. Imported cases have occurred in the United States, Spain, the United Kingdom, and Italy.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで4人の医療従事者がエボラで死亡、ベトナムがエボラ流行を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WHO PHEICが既に宣言されている。また、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、ベトナムを含む対象国での対応が進行中である。
triage.notes: WHOがPHEIC(Public Health Emergency of International Concern)を5月17日に宣言済み。DRCのIturi州で5月初旬より大規模流行が継続中（5月18日時点で516疑似患者、131死亡）。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株には既存ワクチン・治療法が有効でない点が特に懸念される。ベトナムは国内症例なしだが、検査体制強化と渡航者への警告を実施中。

article.articleHeadline: Focarul de Ebola din Republica Democrată Congo se extinde rapid
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading rapidly.
article.articleSummary: As of May 22, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading rapidly, centered in Ituri with cross-border transmission to Uganda and new cases in South Kivu and Goma. Protests and violence near a treatment center in Rwampara have hindered response, with cases under-reported due to fear. Official data report 670 suspected cases and 160 suspected deaths, of which 61 are lab-confirmed. A 28-year-old man died in South Kivu; another case had been confirmed in Goma. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo, a strain for which there is no approved vaccine or specific antiviral; CEPI is evaluating candidates, but distribution may take 6–9 months. WHO has declared a public health emergency of international concern. UK has pledged £20 million and the US about $23 million; Uganda has suspended public transport to/from DRC for four weeks. US DHS is screening travelers at Dulles for Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan travelers.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ患者数が急速に拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の急速な国際的拡大、複数国への越境感染、WHO国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言、重篤な症状と死亡例により、フルRRAが必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン、米国での対応が言及されているが、実際の発生地はDRCのみ（ウガンダは越境リスク・対応段階、米国はスクリーニング実施地）。Bundibugyo株によるエボラはワクチン未承認株で、6～9ヶ月の開発期間が必要。WHO PHEIC宣言済み、複数国からの支援誓約、国境閉鎖措置により国際的緊急度は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Thailand readies BSL-3 laboratories for Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: As of May 22, 2026, Thailand is preparing BSL-3 laboratories and strengthening genomic surveillance, diagnostic test-kit production, and a nationwide laboratory network to enable a rapid response to the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak. Dr. Sarawut Boonsuk, Director-General of the Department of Medical Sciences, said Public Health Minister Pattana Promphat has instructed all agencies under the ministry to sustain strict disease surveillance, prevention, and control measures and to ready capacities to handle the situation. The move follows the WHO’s designation of the Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo strain in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and in Uganda as a public health emergency of international concern. The Department of Medical Sciences was assigned to bolster laboratory capacity, diagnostic testing, and biosafety systems to support efficient analysis of dangerous pathogens and to bolster public confidence.

triage.headline_ja: タイ、ブンディブギョエボラアウトブレークへの対応としてBSL-3検査室を準備
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目以上該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WHO PHEIC認定されたエボラアウトブレークに対する地域対応が確認され、国際的な関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はタイが実施している準備体制に焦点を当てているが、サマリーから DRC と Uganda でのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレークの存在が確認される。対象国リストに DRC（203312）と Thailand（1605651）が含まれるため これらを verified_locations に列挙した。Uganda（226074）は対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。WHO PHEIC認定により国際的な関心・対応の必要性が明確。

article.articleHeadline: India issues Ebola advisory for passengers from high-risk African nations
article.articleSummary: Ebola advisory expanded in India as of 2026-05-22: passengers arriving from or transiting through Ebola-affected regions must report symptoms or exposure history to airport health authorities before completing immigration. High-risk countries identified include Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan, per WHO risk classifications. India has not detected any Ebola cases to date. Airport screening is tightened by the Directorate General of Health Services and the Airport Health Organisation, with advisories posted at airports such as Delhi for early identification of exposed travellers. Symptoms to report include fever, weakness, headache, muscle pain, vomiting/diarrhoea, sore throat, and unexplained bleeding; travellers with direct contact with blood or body fluids of a suspected/confirmed patient must inform officers. Any symptoms within 21 days of arrival should seek medical care and disclose travel history. SOPs cover pre/post-arrival screening, quarantine, case management, lab testing; coordination across ministries; WHO has declared Ebola a Public Health Emergency of International Concern.

triage.headline_ja: インド、アフリカの高リスク国からの乗客に対するエボラ警告を発令
triage.triage_reason: WHOがエボラを国際的懸念事項の公衆衛生上の緊急事態と宣言し、複数アフリカ諸国で発生、インドが国境検疫強化措置を実施。IHR基準3項目（深刻な影響・予想外・国際拡大リスク）に該当し、WPRO基準も複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はインドが複数アフリカ諸国（DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン）からのエボラリスク地域からの乗客に対する警告を発令した内容。インドではまだ症例検出なし。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に追加。ウガンダ・スーダンは対象国外のため除外。WHO PHEIC宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: مسئول أممي: تخصيص 60 مليون دولار لمواجهة إيبولا في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UN official: $60 million allocated to combat Ebola in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: UN official allocates $60 million to combat Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The funding aims to accelerate relief operations and support humanitarian and health responses to the Ebola outbreak in the DRC, according to a breaking news report on Cairo News Channel. The money will bolster urgent interventions and improve field response efficiency amid the health and humanitarian challenges posed by the virus. The announcement underscores ongoing efforts to control transmission, reinforce medical services, and coordinate outbreak containment measures in affected regions. No new case counts or laboratory confirmation details are provided in the report. The allocation reflects continued international attention and resources dedicated to Ebola control in the DRC as of May 22, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 国連関係者：コンゴでのエボラ対策に6000万ドル配分
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症は極めて高い致死率を持つ疾患であり、IHR基準（異常性・国際的拡大リスク）に該当。DRCでの発生と国際的資金配分により、公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められシグナルとして識別される。
