triage.notes: Bluedot APIが提供した発生地域にはCairo（エジプト）が含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRC（コンゴ民主共和国）でのエボラ対策資金配分である。エジプトは報道元の地理的情報に過ぎず、実際のエボラ発生地はDRCのみであるため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを列挙。2026年5月時点での記事であり、具体的な症例数や確認情報は示されていないが、国連による6000万ドルの資金配分という国際的対応が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo: Angry relatives of deceased patient set medical centre on fire after demanding traditional burial, WHO declares International Concern
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ituri province driven by Bundibugyo strain; around 600 suspected cases and about 130 deaths across the country, with Mongbwalu, Rwampara, and Bunia worst affected; and cross-border transmission into Uganda. The Bundibugyo strain has no established treatment or vaccine, with a fatality rate of 25-30%. On May 21, 2026, relatives of a deceased patient attacked Ebola treatment tents at Rwampara General Hospital while demanding a traditional burial; six patients were evacuated and ALIMA tents were destroyed as police fired warning shots. Transmission occurs via contact with bodily fluids; traditional burials can fuel new outbreaks. The region is under military rule since 2021 and lacks civilian government; authorities urge cooperation, counter misinformation, and strict adherence to isolation and quarantine measures to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行：故人の親族が伝統的埋葬を要求して医療センターに放火、WHOが国際的懸念を宣言
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：600疑似患者・130死亡、Bundibugyo株は新規・ワクチンなし、ウガンダへの越境伝播、国際的懸念宣言）。WPRO基準も全て該当。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株によるエボラ流行、致死率25-30%、治療法・ワクチンなし。ウガンダへの越境伝播あり。医療施設への攻撃による患者エスケープ、伝統埋葬による二次感染リスク高い。軍事統治下で民間政府機能不全。WHOが既に国際的懸念を宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: Alarm in Africa: Ebola outbreak hundreds of kilometers away from the hotspot
article.articleSummary: As of May 22, 2026, an Ebola outbreak is affecting eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). A 28-year-old man from a rural area near Bukavu died after suspected infection; he had traveled from Kisangani. South Kivu authorities report two suspected cases, including the deceased, with the second awaiting test results. The DRC Ministry of Health records 670 suspected cases, 61 confirmed infections, and 160 deaths. In neighboring Uganda, two confirmed Ebola cases have been identified, and Uganda plans to suspend flights to Congo within 48 hours. The African Union postponed the India-Africa Forum Summit in New Delhi (May 28–31) due to the worsening health situation. The WHO has declared the Bundibugyo strain outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, noting no vaccine exists for this strain. The 2018–2020 Congo outbreak killed about 2,300 and saw hundreds of attacks on health facilities.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカの警告：エボラ感染症の流行が震源地から数百キロ離れた場所で発生
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WHO PHEIC宣言、複数国への感染拡大、国際的なイベント延期など、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: DRCが主要な流行地（670疑い例、61確認例、160死亡）。ウガンダでも確認例あり。インドのニューデリーは国際フォーラムの延期舞台であり、航空接続を通じた拡大リスク存在。WHO PHEIC宣言済み、Bundibugyo株、ワクチン非存在。

article.articleHeadline: UN Agencies Increase Ebola Response in DR Congo and Uganda * Okay News
article.articleSummary: On May 22, 2026, UN agencies escalated Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri; North Kivu with Goma, Butembo, Katwa; Bukavu in South Kivu) and Uganda. The Bundibugyo strain, a rare variant, drives the current outbreak, with about 139 deaths and roughly 600 suspected cases in DR Congo; Uganda has two confirmed cases. MONUSCO provided four light vehicles and a helicopter to surge operations; two ambulances and two armoured vehicles are en route from Goma to Bunia for medical evacuations coordinated by the WHO. WFP is funding and facilitating transport for aid workers and food aid, citing needs of over 214 million dollars for operations, including more than 10 million dollars for Ebola. UNICEF mobilized nearly 50 tonnes of supplies and is sending an Emergency Rapid Response team to Bunia. DR Congo has faced Ebola 17 times in 50 years.

triage.headline_ja: UN機関がコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでのエボラ対応を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。Bundibugyo株による稀な変異株による流行で、DRC約600疑い例・139死亡、ウガンダ2確認例。国際的拡大リスク高く、UN機関による大規模対応が展開中。
triage.notes: 記事ではウガンダ（WPRO域内）での2確認例が報告されているが、ウガンダはGeoNames対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCのみ対象国該当。エボラ出血熱のBundibugyo株は稀な変異株であり、過去50年間で17回の流行歴を持つDRCにおいて国際的対応が実施されている点が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Три сотни россиян оказались в зоне риска заражения лихорадкой Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three hundred Russians are at risk of contracting Ebola.
article.articleSummary: About 300 Russians in Kenya and Tanzania are at risk of Ebola amid outbreaks in neighboring Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. Ebola spreads through close contact with infected individuals or their bodily fluids, and fruit bats are natural reservoirs; fruit contaminated with bat residues has been cited as a transmission possibility. In the DRC, more than 500 cases have been reported with around 130 deaths; Uganda has two confirmed cases, one fatal. The report notes that importation of Ebola into Russia is theoretically possible but has very low probability, and health authorities typically respond swiftly to such threats. Kenya and Tanzania border DR Congo and Uganda, where Ebola is active.

triage.headline_ja: 300人以上のロシア国民がエボラ出血熱感染のリスク地域にいる
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認事例と相応の死亡者数、国際的な拡大リスク（隣接国への感染）、旅行制限の可能性を考慮し、IHR基準2項目以上該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数項目該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC、ウガンダでのエボラ流行を主に言及。ケニア・タンザニアは「リスク地域」として記載されているが、確認された発症地ではない。対象国リスト内ではDRCのみ確認。ロシアは対象国外。アフリカ地域でのエボラ流行による感染リスク増加は重要なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Tulpina rară de Ebola se răspândește. Iată de ce este atât de greu de ținut sub control
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The rare Ebola strain is spreading. Here's why it's so hard to contain.
article.articleSummary: WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern over a Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. As of May 20, 139 deaths and about 600 suspected cases, with 51 laboratory-confirmed in Ituri province in NE DR Congo; Uganda has two confirmed cases. The Bundibugyo strain is rare and poorly studied; no vaccine or specific treatment is approved for it. Early symptoms resemble severe flu; diagnosis can be delayed and misattributed to malaria or typhoid in settings with limited testing. Transmission requires close contact with the bodily fluids of an infected person or deceased, and traditional funeral rites contribute to spread. Ervebo (Zaire Ebola vaccine) may offer some protection, but data are limited; experimental vaccines are under consideration but require trials. Overall pandemic risk deemed low, but global health systems' fragility is highlighted.

triage.headline_ja: 稀なエボラ株が拡散している。ここにそれが制御するのが非常に難しい理由がある。
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言した稀なBundibugyo Ebolaアウトブレイク。
triage.notes: Uganda（ウガンダ）は対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsから除外。記事サマリー上でDRC（Ituri州）が主要な発生地で、確認症例139死亡・600疑い患者が記載される。WHOのPHEIC宣言済み。ワクチン・治療法の限定的な可用性、診断の遅延リスク（マラリア・腸チフスとの誤診）、葬儀風習による拡大が言及されており、管理可能性の懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: В Конго жители подожгли медицинский центр по борьбе с лихорадкой Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, residents set fire to a medical center fighting Ebola.
article.articleSummary: In eastern Congo's Ituri province, where a new Ebola strain has emerged, residents of Rwamparé set fire to a clinic treating patients after authorities barred them from taking a relative's body amid burial-rule clashes. Locals reportedly distrust medical staff and doubt the virus's existence, calling for greater transparency and community involvement in outbreak response. Since the outbreak's start, Congo's authorities report at least 160 deaths and 671 suspected cases across two provinces; the UN notes one death and one infection in neighboring Uganda. Experts stress sanitation, vaccination programs, and targeted support for vulnerable groups as essential measures, with community engagement key to stopping transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱対策の医療センターが住民により放火される
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の新規株による発生で死亡171例（Congo 160例＋Uganda 1例）、疑い例671例以上が報告されており、IHR基準の「深刻な公衆衛生影響」「国際的拡大（ウガンダに波及）」「予想外性」に該当。コミュニティ不信による対策阻害が重大なリスク。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国外のため verified_locations に含めていません。イツリ州での新規株出現、コミュニティによる医療施設放火、患者遺体の埋葬規則を巡る紛争など、対策への住民不信が深刻。160+死亡、671+疑い例という報告数字は極めて懸念される規模。ワクチン接種とコミュニティ・エンゲージメント強化が急務として言及されている。

article.articleHeadline: Οι αρουραίοι που εκτίθενται σε φάρμακα αποκαλύπτουν τον επόμενο ζωντανό κίνδυνο στις πόλεις " OnCamera.gr
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rats exposed to drugs reveal the next real danger in the cities — OnCamera.gr
article.articleSummary: Urban rats in Salvador, Brazil, were studied to assess environmental exposure to human medicines. Researchers captured Rattus rattus and Rattus norvegicus from seven impoverished neighborhoods and screened for 97 active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) via liquid chromatography–mass spectrometry. They detected APIs including antibiotics, antipsychotics, and antidepressants in rat tissues. The study also identified pathogens such as Leptospira spp., Toxoplasma gondii, Angiostrongylus spp., and Capillaria spp., suggesting a link between pharmaceutical residues and increased zoonotic infection risk. Sub-therapeutic, chronic API exposure can alter physiology, behavior, and microbiomes, potentially shaping disease dynamics in urban wildlife and spillover to humans. About 60% of human infections are zoonotic, with low-income communities most affected; projections forewarn rapid urban population growth in these areas by 2050. The study is published in Environmental Science & Technology Letters.

triage.headline_ja: 医薬品に曝露されたラットが都市における次の現実的な危険性を明かす
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル（サルバドル）の都市ラットから人獣共通感染症病原体（レプトスピラ、トキソプラズマ、アニサキス類）が検出されており、医薬品曝露との関連性が指摘されている。ただし、現在の人間への具体的な感染事例報告がなく、病原体検出は動物調査ベースのため、情報が確定的でない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル（サルバドル）の低所得地域における都市ラットの医薬品汚染と人獣共通感染症リスクに焦点を当てている。レプトスピラ症、トキソプラズマ症、アニジストロンギル症の病原体がラット組織で検出されているが、これは現在の人間の症例報告ではなく、環境疫学的な危険信号である。El Salvadorは記事タイトル翻訳では言及されておらず、Bluedotが付与した発生地域として記載されているが、サマリー本文ではブラジル（サルバドル）のみが主題であるため、verified_locationsはBrazilのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: ВИДЕО | Разгневена толпа запали болнички центар за ебола во Конго - Слободен печат
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Video | Angry mob set fire to an Ebola hospital in Congo - Sloboden Pecat
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri province, near Bunia) triggers violent protests as distrust in authorities grows; angry locals burn part of the Rwampara General Hospital after family and friends of a young man believed to have died from Ebola were prevented from taking his body for burial. The body is described as highly infectious, prompting authorities to ensure a safe burial and to limit further spread. Health workers at Rwampara Hospital are placed under military protection while police disperse the crowd; one health worker was injured by stones. Local officials report increasing skepticism about the disease, with some residents viewing Ebola as a foreign hoax. The World Health Organization stresses the need for safe burials due to contagious bodies. In DRC, the outbreak has caused over 130 deaths, with cases also reported in Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: ビデオ | 怒った群衆がコンゴのエボラ病院に火をつけた - スロボデン・ペチャット
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行でIHR基準3つ該当（深刻な影響：130死亡、異常性：社会不安・病院放火、国際拡大：ウガンダへの波及）。WPRO基準複数該当（重症度、流行可能性、管理可能性）。社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダは発生地域フィールドに含まれているが、記事サマリーでは「ウガンダでも症例報告」との記述のみで、ウガンダが主要な発生地域ではないため verified_locations から除外。コンゴでの社会不安（病院放火、当局への不信）と医療対応の複雑さが管理可能性を低下させている。

article.articleHeadline: Около 300 россиян находятся в зоне риска заражения Эболой в Африке
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: About 300 Russians are at risk of contracting Ebola in Africa.
article.articleSummary: About 300 Russians are at risk of contracting Ebola in Africa. Tourists vacationing on Kenya and Tanzania resorts are in areas with elevated epidemiological risk due to proximity to the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, where Ebola outbreaks have been reported. Virologist Alexander Buteyko explained that the virus chiefly spreads through close contact with infected people, animals, or their bodily materials, but an indirect route via bananas carrying bat residues is possible. In the DRC, more than 500 cases and over 130 deaths have been recorded; Uganda has two officially confirmed cases, one of which was fatal. In response, Kenya and Tanzania have intensified border and airport screening. The World Health Organization has warned about the fast spread of Ebola and declared a public health emergency of international concern.

triage.headline_ja: 約300人のロシア人がアフリカでのエボラ感染リスクにさらされている
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの国際的流行であり、IHR基準4項目全て該当。WHOが国際的懸念事項である公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言し、複数国での確認例と死亡例がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、DRC、ウガンダ、ケニア、タンザニアに実際のエボラ発生が確認されている。対象国リストにはDRC（203312）のみが含まれるため、verified_locationsにはDRCを優先的に含める。ケニア・タンザニアはサマリーで「観光リゾート」「高いリスク」と記載されているが、確認例は主にDRCとウガンダで報告されている。ただし、記事は4カ国全てでの現在の懸念を述べているため、全て検証済み位置として記載。対象国リスト外のケニア・タンザニア・ウガンダについても、IHR通知対象の流行であるため、フルRRA実施時には含める必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: El brote del virus del Ébola en el Congo sigue avanzando: con "160 muertes sospechosas" y "671 posibles casos"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola virus outbreak in the Congo continues to advance: with "160 suspected deaths" and "671 possible cases"
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) continues to advance. Since its declaration a week ago, the health ministry reports 160 suspected deaths and 671 possible cases, with 64 laboratory-confirmed infections and 160 recoveries, all in Ituri and North Kivu. The Bundibugyo strain—no licensed vaccine or specific treatment—likely began circulating in Ituri about two months ago and has spread to South Kivu. Uganda has confirmed two cases in Kampala; South Sudan is testing a suspected case. The World Health Organization has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, though global risk is considered low. Rwanda has closed borders; Africa CDC and WHO are mobilizing resources. This is the 17th outbreak in the DRC since 1976, with mortality historically ranging from 25% to 90%. Transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids, causing fever, hemorrhagic symptoms, vomiting, diarrhea, and bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラウイルス感染拡大が続く：「疑い死亡160例」「可能性のある症例671例」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の発生であり、複数国への越境（ウガンダ、南スーダンで確認または検査中）、死亡および重症例を伴い、WHO PHEICが宣言されている国際的に重大な公衆衛生上の脅威。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域フィールドにはウガンダ、ルワンダ、南スーダンが含まれているが、記事サマリーではこれらは接触国または隣接国として記載されており、実際の主要発生地はDRCである。ウガンダでの確認例（Kampala 2例）は越境拡大の証拠であるが、本流行の中心地はDRCのイトゥリ州およびキヴ州北部。南スーダンは検査中の疑い例のみで確定していない。WHO PHEICが宣言されており、RRA段階への進行が緊急に必要。

article.articleHeadline: Bộ Y tế cảnh báo 4 dấu hiệu bất thường của dịch Ebola, chủ động ngăn chặn xâm nhập
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health warns four abnormal signs of the Ebola outbreak, proactively preventing its entry.
article.articleSummary: Four abnormal signs mark the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak: community death clusters with Ebola-like symptoms; four healthcare workers dead from suspected infection, signaling possible nosocomial transmission; uncertainty about true infection numbers and transmission links; a high positivity rate (8 of 13 tested samples) across multiple regions, suggesting wider-than-reported spread; and cross-border transmission to neighboring countries. WHO flags the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri) and Uganda as complex, with May 17 declaring it a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Since 1976, Ebola outbreaks have affected 13 African countries; this is the 17th Congo outbreak. In Ituri, by May 16: 8 lab-confirmed, 246 suspected, 80 suspected deaths; by May 18, 516 suspected cases and 131 suspected deaths. In Uganda, by May 16: 2 cases and 1 death, linked to Congo. Vietnam reports no cases as of May 21; risk locally high but globally low; enhanced border screening and surveillance; two national institutes with BSL-3 capable of sequencing and RT-PCR; diagnostic reagents expected in 7–10 days. Vaccines/therapies exist only for the Ebola virus strain, not Bundibugyo.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省がエボラアウトブレイクの4つの異常な兆候に警告、侵入の能動的な防止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。ブンディブギョエボラアウトブレイクはWHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言しており、複数国での確認、院内感染の可能性、国境を越えた感染拡大が報告されている。
triage.notes: 発生地域にウガンダ（ID: 226074）が含まれているが、サマリーではウガンダは「コンゴとの関連で2症例1死亡」として言及されており、主要な発生地はDRC（Ituri）である。ベトナムはウイルスの侵入防止措置を講じており、警告・監視段階の国として verified_locations に含めた。WHO PHEIC宣言（2026年5月17日）により国際的な関心が最高度に達している。

article.articleHeadline: Serum Institute joins race for Bundibugyo Ebola vaccine as outbreak widens
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda has 575 suspected cases, 51 confirmed infections, and 148 suspected deaths, with Kampala raising cross-border transmission concerns. WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern; Africa CDC calls it a Public Health Emergency of Continental Security. No licensed vaccine exists for Bundibugyo virus disease. Serum Institute of India (SII) joins the race to develop an experimental ChAdOx-based vaccine with the University of Oxford and CEPI; a second rVSV-based candidate is under consideration, with neither yet in clinical trials and no doses for testing. SII cites a 20–30 day window to begin producing doses once seed material is available; the ChAdOx route could move faster due to existing manufacturing, but there are no efficacy data for Bundibugyo yet. Gavi’s stockpile (~500,000 Ervebo doses) exists, but cross-protection remains uncertain; global bodies coordinate accelerated evaluation for potential emergency use.

triage.headline_ja: Bundibugyo Ebola vaccine開発競争にSerum Instituteが参加、流行が拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の流行拡大、国際的拡大リスク、国際渡航制限リスク）。WHO/Africa CDCが公式宣言。対象国DRC・Ugandaで発生。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC・Ugandaでの流行を述べているが、対象国リストはDRCのみ含む。インドはSerum Instituteの本拠地として言及されているが、イベント発生地ではないため除外。WHO PHEIC宣言済み。Bundibugyo Ebolavirus（Sudan ebolavirus系統）は致死率が高く、ワクチン候補が開発段階であることが特徴。

article.articleHeadline: Küresel salgın riskine karşı DSÖ alarmda: "Grip ile karışabilir"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO on high alert over global pandemic risk: "Could be mistaken for influenza."
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreaks have resurfaced in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, triggering global concern and a WHO alert. Infectious Diseases and Clinical Microbiology Specialist Dr. Müberra Hraloğlu says hundreds of infections are suspected and many countries have strengthened border controls. Ebola, caused by viruses in the Ebolavirus genus, spreads mainly through direct contact with blood, vomit, feces, and other bodily fluids of infected people, and via contaminated clothing, bedding, needles, and medical equipment. The incubation period is 2–21 days. Early symptoms resemble flu-like illness—fever, malaise, muscle aches, and sore throat—progressing to vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, rash, organ dysfunction, and sometimes internal or external bleeding. Fatality rates range from 25% to 90% depending on virus type and healthcare access, averaging about 50%. Travelers to high-risk areas should maintain strict hygiene and avoid contact with patients and wild animals; early diagnosis, isolation, and supportive care are critical.

triage.headline_ja: WHO高度警戒中：グローバルパンデミックリスク対策「インフルエンザと間違える可能性」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラウイルス病の再発生は予想外で、WHOが高度警戒中であり、複数国が国境管理を強化している。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の再発生が報告され、WHOが国際的警戒を発令している。記事は感染経路、潜伏期間（2-21日）、症状（初期はインフルエンザ様）、致死率（25-90%）について詳述。複数国による国境管理強化が確認されており、国際的拡大リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: 苗栗爆麻疹境外移入！確診女曾赴頭份 匡列112人監測 - 自由健康網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles Imported from Abroad in Miaoli! Confirmed Female Patient Had Been to Toufen; 112 People Placed Under Monitoring - Liberty Health Net.
article.articleSummary: Measles, imported from abroad, confirmed in Miaoli County, Taiwan: a foreign national woman in her 30s who entered on May 12 from Thailand developed fever on May 15 and a rash on May 17; laboratory confirmation was reported May 21 by the Taiwan CDC. She had dined at a Toufen City restaurant on May 13 from 6:00 to 8:00 pm. The Miaoli County Health Bureau identified 112 contacts—household members, lodging/food-service workers, and medical staff—and placed them under health monitoring through June 8, with exposed individuals advised to self-monitor through June 3. Measles spreads via airborne, droplet, and contact with infectious secretions; contagiousness extends from four days before to four days after rash onset. Guidance emphasizes masking for contacts, avoiding crowded places, and limiting exposure to infants under one year, unimmunized children, pregnant or immunocompromised individuals; seek medical care if fever, rash, cough, or conjunctivitis develops.

triage.headline_ja: 苗栗爆麻疹境外移入！確診女曾赴頭份 匡列112人監測
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。境外移入による麻疹確定患者、接触者監視体制の確立、対象地域との近隣国タイでの感染リンク。
triage.notes: 台湾での麻疹確定患者（タイからの境外移入）。タイが対象国リストに含まれるため検証ロケーションに含める。台湾は対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。麻疹は空気感染・飛沫感染で高い伝播性を持ち、112人の接触者が監視下に置かれている。感染源がタイであり、国際的な拡大リスク有。

article.articleHeadline: Bộ Y tế họp bàn triển khai các biện pháp ứng phó dịch Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health holds a meeting to discuss and implement Ebola outbreak response measures.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is active in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri and North Kivu) and Uganda, caused by Bundibugyo. On 5 May four Ituri health workers died; by 16 May eight lab-confirmed, 246 suspected, and 80 deaths suspected in Ituri. By 18 May, 516 suspected cases and 131 deaths were reported in Ituri and North Kivu. Uganda confirmed two imported Congo cases, including an elderly man who died on 14 May and a second imported case on 16 May. WHO flags high regional risk but low global risk, including Vietnam, which has no cases. Vietnam’s MOH held online briefings to boost surveillance, border screening, and rapid response; laboratories in Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City can perform Real-time PCR and sequencing; diagnostic kits are being procured and staff trained. Transmission is wildlife-to-human and direct contact with blood or fluids; incubation 2–21 days. No vaccine or specific treatment exists for Sudan and Bundibugyo strains.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省がエボラ感染症の対応措置の展開について協議・検討する会議を開催
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）し、進行中のエボラ出血熱集団発生の地域的拡大と複数国での確認、及び多くの死亡が報告されている。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、実際の発生地はDRC（Ituri及びNorth Kivu地域）とウガンダであり、ベトナムは監視・準備体制を強化中で現在症例なし。Bluedot APIが付与した「発生地域」にはウガンダが含まれるが、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。DRCはAnnex2基準4項目全て該当し、地域的な拡大と複数国確認によるリスク増加が明確。

article.articleHeadline: 131 người tử vong do vi rút Ebola tại Congo, Bộ Y tế đánh giá nguy cơ ra sao?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 131 people have died from the Ebola virus in Congo; how does the Ministry of Health assess the risk?
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri and North Kivu) and Uganda shows rising activity. By 5 May 2026, four health workers in Ituri died from Bundibugyo Ebola virus; by 16 May, 8 laboratory-confirmed cases, 246 suspected cases, and 80 deaths among suspected cases were reported in Ituri. By 18 May, 516 suspected cases were recorded, with 131 deaths in Ituri and North Kivu. Uganda confirmed one imported case from DRC and reported an elderly man’s death on 14 May, with another imported case confirmed on 16 May. WHO assesses high risk of regional spread, but low global risk (including Vietnam), though vigilance is required. Vietnam has no cases; risk remains due to travel from affected areas. The current outbreak is linked to Bundibugyo; there is no vaccine or specific therapy for Sudan and Bundibugyo strains, while some Ebola strains have targeted countermeasures. Transmission involves wildlife-to-human spillover (bats, porcupines, primates) and human-to-human contact with blood/fluids; incubation is 2–21 days. Border screening and rapid-response readiness are advised.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラウイルスにより131人が死亡、保健省はリスクをどう評価しているか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラアウトブレイク（死亡131人、確定患者8人、疑い患者516人）は深刻な公衆衛生上の影響を示し、地域内での拡大が進行中（ウガンダへの越境感染確認）であり、国際的な懸念も高まっている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは明確にDRC（イトゥリとカサイ地域）でのエボラアウトブレイク（Bundibugyo strain）を主題としている。ウガンダへの越境感染も記載されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。Bluedot APIがVietnamを発生地域に含めているのは誤りで、サマリーでベトナムは「症例なし、旅行関連のリスクのみ」と明記されているため除外。WHOが高リスク（地域）・低リスク（グローバル）と評価しているが、DRCでの現在進行中のアウトブレイク、複数死亡、越境感染の確認により、フルRRA対象。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: How it spreads, the treatments available and why this outbreak is so devastating - Medicine Hat News
article.articleSummary: As of May 22, 2026, a rare Ebola strain is spreading in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. An image from Bunia, Congo, dated May 21, 2026, shows a mourner at General Hospital in Bunia. The article notes there are several Ebola strains; the most common are the Ebola virus (Zaire strain) and the Sudan virus, according to Dr. Isaac Bogoch, an infectious-disease specialist. The piece emphasizes the outbreak’s severity and advises Canadians on what they need to know. Ongoing transmission is reported in the DRC and neighboring Uganda, with attention to the human toll in affected areas. The excerpt does not provide specific case or death counts.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：感染方法、利用可能な治療法、そしてこの流行がなぜこれほど壊滅的なのか - Medicine Hat News
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルスは公衆衛生上最高レベルの脅威であり、DRC・ウガンダでの現在進行中の二国間流行、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性があることから、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、DRCとウガンダでの流行を言及していますが、対象国リスト内ではDRC（ID:203312）のみが該当します。Canadaの記載は記事がカナディアン向けメディア（Medicine Hat News）であるための地理的参照であり、エボラウイルスの実際の発生地ではないため除外します。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外します。

article.articleHeadline: Congo, non restituiscono il corpo di una vittima dell'Ebola: i parenti incendiano l'ospedale da campo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo, they do not return the body of an Ebola victim: relatives set fire to the field hospital.
article.articleSummary: In eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, a field hospital treating Ebola patients was set on fire by relatives of a deceased patient after medical staff refused to hand over the body, citing that it is highly contagious and requires special burial protocols. The Rwampara-area facility was attacked with stones and torched amid the protests. Relatives demanded the body, triggering the confrontation and the arson. During the clashes, a humanitarian aid worker was injured. The incident highlights tensions around infection-control measures and safe burial practices during Ebola outbreaks in the region, and raises concerns about the safety of frontline responders and the continuity of care and outbreak response in eastern DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：エボラ患者の遺体返却を拒否、親族が野戦病院に放火
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で公衆衛生への深刻な影響（死亡例、医療施設への攻撃）と異常性が確認でき2つ該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも異常性、重症度、流行リスク、管理可能性が複数該当。DRC東部でのエボラ発生・対応阻害は国際的な懸念事項となり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは東部DRCでのエボラ対応中の医療施設攻撃事件を主題としており、ルワンダはKigali Provinceが地理的に隣接しているが、事件発生地はDRCのRwampara地域と明記。ルワンダは発生地域リストに含まれるが、記事サマリー上での主題はDRCであるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみを列挙。親族による施設攻撃とそれに伴う援助職員負傷は、エボラ対応の阻害と二次的な安全リスクを示す。

article.articleHeadline: Число жертв Эболы в Конго выросло до ста шестидесяти
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola death toll in Congo has risen to 160.
article.articleSummary: 160 deaths and 671 suspected Ebola cases have been reported in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with the outbreak centered in Ituri Province; initial signals appeared on May 5. Uganda has suspended all direct air travel to the DRC as the situation worsens. The World Health Organization has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern for both the DRC and Uganda, signaling international significance. The figures reflect ongoing transmission and cross-border implications, with authorities continuing surveillance in the wake of the May 5 signals. The outbreak is ongoing, with fatalities and suspected cases rising as cross-border concerns draw international attention.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ死亡者数が160人に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病による死亡者数の増加、国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言、国境を超えた感染リスク、および国際的な対応が必要な状況であり、フルRRAが必須。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaが含まれているが、記事サマリーにおいてUgandaでの実際の症例発生は明記されておらず、空路停止などの予防的措置のみ記載されているため verified_locations には DRC のみを含める。WHO による国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言（PHEIC）が発出されており、国際的な対応が既に開始されている。

article.articleHeadline: В ДР Конго протестующие подожгли центр лечения пациентов с Эболой
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, protesters set fire to an Ebola treatment center.
article.articleSummary: In eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, protesters set fire to an Ebola treatment center at Rwampara Hospital in Ituri Province after medical staff refused to hand over the body of a deceased patient to relatives. Relatives, who had tried to seize the body by force, attacked the camp, burning two medical tents; six patients were inside the facility at the time. The Ebola outbreak in DRC continues, with authorities reporting at least 160 suspected deaths as of May 22, 2026. On May 17, 2026, the World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern for the outbreak in the DRC and Uganda, though officials noted it does not meet the criteria for a pandemic.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ患者治療センターが抗議者に放火される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WHOが公衆衛生上の国際的に懸念される事態を宣言済み。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでウガンダが言及されているが、実際のイベント発生地はDRC（イトゥリ州ルワンパラ病院）のみ。ウガンダはWHOの公衆衛生上の国際的に懸念される事態の宣言に含まれているが、本イベントの主発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。2026年5月17日、WHOがDRCとウガンダのエボラ発生に関してPHEIC（公衆衛生上の国際的に懸念される事態）を宣言。医療施設への暴力により治療活動が阻害され、管理可能性が著しく低下している。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: How it spreads, the treatments available and why this outbreak is so devastating
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus drives an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. Unlike Zaire Ebola, there are no therapeutics or vaccines proven for Bundibugyo; vaccines for Zaire exist but are not licensed or tested for Bundibugyo. Symptoms begin like other Ebola strains—with fever, fatigue, muscle pain, headache and sore throat, potentially progressing to vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, rash and kidney/liver dysfunction; bleeding is less common and late. Incubation is 2–21 days, and people are contagious only after symptoms start. Transmission is via contact with bodily fluids, with high risk to family caregivers, health workers without proper PPE, and during burial rites. Diagnosis requires laboratory confirmation; monoclonal antibodies help Zaire infections but not Bundibugyo, so supportive care is essential. Canada has no Ebola cases; Ontario is testing a traveler, with samples to the National Microbiology Laboratory in Winnipeg. GAVI notes no licensed Bundibugyo vaccines; trials may begin in months.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：感染経路、利用可能な治療法、そしてこのアウトブレイクが破滅的である理由
triage.triage_reason: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（エボラの一種）がDRCおよびウガンダで流行中であり、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する可能性が高い。利用可能な治療法やワクチンがない未知の脅威であり、国際的な関心が急速に高まっている。
triage.notes: 記事はカナダのウィニペグで公開されており、カナダでの検査例（Ontario州の旅行者）が言及されているが、実際の流行はDRCとウガンダで発生している。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株は、既存のZaire Ebola用ワクチンや治療法が有効でない可能性があるため、特に懸念される。国際的な拡大リスクと保健体制への負荷が明らかである。対象国リストにはUgandaが含まれていないため、検証対象国はDRCのみだが、公開情報からはUgandaでも確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: Подожгли медцентр после отказа отдать тело зараженного: из лечебницы в ДР Конго сбежали шесть пациентов с Эболой
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: They set fire to a medical center after refusing to hand over the body of the infected person: six Ebola patients escaped from a hospital in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: Six Ebola patients escaped from a medical center in Rwampara, Democratic Republic of the Congo, after locals set the facility on fire. The NGO-run center operated by ALIMA housed six patients at the time; three had laboratory-confirmed Ebola, while three were awaiting results. The incident followed the death of a terminal-stage Ebola patient, whose relatives demanded the body for burial despite infection risk. The blaze forced the patients to flee and prompted authorities to launch searches and enhanced surveillance to prevent further transmission. The situation is being monitored by regional epidemiological services as of 22 May 2026, with authorities conducting active risk assessment.

triage.headline_ja: 医療センターが火をつけられた後、感染者の遺体の引き渡しを拒否：コンゴ民主共和国の病院からエボラ患者6人が逃げた
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症の確定患者3人を含む患者6人の医療施設からの逃亡という極めて異常で予期しない事象であり、IHR基準で「異常性」および「公衆衛生への影響」が明確に該当し、感染のヒト-ヒト拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: エボラ患者の逃亡、医療施設の焼失、地域住民の感染リスク認識の欠如、捜索・監視強化中というスケーラビリティの高い危機状況。DRC当局が積極的なリスク評価を実施中であり、域内疫学サービスにより監視されている。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : " C'est un peu un cocktail fatal "
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: "It's a bit of a deadly cocktail."
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is driven by the rare Bundibugyo strain, with Mongbwalu—an active mining town and highly mobile population—as the epicenter, raising cross-border risk to Uganda and South Sudan. Initial testing showed a 65% positivity rate, indicating uncontrolled transmission and unlinked chains across kilometers. Nine days were lost between testing for the Zaire strain on May 9 and confirmation of Bundibugyo at Kinshasa on May 14. There is no approved treatment or vaccine for Bundibugyo; the 2018–2019 outbreak reached 3,470 cases and 2,887 deaths, despite monoclonal antibodies and vaccines. Key measures remain rapid patient care, isolation, contact tracing, safe burials, and population education. Displacement from armed groups hinders access to care, and the WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern within two days of confirmation. This is the eighth PHEIC in WHO history; Canada’s risk is extremely low.

triage.headline_ja: DRCのエボラ：「それは致命的なカクテルのようなものだ」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラ出血熱の希少なBundibugyo株による多国間リスク、WHOによるPHEIC宣言、高い伝播率（65%陽性）、および治療法・ワクチンの欠如により、直ちにフルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株はエボラウイルスの希少株であり、Kinshasa確認までの9日間の遅延、採鉱町Mongbwaluにおける高い移動性人口、武装勢力による避難民化による治療アクセス障害など、複数の懸念要因が存在。WHOはPHEIC宣言（歴史上8番目）を実施済み。ウガンダ・南スーダンへの越境リスクが明記されているが、これら国の確認情報は記事に明示されないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: Ex-CDC Chief Warns Ebola Outbreak Could Become 'Very Significant Pandemic'
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-22, Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and neighboring Uganda are described as potentially escalating into a 'very significant pandemic' by former CDC director Robert Redfield, who warned it could spill into Tanzania, South Sudan, and Rwanda. The outbreak has more than 500 suspected cases and nearly 150 deaths, with rapid spread noted. WHO has declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern, though not yet a pandemic on the scale of COVID-19. The United States reports no Ebola cases; public risk remains low. The CDC has stepped up public health screening and traveler monitoring for arrivals from the DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan, and barred entry for non-U.S. passport holders who have been in Uganda, DRC, or South Sudan within the previous 21 days. Redfield argued early detection was delayed, as this outbreak wasn't recognized until after surpassing 100 cases.

triage.headline_ja: 前CDC長官、エボラ感染症の流行が「極めて重大なパンデミック」に発展する可能性を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5つすべてに該当。複数国での急速な感染拡大、高い死亡率、国際的な渡航制限実施、WHO緊急事態宣言済み。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドにはRwanda、Tanzania、Uganda、Sudanが含まれているが、記事サマリーで具体的なイベント発生の主要舞台は『DRCおよび隣接するウガンダ』と明記されている。タンザニア、南スーダン、ルワンダは『スピルオーバーの可能性がある地域』として言及されているが、現在のアクティブな発症は主にDRCと確認。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。WHO緊急事態宣言済み、CDC渡航制限実施、500+疑似症例、150近い死亡報告あり、高い流行ポテンシャル。

article.articleHeadline: Levering ebola-noodpakketten
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Delivery of Ebola emergency relief packages.
article.articleSummary: As of May 22, 2026, twelve tons of medical supplies and more than forty health workers arrived at the epicenter of the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo near the Uganda border. From there, the rare Bundibugyo variant is spreading, a strain not seen in humans for about a decade. The World Health Organization says the virus is spreading faster than expected. About 136 people have likely died. Alarmingly, the outbreak has reached Kinshasa, the capital, roughly 1,000 kilometers away. The report highlights delivery of emergency relief and deployment of frontline responders to support patient care and outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱緊急支援物資の配送
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。Bundibugyo株の予想外の出現、国際的な懸念（ウガンダとの国境付近）、死亡事例多数、WHOが拡大の警告を発出。エボラ出血熱は重篤な感染症危機。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにより、発生地はDRC東部（ウガンダ国境付近）およびDRCの首都キンシャサと明記されている。ウガンダは言及されているが、サマリー上でウガンダでの発生確認は述べられていないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含める。Bundibugyo株は約10年間ヒトでは見られていない稀な亜種で、WHO発表の予想外の拡大速度が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo moves World Cup training camp amid Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern DR Congo prompts public health action as DR Congo prepares for the 2026 FIFA World Cup. The outbreak, centered in Ituri and North Kivu with possible spread to South Kivu, has reportedly killed more than 130 people, with investigations ongoing. The WHO classed the event as a public health emergency of international concern; no approved vaccine exists for the Bundibugyo strain, and officials warned it could be months before a vaccine is available. In response to travel restrictions and safety concerns, the Leopards cancelled a public training session in Kinshasa planned for 26 May and shifted pre-tournament camp to Belgium, with friendlies against Denmark and Chile in Europe ahead of the World Cup opener vs Portugal in Houston on 17 June. Visa services at the US embassy were paused; reports of possible spread to South Kivu and access challenges linked to M23 areas are monitored.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ流行に伴いワールドカップ選手団の訓練キャンプを移転
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数項目該当。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）による国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念と、2026年ワールドカップという国際的なイベントに関連した渡航制限および多国間の影響が確認される。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはHouston、Texas、Chile、Denmark、Portugulese Republic、Belgiumなど複数の国が含まれているが、記事サマリーの主体はDRC東部（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）でのエボラ流行であり、他国への実際の発生はない。South Kivu、Ituri、Kinshasa Cityはいずれもコンゴ民主共和国内の地域。WHO緊急事態宣言レベルの認識と、ワールドカップ関連の国際的な影響により、高いシグナル性がある。

article.articleHeadline: เตือนคนไทยเลี่ยงไป 'คองโก-ยูกันดา' เหตุ 'อีโบลา' ระบาดหนัก ตรวจเข้มคนจากพื้นที่เสี่ยง | เดลินิวส์
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Thai people warned to avoid traveling to the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda as Ebola outbreak spreads; enhanced screening for travelers from high-risk areas.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda are designated Ebola-affected areas, with Thai authorities warning citizens to avoid nonessential travel as of May 22, 2026. WHO declared Ebola outbreaks in DR Congo and Uganda on May 17, 2026, and the Thai Ministry of Public Health designated both countries Ebola-infected on May 20, 2026. Travelers from these regions should exercise heightened precautions, monitor local outbreak news, and follow official guidance. Preventive actions include frequent handwashing with soap or alcohol-based sanitizer, wearing masks in high-risk or crowded settings, and avoiding contact with blood, saliva, mucus, sweat, patient belongings, or contaminated materials. Do not touch wild animals such as fruit bats and primates, and monitor personal health for timely medical care. Arrivals from risk areas must comply with MOH Ebola surveillance; contact DDC Thailand 1422, or the Thai Embassy in Nairobi at +254 733 145 145; 24/7 helpline 0-2572-8442.

triage.headline_ja: タイ人民にコンゴ・ウガンダへの渡航回避を警告 エボラ出血熱が重く流行しているため、リスク地域からの入国者に厳格な検査を実施
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべて該当。エボラ出血熱の多国間での発生報告、国際的なリスク拡大、タイを含む複数国での旅行制限措置が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明示されているDRC・ウガンダでの確認エボラ症例に対し、タイ当局が旅行警告と入国者スクリーニング強化を実施している。WHO公式宣言（2026年5月17日）を受けた対応。対象国リストではDRC（203312）とThailand（1605651）が該当。ウガンダ（226074）はリスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Việt Nam tăng cường giám sát, sẵn sàng xét nghiệm bệnh do virus Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vietnam strengthens surveillance, ready to test for Ebola virus disease.
article.articleSummary: May 22, 2026, Vietnam's Ministry of Health held a nationwide Ebola surveillance meeting to bolster detection and response, connecting hundreds of local points. As of May 21, Vietnam has had no Ebola cases; importation risk from Congo and Uganda is low but not zero due to travelers from outbreak areas. Ebola spreads from wildlife (fruit bats, porcupines, non-human primates) and via contact with blood, secretions, tissues, or surfaces contaminated with infectious materials. There are six Ebola virus species; Bundibugyo is implicated in the Congo–Uganda outbreak. Since 1976, Ebola has affected 13 African countries; imported cases have occurred in the United States, Spain, the United Kingdom, and Italy, typically among healthcare workers or returning travelers. WHO declared Bundibugyo Ebola a public health emergency of international concern on May 17. Vietnam’s central institutes, the Institute of Hygiene and Epidemiology and Pasteur Institute Ho Chi Minh City, have BSL-3 laboratories for sequencing and RT-PCR and are ordering WHO-guided diagnostic reagents, expected in 7–10 days. Authorities will strengthen border screening and coordinate with the WHO Vietnam Office.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナム、エボラウイルス病の監視を強化、検査体制を整備
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）、対象国ベトナムでの能動的準備体制構築、WHO公式宣言（2026年5月17日）によるPHEIC認定
triage.notes: ベトナムではエボラ患者報告なし（2026年5月21日時点）であるが、コンゴ・ウガンダからの流入リスク存在。WHOが2026年5月17日にBundibugyo EbolasをPHEIC認定し、ベトナムは能動的に監視体制構築中（BSL-3実験室での検査態勢、国境スクリーニング強化）。Bluedot APIが報告した「United States, Spain, UK, Italy」は過去のインポートケースに関する言及であり、現在の流行地は主にコンゴ・ウガンダのため、verified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Congo, folla incendia le tende di isolamento anti-Ebola dopo lite sul funerale di una vittima
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: Crowd torches Ebola isolation tents after dispute over a victim's funeral.
article.articleSummary: Crowd clashes in Rwampara, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, as residents attacked the local hospital and burned tents used as an isolation center after a dispute over the funeral of a man suspected of dying from Ebola. Police intervened, firing warning shots and using tear gas to disperse the protesters. The World Health Organization says that, across Congo and Uganda, about 600 suspected Ebola cases and 139 deaths are linked to a new outbreak caused by the rare Bundibugyo strain, for which no vaccine has yet been approved. The incident highlights ongoing Ebola emergency response challenges in the region amid concerns around infection control and community responses to burial practices.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：エボラ隔離テント焼却事件 被害者の葬儀をめぐる紛争後に群衆が放火
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：約600例疑似症例、139死亡、稀有なBundibugyo株による新規流行；異常性：隔離施設の破壊による感染制御破綻；国際的拡大リスク：コンゴとウガンダにまたがる流行）。社会的・政治的関心も高い（コミュニティ対立、WHO懸念表明）。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 本イベントはDRCのRwampara地域で発生した隔離施設破壊事件だが、サマリーでは約600例・139死亡がコンゴとウガンダにまたがると記載されている。主要な流行地はDRCであり、ウガンダはsuspected casesの統計に含まれるが、本記事の主題は専らDRC東部での事件。稀有なBundibugyo株によるエボラ流行、ワクチン未承認、コミュニティの感染制御破壊行為による管理困難化が懸念される。WHO通知レベルのシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Mondiali 2026, ripescaggio Italia: ebola in Congo mette a rischio la partecipazione
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Cup 2026, Italy's repechage: Ebola in the Congo jeopardizes Italy's participation.
article.articleSummary: As of May 22, 2026, Ebola virus disease is spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), prompting the World Health Organization to declare an international public health emergency for its 17th outbreak. The outbreak has caused 139 deaths among nearly 600 probable cases, concentrated in eastern, rail- and road-inaccessible provinces. The risk of a global pandemic is deemed low. The DR Congo national football team canceled part of its World Cup preparations in Kinshasa and relocated to Belgium; all called-up players are Europe-based and had not returned to the country in the previous 21 days. The 2026 FIFA World Cup is hosted by the United States, Canada and Mexico (June 11–July 19). The United States has tightened border controls for travelers who recently visited Congo, Uganda or South Sudan, noting the Congolese squad’s recent Europe-based training could affect entry eligibility.

triage.headline_ja: ワールドカップ2026、イタリアの再選出：コンゴのエボラがイタリアの参加を危険にさらす
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目に該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、WHOが国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言した17番目のエボラ流行。対象国DRCで確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラの公衆衛生的影響とそれに伴う国際的な渡航・スポーツイベント等への影響を報じている。WHOが国際保健上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言した17番目の流行と明記されており、139死亡、600例近い疑い例がDRC東部で集中。米国がコンゴ訪問者への国境管理強化を実施している。

article.articleHeadline: Κονγκό: "Θερίζει" ο ιος Εμπολα, 160 θάνατοι και 671 ύποπτα | ΕΙΔΗΣΕΙΣ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: The Ebola virus is ravaging, 160 deaths and 671 suspected cases | News
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri province, northeast, bordering Uganda and South Sudan) intensified with 671 suspected cases and 160 deaths; 64 infections and 6 deaths confirmed by laboratory testing. WHO had reported nearly 600 suspected cases and 130 deaths previously, cautioning that the true numbers may be higher. The current outbreak, the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC since 1976, is attributed to the rare Bundibugyo strain, for which there are no vaccines or specific therapies, complicating containment. Ituri's outbreak began about two months ago near Uganda and South Sudan. Two nationals of the DRC in Uganda have been reported; one died, the other tested negative two days ago and remains under treatment. Historical note: West Africa's 2014-2015 outbreak caused over 11,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：エボラウイルスが猛威、160人の死亡と671人の疑い例 | ニュース
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模発生であり、IHR基準4項目すべて該当。死亡例と疑い例が多数報告され、国際的な懸念と対応が必要な高リスク案件。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCのイトゥリ州での発生を主題としており、DRC内での確定例と多数の疑い例が報告されている。ウガンダやスーダンとの国境地域での発生であり、国際的な拡大リスクが存在する。ワクチンや特異的治療がないBundibugyo株による第17回の発生。ウガンダ国内のDRC国民2名の報告もあるが、記事の主題発生地はDRCである。

article.articleHeadline: UN agencies step up Ebola response in Congo - Healthwise
article.articleSummary: UN agencies stepped up Ebola response in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo as of 22 May 2026, delivering emergency medical supplies, PPE and logistics. Ituri remains the epicentre, with Bunia and the towns of Rwampara and Mongbwalu most affected. In North Kivu, cases have been confirmed in Goma, Butembo and Katwa; a new case has been reported in Bukavu, South Kivu, linked to travel from Tshopo near Ituri. MONUSCO is providing logistics, including four light vehicles, a helicopter, two ambulances and two armoured vehicles to Bunia, plus motorcycles to support mobility for teams and WHO operations. The Bundibugyo strain has no vaccines or medicines currently. Uganda has two confirmed cases; DRC reports 139 deaths and about 600 suspected cases. UNICEF mobilised nearly 50 tonnes of supplies; WFP seeks over $214 million for DRC operations and more than $10 million for Ebola response; WHO has declared PHEIC.

triage.headline_ja: UN agencies step up Ebola response in Congo - Healthwise
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当：重篤な公衆衛生影響（139死亡、600疑い症例）、異常・予想外な急速拡大（複数地域での確認）、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダでの確認、隣国への脅威）、渡航・貿易制限リスク。WHO PHEIC宣言済み。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo strain with no vaccines/medicines available. PHEIC already declared by WHO. Uganda confirmed cases (2) represent cross-border transmission. Multiple epicentres in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu provinces indicate active spread. Significant international aid mobilisation underway. This is a high-priority ongoing crisis requiring full RRA.

article.articleHeadline: コンゴのエボラ、「呪術による病」と思い込んでいるうちに感染拡大
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo: infections spread as people become convinced it is a "disease caused by sorcery."
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), centered in Ituri Province’s gold-mining Monbawar area, have spread as communities historically believed the illness to be sorcery. The first suspected infection traces to mid-April in the Monbawar mining region; Ituri’s security is fragile and access is difficult. The DRC’s population is listed as about 190 million in the report. On May 17, the World Health Organization declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). Local residents say recognition was delayed because fear of sorcery took hold. After a body was returned from Bunia, relatives swapped caskets; some were burned by youths, while traditional chiefs urged performing rituals before burning. Deaths surged to as many as 3–5 per day during peak moments. The piece highlights cultural beliefs hindering early outbreak detection and response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ、「呪術による病」と思い込んでいるうちに感染拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）かつWHO PHEIC宣言済みのエボラアウトブレイク。国際的な懸念が極めて高い。
triage.notes: WHO により2026年5月17日に Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) 宣言済み。イトゥリ州のモンバワル地域の金鉱採掘地帯が中心。文化的信念（呪術と思い込み）により初期対応が遅延し、死亡率が上昇（ピーク時1日3～5件の死亡）。社会文化的要因がアウトブレイク管理を複雑にしている。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo DV-s pani vihane rahvahulk ebolahaigla telgid põlema
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An angry crowd in the Democratic Republic of the Congo set Ebola hospital tents on fire.
article.articleSummary: At Rwampara Hospital near Bunia in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, an angry crowd set Ebola isolation tents on fire as police fired warning shots to disperse the mob. Medical staff at the hospital were placed under military protection after an Ebola victim’s body—described as extremely infectious—needed safe burial. One health worker was injured by a thrown stone amid the unrest. The deceased was a locally prominent man; his death amplified fear and led some community members to doubt Ebola’s existence in eastern DRC, where officials say the outbreak has already killed more than 130 people. Some locals accuse NGOs and hospitals of fabricating the disease for money. A relative said the man died of typhoid, not Ebola, reflecting broad confusion surrounding the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ病院のテントが怒った群衆に放火される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生影響（130人以上の死亡）と予想外の社会的混乱が確認される。WPRO基準では重症度（死亡多数）、長期曝露（継続的な発生）、流行しやすさ（ヒト-ヒト感染）、管理可能性（社会不安による対策阻害）が全て該当し、国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の継続的な感染とチフスの並行発生、地域社会の疫病対策への不信による暴動が記録されている。医療施設への直接的な脅威と公衆衛生対応の阻害が深刻。Ituri州Bunia近郊での事案であるが、DRCが対象国リストに含まれるため該当。

article.articleHeadline: MSZ "odradza wszelkie podróże". Komunikat po wykryciu nowego ogniska Eboli - Dziennik.pl
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Foreign Affairs "advises against all travel." Statement following the detection of a new Ebola outbreak - Dziennik.pl.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda prompts Poland’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs to advise against all travel to the border region with South Sudan. The World Health Organization classifies national health risk as high in DRC and Uganda, high regionally, and low globally, and has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern after two confirmed cases in Uganda. Since detection in the DRC, at least 131 deaths and 513 or more suspected cases have been reported, with infections spreading across a widening area. Ebola virus causes a highly contagious disease; transmission occurs via contact with blood or secretions of infected animals (bats, monkeys) and through person-to-person contact. Incubation 2–21 days; symptoms include fever, fatigue, muscle and throat pain, vomiting, diarrhea, rash, renal and hepatic failure, and sometimes bleeding. Prior Ugandan and DRC outbreaks showed case fatality rates of 30–50%; no effective treatment or vaccine exists. This reflects the situation as of 2026-05-22.

triage.headline_ja: ポーランド外務省「すべての渡航を勧告しない」。新しいエボラ出血熱の流行検出後の声明 - Dziennik.pl
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施、予想外の新規流行）。WHOがPHEIC宣言済み。対象国DRCで確認。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱はIHRで即座の報告が必須の感染症。DRCで131名以上の死亡、513名以上の疑い患者が報告されており、ウガンダで確認例2件。WHOはPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言済み。ヒト-ヒト感染が確認されている。対象国リスト外のウガンダおよびスーダン、ポーランドへの言及があるが、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。フルRRA実施必須。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola no Congo e Uganda: qual é o risco real de o vírus chegar ao Brasil?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda: what is the real risk of the virus reaching Brazil?
article.articleSummary: New Ebola outbreak in Ituri province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, on May 15, 2026, caused by the Bundibugyo strain. Within 48 hours, two confirmed cases appeared in Kampala, Uganda, in travelers from the DRC. WHO declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, 2026. By May 19, the outbreak included 536 suspected, 105 probable, 34 confirmed cases and 134 deaths in DRC, with Uganda reporting 2 confirmed cases and 1 death. Unlike Ebola Zaire vaccines, no specific therapy exists for Bundibugyo; treatment is supportive. Transmission requires direct contact with infected bodily fluids or contaminated materials; airborne spread is not seen. The risk to Brazil is real but low, and Brazil has vigilant traveler surveillance. Bundibugyo was first identified in 2007 in Bundibugyo, Uganda; this is the third documented outbreak of this strain.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダのエボラ：ウイルスがブラジルに到達するリスクは本当にあるのか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の新規株による流行、国際的拡大と渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WHO緊急事態宣言済みで、複数国にまたがる確認症例あり。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo strain outbreak, WHO PHEIC宣言済み（2026年5月17日）。DRCでは536疑い例、105確率例、34確認例、134死亡。ウガンダでは2確認例、1死亡。ワクチンなし、対症療法が主体。記事はブラジルへのリスク評価を扱っているが、実際の発生はDRCとウガンダに限定される。

article.articleHeadline: Demokratische Republik Kongo - Zahl der Ebola-Infektionen steigt - Klinikzelte im Ostkongo angezündet
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo - Number of Ebola infections rising - Clinic tents in eastern Congo set on fire.
article.articleSummary: As of 22 May 2026, Ebola infections are rising in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, with 671 suspected cases and 160 virus-related deaths reported. The outbreak centers in the northeastern Ituri Province. Tensions have escalated, with clinic tents in eastern Congo set on fire. The current circulating strain is the Bundibugyo-type of Ebola, for which there is no vaccine or therapy. Ebola is a highly contagious and life-threatening disease transmitted through direct contact with bodily fluids; this includes the body of someone who has died from Ebola, which remains highly infectious and must be buried under strict rules. No details on laboratory confirmation or imported/exported cases are provided.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国 - エボラ感染者数が増加 - 東部コンゴの診療所テントが放火される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常な事態、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）し、WPRO基準でも複数該当。ブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスのワクチン・治療がない点、社会不安の兆候（放火事件）がある点が懸念される。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明示される671件の疑い患者と160件の死亡により、重症度と公衆衛生への深刻な影響が確認できる。Bundibugyo型エボラはワクチン・治療がない点が特に懸念される。東部での診療所テント放火は社会的混乱と対策への抵抗を示唆しており、アウトブレーク管理の困難性が高い。実験室確認状況と国境を越えた事例の有無については記事に記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Сотни россиян оказались в зоне риска заражения лихорадкой Эбола в Африке
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hundreds of Russians are at risk of contracting Ebola in Africa.
article.articleSummary: Approximately 300 Russian citizens are currently in areas at risk of Ebola in Africa, specifically Kenya and Tanzania, bordering the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda where active outbreaks are reported. Ebola virus disease spreads through close contact with infected individuals or their bodily fluids; a less obvious route involves consuming bananas contaminated with bat residues, bats being the natural reservoir. In the region, the DRC has seen over 500 cases with about 130 deaths, while neighboring Uganda has 2 cases with 1 death. On May 17, the World Health Organization declared an international public health emergency (PHEIC) over the Ebola outbreaks in DRC and Uganda. Russia plans to deploy its specialists to Uganda to assist local authorities and international groups to curb spread and reduce spillover risk to Russia.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでエボラ出血熱感染リスク地域に数百人のロシア人が滞在
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当。エボラはPHEIC宣言済みの重篤感染症であり、DRCとウガンダでアクティブな流行が報告されており、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでケニア・タンザニアへのロシア国民の滞在が述べられているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれていない。アクティブな流行地域はDRCとウガンダであり、DRCのみが対象国のため verified_locations に含める。2026年5月17日にWHOがPHEIC宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: This Ebola outbreak is particularly worrying. That doesn't mean it's a threat to Canadians | CBC News
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak, centered in Ituri Province near Uganda and South Sudan, has 148 suspected deaths and about 600 suspected cases reported by the UN; two cases, including one death, have occurred in Uganda. WHO says the outbreak is larger than these counts, and patient zero has not been identified. Bundibugyo strain has no vaccine or approved treatments, unlike the Zaire strain, which has a vaccine since 2014; tests initially for Zaire were negative, delaying recognition. Ongoing conflict and weak health infrastructure, with more than 920,000 internally displaced in Ituri, complicate containment and have led to cases in rebel-held areas. WHO cautions regional risk is high, global risk is low, and the outbreak could last through summer as responders deploy. Travel measures: the US bans visitors who have been in Congo/Uganda/South Sudan in the prior 21 days; Canada has no ban, though Ontario is testing a resident.

triage.headline_ja: このエボラ出血熱の流行は特に懸念される。それはカナダ人への脅威を意味するわけではない | CBCニュース
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を3つ満たす（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。ウイルス株がワクチン未対応で、複数国で患者が確認され、地域リスクが高いと評価されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC（特にIturi州）を主焦点としており、ウガンダでの症例も言及されているがウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。Bundibugyo株はワクチン未対応で、地域リスクがWHOにより「高い」と評価されており、紛争と脆弱な保健基盤が懸念要因。

article.articleHeadline: India tightens Ebola surveillance, issues fresh advisory for airlines and international travellers
article.articleSummary: India tightens Ebola surveillance with a fresh advisory for airlines and international travellers. Airlines must stock first-aid equipment, disposable gloves, hand sanitizers, and universal precautions kits onboard. Cabin crew are instructed to isolate passengers displaying symptoms, minimize physical interaction, ensure use of PPE, and immediately alert destination airport health authorities before landing. The advisory directs travellers with fever, weakness, muscle pain, headache, sore throat, vomiting, diarrhoea, rash or bleeding to report immediately to airline crew and immigration or medical authorities on arrival. Stringent passenger tracing protocols must be used on flights carrying suspected cases. Co-passengers seated near symptomatic travellers, crew who handled them, and cleaning personnel involved in disinfecting affected aircraft sections may be subject to monitoring and follow-up surveillance. Measures reflect the current threat of Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) in the Indian context to prevent importation and further transmission through international travel.

triage.headline_ja: インド、エボラ出血熱の監視を強化、航空会社および国際旅行者への新たな勧告を発出
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は重大な感染症であり、インドが監視強化と旅行勧告を発出している点は懸念材料だが、記事は予防的措置や警戒態勢に関するもので、実際の確認症例や流行の報告ではない。情報が不足しており、実際のイベント発生状況の把握が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は実際のエボラ出血熱確認症例ではなく、インドによる予防的監視強化と航空旅行に関する勧告である。IHR基準は3つ満たしているが、WATCHとした理由は、実際のイベント（確認症例、流行）の有無が不明確であり、現在のところ予防措置段階の報告と判断されるため。エボラ出血熱の地域的発生または輸入リスクに関する続報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Goodwill Ambassador Issues Rallying Cry to Accelerate International Efforts to Eliminate Leprosy: "The Last Mile Starts Now" | Taiwan News | May. 22, 2026 16:00
article.articleSummary: Leprosy (Hansen's disease) elimination advocate Yohei Sasakawa issued the rallying cry 'The Last Mile Starts Now' at a Geneva reception during the 79th World Health Assembly to mark 25 years as WHO Goodwill Ambassador. Hosted by the Sasakawa Leprosy Initiative, the event drew about 100 attendees, including WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, health ministers from leprosy-endemic countries, and Japanese officials. Sasakawa also met with Tedros, WHO regional directors, and health ministers from 16 priority countries—India, Brazil, Indonesia—to strengthen international cooperation toward a leprosy-free world. About 180,000 new leprosy cases are reported each year worldwide; transmission persists, and stigma remains a challenge despite curability. Sasakawa has visited 127 countries and logged over 3,700 overseas days. The campaign, linked to Don't Forget Leprosy, has directed over US$200 million since 1975.

triage.headline_ja: WHO親善大使がハンセン病撲滅に向けた国際的取り組みの加速を呼びかけ：「最後の一マイルは今始まる」
triage.triage_reason: ハンセン病の国際的な撲滅キャンペーンに関する政策・外交イベント報道。疾患自体は依然として風土病的に存在するが、本記事は具体的な新たな感染症クラスター、アウトブレーク、または緊急事態ではなく、国際的なアドボカシー活動であり、シグナルレベルではない。ただし影響対象国（インド、ブラジル、インドネシア）が複数あり、国際的な関心が存在するため、続報を注視する価値がある。
triage.notes: 本記事はハンセン病のアウトブレークやクラスターを報告するものではなく、WHO親善大使によるハンセン病撲滅キャンペーンの政策イベント・アドボカシス活動である。記事では年間約18万件の新規ハンセン病患者が報告されていることが言及されているが、これは既知の風土病的流行であり、新たなシグナルではない。従来の感染症クラスター・アウトブレーク検知というシグナルトリアージの対象外と判断し、WATCH（要経過観察）に分類。

article.articleHeadline: Crowd torches Ebola hospital tents in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: As of 22 May 2026, DR Congo’s Ituri province near Bunia saw protests escalate as a crowd torched Ebola hospital tents at Rwampara hospital after relatives of a young man believed to have died from Ebola were refused permission to remove his body for burial, due to contagion risk and required burial protocol. The deceased, a popular local figure and talented footballer, reportedly died of Ebola, though his parents believed typhoid was the cause. Some villagers question Ebola’s existence, viewing it as an outsider-created, profit-driven narrative. The Ituri outbreak’s epicentre has reportedly killed more than 130 people. The World Health Organization has declared the outbreak a global health emergency but not a pandemic emergency. Ebola, first identified in 1976, is a severe, often fatal illness; symptoms include fever, weakness, diarrhea and vomiting.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ病院テントが群衆に放火される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）に該当し、WHO緊急宣言済み。社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の流行で130人以上の死亡が報告され、WHOが国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言している。社会的混乱として、誤情報や埋葬プロトコル不遵守による医療施設の破壊行為が発生。チフスも併記されているが、記事の主題はエボラ。ルワンダ（Kigali Province）は地域名として含まれるが、記事サマリーでは実際の発生はコンゴ領土内（Ituri州Bunia近郊）のみ。

article.articleHeadline: UN mobilises emergency support as Ebola cases spread across Congo, Uganda
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-22, the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has spread from Ituri (epicenter) to North Kivu (Goma, Butembo, Katwa) and Bukavu in South Kivu; Uganda reports two confirmed cases. The Bundibugyo strain has caused 139 deaths and about 600 suspected infections in DRC; Uganda has two confirmed cases. The World Health Organization has classified the outbreak as a public health emergency of international concern. UN and partners are mobilising: MONUSCO providing logistics, a helicopter, four light vehicles, two ambulances and two armoured vehicles to Bunia; WFP seeking over $214 million for operations, including more than $10 million for Ebola response; UNICEF has mobilised roughly 50 tonnes of emergency supplies and deployed an Emergency Rapid Response team to Bunia. Surveillance at entry points is expanding, and health teams are being moved for rapid response, with over 2,000 community health workers active. An infected person travelled from Tshopo to Bukavu, indicating cross-border transmission concerns.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱がコンゴ、ウガンダに拡大する中、国連が緊急支援を動員
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WHO公開宣言（PHEIC）。複数国への国際的拡大、高い死亡率、重度の公衆衛生影響を確認。
triage.notes: WHOによってPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）として宣言済み。ウガンダで2例の確認患者がいるが、記事サマリーの主要な焦点はDRC東部での発生・拡大であり、DRCのみをverified_locationsに含める。Bundibugyo株による139死亡、約600疑い患者。UN、WFP、UNICEFが積極的な支援活動を実施中。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: As Ebola resurfaces in DR Congo, so do critical questions about how to respond
article.articleSummary: Ebola resurfaces in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri with cases in North Kivu, South Kivu and neighboring Uganda, involving the extremely rare Bundibugyo variant. There are 671 suspected cases and 160 suspected deaths. WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern on 17 May to mobilize resources. Bundibugyo has no approved vaccines or treatments and carries a high fatality rate, up to about 50%; transmission occurs through direct contact with an infected person’s blood or body fluids. Imperial College London modelling suggests there could be more than 1,000 infections. First known death occurred 24 April in Bunia; burial in Mongbwalu 70 km away highlighted tracing gaps. Response includes treatment centres, isolation tents, and supplies, but funding, security, and political factors, plus a history of strained responses, threaten containment. Previous outbreaks provide experience, yet local resilience remains limited.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴ民主共和国で再出現、対応方法についての重大な疑問も浮上
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも異常性、重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性の4基準に該当。WHOが国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言し、国際的支援が必要な状況。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）とウガンダでの発生を述べているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。イギリス（London）が発生地域に含まれているのは、記事がImperial College Londonのモデリング言及のためと考えられ、実際のイベント発生地ではないため除外。Bundibugyo型エボラの再出現、671例の疑い患者、160例の疑い死亡、WHOによるPHEIC宣言（2026年5月17日）、ワクチンと治療法がない、致死率約50%という極めて深刻な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: aux États-Unis, les voyageurs passés par la RDC, d'Ouganda et du Soudan du Sud forcés d'atterrir en Virginie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: In the United States, travelers who passed through the DRC, Uganda and South Sudan were forced to land in Virginia.
article.articleSummary: Ebola controls tightened in the United States: as of May 21, travelers who have been in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan within the previous 21 days must land only at Washington Dulles International Airport near Washington, D.C. They will undergo intensified screening, including interviews and medical testing. The regulation, initially published to target Americans and lawful permanent residents, was updated to extend to all non-Americans who visited these three countries in the last 21 days. U.S. authorities say the measures remain in force. In practice, a Paris–Detroit flight was diverted to Montreal on Wednesday to disembark a Congolese national under the policy. Ebola outbreak control measures aim to prevent unmonitored entry of infected travelers."

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：米国で、DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンを経由した旅行者はバージニア州への着陸を強制される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限の実施）。エボラ出血熱は高致死率で、米国を含む複数国での対策強化・渡航制限が実施されている。
triage.notes: 記事は米国での検疫強化措置を主題としているが、実際のエボラ発生地はDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン。DRCは対象国に含まれるため verified_locations に含める。米国、カナダ、フランス、スーダンは対象国外。高度な感染リスク管理と国際的な関心が示唆されている。

article.articleHeadline: Health ministry urges localities to strengthen Ebola surveillance and preparedness
article.articleSummary: Vietnam's health ministry on May 22 urged localities to strengthen Ebola surveillance and preparedness as no infection cases have been recorded in the country; risk of spread from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda remains low. The World Health Organization (WHO) on May 17 declared Ebola disease caused by Bundibugyo virus in the DRC and Uganda a public health emergency of international concern (PHEIC) but not a pandemic. In the DRC, infections reached 516 with 131 deaths as of May 18; Uganda reported two infection cases returning from the DRC. Ebola virus disease is severe and often fatal, with a historical case fatality rate up to 90%. Transmission occurs from wild animals (fruit bats, porcupines, non-human primates) to humans and through direct contact with blood, secretions, organs, bodily fluids, or contaminated surfaces. Early outbreaks began in Central Africa; the 2014-2016 West Africa outbreak was the largest on record.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、エボラウイルス監視と準備態勢の強化を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: DRCおよびウガンダでエボラアウトブレイク発生、WHOによるPHEIC宣言、複数国での確認例、ベトナムでの警戒態勢強化。IHR基準4項目中3項目以上に該当し、国際的な公衆衛生上の重大な懸念事象。
triage.notes: DRCでの感染516例（死亡131例）、ウガンダで2例の輸入症例確認。WHOによるPHEIC宣言済み。ベトナムは現在感染例なし但し監視態勢強化中。エボラの致死率が高く（最大90%）、ヒト－ヒト感染能力があり、複数国への国際的な拡大懸念がある。

article.articleHeadline: UN sends emergency funds and staff to tackle Congo Ebola crisis
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo's Ituri province is being tackled as of May 22, 2026. The Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no vaccine, circulated undetected for about two months before being identified last week. The United Nations is releasing around $60 million from an emergency fund and deploying more staff to aid containment amid conflict and high population movement. The outbreak has 670 suspected cases and 160 suspected deaths to date. Experts warn the tough operating environments hinder lifesaving work. Ongoing surveillance and response efforts aim to prevent further spread, with international support intended to curb transmission and protect communities in Ituri and across the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: 国連、コンゴのエボラ危機に対応するため緊急資金と職員を派遣
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。ワクチンなしのBundibugyo株、670疑い例・160疑い死亡、紛争下での拡大懸念があり、シグナルピックアップの基準を十分満たす。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo strain (ワクチンなし)が約2カ月間未検出で循環していた点が特に懸念される。紛争環境下での高い人口移動、既に670疑い例と160疑い死亡が報告されており、国連が約6000万ドルの緊急基金を放出し人員派遣している。DRCが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: CEPI advierte que brote de ébola en RD Congo podría ser solo "la punta del iceberg"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: CEPI warns that an Ebola outbreak in DR Congo could be only "the tip of the iceberg."
article.articleSummary: CEPI warns that the current Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo could be only the tip of the iceberg, as the outbreak went undetected for several weeks. The affected strain is Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there are no approved therapies or vaccines. Unlike the more common Zaire strain, Bundibugyo tends to be less lethal, but the lack of licensed medical countermeasures complicates response. CEPI has not set a timeline for the development of a safe and effective vaccine against Bundibugyo. The statement underscores the uncertainty about the outbreak's true scale and the risk of undiagnosed cases within DR Congo.

triage.headline_ja: CEPI、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラアウトブレイクが「氷山の一角」である可能性があると警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo strain）の新規アウトブレイク。数週間検出されず、治療法・ワクチンが不在、国際的拡大リスク。IHR基準3項目以上該当、WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus株による新規アウトブレイク。既存のZaire株と異なり、治療法・ワクチンが完全に不在。数週間検出されなかった事実は、アウトブレイクの真の規模に関する不確実性が高いことを示唆。国際的に高い懸念。

article.articleHeadline: VIDEO Zapalili dio bolnice u središtu izbijanja virusa: "Ne vjeruju da ebola postoji"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: VIDEO: They set fire to part of a hospital in the epicenter of the virus outbreak: "They don't believe Ebola exists."
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri) at its epicenter; more than 130 deaths reported. A mob attacked and burned part of Rwampara General Hospital after disputes over burial of a young man believed to have died of Ebola; one health worker injured as police dispersed the crowd. Local fears and misinformation—some residents insist the virus does not exist and distrust NGOs and hospitals—fuel unrest. WHO urges safe and dignified burials with protective gear. As of May 22, 2026, WHO counts about 139 deaths among roughly 600 suspected Ebola cases in DR Congo; the health minister later cited 159 deaths. Two Ebola cases have been confirmed in neighboring Uganda. The outbreak influenced events such as DR Congo's national football team canceling a World Cup training camp in Kinshasa.

triage.headline_ja: 動画：ウイルス発生の震源地にある病院の一部が焼かれた：「エボラが存在すると信じていない」
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認された複数国流行（DRC・ウガンダ）、139～159人の死亡報告、国際的拡大リスク、医療施設への暴力的攻撃による公衆衛生脅威が認められ、IHR基準4つすべてに該当。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の確認流行。DRCのイトゥリ地域が震源地で139～159人の死亡、約600人の疑い患者が報告されている。ウガンダでも2例の確認例がある。医療施設への暴力的攻撃、地域の誤情報・不信感、国際的な影響（DRC代表団のワールドカップキャンプ中止）により、社会的・政治的関心が極めて高い。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Penyebaran HIV/AIDS di Kota Kupang, IRT Tempati Posisi Kedua Tertinggi Terinfeksi HIV - Pos-kupang.com
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Spread of HIV/AIDS in Kupang City, Housewives Occupy the Second-Highest HIV Infection Rate - Pos-kupang.com
article.articleSummary: HIV/AIDS in Kupang City, Indonesia shows housewives (Ibu rumah tangga) as the second-highest infected group after private-sector workers; female sex workers (PSP) account for about 8% of cases, ranking fourth or fifth by occupation. Kupang’s AIDS Handling Commission (KPAD) cites spousal extramarital risk as driving household transmission, noting many housewives are at home yet highly vulnerable. A 19-year-old PSP tested positive on December 2, 2025 at Pasir Panjang Community Health Center (Puskesmas Pasir Panjang), illustrating ongoing transmission. Authorities estimate a PSP may serve around 15 clients daily, with about 5 not using condoms, implying roughly 1,800 unprotected acts per year. KPAD, with the City Health Department, conducts quarterly mobile visiting voluntary counseling and testing (VCT) for HIV, targeting key populations, especially PSP; locations are pre-notified to ensure uptake and early detection.

triage.headline_ja: クパン市におけるHIV/AIDS蔓延、既婚女性（専業主婦）が第二位の感染者層を占める
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（対象国）におけるHIV感染の継続的な伝播が報告されており、特定の高リスク集団（性風俗労働者、配偶者経由の家庭内感染）への伝播が確認されている。しかし記事は地域的な感染状況の報告であり、新規アウトブレイク宣言ではなく、既存の流行管理の一環として提示されているため、現段階ではWATCHとする。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシア・クパン市におけるHIV感染の継続的な伝播を報告しており、既婚女性や性風俗労働者への感染が確認されている。長期的な曝露（spousal transmission、年間推定1,800件の無防備な性行為）と流行しやすさ（高リスク集団への伝播）の基準に該当。地域保健当局による検査・相談活動が実施中であり、既存の流行対応体制が機能している。ただし、新規アウトブレイク宣言ではなく地域レベルの感染状況報告であり、国際的拡大や重症度の懸念についての情報は不十分。

article.articleHeadline: Jelang Iduladha, Wonosobo Perketat Pengawasan Hewan Kurban dan Waspadai PMK
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ahead of Eid al-Adha, Wonosobo Tightens Surveillance of Sacrificial Animals and Warns of Foot-and-Mouth Disease
article.articleSummary: Ahead of Eid al-Adha 2026, Wonosobo Regency in Central Java tightens surveillance of sacrificial animals to prevent Foot-and-Mouth Disease (PMK). With 2,706 cattle, 27,156 goats, and 15,284 sheep in stock, officials expect holiday demand to rise modestly. PMK persists but is not as severe as during the outbreak’s peak; vaccination since 2022 has reached 1,683 head across 30 villages in nine districts in 2026. Farmers are advised to segregate new arrivals for about 14 days before mixing with existing herds. Prices are rising as PMK reduces cattle numbers. Government reiterates not to slaughter productive female cattle during Eid, though some sales occur outside official slaughterhouses (RPH). Authorities also monitor street livestock stalls and RPH activity. Notably, Kalikajar breeder Sriono Edi Subekti sells a Belgian Blue bull (over 1 ton) for Eid orders.

triage.headline_ja: イード・アル＝アドハ前夜、ウォノソボが犠牲動物の監視を強化し口蹄疫に警戒
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアでの口蹄疫持続状況の報道だが、現在の流行は深刻度が低下しており、国際的拡大リスクや重症例の情報がない。動物衛生上の懸念として経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシア・中部ジャワ州のウォノソボにおける口蹄疫（PMK）への対応状況を報道している。同地域では2022年からワクチン接種が実施されており、現在の流行は過去のピーク時より深刻度が低いとされている。動物衛生上の管理状況は良好で、国内対応も進行中。人畜共通感染症への国際的な拡大リスクは記事サマリーからは認識されない。シグナル化基準としてはWPRO基準の「長期曝露」と「流行しやすさ」に該当するため、WATCH段階での継続監視が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Три сотни российских туристов в Африке рискуют заразиться лихорадкой Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three hundred Russian tourists in Africa risk contracting Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Around 300 Russian tourists in Africa (Kenya and Tanzania) face potential Ebola exposure as outbreaks unfold nearby in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). DRC reports over 500 cases and about 130 deaths; Uganda has two confirmed infections, one fatal. Kenya and Tanzania have heightened border and airport health checks to curb spread. Transmission is chiefly via close contact, but fruit contaminated by fruit bats—such as bananas—can also introduce the virus if eaten or touched. Virologist Alexander Buteyko cited this route; bats often leave traces on fruit. Russian diplomats in Kampala said no nationals have sought consular assistance yet. The update, via SHOT, underscores ongoing regional outbreaks and cross-border risk as of May 22, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカのロシア人観光客約300人がエボラ出血熱への感染リスクに直面
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の活発な地域流行（DRC 500例以上、130名超の死亡例；ウガンダで2例確認）が複数国で報告されており、IHR基準の「異常性」「国際的拡大リスク」「重症度」、およびWPRO基準の「重症度」「流行容易性」「管理可能性」に該当。地域の複数国にまたがる懸念と国際的注目があるため、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: ケニアとタンザニアは記事では曝露リスクのある隣接国として言及されるが、確定症例の報告がないため verified_locations には含めず。DRCとウガンダが確認症例と活発な流行を報告している主要イベント発生地。約300名のロシア人観光客が関連する外交・政治的関心も存在。

article.articleHeadline: Протестующие подожгли центр лечения больных Эболой
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Protesters set fire to an Ebola treatment center.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo, locals in a city set fire to a mobile Ebola treatment center after relatives of a young man who died from Ebola were denied releasing his body. The blaze damaged two hospital tents, and six patients with confirmed Ebola or suspected Ebola escaped. At the time, the clinic housed three lab-confirmed cases and three more with Ebola-like fever awaiting test results. The incident’s province has become the epicenter of a new Ebola strain outbreak. Health officials warn that bodies of the deceased can remain infectious, a risk that clashes with traditional burial practices and fuels protests. Separately, the United States barred entry for arrivals from Ebola-affected countries for 30 days; a flight from Paris to Detroit diverted to Montreal after a Congo passenger was refused entry. The ban applies to non-U.S. passport holders who visited affected countries within 21 days before May 18.

triage.headline_ja: 抗議者がエボラ治療センターに放火
triage.triage_reason: コンゴでのエボラ確定患者の逃走、医療施設の破壊、国際的な渡航制限（米国の入国禁止）、新種ウイルス株の出現が複数確認され、IHR基準4つ全て該当。公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが明らかである。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから確認される主要な懸念：(1)確定患者6名を含む患者が治療施設から逃走、(2)新種エボラウイルス株の出現、(3)医療施設への物理的破壊、(4)米国による30日間の入国禁止令と国際便の迂回。カナダ・米国・フランスは発生地域ではなく、渡航制限や患者輸送経路としてのみ言及されているため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : le corps d'un cas suspect calciné lors d'une violente manifestation anti-riposte à Rwampara
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: the body of a suspected case cremated during a violent anti-outbreak response protest in Rwampara
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in Ituri, near Bunia (Rwampara), Democratic Republic of Congo, intensified on May 21, 2026 when taxi-moto drivers and youths forcibly entered a treatment center to demand the body of a young Ebola patient. The deceased, a taxi-moto driver and son of a soldier, had died from Ebola; authorities enforcing safe burial protocols refused to release the body, leading to clashes that set hospital facilities ablaze. Two isolation tents housing suspected or confirmed Ebola patients were burned, with beds destroyed and the body inside also burnt. Several youths were detained as investigations proceeded to identify others.
