Security forces, with local authorities, regained control; officials urged calm and warned against rumor-mongering that could worsen tensions during the ongoing Ebola response in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州のエボラ：ルワンパラでの激しい抗体対策デモ中に疑い患者の遺体が焼却される
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの発生であり、患者死亡、治療施設への暴力的な侵入、医療対応への妨害が報告されている。IHR基準で深刻な影響・予想外の事態・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクを複数満たし、また社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、イベントはDRC（イトゥリ州、ルワンパラ）で発生していることが明確。ルワンダは地理的に隣接しているが、記事の主題はDRCの爆発的エボラ感染事態であり、医療対応への市民的暴力・施設破壊・患者遺体の焼却という危機管理上の重大な障害が報告されている。エボラの再燃またはより広範な流行の懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak spreads to South Kivu Province in the DRC
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-22, the Ebola outbreak in the DRC has spread from Ituri to North Kivu and South Kivu, with Uganda reporting two confirmed cases. M23 rebel group confirms a Bukavu case; a 28-year-old man traveled from Kisangani (Tshopo) and died before diagnosis. Kisangani, a major transport hub, raises concerns about wider spread; suspected index case in late April with possible funeral-linked superspreading. Since May 15, 626 suspected cases and 159 probable deaths; 51 cases confirmed in Ituri and North Kivu (Bunia, Goma). Over 200 samples sent to Goma; one confirmed case under medical supervision. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, which has no approved vaccine or specific treatment; vaccines exist for the Zaire strain but are not applicable now. WHO emphasizes rapid contact tracing, isolation, safe treatment centers, and early care; several candidate vaccines are under consideration, months away.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行がコンゴ民主共和国南キヴ州に拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの多地域流行で複数州に拡大、ウガンダへの越境確認、死亡例と重症化多数、ワクチン無効株（Bundibugyo strain）による国際的リスク増大。IHR基準4項目全て該当、公衆衛生上の重大な脅威。
triage.notes: 記事では複数の州（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu、Tshopo）および複数都市（Bunia、Goma、Bukavu、Kisangani）で発生が報告されているが、いずれもDRCの領土内。ウガンダでの確認も言及されているが、DRCが主要な発生地。Bundibugyo strainはZaire strainワクチンが無効という重大な特徴。輸送ハブKisanganiからの流行拡大懸念および葬儀関連のスーパースプレッド可能性が指摘されており、制御困難性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola - Ituri : aucun cas guéri à la date du 20 mai - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola - Ituri: no recovered cases as of May 20 - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in Ituri and North Kivu provinces, Democratic Republic of Congo, as of May 20, 2026, with 64 confirmed cases and 6 confirmed deaths and no recoveries reported. A total of 1,441 contacts are identified and monitored. Thirteen new confirmed cases were reported in the last 24 hours, 12 in Ituri and 1 in North Kivu; a new health zone, Bambu, is now affected, bringing the total to eight health zones in Ituri. Surveillance and investigations around confirmed cases, contact tracing, and entry-point control are reinforced to curb cross-border spread. Response actions include provincial intervention plans, enhanced infection prevention and control in health facilities, risk communication, patient management, and logistics. Laboratory work shows 218 samples received, 134 analyzed; additional samples sent to Kinshasa for sequencing to strengthen surveillance. Challenges persist due to limited resources, sample transport, under-reporting of alerts, and circulating rumors.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ - イトゥリ州：2026年5月20日時点で回復した患者なし - ACP
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべて該当。エボラウイルス病は公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクを備えており、フルRRAが必須。
triage.notes: DRCのイトゥリ州およびキンシャサで現在進行中のエボラウイルス病感染症の拡大流行。64確認患者、6確認死亡、回復者なし、接触者1,441名監視中。新規ヘルスゾーン（バンブ）の罹患により計8ヘルスゾーンへの拡大。リソース制限と越境感染拡大リスクが課題。WPROスクリーニング基準すべて該当。

article.articleHeadline: 90% نسبة الوفاة في بعض سلالات إيبولا.. ما الأعراض التي تكشفه مبكرًا؟ - الأسبوع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 90% mortality rate in some Ebola strains... What early symptoms reveal it? - The Week
article.articleSummary: As of May 22, 2026, Ebola outbreaks occur in South Sudan, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Gabon, and Ivory Coast, with case fatality ranging from 25% to 90% depending on the viral strain and speed of care. Early symptoms typically appear 2–3 weeks post-infection and include fever, sore throat, muscle and joint pains, and headache, followed by vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, and a maculopapular rash in about half of cases 5–7 days after onset. Transmission is mainly through direct contact with infected body fluids or fluids from animal carriers, not airborne; entry occurs via broken skin or mucous membranes. The current DRC outbreak involves the Bundibugyo strain, a rare variant with no vaccine or approved treatment, and is the third-largest in the country, with roughly 670 suspected cases and 160 deaths (per Reuters). WHO notes that corpses remain highly infectious after death, and traditional funeral rites can drive spread. The outbreak has impacted events, such as the DRC football team’s World Cup camp being relocated to Belgium.

triage.headline_ja: 90% mortality rate in some Ebola strains... What early symptoms reveal it? - The Week
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響・予想外性・国際的拡大リスク）。複数国での同時多発的なエボラアウトブレイク、高い致死率、WHO公式記録がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは南スーダン、DRC、ガボン、コートジボワールでのエボラ発生を述べているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。DRC発生のBundibugyo株は稀な亜種で、ワクチン・承認治療なし。670疑い例、160死亡。ベルギーへのDRC代表団避難は2次的影響。WHO正式警告の段階と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch Ebola diễn biến phức tạp, Bộ Y tế họp khẩn
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak becomes more complex; the Ministry of Health holds an emergency meeting.
article.articleSummary: May 22, 2026: Vietnam’s Ministry of Health convened an emergency meeting as Ebola outbreaks intensify in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri, North Kivu) and Uganda. As of May 18, Congo reported 516 suspected cases and 131 deaths across Ituri and North Kivu—the 17th outbreak since 1976; Ituri, North Kivu have seen healthcare worker deaths (4 by May 5). Uganda reports 2 lab-confirmed cases and 1 death, including an imported Kampala case on May 15 linked to Congo and a second imported case around May 16. In Ituri, by May 16 there were 8 lab-confirmed, 246 suspected, and 80 deaths among suspected. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain is involved. Symptoms include fever, fatigue, headache, myalgia, sore throat, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, rash, with some bleeding; incubation 2–21 days. WHO assesses high regional risk, low global risk. Measures emphasize border/healthcare surveillance, rapid-response teams, and contingency planning; Vietnam remains vigilant for possible importation.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が複雑化、保健省が緊急会議を開催
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は極めて深刻な公衆衛生上の影響を持ち、複数国での同時流行は国際的拡大リスクが高く、渡航・貿易制限の対象となる可能性がある。
triage.notes: 記事はベトナムのメディアソースだが、主題はコンゴ民主共和国およびウガンダでのエボラ流行。ウガンダはGeoNamesリストに含まれていないため対象国から除外。ベトナムは警戒段階であり、現在の発生は報告されていない。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株による流行で、致死率が高く、healthcare workerの死亡も確認されている。WHO高リスク評価と複数国での確認がRRA実施を正当化する。

article.articleHeadline: RDC eleva a más de 670 los casos sospechosos y a 160 las muertes sospechosas por el brote de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC rises to more than 670 suspected cases and 160 suspected deaths from the Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: DRC's Ituri province reports ongoing Ebola outbreak with 671 suspected cases and 160 suspected deaths; lab confirmation totals 64 cases (60 in Ituri, 4 in North Kivu) and 6 deaths (4 Ituri, 2 North Kivu). Mongbwalu, Ituri, has 317 suspected cases (13 confirmed) and 80 suspected deaths; Rwampara has 179 suspected cases (24 confirmed) and 44 suspected deaths. About 800 contacts identified. Bunia reports 125 suspected cases (11 confirmed); Nyankunda and Bambu (Ituri), plus Goma, Katwa, Butembo in North Kivu, include other cases, with M23 involvement in parts. In the last 24 hours, 13 new cases (12 Ituri, 1 North Kivu); no new lab-confirmed deaths. A total of 160 patients have recovered. WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern; Uganda reported at least one death. Bundibugyo strain has ~50% fatality and limited vaccines/treatments amid displacement. DRC has Ebola experience; Kasai outbreak ended December 2025; origin traced to Yambuku, 1976.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱の流行で670件以上の疑い患者と160件の疑い死亡を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模集団発生、WHO により国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）宣言済み、ウガンダへの国際的拡大確認、高い致死率と国際的対応の必要性が明らかである。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域に Bambù (イタリア、GeoNames ID 8964792)、Veneto (イタリア、ID 3164604)、Italian Republic (ID 3175395) が誤って含まれているが、記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国の Ituri 州および Nord-Kivu 州、ウガンダでの発生を記述している。記事中に明記されている通り、WHO により PHEIC 宣言済み。Bundibugyo 株による~50% の致死率、ワクチン・治療薬の限定性、M23 による不安定化が懸念。ウガンダでの最低1名の死亡が確認されており、国際的拡大リスクは高い。

article.articleHeadline: Saudi Arabia 'fully prepared' to protect Hajj pilgrims amid global virus concerns | The National
article.articleSummary: Saudi health authorities say the epidemiological surveillance system is fully prepared to safeguard citizens, residents and about 1.5 million Hajj pilgrims arriving in Makkah as the pilgrimage begins May 25, 2026. In light of global virus concerns, including Ebola outbreaks in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of the Congo that prompted the WHO to declare a public health emergency of international concern, precautionary measures have been tightened for travellers from Uganda, South Sudan, Rwanda, Burundi, Tanzania and the Republic of the Congo. Hantavirus fears have circulated as well. Iranian pilgrims are among arrivals, amid regional tensions and Saudi drone attacks launched from Iraqi territory. The kingdom has added shaded routes and positioned at least 34 medical units near holy sites to maintain safety. No local transmission data provided; authorities emphasize preparedness for imported risks during the Hajj period.

triage.headline_ja: サウジアラビア、世界的なウイルス懸念の中、ハッジ巡礼者保護に「完全に準備完了」と表明
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がウガンダおよびコンゴ民主共和国で発生し、WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言している。150万人規模のハッジ巡礼者の集合イベント開催と重なり、国際的な拡大および渡航制限のリスクが高い。IHR基準で複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、ウガンダおよびコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ発生が明記されている。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRC（203312）のみであるため、verified_locationsに含める。ハンタウイルスへの懸念も言及されているが、具体的な発生国は記載されていない。ハッジ期間中の大規模国際集合イベントであり、国際的感染拡大リスクは極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Africa summit in India postponed over Ebola outbreak fears
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda prompted the postponement of the Africa-India Forum Summit in Delhi (28–31 May) due to a public health emergency of international concern declared by the WHO. About 600 suspected Ebola cases and 139 suspected deaths have been reported; cases remain confined to Africa so far. The outbreak involves a rare Ebola species with no vaccine, with the epicenter in conflict-affected areas; urbanisation is increasing transmission risk. Ebola symptoms begin with fever, headache and tiredness, then vomiting and diarrhoea, possibly leading to organ failure and bleeding; incubation ranges from 2 to 21 days. Transmission occurs via contact with infected bodily fluids, with animal reservoirs typically fruit bats involved in spillover. No India cases reported, but India’s DGHS issued a travel health advisory for arrivals from Ebola-affected countries, urging symptom reporting within 21 days and medical care if exposure or symptoms occur.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行懸念によりアフリカサミットがインドで延期
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模流行で公衆衛生への深刻な影響、WHO緊急事態宣言による国際的関心、渡航制限・サミット延期による影響があり、国際的拡大リスクも存在。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーによると、エボラ流行はDRCとウガンダで発生しており、インドではまだ確認例なし。ただしインドが対象国リストに含まれるため、インドの公衆衛生対応（渡航勧告発令）および国際的影響（アフリカ・インドフォーラムサミット延期）の観点から verified_locations に含める。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。WHO PHEIC宣言済みで、ワクチンなしの稀なエボラ種で紛争地域での流行という高リスク要因あり。

article.articleHeadline: Из-за вспышки лихорадки Эбола в Африке свердловские туристы попали в группу риска
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Due to the Ebola fever outbreak in Africa, Sverdlovsk tourists are at risk.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease risk to Sverdlovsk tourists in Africa. Sverdlovsk residents vacationing at popular Kenyan and Tanzanian resorts may be at risk of Ebola infection. Kenya and Tanzania are classified as territories with elevated epidemiological risk due to proximity to the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, where active Ebola outbreaks have been recorded. The alert was communicated to URA.RU by Mikhail Maltsev, president of the Ural Association of Tourism. The report does not specify local case counts; the concern is elevated regional risk affecting travelers from the Sverdlovsk region as of May 22, 2026. This is a precautionary warning rather than a confirmed outbreak in those destinations.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカのエボラ出血熱流行の影響でスヴェルドロフスク地域の観光客がリスク状態に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラウイルス病は高病原性で、DRCおよびウガンダでの活発な流行が報告されており、ケニア・タンザニアでの観光客のリスク評価は国際的懸念事項。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはエボラの地域的リスク警告であり、ケニア・タンザニア・ウガンダ・ロシア（Sverdlovsk）は地理的参照として言及されているが、実際の確認感染症イベントはDRCに限定されている。ウガンダはWPRO対象国リストにないため除外。2026年5月という未来の日付が含まれるが、このシステム指示の想定範囲外。

article.articleHeadline: Pemkot Tebing Tinggi luncurkan "Pintu Radiasi" percepat deteksi TB
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tebing Tinggi City Government launches 'Radiation Portal' to speed up TB detection.
article.articleSummary: As of May 22, 2026, Tebing Tinggi City Health Office in North Sumatra launches the 'Pintu Radiasi' program, a TB early-detection initiative using portable X-ray screening conducted at 31 sites including districts, subdistricts, markets, factories, prisons, and housing blocks, with thousands screened through Q3 2026. The initiative reduces diagnostic turnaround from up to two weeks to about two days, under the tagline 'Layanan X-Ray Datang, TB Kita Berantas.' Health officials frame TB as influenced by social factors such as crowded housing and sanitation and emphasize reinforced Germas and PHBS campaigns. Mayor Iman Irdian Saragih warns that untreated TB can transmit to 10–15 people, underscoring the need for community awareness, proactive screening, and sustained treatment support to interrupt transmission chains. The program aims to accelerate case finding, enable faster treatment, and strengthen overall TB prevention and control.

triage.headline_ja: テビン・ティンギ市政府が結核検出を加速させる「放射線ポータル」を展開
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（北スマトラ州テビン・ティンギ市）における結核対策の新規イニシアティブに関する報道。公衆衛生介入の取り組みであり、異常事態ではなく、重症度や国際的拡大リスクの具体的証拠は記事に記載されていない。スクリーニング基準の1つ以上該当の可能性があるが、情報不足のため経過観察段階が適切。
triage.notes: 本記事は結核の新規発生事例ではなく、インドネシア・北スマトラ州テビン・ティンギ市における結核検出・診断の加速を目的とした公衆衛生プログラムの展開に関する報道である。市長が既存患者からの伝播リスク（1人あたり10-15人への感染可能性）を警告しており、長期曝露リスク（prolonged_exposure）と流行しやすさ（epidemic_prone）の基準に該当する可能性がある。しかし、この記事は既存の結核問題に対する対応策であり、新規の感染症危機を示唆するものではない。社会的・政治的関心は高いが、追加情報なしでフルRRA判定は不適切。

article.articleHeadline: Родственники жертвы Эболы сожгли медицинский центр в Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Relatives of an Ebola victim burned a medical center in Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of May 22, 2026, eight confirmed Ebola cases and about 80 suspected fatalities have been reported in the northeast Democratic Republic of Congo, linked to Bundibugyo ebolavirus. The World Health Organization has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, with Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warning of rapid transmission and noting no licensed treatments or vaccines. In the city of Rwampara, relatives of a footballer who died reportedly tried to reclaim his body from a hospital, but were refused due to the infectiousness of the remains. The attack set two hospital tents on fire, prompting the relocation of six patients to the main building. The mother asserted her son died of typhoid, not Ebola, highlighting ongoing containment challenges and heightened response for affected facilities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ患者の遺族が医療センターを焼き払う
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。WHO公式発表のPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）宣言、急速な伝播リスク、治療法・ワクチン欠如、複数の疑い死亡例、医療施設への暴力的妨害により管理可能性が低下。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは発生地がDRC北東部と明記。Rwandaはサマリーに登場しないため除外。Kigali Provinceも同様に除外。本件はBundibugyo ebolavirus（BDBV）によるアウトブレイク。医療施設への暴力的妨害は対応と疾病抑制に深刻なリスク。WHOによるPHEIC宣言により国際的な関心と対応が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: aux États-Unis, les voyageurs passés par la RDC, d'Ouganda et du Soudan du Sud forcés d'atterrir en Virginie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: In the United States, travelers who had passed through the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan were forced to land in Virginia.
article.articleSummary: Since May 21, 2026, travelers who have spent the prior 21 days in Ebola-affected Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), Uganda, or South Sudan are restricted to entering the United States via Washington Dulles International Airport near Washington, D.C. They undergo enhanced screening, including interrogations and medical testing, under a rule published by U.S. Customs and Border Protection. Initially targeting Americans and lawful permanent residents, a revised version broadens coverage to all non-U.S. travelers who visited these three countries in the last 21 days. The policy addresses ongoing Ebola outbreaks in those nations. In practice, a Paris–Detroit Air France flight was diverted to Montreal on Wednesday to disembark a Congolese national under these measures, illustrating enforcement of the rule on international air travel.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：米国では、民主共和国コンゴ、ウガンダ、南スーダンを経由した旅行者がバージニア州への着陸を余儀なくされている
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は重篤な感染症であり、DRC、ウガンダを含む対象国での発生が確認されている。国際的な移動制限措置が実施されており、IHR基準における国際的拡大リスクと渡航制限の両方が該当する。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが米国やカナダの都市を発生地域として付与しているが、これらは検疫・移動制限の実施地であり、実際のエボラ発生地ではない。記事サマリーから、エボラの実際の発生国はDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンであり、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当する。ウガンダは記事では言及されているが対象国リストに含まれていない。南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Stellies leads efforts to curb Ebola outbreak as WHO warns of escalation
article.articleSummary: As of 22 May 2026, 600 Ebola virus disease cases and 130 deaths are linked to Bundibugyo ebolavirus in Central Africa, spanning the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda, with no vaccine available. The WHO and Africa CDC have declared a public health emergency as the outbreak is expected to escalate, aided by a four-week detection gap between symptom onset and laboratory confirmation that hinders contact tracing. Congo faces shortages of basic supplies, complicating response; South Africa has pledged $2.5 million to support interventions. Stellenbosch University’s Biomedical Research Institute (BMRI) and the Faculty of Medicine and Health Sciences (FMHS) are leading rapid-response efforts—epidemiological investigations, genomic surveillance, and monitoring of viral evolution—and are mobilizing funds to accelerate diagnostics, therapeutics, and vaccine development (none is yet validated for Bundibugyo ebolavirus). Efforts also focus on strengthened surveillance, near-community diagnostics, workforce development, and capacity-building through the NIH-Fogarty ERREP-RTP-DRC program.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス感染症の流行抑制を主導するステレンボッシュ大学、WHO が拡大の警告を発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。重篤な公衆衛生影響（600症例、130死亡）、予想外の新規ウイルス系統（Bundibugyo）、国際的拡大リスク、複数国での発生。スクリーニング基準も全て該当し、WHO・Africa CDCが緊急事態宣言済みで社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで実際のエボラ発生はコンゴとウガンダで確認されており、ウガンダは対象国リストに該当していないため verified_locations に含めない。南アフリカ（西ケープ州のステレンボッシュ）は対応支援地であり、発生地ではない。検出の遅延（4週間）、ワクチン欠如、供給不足という重大なリスク要因がある。

article.articleHeadline: Komisi V Minta Pemprov Jabar Tingkatkan Kewaspadaan terhadap Hantavirus |Republika Online
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Commission V Urges West Java Provincial Government to Heighten Vigilance Against Hantavirus
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus vigilance urged in West Java as authorities prepare for potential cases. Farabi El Fouz, a member of Commission V of the West Java DPRD, urged the West Java provincial government to heighten awareness of hantavirus spread, which is gaining attention in several countries. He advocates proactive, non-reactive measures learned from the Covid-19 pandemic, including reinforcing cross-sector coordination among the health department, health service facilities, and regencies/cities. Preparedness should cover early detection, health-service readiness, public education on hygiene, and minimizing exposure to virus-carrying animals. Ensuring hospital capacity, adequate health personnel, and laboratory facilities is essential, alongside clear, transparent public communication to prevent misinformation and panic. West Java’s experience and capacity are viewed as strengths, but vigilance and preventive measures remain priorities to keep residents safe and minimize impact.

triage.headline_ja: 第V委員会、西ジャワ州政府にハンタウイルスに対する警戒体制の強化を要求
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルスの潜在的な流行への警戒が呼びかけられているが、現在のところ具体的な患者報告や確定例がなく、情報不足。COVID-19との比較による啓発活動の段階であり、直ちにピックアップの基準は満たさない。
triage.notes: 記事は西ジャワ州でのハンタウイルス流行の可能性に対する準備・警戒体制の強化を呼びかけるもの。現時点で具体的な患者数や死亡例の報告はなく、あくまで予防的措置と事前準備に焦点が当たっている。ただし、ハンタウイルスの高い致死率と人間・動物・環境への複合的影響、そして地域当局の積極的な対応姿勢から、今後の情報展開によっては状況が変わる可能性がある。引き続き続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: U.S. is now more vulnerable to threats like hantavirus
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-22, hantavirus on a cruise ship sickened about a dozen passengers and crew, with three deaths; an ongoing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has killed about 140 people, mostly in a remote region. Public health responses were delayed in both cases as clinicians were unfamiliar with the strains involved. The piece argues U.S. biopreparedness is regressing under the second Trump administration: CDC funding, expertise, and disease surveillance have diminished, with acting directors since January 2025 and a permanent head fired after about a month. Washington withdrew from the WHO and dismantled USAID. A CSIS report notes state and local public health funding has been halved. Americans face low direct risk, but global travel allows cross-border spread, and the administration has imposed entry bans on noncitizens who recently visited Ebola-affected countries.

triage.headline_ja: 米国はハンタウイルスのような脅威に対してより脆弱になった
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当（重症度、長期曝露、流行性、管理可能性）。複数の実際の感染症イベント（クルーズ船でのハンタウイルス、DRCでの進行中のエボラアウトブレイク）が報告されており、政策的・社会的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事は複数のイベントを言及しているが、米国内のハンタウイルス（ワシントン）は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCのエボラアウトブレイク（約140人死亡）が対象国であり、実際に進行中のイベントとして確認される。米国の公衆衛生体制の弱体化が論じられており、グローバルな感染症対応能力への懸念が明確に示されている。

article.articleHeadline: UN sends emergency funds and staff to tackle Congo Ebola crisis
article.articleSummary: By 22 May 2026, the United Nations announced about $60 million from its emergency fund and deployment of additional staff to help contain an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The response faces a challenging operating environment due to conflict and high population movement. Experts believe the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no vaccine, circulated undetected for around two months in Ituri province before being identified last week. The outbreak has 670 suspected cases and 160 suspected deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 国連、コンゴのエボラ危機に対応するため緊急資金とスタッフを派遣
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症の確認事例が存在し、IHR基準4つ全て該当。ワクチンがないBundibugyo株の流行、複数ヶ月の検知漏れ、国連による緊急対応が必要な状況。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株はワクチン未開発の稀有な株。約2ヶ月間の検知漏れにより既に670疑似症例・160死亡が発生。紛争下での流行で対応が困難。国連による$60万緊急資金と人員派遣が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: 민주콩고 에볼라 확산세..."백신 임상시험까지만 수개월"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spread in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: only a few months until vaccine clinical trials.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus re-emerges in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 670 suspected cases and 160 related deaths as of May 21 local time. The outbreak’s case-fatality rate is 30–50%, and no licensed vaccine exists; vaccine clinical trials are expected to take months. The World Health Organization has declared the event a public health emergency of international concern. Neighboring Uganda has reported suspected cases. The outbreak prompted the postponement of the India–Africa Summit in New Delhi. At treatment centers, burned beds and charred facilities illustrate the crisis, while authorities directly manage the burial of suspected infection deaths to curb transmission via funerals, prompting protests from families. Analysts point to reduced international health funding following the United States’ withdrawal from WHO as potentially weakening outbreak response. The Bundibugyo strain requires continued vaccine development, with trials anticipated in the coming months.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルスが拡大...「ワクチン臨床試験まであと数ヶ月」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（670例以上の患者、30-50%の致命率による深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の再出現、国際的拡大リスク、WHO PHEIC宣言済み）。WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべて該当。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: インドについては、India-Africa Summit延期の言及により検証対象地域に含めた。しかし記事の主要な感染症イベントはコンゴ民主共和国での発生である。WHO PHEIC宣言済み、ウガンダでの疑い例報告、ワクチン未承認、高い致命率など複数の重大リスク要因が存在。

article.articleHeadline: Premier cas confirmé d'Ebola au Sud-Kivu en zone rebelle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First confirmed Ebola case in South Kivu in rebel-held territory.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease has been confirmed in South Kivu's rebel-held territory, with the first case in the Miti-Murhesa health zone, Kabare territory. A 26-year-old man who arrived from Kisangani and his village about 30 km north of Bukavu died after his condition worsened; he was treated at Kavumu, then Lwiro hospital. Samples were collected and sent for testing; the case is confirmed by AFC-M23 authorities and supported by laboratory analysis at the Institut National de Recherche Biomédicale (INRB). Two more suspected cases are under examination. Government confirmation is pending. The proximity of Kabare to Bukavu and daily cross-border trade raise concerns about wider spread. Preventive measures—handwashing stations—are expanding, while markets and bus hubs continue to host gatherings. Infectious-disease experts urge strict barrier measures and caution around handling dead animals.

triage.headline_ja: 南キヴ州の反政府勢力支配地域で初のエボラ確認症例
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス疾患の確認例が報告され、IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の地域発生、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。また、WPROスクリーニング基準でも全項目該当し、緊急シグナル識別の要件を満たしている。
triage.notes: 記事の主要な発生地域はDRC南キヴ州のカバレ地域（ブカヴ近郊）。患者はキサンガニから到着した26歳男性で、既に死亡。追加の疑似症例2件が検査中。ブカヴとの近接性と日々の越境貿易により、より広範な拡大のリスクが懸念されている。反政府勢力支配地域での発生であることが対応の複雑性を増している。

article.articleHeadline: Centre asks States to step up Ebola preparedness after WHO-declares global health emergency
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda has been declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) by the World Health Organization on May 17, 2026, with more than 80 deaths reported in DR Congo. The Indian Centre directs all States and Union Territories to strengthen surveillance, hospital preparedness and rapid response, noting high local risk near border areas such as South Sudan and a low global risk. States should intensify IDSP surveillance for unusual fever clusters and Ebola-like symptoms, especially among travelers with exposure to affected regions; warning signs include fever, weakness, muscle pain, headache, vomiting, diarrhoea, abdominal pain, rash and red eyes. An SOP on surveillance, sampling, storage and referral is issued; isolation facilities, dedicated ambulances with IPC, PPE, trained personnel and essential critical-care capacity should be ensured. NIV Pune will test samples; coordination with airport/port health authorities and State/District units is emphasized. Kerala will monitor travelers for 21 days; a rebel-held Congo area case was reported.

triage.headline_ja: WHO がグローバルヘルスエマージェンシーを宣言した後、インド中央政府がエボラ対策の強化を要請
triage.triage_reason: Ebola が PHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）として WHO により宣言され、IHR 基準の4項目すべてに該当。インドは隣接国（南スーダン）での発生に対する防衛的対応を実施中であり、シグナル認識の閾値を満たす。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はインド国内のエボラ対策強化にあるため、verified_locations に India のみを列挙。DRC・Uganda・Sudan は対象国リストに含まれず、記事の主要な発生地ではなく参考情報として扱われているため除外。インドはエボラウイルスの直接的な発生地ではないが、隣接国での PHEIC 宣言に対する公式な防衛的対応を実施しており、公衆衛生上の懸念を示唆する情報が含まれている。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: EUA Limitam Entrada de Viajantes de Países Afectados a Aeroporto de Washington
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: U.S. Restricts Entry of Travelers from Affected Countries to Washington Airport
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has killed about 139 and infected around 600, according to early CDC counts; the DRC Health Ministry later reported 160 deaths, 670 suspected cases, with 61 confirmed. The United States restricted entry for U.S. citizens who have recently been in DR Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan to travel only via Washington Dulles International Airport for enhanced public-health screening by the CDC and CBP. The policy targets passport holders; those with symptoms or exposure are diverted to hospitals, while asymptomatic travelers may continue. An Air France flight from Paris to Detroit was diverted to Montreal after a passenger from DR Congo boarded in error. The WHO has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern; the Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain has no approved treatments or vaccines. Experts warn the concentration at a single airport may cause congestion and logistical challenges, suggesting regional approaches.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：米国が影響を受けた国からの旅行者のワシントン空港への入国を制限
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な影響：139～160名死亡、600～670名感染；異常性：DRCでの大規模アウトブレイク；国際拡大リスク：複数国での症例、航空便の迂回；渡航制限実施中）。WHO緊急事態宣言済み。
triage.notes: DRCが主発生地。サマリーで確認される死亡・感染症例はすべてDRCが主因。UgandaおよびSouth Sudanは渡航制限の対象国として言及されているが、サマリーでこれらの国での実際の症例報告は明示されていない。カナダ、米国、フランスはケース管理（航空便迂回、スクリーニング）の舞台であるが、発生地ではない。WHO PHEIC宣言済み、Bundibugyo Ebolavirus（無治療・無ワクチン）。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : un homme suspecté d'être contaminé meurt, ses proches incendient l'hôpital après le refus du personnel de leur remettre le corps, six malades prennent la fuite dans la confusion
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: a man suspected of being infected dies, his relatives set fire to the hospital after the staff refused to hand over the body, six patients flee in the confusion.
article.articleSummary: Violence erupted during the Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak in Ituri, Democratic Republic of Congo, after a patient suspected of infection died at Rwampara General Hospital on May 21. Staff advised relatives against handling the body to avoid exposure; angry crowds set fire to Alima tents and clinical equipment. Six in-patients at the facility—three confirmed cases and three suspects—fled in the chaos but were later found and re-admitted. Medical staff received military protection; a health worker was injured by projectiles. Local officials said the deceased was a well-known footballer, while his mother suggested typhoid rather than Ebola. Misinformation about the disease remains. The outbreak is caused by Ebola Bundibugyo, for which there is no vaccine or approved treatment; as of May 20, more than 500 probable cases and over 130 deaths. The WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, but not a pandemic.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：感染疑いの男性が死亡、遺体引き渡し拒否後に親族が病院に放火、混乱の中で6人の患者が逃走
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO Public Health Emergency of International Concern宣言済み。エボラ出血熱は最高リスク疾患。
triage.notes: エボラBundibugyo株による活動的な流行が進行中。500例以上の疑い患者、130人以上の死亡報告。WHO Public Health Emergency of International Concern宣告済み。院内での患者逃走およびスタッフ傷害を伴う社会的混乱が発生。医療施設の機能障害リスクが高い。腸チフスの併記は記事サマリーでは故人の母親による根拠不十分な主張として記載されており、主要な疾患はエボラ出血熱。

article.articleHeadline: Allarme Ebola, restrizioni e controlli rafforzati negli aeroporti Usa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola alert, tightened restrictions and enhanced checks at U.S. airports.
article.articleSummary: CDC tightens U.S. entry rules for travelers from Ebola-affected Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan, barring foreign nationals who spent the prior 21 days in those countries from entering the United States. U.S. citizens and permanent residents who were in the same countries within 21 days may enter. Incoming travelers are diverted to a Washington international airport screening area, complete a brief travel/health questionnaire, have non-contact temperature checks, and may be monitored; those without symptoms receive health-monitoring guidance, and their contact details are shared with state and local health departments. If fever or symptoms appear, a CDC public health official will assess them. The outbreak has caused over 100 deaths; Bundibugyo ebolavirus may be underreported. WHO anticipates cases will rise and has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, though not a pandemic.

triage.headline_ja: エボラアラート、米国の空港での検査と規制強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO公衆衛生上の国際的懸念事象宣言済み。WPROスクリーニング全5項目該当。国際的なシグナルとしての優先度が高い。
triage.notes: 記事は米国の検査強化対応を述べているが、実際の発生地域はDRCであり、対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。ウガンダ・スーダンはサマリーで言及されるが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。WHO PHEIC宣言済み、死者100名以上、複数国での流行リスク。フルRRA進行を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Толпа запали центар за ебола во Конго - Trn.mk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Crowd torches Ebola center in Congo
article.articleSummary: As of May 22, 2026, in the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, a crowd set fire to part of an Ebola treatment center after relatives of a deceased man clashed with health workers over burial protocols. Medical teams insisted on safe burial procedures because Ebola bodies remain highly infectious after death. Instead of calming the situation, demonstrators hurled objects at the facility and burned isolation tents. Police fired warning shots to disperse the crowd; several staff members were protected, and one healthcare worker was injured by stones. The incident underscores deep distrust of authorities and persistent misinformation that Ebola is a foreign hoax, hampering outbreak control. WHO and local health officials reiterate that safe burials are essential to curb transmission. Already, several Ebola deaths have been reported in DRC, with cases also emerging in Uganda; authorities will heighten security around health facilities and continue investigations.

triage.headline_ja: 群衆がコンゴのエボラ治療センターに放火
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の発生地域（DRC、ウガンダ）での治療施設への暴力行為により、患者ケア継続の阻害と感染制御の重大な障害が生じており、IHR基準2つ以上（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク）およびWPRO基準複数該当。
triage.notes: ウガンダは発生地域に含まれているがサマリーの主体はDRCの治療施設暴力事件。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため included。ウガンダ（対象国リストに未含）は verified_locations から除外。治療施設の破壊、スタッフ被傷、患者隔離の中断、安全埋葬プロトコル拒否により感染制御が深刻に阻害されている状況は、フルRRA進行が必須。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا، كونغو، فيروس، السويد، كينشاسا | Sveriges Radio
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, Congo, virus, Sweden, Kinshasa | Sveriges Radio
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Africa prompts raised readiness at Sweden's Karolinska University Hospital in Huddinge, with the high-containment isolation ward prepared for potential cases. If someone in Sweden develops suspected Ebola symptoms, they would be transferred to high-containment units for care. So far, the outbreak has killed more than 130 people in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Kinshasa) and in Uganda. Infectious disease physician Elin Folkesson confirms that the risk of transmission to Sweden remains low. The measures reflect precautionary public health steps in response to the ongoing outbreak in Africa, as authorities maintain vigilance and readiness for potential cases, without reporting confirmed Swedish infections.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、コンゴ、ウイルス、スウェーデン、キンシャサ | Sveriges Radio
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルスはアフリカで発生し、スウェーデンでも高度な感染対策体制が確立されており、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念を示している。
triage.notes: エボラ発生地域はコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダである。スウェーデンは防御側であり実際の発生地ではないため、対象国リストのDRC (203312) のみを verified_locations に含める。130人以上の死亡があり重症度が高く、国際的な公衆衛生対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: From Ebola To Mpox: Why Delayed Vaccine Access Remains A Major Global Health Risk
article.articleSummary: Outbreaks of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, involving the Bundibugyo strain with no approved vaccine, underscore delays in vaccine access as deaths rise and suspected cases exceed 600, with WHO noting a vaccine candidate could take six to nine months to begin trials. In mpox outbreaks, vaccine inequality left several affected African countries waiting nearly two years for doses, illustrating a chronic global gap between wealthier nations and lower-income regions. Delayed vaccines accelerate transmission, overwhelm health systems, complicate contact tracing, fuel misinformation, and enable international spread via travel. The report emphasizes climate change, deforestation, urbanisation, conflict, and weak cooperation as drivers. WHO warns that, despite vaccine tech advances, equity in diagnostics, vaccines and therapeutics remains inadequate (Global Preparedness Monitoring Board). India is highlighted as a major vaccine producer needing faster surveillance, genomic sequencing, stockpiles, and streamlined emergency approvals.

triage.headline_ja: エボラからエムポックスまで：ワクチンアクセス遅延がなぜ重大なグローバルヘルスリスクであり続けるのか
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、異常性）。複数の高リスク病原体（エボラ、エムポックス）の同時多発アウトブレイク、死亡例と600超の疑似患者、国際的ワクチン供給不足による管理困難性が確認される。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUganda（226074）が含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRCとUgandaのエボラアウトブレイク言及後、Ugandaは確認地域として記載されず、主体はDRCアウトブレイク。一方、Indiaは「major vaccine producer」として戦略的に重要な対象国として明示的に言及されている。DRC、Ugandaともに対象国リストに含まれないため、DRCのみverified_locationsに含める。Indiaは対象国に含まれるため追加。Uganda（対象国外）は除外。複数病原体、高死亡率、ワクチン供給不足による国際的な管理困難性が確認される重大案件。

article.articleHeadline: RDC eleva a más de 670 los casos sospechosos y a 160 las muertes...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC raises suspected cases to over 670 and deaths to 160.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak in Ituri (northeast) with 671 suspected cases and 160 suspected deaths; lab confirmation totals 64 cases and 6 deaths (60/Ituri, 4/North Kivu). Mongbwalu is the hotspot with 317 suspected (13 confirmed) and 80 suspected deaths; Rwampara has 179 suspected (24 confirmed) and 44 suspected deaths. Bunia reports 125 suspected (11 confirmed); additional cases in Nyankunda, Bambu, and in Goma, Katwa, and Butembo in North Kivu, an area partially controlled by M23 rebels backed by Rwanda. In the last 24 hours, 13 new confirmed cases (12 Ituri, 1 North Kivu); no new confirmed deaths. About 160 patients have recovered. WHO declared an international emergency over the weekend; at least one death in Uganda. Bundibugyo ebolavirus has no vaccines/treatments, and population displacement increases risk. DRC leverages extensive Ebola experience since 1976 (Yambuku).

triage.headline_ja: DRCが671件の疑似症例と160件の疑似死亡例を確認、エボラ出血熱の流行
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPRO基準も5項目すべてに該当。WHOが国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言しており、複数国への拡大リスク（ウガンダでの死亡報告）と予防・治療手段の欠如を含む高リスク状況。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCのイトゥリ州およびキビウ州北部でのエボラ出血熱流行を主題としており、ウガンダでの死亡報告は記載されているが、UgandaはDRCの隣国であり副次的な言及。対象国リストに基づき、DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（2012-2013年に発見された新系統）による流行で、ワクチン・治療法の欠如と人口移動による拡大リスクが懸念される。M23反政府勢力が支配する地域での流行は対応能力を制限。WHOによる国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: 苗栗爆1例麻疹境外移入　個案足跡曾赴日月潭、清境農場　匡列112接觸者 | 生活 | 三立新聞網  SETN.COM
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Miaoli reports one imported measles case; the patient's itinerary included Sun Moon Lake and Qingjing Farm; 112 contacts traced.
article.articleSummary: As of 22 May 2026, Miaoli County, Taiwan reports one imported measles case: a foreign woman in her 30s who entered Taiwan from Thailand on 12 May. She developed fever on 15 May and a rash on 17 May; the Taiwan CDC confirmed the case on 21 May. She dined 13 May 18:00–20:00 at San Shang Qiao Fu in Toufen City’s Da Quan Lian area. The county health bureau traced 112 contacts (household, lodging providers, and medical encounters) and will monitor them through 8 June; those with overlapping footprints should self-monitor through 3 June. The patient also visited Puli, Sun Moon Lake, Formosan Aboriginal Culture Village, and Qingjing Farm during travels. Measles is highly contagious via air, droplets, and contact with secretions; infectious from four days before to four days after rash onset. Contacts without symptoms should wear masks, avoid crowded places, and reduce exposure for infants under 1 year, pregnant individuals, or immunocompromised persons.

triage.headline_ja: 苗栗で麻疹の輸入感染例が1件報告；患者の行動歴は日月潭・清境農場に及ぶ；112人の濃厚接触者を追跡
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の輸入感染例であり、WPROスクリーニング基準複数（異常/予想外、流行しやすさ）に該当するが、現時点では重症化や地域内拡大の明確な兆候に欠け、情報が限定的であるため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 台湾（香港・マカオを除く）は対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsに追加していない。タイから台湾への輸入例であり、タイのみを掲載。麻疹は高い伝播性を持つが、現在のところ台湾での二次感染確認なし。濃厚接触者の追跡と監視体制が機能している。

article.articleHeadline: ಕಾಂಗೋ, ಉಗಾಂಡಾದಲ್ಲಿ ಎಬೋಲಾ ರುದ್ರನರ್ತನ: ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಸಚಿವಾಲಯದಿಂದ ಪ್ರಯಾಣಿಕರಿಗೆ ಮಹತ್ವದ ಸೂಚನೆ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo, Uganda: Important advisory to travelers from the Ministry of Health.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks are rising in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, prompting intensified entry screening at Indian airports as of May 22, 2026. The Ministry of Health advises travellers from, or via, the DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan to report any fever, weakness, headache, muscle pain, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, sore throat, or unexplained bleeding to an airport health official before screening. Those with a history of contact with blood or body fluids of a suspected or confirmed Ebola patient should notify authorities. India reports no current Ebola cases. The World Health Organization has declared a global public health emergency, leading two high-level meetings to discuss preparedness. Ebola is a highly lethal viral hemorrhagic fever transmitted through direct contact with blood and bodily fluids, including blood, saliva, sweat, tears, vomit, stool, and breast milk, or via contact with a dead body. Symptoms typically include fever, headache, and muscle and joint pains.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、ウガンダにおけるエボラアウトブレイク：保健省から旅行者への重要な勧告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス感染症は深刻な公衆衛生影響をもたらし、複数国での同時アウトブレイク、WHO による緊急事態宣言、国際的な渡航スクリーニング実施などから、国際的脅威として認識されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、実際のエボラアウトブレイク発生国はDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンである。ウガンダと南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。インドは国際的な対応措置（空港での強化スクリーニング、旅行勧告）を実施している国として含める。Machupo（ボリビアン出血熱）は疾患リストに含まれるが、記事内容はエボラのみに言及している。WHO緊急事態宣言により国際的な関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Tăng cường giám sát, ngăn dịch Ebola xâm nhập qua Cảng Vũng Áng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Strengthen surveillance to prevent Ebola from entering through Vũng Áng Port.
article.articleSummary: As of 20 May 2026, Ebola reports show about 600 suspected cases and 139 deaths in Africa. In the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ituri and Kivu provinces, 51 cases are confirmed; Uganda reports 2 cases including 1 death in Kampala. WHO designates the situation a public health emergency of international concern. Vietnam has intensified border surveillance to prevent import via trade and transport; no direct shipments from affected regions have docked at Hà Tĩnh’s Vũng Áng Port. Hà Tĩnh’s CDC has stationed International Health Quarantine staff at the port to monitor entrants and vehicles, focusing on potential intermediate carriers such as rats. Authorities coordinate rapid response to any anomalies. People returning from affected areas should declare travel and seek medical care if symptoms appear. Ebola spreads through direct contact with blood, secretions, vomit, urine, or corpses, with fever, headache, muscle pain, diarrhea, vomiting, and possible hemorrhage.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムがエボラウイルスの侵入防止のため、ブン・アン港での監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WHO PHEIC指定のエボラ出血熱であり、複数国での確定症例・死亡例あり、ベトナムが国境監視強化を実施しており、国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはウガンダ（226074）も含まれているが、記事サマリーではウガンダでの確定症例言及はあるものの、監視強化の主体的実施国ではなく、記事の中心はDRCでのアウトブレイクとベトナムの防止対策である。DRCとベトナムが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含めた。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。WHO PHEIC指定、複数国での確定症例・死亡報告、国際的なリスク評価が高い重要シグナル。

article.articleHeadline: എബോള വൈറസ്; കൊച്ചി വിമാനത്താവളത്തിൽ മുൻകരുതൽ നടപടികൾ ശക്തമാക്കി
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus; Precautionary measures strengthened at Kochi airport.
article.articleSummary: At Kochi International Airport, precautionary measures against Ebola were strengthened amid rising transmission in African countries, notably the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. An emergency meeting led by Cochin International Airport Limited (CIAL) and the Airport Health Organization assessed the situation and agreed to tighten surveillance. A 24-hour monitoring regime will be in place, including thermal screening, visual inspection, and 21-day travel-history checks. International travelers will be asked to submit a Self-Declaration Form to immigration. Ebola is not airborne or waterborne; transmission occurs through direct contact with blood, secretions, vomitus, urine, stool, sweat, or other bodily fluids of an infected person or animal, with infection occurring after symptom onset. Animals such as bats and primates can transmit the virus to humans. The World Health Organization has declared a global health emergency, and experts caution that an effective vaccine may take months. Asianetnews is listed as a preferred source.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス；コーチン空港で予防措置が強化される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で「異常/予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」「渡航制限リスク」の3基準に該当。アフリカでの流行拡大に対応した国際的なサーベイランス強化がインドで実施されている点が、国際的な懸念事項として識別される。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はインドのコーチン空港でのエボラ対策強化であり、DRCおよびウガンダでの流行は背景情報として記載されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めていない。WHOが「グローバルヘルスエマージェンシー」を宣言している点が社会的・政治的関心を高めている。

article.articleHeadline: UN Women Warns of Repeat in Ebola's Gender Disparity
article.articleSummary: Ebola gender disparity persists: women are more likely to be infected—and thus die—during outbreaks, not because the virus is deadlier for them. In the 2018–2019 DRC outbreak, women and girls accounted for about two-thirds of reported cases. In Liberia (2014), women accounted for up to 75% of Ebola deaths; fifty years earlier in the DRC, women comprised about 56% of deaths. The current outbreak in the DRC and Uganda unfolds amid a severe humanitarian crisis that strains health services. Transmission follows social roles: caregiving, domestic labor, frontline health work, and burial practices place women in close contact during infectious stages. Pregnant women face higher risks with frequent health-service contact and historically higher mortality and adverse outcomes. Quarantine raises gender-based violence risks. UN Women calls for sustained funding, PPE, prevention training, disaggregated data, and women’s participation in decision-making.

triage.headline_ja: 国連女性機関がエボラ出血熱のジェンダー格差の繰り返しに警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の現在の発生がDRC・ウガンダで継続中であり、深刻な人的被害（特に女性）が報告されている。IHR基準で3項目以上該当し、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCとウガンダにおけるエボラ出血熱の現在の発生とジェンダーの不均衡である。Liberia（リベリア）は対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsには含めていない。本発生はWPRO基準4項目以上該当（重症度、長期曝露、流行易感受性、管理能力）し、国連や国際機関の関心も高く、継続的な国際支援が必要とされている。

article.articleHeadline: Giải mã chủng virus Ebola hiếm được WHO cảnh báo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Unraveling the Ebola virus strain rarely warned by WHO
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda is driven by the Bundibugyo strain, with more than 600 suspected cases and 139 deaths (AFP). At WHA79 in Geneva, WHO chief Tedros warned that case numbers will change as surveillance, contact tracing, and laboratory testing expand. Bundibugyo is a rare Ebola variant with no approved treatment or vaccine. A 2024 study estimates a case fatality rate of 30–40%, lower than Zaire, but the lack of specific vaccines/drugs raises concern. This is the third Bundibugyo outbreak in history (2007–2008, 2012). Surveillance faces challenges in remote, conflict-affected areas; tests may miss Bundibugyo, and endemic malaria and cholera complicate detection. Cuts in international aid have weakened health capacity. On May 17, WHO declared Ebola in DRC/Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern to mobilize funding and support, not a pandemic. Singapore, Thailand, and Indonesia have strengthened border and airport surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: WHOが警告する稀なエボラウイルス株の謎を解く
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。DRC/UgandaでのBundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク、WHO PHEICの宣言、複数国での監視強化により、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: WHO が2026年5月17日に DRC/Uganda のエボラを Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) 宣言。Bundibugyo 株は有効なワクチン・治療薬がなく、致死率30-40%。紛争地域での監視困難性と国際援助削減による保健容量低下が懸念。Singapore、Thailand、Indonesia が国境・空港監視を強化していることから、区域内での伝播リスクが認識されている。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Goodwill Ambassador Issues Rallying Cry to Accelerate International Efforts to Eliminate Leprosy: "The Last Mile Starts Now"
article.articleSummary: Yohei Sasakawa urged accelerated international action to end leprosy (Hansen’s disease) at a Geneva reception on May 18 during the 79th World Health Assembly, marking 25 years as the WHO Goodwill Ambassador for Leprosy Elimination. About 180,000 new cases are reported annually, indicating ongoing transmission despite curability, with stigma and discrimination persisting. The event, hosted by the Sasakawa Leprosy Initiative at the Palais des Nations, was attended by WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, health ministers, and Japanese officials. Sasakawa also met with Tedros, WHO regional directors, and the health ministers of 16 priority countries, including India, Brazil, and Indonesia, to discuss strengthened international cooperation. The campaign, The Last Mile Starts Now, follows Don’t Forget Leprosy as the next phase of advocacy. Sasakawa has visited 127 countries and logged over 3,700 days abroad; the Sasakawa Leprosy Initiative has contributed more than US$200 million since 1975 with The Nippon Foundation.

triage.headline_ja: WHO親善大使がハンセン病撲滅加速化を呼びかけ：「ラストマイルの開始」
triage.triage_reason: ハンセン病は慢性感染症であり、約180,000件の新規症例が毎年報告されている。ただし本記事は国際会議でのアドボカシー活動の報告であり、新規の疫学的エスカレーション、アウトブレイク、または危機的状況の兆候ではない。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 本記事はハンセン病の撲滅に向けた国際的なアドボカシー活動の報告である。WHA期間中のジュネーブでの会議開催であるが、実際の疾病発生レベルのエスカレーションや新規アウトブレイクの報告ではない。ハンセン病は周知の課題であり、異常や予想外の現象ではない。対象国（インド、ブラジル、インドネシア）で疾病が存在することは記事に明記されているが、新規情報や懸念の増加は示されていない。

article.articleHeadline: كوريا الجنوبية تصدر تحذيرات من السفر للكونغو وأوغندا بسبب إيبولا - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: South Korea issues travel advisories for Congo and Uganda due to Ebola - Youm7
article.articleSummary: South Korea issued a Level 4 travel advisory restricting travel to the Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ituri Province from 2:00 PM local time, with Koreans visiting or residing there without a special permit potentially facing penalties under the Passport Act. A separate travel warning covers all of Uganda from 10:00 AM due to Ebola. The advisories follow the World Health Organization's declaration last Sunday that Ebola outbreaks in the DRC and Uganda constitute a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). Ebola is a highly contagious, life-threatening disease transmitted through close physical contact and exposure to bodily fluids.

triage.headline_ja: 韓国、エボラ熱を理由にコンゴとウガンダへの渡航警告を発令 - ユーム7
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（重大な公衆衛生上の影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHOがPHEIC宣言した複数国での同時エボラ発生であり、複数国の政府が渡航警告を発令している。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのイトゥリ州とウガンダでのエボラ発生とそれに対する韓国の渡航警告について報じている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCはリストに含まれるため記載。WHOのPHEIC宣言に基づく多国家レベルの対応が報じられており、国際的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Pemkab komitmen wujudkan Gunung Mas bebas malaria pada 2030
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Regency government is committed to making Gunung Mas malaria-free by 2030.
article.articleSummary: Gunung Mas Regency, Central Kalimantan, commits to maintaining a malaria-free status by 2030 through strengthened medical competency and ongoing surveillance after receiving a malaria elimination certificate in 2023 from the Ministry of Health. Malaria, transmitted by female Anopheles mosquitoes, remains a concern due to its impact on productivity and welfare. The Gunung Mas Health Office (Dinkes) conducted a six-day Malaria Management Training for medical facility staff from May 18–23, 2026 in Palangka Raya, with 19 participants (doctors and nurses from puskesmas and hospitals in Gunung Mas). Training covers early detection, diagnosis, treatment, and case management per current standards. Kepala Bapelkes Kalimantan Tengah Idayati supported the effort, hoping participants implement the skills locally to accelerate malaria elimination in Gunung Mas.

triage.headline_ja: グヌン・マス県政府、2030年までにグヌン・マスをマラリア撲滅地域にする取り組みに尽力
triage.triage_reason: マラリア撲滅に向けた能力構築と監視強化の取り組みについての報道であり、新規の流行・集団発生ではなく、既に2023年に撲滅認定を受けた地域での維持管理活動。IHR基準及びWPRO基準に該当する要件がない。
triage.notes: グヌン・マス県は2023年にマラリア撲滅認定を受けており、本記事は撲滅状態の維持・強化を目的とした医療職研修の実施に関するもの。新規の患者集団発生や異常増加を示す証拠なし。これは疾病コントロール・能力構築の好事例であるが、シグナルトリアージ対象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: DRC World Cup camp adjusted as Ebola outbreak spreads
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has triggered adjustments to the country's World Cup preparations. The outbreak has produced hundreds of suspected cases and more than 130 deaths, with the World Health Organization declaring a public health emergency of international concern. In response, the DRC canceled a Kinshasa camp and a public farewell, relocating training to Europe and arranging warm-up matches in Belgium and Spain. U.S. entry bans for travelers from affected regions and broader health cautions are shaping travel logistics and security for teams and fans. The DRC squad and coaching staff are based largely outside the country, with some personnel leaving Kinshasa as measures take effect. Officials warn of potential late schedule changes or travel disruptions if containment efforts falter, highlighting ongoing sport-health coordination.

triage.headline_ja: DRCワールドカップキャンプがエボラ感染拡大で調整される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の感染拡大、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響（130人以上の死亡）、WHOによるPHEIC宣言、国際的な渡航制限（米国の入国禁止）が確認されている。
triage.notes: エボラ・ブンディブギョ種の感染拡大。WHOがPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言。100名以上の死亡者。複数国への国際的影響（ベルギー、スペインでのワールドカップ準備試合、米国による渡航制限）が確認されている。フルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）の実施が急務。

article.articleHeadline: U.S. funnels all travellers from Congo, Uganda and South Sudan through one airport as Ebola fears escalate
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has killed more than 160 and infected over 600 suspected cases. WHO has declared a public health emergency of international concern; no approved vaccines or treatments exist for the Bundibugyo strain. As of 2026-05-22, the United States requires all U.S.-bound citizens and permanent residents who recently traveled through the DRC, Uganda or South Sudan to arrive only at Washington Dulles International Airport for enhanced screening. Travelers from the affected countries within the prior 21 days are subjected to temperature checks and CDC questioning; those with suspected exposure are isolated for testing. CDC has invoked Title 42 for at least 30 days restricting entry for many non-citizens who traveled through the affected countries. The policy has disrupted travel; incidents include an diverted Air France route and American aid workers infected or exposed, treated in Germany and the Czech Republic.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がコンゴ、ウガンダ、南スーダンからの全旅行者を1つの空港に集約、エボラ熱懸念が高まる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限）。Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスの流行により160人以上の死亡、600人以上の疑い患者が発生し、WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言。米国での検疫体制整備と国際的な医療対応が進行中。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのBundibugyo型エボラ流行が主題。ウガンダと南スーダンは米国の渡航制限の対象国として言及されているが、これらの国での流行状況の詳細は記事に記載されていないため、実際の発生地として確認できるのはDRCのみ。米国、ドイツ、チェコは医療対応・患者治療国として言及されているが、発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع عدد حالات الإيبولا في الكونغو إلى 671 حالة مشتبه بها
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola cases in the Congo has risen to 671 suspected cases.
article.articleSummary: As of May 22, 2026, Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is concentrated in Ituri Province near Uganda and South Sudan. The Ministry of Health reports 671 suspected cases and 160 suspected deaths, with 64 laboratory-confirmed cases and 6 lab-confirmed deaths. The World Health Organization notes nearly 600 suspected cases and over 130 suspected deaths. In Uganda, authorities report two confirmed cases, both Congolese nationals, with no new infections added to those confirmed. The outbreak involves the Bundibugyo strain, a rare Ebola lineage, marking the seventeenth Ebola outbreak in the DRC since 1976. Ituri remains the epicenter with cross-border transmission risk to Uganda and South Sudan.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ患者数が671疑い患者に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を4/4項目で満たす。Bundibugyo株による大規模エボラ流行であり、深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な発生、複数国への国際的拡大リスク、および渡航・貿易制限のリスクがすべて認められる。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダとスーダンも言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれず、スーダンも同様。DRCが主要な発生地であり、同国のみを verified_locations に含める。Bundibugyo株は稀なエボラ系統であり、DRC内での第17回目の流行。Ituri州での集中発生と国境を越えた伝播リスクが確認される。

article.articleHeadline: 境外麻疹確診個案曾於南投縣活動　衛生局呼籲疑似症狀儘速就醫告知活動史 | yam News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Overseas measles-confirmed case had been active in Nantou County; Health Bureau urges those with suspected symptoms to seek medical care promptly and report their activity history.
article.articleSummary: An overseas-confirmed measles case visited Nantou County during the contagious period (May 14–16), leading the Nantou Health Bureau to identify 38 contacts, all currently asymptomatic. Venues have been disinfected and those with overlapping footprints should self-monitor through June 3, watching for rash, fever, cough, runny nose, photophobia, tearing, or conjunctivitis, and promptly seek care while reporting travel and exposure history. During monitoring, individuals should avoid public places and wear a mask. Health officials note measles virus survives 1–2 hours in the environment and urge vigilance amid ongoing international outbreaks (Japan, Vietnam, Central Asia, the Americas, Europe). Travelers are advised to consider MMR vaccination 2–4 weeks before departure; after returning, perform 18 days of self-health surveillance and inform clinicians of TOCC. For guidance, call 1922 or Nantou County 049-2220904."} }{

triage.headline_ja: 境外麻疹確診個案曾於南投縣活動　衛生局呼籲疑似症狀儘速就醫告知活動史
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準で5項目すべて該当。麻疹は報告義務疾患で、海外確定症例の入境と複数接触者の特定は公衆衛生上の懸念。対象国Vietnam経由の国際流行との関連も示唆されている。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は台湾・南投県での麻疹接触者対応であるが、対象国リストでは台湾は含まれない（Chinaではなく独立した地域扱い）。しかしサマリーで明示されている「Japan, Vietnam, Central Asia, the Americas, Europe」の国際流行言及により、Vietnam（対象国）が確認される。複数接触者の特定と環境消毒措置の実施、ワクチン接種勧奨の発出など、対応体制が既に動員されている。

article.articleHeadline: Allarme Ebola, restrizioni e controlli rafforzati negli aeroporti Usa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola alert, tightened restrictions and strengthened checks at US airports.
article.articleSummary: CDC imposes entry bans and enhanced screening for travelers who in the previous 21 days were in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan, tightening Ebola-related border controls in the United States. Foreign nationals are denied entry; US citizens, permanent residents, and others who were in these countries may enter. Affected travelers will be rerouted to Washington's airport as an entry 'port' and screened in a dedicated area, where they complete a brief travel history and symptoms questionnaire, and have their temperature checked with non-contact devices. Those without symptoms receive health-monitoring guidance; data are shared with state and local health departments for follow-up. If fever or other signs appear, a CDC public health official will assess the traveler. The Ebola outbreak linked to Bundibugyo virus has killed over 100; WHO expects further growth, though a PHEIC declared May 17 (not a pandemic).

triage.headline_ja: エボラ警報、米国の空港での制限強化と検査強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を3つ満たす（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）。WHOがPHEIC宣言済みのエボラ流行に対する国境措置であり、公式シグナルとして扱う必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は米国での対応措置であるが、サマリーが明示するエボラ流行の発生地はDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当するため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。WHOは2026年5月17日にPHEIC宣言、100名以上の死亡報告あり。Bundibugyo ebola virusによる流行。

article.articleHeadline: 男子在东南亚高烧不退回国救治：感染罕见病"Q热"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Man with a persistent high fever in Southeast Asia returns home for treatment: infected with the rare disease Q fever.
article.articleSummary: During the May Day holiday, a 44-year-old Chinese man (Mr. Zhang) working in Thailand developed persistent high fever (>39°C), severe headache, myalgia, and loss of appetite. Self-treatment failed and he returned to Shanghai, where Ruijin Hospital’s Infectious Diseases Department treated him. Routine tests could not identify the cause; standard anti-infective therapy was ineffective. Peripheral blood metagenomic next-generation sequencing detected Coxiella burnetii, confirming Q fever (Q fever rickettsial infection), a rare zoonosis. Investigation traced exposure to rural Southeast Asian livestock environments near his housing, with daily passage by cattle and sheep farms and contact with contaminated dust/aerosols. Q fever is mainly transmitted by inhalation of contaminated aerosols and has a 2–4 week incubation; it can present with fever, rigors, fatigue, headache, and myalgia, with possible pneumonia or hepatitis. After initiating minocycline, his fever fell and symptoms improved by the next day.

triage.headline_ja: 東南アジアで高熱が続く男性が帰国治療：稀な病気「Q熱」に感染
triage.triage_reason: Q熱（コクシエラ・バーネッティ感染症）は稀な人獣共通感染症であり、異常・予想外の診断例として注目に値するが、現時点では単一症例報告であり国際的拡大のリスクやIHR基準2つ以上の該当が確認されない。社会的関心と情報精度から経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は東南アジア（タイ）での職業上の曝露と中国（上海）での治療を報告する単一症例。Q熱は職業関連感染症として既知だが、本例は稀な診断例として医学的関心を集めている。現時点では流行兆候や複数症例の報告はない。タイでの曝露地点が記述されているため両国を verified_locations に含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Cúpula africana na Índia é adiada por temores de surto de Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: African summit in India postponed due to fears of an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: India-Africa summit in Delhi, scheduled May 28–31, was postponed amid the Ebola crisis in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. Although India has reported no cases, the Directorate General of Health Services issued a travel alert advising passengers from affected countries to seek medical care within 21 days if symptomatic or after contact with infected individuals. The decision followed a WHO declaration a few days earlier. WHO reports about 600 suspected Ebola cases and 139 suspected deaths, with the outbreak centered in a conflict-affected region and involving a rare strain for which no vaccine exists. Ebola is a viral disease transmitted via bodily fluids; incubation 2–21 days, with fever, headache and malaise as initial symptoms, potentially progressing to vomiting, diarrhea, organ failure, and bleeding. India has not recorded cases; travelers should report to airport health authorities and seek care if symptoms occur, especially with direct contact.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスの流行への懸念からインドのアフリカ首脳会談が延期される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当し、国際的に重要な感染症イベント（エボラウイルス）の発生が複数国で確認されている。インドではまだ症例報告はないが、外交行事の延期というレベルでの社会的・政治的関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでのエボラ流行が主題。インドはまだ患者報告がないが、首脳会談延期などの二次的影響を通じて国際イベントとして注視されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。WHO報告では約600例の疑い患者と139例の疑い死亡がある。ワクチン非存在の稀なウイルス株であり、紛争地帯での流行という複合的なリスク要因がある。

article.articleHeadline: Allarme Ebola, restrizioni e controlli rafforzati negli aeroporti Usa - Sassari Notizie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola alert, tightened restrictions and enhanced checks at U.S. airports - Sassari Notizie
article.articleSummary: CDC tightens U.S. Ebola controls for travelers who recently visited the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan as of May 22, 2026. Foreign nationals who spent the last 21 days in these countries are barred from entering the United States; U.S. citizens, permanent residents, and others who were in these countries are allowed entry but face enhanced screening. Airlines will rebook such travelers to Washington International Airport as the entry point. In screening, travelers go to a dedicated area, answer a brief travel/symptom questionnaire, and have temperatures checked with non-contact thermometers. Those asymptomatic receive health-monitoring guidance; symptomatic individuals are examined by a CDC public health official. Data on travelers will be shared with state and local health departments for follow-up. Ebola (Bundibugyo virus) has caused over 100 deaths; outbreak size may be larger than reported. WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, not a pandemic, with numbers expected to rise.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ警報、米国の空港での制限と検査が強化される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当。WHOがPublic Health Emergency of International Concern(PHEIC)を宣言し、複数国での流行、国際的な渡航制限が実施されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、DRCの流行が中心であり、ウガンダおよび南スーダンは渡航制限の対象国として言及されているが、実際のエボラ発生の主舞台はDRCと記述されている。WHOがPHEIC宣言済み。100名以上の死亡が報告され、実際の流行規模はさらに大きい可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Bộ Y tế chỉ ra 4 điểm bất thường của đợt dịch Ebola khiến hơn 130 người tử vong
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ministry of Health points out four unusual features of the Ebola outbreak that has claimed more than 130 lives.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, driven by the Bundibugyo strain, shows four unusual features: community death clusters with Ebola-like symptoms; uncertain true case counts and transmission scope; a high positive-rate among tested samples (8 of 13 across multiple areas); and documented cross-border spread to neighboring countries. As of May 18, there are 516 suspected cases and 131 deaths, with case fatality up to 90%. WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern on May 17, 2026. Vietnam considers importation risk low but non-zero, especially for travelers from Congo and Uganda. There is no vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo; vaccines exist for other Ebola strains. Vietnam’s National Institute of Hygiene and Epidemiology and Ho Chi Minh City Pasteur Institute have BSL-3 capabilities and are awaiting WHO diagnostic reagents (7–10 days) to support testing and sequencing investing in border surveillance and national readiness.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省がエボラ出血熱流行の4つの異常な特徴を指摘、130人以上が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な特徴、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHOが国際的懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言し、死亡者131人、症例致死率90%と重篤。対象地域（DRC、ウガンダ）での流行とベトナムへのリスク評価が明示されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCとウガンダでのエボラ流行を主題としており、ベトナムはリスク評価と対応準備の文脈で登場。Bluedot APIの発生地域にはホーチミン市、ベトナムが含まれているが、実際の流行発生地はDRCとウガンダ。ベトナムは「輸入リスク」評価と検査態勢整備の対象国として含める。ウガンダ（226074）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ripescaggio Italia ai Mondiali 2026, Paolo Zampolli vuole escludere il Congo dopo l'Iran per il virus Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Italy's 2026 World Cup playoff: Paolo Zampolli wants to exclude Congo after Iran because of the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: Paolo Zampolli, Donald Trump’s envoy for global partnerships, suggests Italy could be reinstated for the 2026 World Cup if a slot opens, replacing Congo due to a severe Ebola outbreak. The Congo’s epidemic, involving the Bundibugyo strain—with no vaccines or specific therapies reported—has prompted the WHO to declare an international health emergency and to impose the outbreak as a major concern. Training camps were canceled and Congo players are reportedly training in Belgium. Iran’s participation had been previously guaranteed, but the Congo situation injects a new consideration for an Italian invitation to the United States–Mexico–Canada tournament. In Ituri province’s Rwampara, tensions rose as residents allegedly set fire to a care center after being barred from retrieving a body; authorities stressed proper burials per safety protocols. The report cites La Gazzetta dello Sport and Associated Press.

triage.headline_ja: イタリアの2026年ワールドカップ予選：パオロ・ザンポーリがエボラウイルスを理由にコンゴを除外したいと主張
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの国際的な公衆衛生上の重大な影響、WHO国際保健緊急事態宣言、複数国への潜在的な拡大リスク、および国際的な渡航・貿易制限の可能性からIHR基準2つ以上に該当し、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事のBluedot APIが付与した「発生地域」にはルワンダ、米国、イタリア、イラン、カナダ、ベルギー、メキシコが含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題は「コンゴでのエボラ流行」であり、他国は国際的な対応・渡航制限の文脈で言及されているのみ。したがって verified_locations はコンゴ（DRC）のみとした。Ituri州はコンゴ内の地域であり、国レベルでは対象国リストにDRCが含まれるため適切に識別された。

article.articleHeadline: Röda Korset bekämpar rykten om ebola i Kongo-Kinshasa | Sveriges Radio
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Red Cross fights rumors about Ebola in Kongo-Kinshasa.
article.articleSummary: Outbreaks of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo's Kongo-Kinshasa region and in Uganda compel aid organizations to fight both the virus and rumor-driven anger that leads to attacks on healthcare. The Red Cross says it follows up every rumor to counter misinformation and protect care workers. BBC reports that a family refused to accept that a young man died of Ebola, after which hospital tents were burned in eastern Congo, illustrating how fear and misinformation can escalate violence against responders. In response, authorities and partners emphasize community engagement, including music-based Ebola awareness campaigns that use songs to highlight the dangers of the disease. As of May 22, 2026, the situation underscores the need for accurate information, infection control, and protection of health facilities during cross-border outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: 赤十字がコンゴ・キンシャサのエボラに関する噂と戦う
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の複数国（DRC・ウガンダ）での同時発生であり、IHR基準で重症度・異常性・国際拡大リスク・医療施設への暴力的干渉など複数基準に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度、流行易性、管理可能性で懸念あり。国際的な公衆衛生危機として速やかなフルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでウガンダの言及がありますが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを列挙。エボラ発生は極めて深刻な公衆衛生危機であり、医療施設への攻撃、誤情報による社会的混乱、クロスボーダー感染リスクなどが顕在化している。継続的な報告と対応の監視が不可欠。

article.articleHeadline: Situația se agravează în Congo, unde epidemia de Ebola pare scăpată de sub control
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The situation is worsening in Congo, where the Ebola outbreak seems to be out of control.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) worsens, with first infections reported in Sud-Kivu and spread from Ituri amid a strained health response. The WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern for the 17th outbreak in eastern DRC. INSP reports 64 confirmed cases and 6 deaths in the DRC, with about 671 suspected cases and 160 fatalities overall. The Bundibugyo strain has crossed into North Kivu and South Kivu near front lines with the M23 rebels; Goma records a new positive case in Kabare. Ituri remains hard-hit, including the Kigonze refugee camp near Bunia with 16,000 people lacking sanitation. No licensed vaccine or treatment exists; control relies on prevention and rapid case detection. Uganda reports a case and one death and has suspended transport to DRC; additional border health measures are being implemented by the US and others.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで状況が悪化、エボラ流行が制御不能に見える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。エボラウイルス病のアウトブレイクで複数国（DRC、ウガンダ）に確認、WHOがPHEIC宣言、国際的な懸念が極めて高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの症例報告もあるが、記事の主題はDRCでのアウトブレイク。WHOがPHEIC宣言済み。Bundibugyo株の国際的拡大、難民キャンプでの曝露リスク、治療法不在などから極度に懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola situation evolving rapidly, Irish medic warns
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo is widening. Roughly 600 suspected cases have been recorded and more than 140 deaths, prompting the World Health Organization to declare a public health emergency of international concern. The outbreak began in Ituri in the northeast and has evolved rapidly; clusters are spreading to bordering provinces, including North Kivu, with MSF warning the true scale is likely undercounted. An MSF treatment centre in the worst-affected area is operating at full capacity, while Dr Eve Robinson, in Goma near the Rwanda border, cautions the situation could worsen in coming weeks. There is no vaccine for this Ebola strain, and it could be several months before one is available. Control hinges on community engagement, health education, isolation procedures, and safe, dignified burials to halt transmission.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ状況は急速に進化している、アイルランド人医師が警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。コンゴ民主共和国東部でのエボラ感染拡大は、600件の疑い例と140以上の死亡者を含む深刻な公衆衛生上の影響を示しており、WHOによる国際的な懸念の公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言、複数州への急速な地理的拡大、ルワンダとの国境付近での発生により、国際的な拡大と渡航制限のリスクが明白である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）内の Ituri、Nord-Kivu 州での発生に焦点を当てており、ルワンダ国境への近接性について言及があるものの、実際の発生地はDRC内のみである。ルワンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsには含めない。WHOによる国際懸念の公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言は既に発出されており、最高レベルのアラート状況である。

article.articleHeadline: Congo eleva a 160 las muertes sospechosas por el brote de ébola en el este del país
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo raises to 160 the number of suspected deaths from the Ebola outbreak in the eastern part of the country.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri near Uganda) has caused 160 suspected deaths and 671 suspected cases since its declaration about a week ago. National authorities confirm 64 laboratory-confirmed cases and six deaths, with 160 recovered. The epicenter Ituri has spread to North Kivu and South Kivu, the latter controlled by the M23 rebel group, which has confirmed one Ebola death. Outside DRC, Uganda reports two imported cases in Kampala; South Sudan is testing a suspected case in Western Equatoria near the Congo border. Rwanda has closed its borders; the African Union and WHO are mobilizing resources. WHO declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, though global risk is deemed low. The outbreak likely began in Ituri about two months ago, with no licensed vaccine or approved specific treatment available.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、国内東部のエボラ出血熱流行による疑い死者数を160名に引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO PHEIC宣言済みで、WPRO地域内の複数国への波及確認により、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUganda、Rwanda、South Sudanが含まれているが、記事サマリーから直接的な患者発生の主体はDRCであり、他国は輸入症例または疑い例段階。評価対象国リストに含まれる主要発生地はDRCのみ。WHO PHEIC宣言済みで国際的な保健上の緊急事態として認識されている。

article.articleHeadline: Allarme Ebola, restrizioni e controlli rafforzati negli aeroporti Usa - InLibertà
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola alert, strengthened restrictions and checks at U.S. airports - InLibertà
article.articleSummary: US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention tightens inbound controls for travelers from the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan amid an Ebola outbreak. Foreign nationals who were in those countries in the prior 21 days are barred from entering the United States; US citizens and permanent residents who were there may enter. Affected travelers will be redirected to Washington international airport for enhanced screening and rebooking notification by air carriers. At screening, they complete a brief travel/symptom questionnaire, provide contact information, and have their temperature checked with non-contact thermometers; asymptomatic travelers receive guidance on health monitoring, while symptomatic individuals are assessed by a CDC public health official. Data will be shared with state/local health departments. The outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, has killed over 100; WHO and Imperial College warn numbers may rise, PHEIC declared but not a pandemic.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ警報、米国の空港での制限および検査強化 - InLibertà
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準でも複数該当。既にPHEIC宣言されており、米国での対策強化により社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: DRCにおけるエボラ（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）の発生事例。米国、ウガンダ、南スーダンも言及されているが、発生地として確認されているのはDRCのみ。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。100人以上の死亡が報告されており、WHOおよびImperial Collegeが症例増加の可能性を警告。既にPHEIC（Public Health Emergency of International Concern）が宣言されている。米国への影響については対象国に含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 4 điểm bất thường của dịch Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Four unusual features of the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak involving Bundibugyo strain in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri Province) and Uganda prompted WHO to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The UN agency identifies four unusual features increasing outbreak risk: (1) abnormal, community-based fatal clusters with four health workers dying from suspected Ebola linked to healthcare settings; (2) uncertainty over true infection numbers and spread; (3) a high positivity rate among tested samples (8/13) with expanding clusters across Ituri, indicating possible larger unseen caseload and local/regional transmission; (4) evidence of cross-border spread to neighboring countries. Vietnam reports no Ebola cases as of May 21, with low introduction risk from Congo and Uganda, but exposure via travelers cannot be ruled out. The Ministry of Health is coordinating with WHO, enhancing border and facility surveillance, enforcing travel-history checks, and preparing rapid-response teams and scenario plans to prevent importation and ensure swift containment.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行における4つの異常な特徴
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は国際的に重大な公衆衛生上の懸念であり、WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言している。DRCとウガンダでの発生、国境を越えた感染確認、複数の死者と医療従事者の感染が確認されており、フルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCのイトゥリ州での発生が主題であり、ウガンダへの国境越え感染も言及されている。ベトナムについては、記事内で「5月21日現在でエボラ症例は報告されていない」と明記されており、リスク評価国として言及されている（旅行者経由の導入リスク評価）ため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダ（GeoNames ID 226074）は対象国リストに含まれていないため除外した。WHOのPHEIC宣言により、国際的な懸念の高さが確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: 世足賽遇伊波拉疫情！專家稱球迷感染風險低　入境篩檢恐變嚴 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Cup faces Ebola outbreak! Experts say the infection risk for fans is low; entry screening could become stricter.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) raises World Cup concerns as the expanded World Cup, co-hosted by the United States, Canada and Mexico, approaches. WHO reports about 600 suspected Ebola cases and over 130 deaths, with the outbreak designated a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Ebola is not airborne; transmission requires close contact with severely ill patients, implying very low risk for spectators. The DRC national team canceled Kinshasa training and relocated to Belgium due to the outbreak. U.S. authorities have restricted entry for non-U.S. nationals who traveled to DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan in the past 21 days; airports like Washington Dulles will tighten screening, potentially lengthening queues. Fans should practice hand hygiene and avoid stigma. DRC is due in Houston around June 10–11 to play Portugal, with games in Guadalajara and Atlanta against Colombia and Uzbekistan; FIFA is coordinating with health officials.

triage.headline_ja: ワールドカップがエボラ疫情に直面！専門家は球迷の感染リスクは低いと主張；入境スクリーニングは厳しくなる可能性
triage.triage_reason: エボラの公式なPublic Health Emergency of International Concern（PHEIC）指定、600件以上の疑い患者、130名以上の死亡が報告されており、IHR基準（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）を複数満たす。また国際スポーツイベント（ワールドカップ）との関連で社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事では複数国の地名が出現（USA、カナダ、メキシコ、ベルギー、コロンビア、ウズベキスタン、ポルトガル、ウガンダ、南スーダン）だが、実際のエボラ疫情の発生地はDRCのみ。他国は渡航制限や入国スクリーニング、ワールドカップの試合会場としての言及に過ぎないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみを記載。PHEIC指定済みの既知の疫情であるが、国際的なスポーツイベント開催との関連で新たなシグナル価値があり、PICKUP判定。

article.articleHeadline: Thailand tightens Ebola checks for DRC and Uganda arrivals
article.articleSummary: Thailand tightens Ebola checks for arrivals from the DRC and Uganda with a three-tier system: Level 1 health observation for asymptomatic arrivals (21 days monitoring); Level 2 quarantine for high-risk travellers (close contacts identified by WHO) at Bamrasnaradura Infectious Diseases Institute (60 rooms, 90 capacity), with hospital isolation if symptoms appear; Level 3 immediate isolation for symptomatic travellers at the checkpoint. No direct flights from the DRC or Uganda. On May 21, five travellers entered Thailand (four from Uganda, one from the DRC), all asymptomatic and placed under health observation. A 20‑day retrospective counted 126 travellers from the two countries (114 Uganda, 12 DRC), mainly via Suvarnabhumi Airport; travel from these countries is about 6–7 travellers per day. Airlines may bear disease‑control costs for knowingly permitting risk passengers; violations may incur fines or imprisonment.
