Bundibugyo strain currently spreading has no vaccine; vaccines exist for Zaire strain; incubation 2–21 days; fatality 40–80%. No suspected/confirmed Ebola cases in Thailand in 2026.

triage.headline_ja: タイ、DRCおよびウガンダからの到着者に対するエボラ検査を強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo strain）の国際的拡大リスクが存在し、タイが実質的な入国スクリーニング措置を導入。IHR基準で異常性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限が該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準で流行性と長期曝露リスクが認められるため、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事はタイがDRCおよびウガンダからの到着者に対する検査措置を実施していることを報告。Bundibugyo strain（ワクチンなし、致死率40-80%）が流行中。タイではまだ確認例なしだが、継続的な入国者監視体制が構築されており、国際的な感染症リスク管理の観点から重要。Ugandaは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: '변종 에볼라'에 민주콩고에서 160명 사망, 미국은 WHO 비난했지만 '미국 책임' 더 크다
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 160 dead from an 'Ebola variant' in the Democratic Republic of the Congo; the United States criticized the WHO, but 'US responsibility' is greater.
article.articleSummary: As of May 21–22, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 670 suspected Ebola cases and 160 deaths, with 61 laboratory-confirmed, in northeastern Ituri Province (Lwampara area). The outbreak is caused by a Bundibugyo virus variant; there are no approved vaccines or established therapies. Transmission occurs via contact with blood, body fluids, feces, or contaminated objects, with funerary rites fueling spread; locals blocked strict burial controls, including arson at an Ebola treatment tent. WHO documents indicate a four-week gap from symptom onset to laboratory confirmation. The United States criticized WHO for slow response, but experts say U.S. withdrawal from WHO and cuts to USAID weakened outbreak response, reducing surveillance and logistics. The U.S. reportedly recognized the outbreak nine days after WHO, about a month after the first death. Historically, Bundibugyo lineage has caused outbreaks since 1976; the 2018–2020 outbreak in DRC caused 2,299 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 160 dead from an 'Ebola variant' in the Democratic Republic of the Congo; the United States criticized the WHO, but 'US responsibility' is greater.
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo variant）の大規模アウトブレイク（670疑い例、160死亡）が民主共和国コンゴで発生。IHR基準4つ全て該当し、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、治療法・ワクチンなし。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo variant は許可されたワクチンや確立された治療法がない。葬儀の儀式による感染拡大が課題。米国が WHO を批判しているが、USAID 削減が対応を弱化させたと指摘されている。国際的な対応支援が極めて重要。

article.articleHeadline: Una multitud prende fuego a un centro de tratamiento del ébola en RD Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A crowd sets fire to an Ebola treatment center in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri and North Kivu) escalates with 671 suspected cases and 160 suspected deaths, according to the health ministry bulletin. Laboratory testing confirms 64 cases and six deaths; 160 patients have recovered. The outbreak involves the Bundibugyo strain, with a case fatality rate estimated 30–50% and no approved vaccine or specific treatment. The virus likely began circulating in Ituri about two months ago and has spread to North and South Kivu amid ongoing conflict in the region. A crowd attacked and set fire to an Ebola treatment center in Ituri after authorities blocked retrieval of a body for burial, forcing humanitarian workers to flee. Outside DRC, Uganda reports two imported cases in Kampala; South Sudan is testing a suspected case near the Congo border. The WHO has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, though global risk remains low.

triage.headline_ja: 群衆がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ治療センターに放火
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO PHEICの宣言あり、複数国での確認症例あり。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の大規模流行。DRCでの671疑似症例・160疑似死亡、ウガンダへの輸入症例2例、南スーダンでの疑似症例検査中。WHO PHEIC宣言済み。治療センター襲撃による懸念あり。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: uma nova guerra viral
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: a new viral war.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has spread to Uganda, with more than 500 cases and at least 134 suspected deaths. The Bundibugyo subtype is less common, and there are no vaccines or antiviral treatments available for this strain. The case fatality rate is estimated around 50%. Since 1976, Ebola outbreaks linked to a likely bat reservoir have emerged in this region. In the city of Goma, health workers and soldiers monitor entries and exits to detect fever and other signs for timely containment. Transmission is not airborne, so the pandemic risk is very low, though the outbreak occurs in a conflict-affected country with limited international support.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：新しいウイルス戦争
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大、予想外のBundibugyo亜型）。WPRO基準も複数該当。DRC及びウガンダでのエボラアウトブレイク、500例以上の症例と134人の疑い死亡、致命率50%であり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaが含まれているが、記事サマリーで明確に「spread to Uganda」と述べられているため、本来はUganda（GeoNames ID 226074）も verified_locations に含めるべき。ただし対象国リストにUgandaが含まれないため、DRCのみ列挙。ウガンダでの確認は国際的拡大リスク評価において重要。Bundibugyo亜型はワクチンおよび抗ウイルス治療法が利用できない点が特に懸念される。紛争地域での限定的な国際支援体制も管理可能性を低下させている。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: تفشي الإيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية وأوغندا يتطلب تضافر الجهود
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda requires concerted efforts.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus today stated that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and neighboring Uganda requires concerted action and mobilization of all available resources. After a meeting with leaders from several organizations in WHO's network for temporary medical measures, he noted there are currently no approved treatments or vaccines for Bundibugyo ebolavirus, but research is advancing vaccines, therapeutics, and diagnostics, with calls for increased investment. Participants emphasized supporting the two affected countries’ leadership and strengthening their capacity to contain and end the outbreak. Remarks were conveyed via X (formerly Twitter) and reported by the Yemeni News Agency (SABA). Date: 2026-05-22.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダのエボラ出血熱流行は協調的な努力が必要
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱は重篤な公衆衛生上の影響を持ち、複数国での発生は国際的な拡大リスクと渡航・貿易制限のリスクが高い。WHO事務局長からの正式な声明であり社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（Uganda）は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCのみが対象国として該当。記事サマリーでは両国での発生が述べられているが、地域検証ルールに基づき対象国のみを列挙。エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）は極めて高リスクの感染症であり、WHO事務局長からの正式声明により国際的な関心と対応が喚起されている。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Goodwill Ambassador Issues Rallying Cry to Accelerate International Efforts to Eliminate Leprosy: 'The Last Mile Starts Now'
article.articleSummary: Leprosy (Hansen's disease) remains a global health challenge with roughly 180,000 new cases annually, despite curability. Yohei Sasakawa, WHO Goodwill Ambassador for Leprosy Elimination, issued a rallying cry—'The Last Mile Starts Now'—at the World Health Assembly in Geneva on May 18, 2026, urging intensified international action to finish leprosy elimination and combat stigma. The Sasakawa Leprosy Initiative and partners have supported governments in 127 countries and contributed over US$200 million since 1975, focusing on endemic countries such as India, Brazil, and Indonesia. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus acknowledged Sasakawa's leadership. Leprosy transmission persists despite cure, and stigma remains a barrier to equity. The campaign builds on the 'Don't Forget Leprosy' initiative, calling for renewed international cooperation to achieve a world without leprosy and discrimination.

triage.headline_ja: WHO親善大使がハンセン病排除への国際的取り組み加速を呼びかけ：「最後の一マイルが今始まる」
triage.triage_reason: ハンセン病の年間新規患者数は約18万件で継続的な公衆衛生課題であり、複数の対象国で流行しているが、記事の主体がWHO主催の啓発イベント・キャンペーン発表であり、新規の急性アウトブレイク情報ではないため。情報の更新を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はWHA2026でのハンセン病排除キャンペーン発表が主体。IHR基準は2つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、国際的拡大リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準も4つ該当しており、社会政治的関心も高い。しかし、新規アウトブレイク情報ではなく、既知の流行疾患に対する啓発・政策キャンペーンであるため、直ちにPickupするのではなく、ハンセン病対策の動向と各対象国での具体的な新規症例動向の続報をWatch段階で注視することが適切。

article.articleHeadline: كوريا الجنوبية تصدر تحذيرات من السفر للكونغو وأوغندا بسبب إيبولا - مصر 140
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: South Korea issues travel advisories for Congo and Uganda due to Ebola - Egypt 140
article.articleSummary: As of May 22, 2026, South Korea has imposed a Level 4 travel ban to Ituri Province in the Democratic Republic of the Congo amid an Ebola outbreak and issued a nationwide travel advisory for Uganda. The higher-level restriction in Ituri warns Korean citizens traveling there or residing without a special permit could face passport-related penalties. The warnings follow the World Health Organization declaring Ebola outbreaks in the DRC and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Ebola is a viral disease that is lethal and spread through direct contact with bodily fluids and contaminated materials. The report does not provide specific case or death counts, nor laboratory confirmation details, and does not indicate any imported or exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: 南朝鮮、エボラウイルス病によりコンゴとウガンダへの旅行警告を発令 - エジプト140
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、かつWPRO基準でも複数該当。WHOがPHEICを宣言した重大な公衆衛生緊急事態であり、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCイトゥーリ州とウガンダでのエボラ発生を報告しており、WHOがPHEIC宣言したとされている。ウガンダは対象国リストに未含有のため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。南朝鮮の旅行警告発令は国際的対応の証拠。具体的な症例数・死亡数は記事に明記されていないが、PHEC宣言と複数国への渡航制限措置の実施から重大性は明白。

article.articleHeadline: В Конго протестующие сожгли центр лечения Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, protesters burned an Ebola treatment center.
article.articleSummary: An attack on a mobile Ebola treatment center in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ituri province, in the town of Rwampara, followed health workers’ refusal to hand over the body of a man who died of Ebola. Family members wished to bury him under local tradition, but clinicians warned that Ebola bodies remain highly contagious. Residents hurled objects at the facility, sparking a fire that destroyed two mobile hospital tents and medical equipment. The incident occurred amid reports of a new Ebola strain circulating in Ituri. The report provides no case or death counts, and does not specify laboratory confirmation or infection sources.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ治療センターが抗議者により焼かれた
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス疾患の発生（Ituri州で新規株報告）に加え、治療施設への攻撃による医療機能喪失という深刻な公衆衛生上の危機。IHR基準3項目以上該当、WPRO基準複数項目該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC Ituri州における具体的なエボラ関連事象を述べており、ルワンダについても発生地域に含まれているがサマリー本文ではDRCのみが主題。新規エボラ株（Ituri州で報告）の流行状況が不明だが、治療インフラの破壊により感染拡大リスク および社会的混乱が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Alert At Kochi Airport: Thermal Screening, 21-Day Travel History Check As WHO Declares Global Emergency
article.articleSummary: Ebola alert at Kochi airport as the Bundibugyo strain drives a global emergency. The World Health Organization declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 16 for the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda; by May 20, about 600 suspected cases and 139 suspected deaths were reported. With no approved vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo, early detection is the main defence. Kochi’s Cochin International Airport Limited (CIAL) and APHO activated 24/7 health surveillance, including thermal screening, self-declaration forms, and verification of a 21-day travel history for passengers from Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan. Isolation wards have been designated at Ernakulam General Hospital, Government Hospital Kalamassery, and District Hospital Aluva. India-wide alerts followed; Delhi IGI airport issued a May 21 advisory. No confirmed India cases; symptoms appear 2–21 days after exposure and include fever, sore throat, headache, vomiting, bleeding. Mortality for Bundibugyo 30–50%.

triage.headline_ja: ココ空港でのエボラ警戒：WHOが世界的緊急事態を宣言、熱スクリーニングと21日間の渡航歴確認
triage.triage_reason: エボラ（Bundibugyo株）がWHOにより国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）として宣言され、DRCとウガンダで600件以上の疑似症例と139件の疑似死亡が報告されている。インドを含む複数国で監視体制が強化されており、IHR基準の複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはDRC（203312）、Uganda（226074）、Sudan（366755）も含まれているが、記事の主題はこれらの国での発生ではなく、インドの空港や医療施設での警戒態勢の活性化である。したがって、verified_locationsにはIndia（1269750）のみを含める。WHOがPHEIC宣言を行った（2026年5月16日）ことで国際的重大性が確認されており、ピックアップ判定は適切。

article.articleHeadline: أوغندا توقف جميع الرحلات الجوية مع الكونغو بسبب إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda halts all air travel with Congo due to Ebola.
article.articleSummary: On 22 May 2026, Uganda suspended all direct air travel with the Democratic Republic of Congo to curb Ebola virus disease (EVD) transmission. Congo reports 131 confirmed Ebola deaths amid rising cases in neighboring states. The World Health Organization has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern and warned that transmission could reach other countries. In Tunisia, authorities activated health protocols for travellers from affected areas, including thermal screening and isolation of suspected cases at designated centers. EVD transmission is through direct contact with infected bodily fluids, aiding contact tracing when isolation is properly implemented. After the previous outbreak ended in October, new hotspots in the Great Lakes region have renewed regional and international concerns about the potential re-emergence of Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、エボラの影響でコンゴとの全航空便を停止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念、複数国での影響、WHO による PHEIC 宣言、渡航制限の実施により、シグナルとしてフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: オーストラリアとニュー・サウス・ウェールズ州は発生地域に記載されているが、サマリーでは言及されていないため除外。チュニジアは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。DRCで131名の死亡が報告されており、WHO PHEIC が宣言されている。地域的な再浮上の懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) caused by the Bundibugyo variant of Ebola virus is highlighted. The Bundibugyo variant, one of five known Ebola virus variants, is circulating in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, and in Uganda. The variant has a case fatality rate of about 25–40%. Illness typically begins with influenza-like symptoms (fever, headache, muscle pains, fatigue), followed by vomiting, diarrhea, a rash, and potential organ failure; in later stages bleeding can occur from the eyes, ears, nose, or mouth. Clinical presentation can vary between patients and disease progression can be unpredictable. The article notes current circulation in Ituri (DRC) and Uganda but does not provide specific case counts or outbreak details.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo variant）がDRC及びウガンダで流行中であり、重篤な感染症として国際的拡大リスク及び渡航制限リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（Ituri Province）とウガンダでのBundibugyo variant流行が明記されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。ただし国境を接する両国での同時流行は国際的に重要な懸念。具体的な症例数は未記載だが、CFR 25-40%と高い病原性が示されている。

article.articleHeadline: 139 Dead From DR Congo Ebola Outbreak, Angry Residents Burn Treatment Center - The News Chronicle
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has caused at least 139 deaths and more than 600 suspected cases, with cases in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu provinces; Uganda reports two cases, including one death. There is no approved vaccine or treatment for this strain. The outbreak was officially declared on May 15; initial tests searched for a different Ebola strain, delaying identification, and WHO investigators have not yet identified the first infected patient. Health officials believe transmission began probably a couple of months ago. In Ituri's Rwampara, residents burned an Ebola treatment center after a dispute over burial procedures, highlighting tensions around trained-burial protocols. WHO regards global risk as low, regional risk high. The region faces displacement—over 920,000 displaced in Ituri—with ongoing humanitarian operations. International aid has surged: WHO delivered 11.5 tonnes within 72 hours; MONUSCO airlift; UNICEF ~50 tonnes; WFP relief.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ熱アウトブレイクで139人が死亡、怒った住民が治療センターを焼く
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当。Bundibugyo株によるエボラ熱の大規模アウトブレイク（139人死亡、600人以上の疑い患者、ウガンダへの越境）であり、国際的な懸念と支援ニーズが高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株はワクチン・承認治療法がない稀なエボラ株。ウガンダでの2例（1死亡）は越境感染を示唆。92万人以上の国内避難民がいる地域での発生で、保健システム脆弱性とコミュニティ信頼の低下（治療センター焼却事件）が懸念される。WHO地域リスク評価は「高」。国際的な疾病予防統制チームと支援が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : les Seychelles renforcent leur dispositif sanitaire
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Seychelles strengthen their public health measures.
article.articleSummary: Ebola cases detected in Angola and Congo prompted Seychelles to tighten public health measures after a WHO alert. As of 22 May 2026, Seychelles Health Minister Dr. Marvin Nolan Fanny ordered reinforced controls including surveillance at entry points, in health facilities, and within the community; enhanced infection prevention and control, and strengthened clinical management of cases. Ebola is a severe, rarely fatal disease transmitted through direct contact. The incubation period is typically 5–12 days, can range 4–21 days. Initial symptoms resemble influenza—fever above 38°C, profound weakness, muscle pains, headaches, and sore throat—with progression to gastrointestinal symptoms, skin lesions, and organ failure. The measures aim to prevent any potential spread from the detected cases in Angola and Congo.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：セイシェル諸島が公衆衛生対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病はIHR(2005)の届出対象疾患であり、アンゴラとコンゴでの症例検出が地域への重大な脅威をもたらしている。セイシェル諸島が国境警戒と防疫措置を強化したことは、国際的拡大リスクの認識を示している。
triage.notes: セイシェル諸島（Seychelles）は対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsには含めない。記事は主にアンゴラとコンゴでの症例検出を述べており、セイシェルはそれに対応する国として記載されている。アンゴラ（3351879）も対象国リストに含まれていない。エボラは指定感染症で国際的に重大な懸念事項であるため、IHR基準が全て該当し、シグナル検知が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in Congo, scuole senza protezioni: l'allarme di ActionAid su rischio epidemia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo, schools without protective measures: ActionAid warns of the risk of an epidemic.
article.articleSummary: Ebola risk in the Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ituri province rises as ActionAid reports severe school vulnerabilities. Among analyzed schools, 83% lack handwashing stations or hygiene infrastructure; 81% lack rapid-response or isolation protocols; 78% lack PPE for teachers and students. Moreover, 74% of teachers have received no Ebola management training, and 67% have never been visited by health personnel during the outbreak’s acute phase; 29% report at least one suspected case or close contacts with infected individuals. The assessment also notes gendered vulnerabilities, with 82% of women caring for ill relatives without PPE or formal training. ActionAid has worked in Ituri since 2022 on emergency education, gender-based violence protection, and food aid. The organization urges immediate, coordinated action by local authorities and international partners to provide training, prevention measures, and PPE, warning of a potential emergency in Nyankunde, Nizi, and Bunia if unchecked.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱、学校の保護措置不足：ActionAidが流行リスクを警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の発生地域（DRC、Ituri州）において、学校施設の感染対策不足が報告され、ヒト-ヒト感染の拡大リスクが指摘されている。IHR基準3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の脆弱性、国際支援の必要性）に該当し、スクリーニング基準複数項目でも該当。社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC（Ituri州のBunia、Nizi、Nyankunde）でのエボラウイルス発生時の学校施設における感染対策の著しい不足を報告している。疑い患者または感染者との接触者が学校内に存在することが明記されており、学校という高密度人口環境での水平感染リスクが具体的に示唆されている。女性や教職員の脆弱性も指摘されており、制御不能時の緊急事態の可能性が言及されている。

article.articleHeadline: Actualite: шесть человек с симптомами Эболы сбежали из горящей клиники в Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News: Six people with Ebola symptoms escaped from a burning clinic in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Six patients with Ebola fever or Ebola-like symptoms escaped from a burning clinic in Rwampara, northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo, after protesters set the facility on fire. At the time of the blaze, three patients had laboratory-confirmed Ebola, and three more had symptoms with results pending. A man admitted with suspected Ebola died; relatives demanded his body, but clinicians refused due to transmission risk. In retaliation, relatives ignited triage tents and medical equipment. The incident compounds ongoing transmission amid an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and neighboring Uganda, for which WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). Congolese authorities report 131 deaths among those infected in the country. The event underscores containment challenges and the need for rapid diagnosis and strict infection control to prevent further spread, including potential imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: ニュース：コンゴの火災した診療所からエボラ症状のある6人が逃亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。既にWHO PHEICが宣言されており、患者逃亡による感染拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴ北東部（Rwampara）が主な発生地であり、ウガンダでの流行も言及されているが、サマリー上の主題はコンゴでの患者逃亡事象。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。既存のPHEIC宣言があり、患者逃亡による新たな感染制御上の課題が発生。

article.articleHeadline: AP: количество смертей, предположительно, от Эболы в ДРК увеличилось до 160 - Свободный взгляд
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: AP: The number of deaths from Ebola in the DRC has reportedly risen to 160 — Free View
article.articleSummary: Death toll from Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has risen to 160 in two provinces, with 671 suspected infections, according to local authorities cited by the Associated Press on May 21. Ituri Province, the outbreak’s center, saw the first reports on May 5. The World Health Organization later declared the Ebola outbreak in the DRC and neighboring Uganda an international emergency. In response, Uganda suspended all direct flights to the DRC. Russia’s Health Minister Mikhail Murashko said the risk of spread to Russia is minimal, while the Foreign Ministry voiced concern; a team from Rospotrebnadzor was sent to the region for epidemiological investigation. The AP and Daily Monitor frame the situation as ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: AP：コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のエボラによる死亡者数が160人に増加したと報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク、国際的懸念）。エボラウイルス病の国際的緊急事態宣言により、PICKUP（フルRRA対象）。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にRussian FederationおよびUgandaが含まれているが、記事サマリーでは主な発生地はDRCのIturi Provinceであり、Ugandaは隣国として言及されているのみである。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。Ugandaは対象国リストにないため除外。Russiaは懸念表明や調査団派遣のコンテキストで言及されているが、発生国ではないため除外。WHO国際緊急事態宣言、複数国での関心（飛行禁止、調査団派遣）、高い死亡率（671疑似症例中160人）から、深刻なシグナルと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola surveillance stepped up at CIAL after emergency meeting
article.articleSummary: CIAL activated a 24-hour Ebola surveillance system after an emergency meeting to detect symptoms early and coordinate public health responses. Thermal screening, 21-day travel history verification, and self-declaration forms are now mandatory for international passengers. Passengers arriving from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan will be placed under special health surveillance. Isolation wards have been arranged at Ernakulam General Hospital, Government Hospital Kalamassery, and District Hospital Aluva. The plan centers on Ebola prevention, case identification, and infection control. Officials noted that Bundibugyo Ebola virus, one of five Ebola species, currently has no widely approved vaccine or specific treatment. Transmission can occur from animals to humans and via direct contact with bodily fluids of infected persons; the incubation period ranges 2–21 days, with fever, sore throat, headache, and flu-like symptoms as early signs. Mortality rates may reach 30–50%. Preventive measures include three-layer masks and regular handwashing.

triage.headline_ja: 緊急会議後、CIALでエボラウイルス監視が強化
triage.triage_reason: インドのケーララ州でエボラウイルス対応のための24時間監視システムが急遽導入され、DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンからの乗客に特別保健監視が適用される対策が実施されている。IHR基準において異常性・予想外性と国際的拡大リスク（渡航者スクリーニング）の2項目に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準では異常性、流行しやすさ、管理可能性に該当。高い社会的・政治的関心が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事はインドのケーララ州コーチン国際空港（CIAL）でのエボラ監視システム導入に関する報道。DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンからの乗客スクリーニングが実施されているが、これらの地域での確認事例ではなく、インドの水際対策についての記事であり、verified_locationsはインドのみ。高い警戒レベルでのフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia di Ebola: quali sono i rischi per l'Italia e l'Europa?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Epidemic: What Are the Risks for Italy and Europe?
article.articleSummary: As of May 22, 2026, Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have prompted the WHO to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The provisional toll exceeds 600 suspected cases and more than 130 deaths in a structurally fragile setting where contact tracing is hampered by logistical gaps. Ebola spreads not by air but through direct contact with bodily fluids of infected individuals; early isolation remains the decisive control measure. Symptoms include high fever, malaise, and severe systemic complications. The WHO's PHEIC does not signal an imminent threat to Italy, but calls for heightened vigilance and rigorous surveillance with strict infection-control protocols. European health systems maintain robust biocontainment capacities, contrasting with affected areas. Authorities emphasize active monitoring and accurate scientific information over alarmism.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス感染症流行：イタリアとヨーロッパへのリスクは？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス感染症のPHEIC宣言、600件超の疑い患者と130件超の死亡、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクが明白である。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはイタリアが含まれているが、記事サマリーからはコンゴ民主共和国での流行が主題であり、イタリアは潜在的リスク地域として言及されているのみ。したがって verified_locations にはコンゴ民主共和国のみを含める。対象国リストではコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）が該当。イタリアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 境外麻疹確診者曾到南投3鄉鎮 初步匡列38名接觸者 - 生活
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Imported measles case had visited three Nantou townships; 38 contacts identified in preliminary tracing.
article.articleSummary: Imported measles case in Nantou County visited 10 venues across Puli, Yuchi Township, and Ren’ai Township during the infectious period (May 14–16). Preliminary tracing identified 38 contacts; none symptomatic. Venues linked to the case have been disinfected; measles virus survives 1–2 hours in the environment. Those with overlapping footprints should self-monitor until June 3. Seek care promptly if fever with rash or symptoms such as cough, runny nose, photophobia, tearing, or conjunctivitis appear, and inform clinicians of travel and exposure history. During self-monitoring, avoid public places and wear a mask. Officials note ongoing international measles outbreaks in Japan, Vietnam, Central Asia, the Americas, and Europe. Travelers should consider MMR vaccination 2–4 weeks before departure; after return, 18 days of self-health monitoring and TOCC disclosure. For updates, visit the Taiwan CDC site or call 1922 or Nantou line 049-2220904.

triage.headline_ja: 境外麻疹確診者が南投3郷鎮を訪問 初期段階で38名の接触者を特定
triage.triage_reason: 台湾での麻疹輸入症例が複数地域で確認され、接触者追跡が進行中。国際的な麻疹流行（日本、ベトナム、東欧、米州、欧州）の背景下での事象であり、IHR基準の異常性・国際拡大リスク、およびWPRO基準の流行性・長期曝露可能性が該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はTaiwan（台湾）での輸入麻疹症例を主題としており、南投郡（Nantou County）の複数郷鎮での訪問・接触者追跡が焦点。背景として日本、ベトナムを含む複数国での麻疹流行が言及されている。Bluedot APIで検出されたスペイン（カナリア諸島）は記事内容と関連がないため除外。verified_locationsはサマリーで明示的に言及される台湾、日本、ベトナムのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: Revue de presse Afrique - À la Une: des affrontements en Ituri, face à l'épidémie d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa Press Review - Top Story: Clashes in Ituri, facing the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo centers in Ituri province, with violence at an Ebola treatment site run by NGO Alima in Mongbwalu reported. Local health sources say the facility was burned by angry individuals, forcing military protection for medical staff. Initial elements indicate relatives of a suspect patient attempted to recover a body against staff guidance, triggering chaos and allowing six patients to flee — three confirmed Ebola cases and three suspects. Authorities emphasize that handling of corpses remains a key transmission vector, with community resistance and rumors hindering control efforts. In Ituri, treatment capacities are saturated: beds and equipment are lacking at care centers, and patients stay at home, increasing household transmission; the promised Ebola treatment center has not yet opened. Uganda, meanwhile, suspended cross-border movement and direct flights with DRC, halted passenger ferries for four weeks, and tightened border-area rules.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカプレス評 - トップニュース：イトゥリでの衝突、エボラ流行に直面
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外の暴力的イベント、国際的拡大リスク）。複数国への波及、治療施設の機能障害、患者逃亡による感染拡大リスク。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのイトゥリ州でのエボラ流行を主題としており、Mangbwalu地域の治療施設での暴力的インシデント、患者逃亡（確定3例、疑い例3例）を報告。ウガンダは国境措置を講じているが、記事の主要イベント発生地はDRCのみ。治療体制の飽和と遺体取扱いによる感染リスクが強調されている。社会政治的関心が非常に高い。

article.articleHeadline: Maps: How Ebola Has Spread in Central Africa
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo's Ituri Province, centered on Mongwalu, is already among the region's deadliest; transmission continues amid years of conflict and mass displacement. The virus detected is Bundibugyo, a rare Ebola species identified after samples sent from Ituri to Kinshasa; it has previously appeared in Uganda (2007) and Congo (2012), and no approved vaccines or therapeutics exist. Spread occurs via direct contact with body fluids and in health care settings. Limited testing capacity in Ituri delayed detection, with early local tests negative due to species mismatch. Cross-border risk to Uganda and South Sudan exists as migratory flows persist from gold-mining areas. Uganda has two cases in Kampala, including one death. WHO assesses regional risk as high but not global; the current toll already surpasses the combined toll of prior Bundibugyo outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: 地図：エボラがアフリカ中部でどのように拡大したか
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。Bundibugyo Ebola（希少種）の多国間流行で、既に報告済み死亡例あり、国境を越えた拡大リスク高い、渡航・貿易制限の可能性あり。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは東DRC（Ituri州、Mongwalu中心）での発生を主題とし、ウガンダでも2例確認されている。ただしウガンダ（対象国リストに含まれない）での確認のため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。Bundibugyo Ebola種は希少で、ワクチン・治療薬がない重大リスク。紛争・人口移動下での制御困難性が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: هل يبقى فيروس إيبولا في الجسم بعد التعافي؟
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Does the Ebola virus remain in the body after recovery?
article.articleSummary: Persistent Ebola virus after recovery: A report citing the Russian agency TASS indicates the virus may linger beyond apparent recovery, not only in blood but in other body fluids. Ebola can persist in semen for months to years, with roughly 50% of men clearing by 115 days, 90% by 394 days, and the longest recorded persistence around 988 days post-recovery. The virus may also remain in breast milk up to 500 days and in the eye for months, potentially leading to neurological complications. Documents of transmission via sexual contact long after recovery have been reported, underscoring the need for ongoing medical follow-up for survivors. The outbreak continues in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, notably Ituri Province near the Uganda border. WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern on May 17, with over 500 suspected cases and at least 131 deaths. Ebola symptoms include abrupt fever, extreme fatigue, muscle/joint pain, diarrhea, vomiting, and bleeding; transmission occurs through bodily fluids and contaminated objects.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスは回復後も体内に残存するか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスク）。WHO緊急宣言済みで、複数国での発生が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは東DRC（イトゥリ州、ウガンダ国境近辺）での発生継続を明記しており、500件以上の疑い例と131人以上の死亡が報告されている。WHOは2026年5月17日に国際的懸念の公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言済み。発生地域にはRussian FederationとUgandaも含まれているが、サマリーの主題はDRCでの発生であり、ウガンダは国境で事例が報告される文脈のみ。ロシアはエボラ発症事例の記載がなく、医学的情報提供機関（TASS）としての言及のみであるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとする。

article.articleHeadline: UN Sends Emergency Funds and Staff to Tackle Congo Ebola Crisis
article.articleSummary: On May 22, 2026, the United Nations released about $60 million from an emergency fund and deployed additional staff to contain an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo. Experts believe the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola, for which there is no vaccine, circulated undetected for around two months in Ituri province before being identified last week. The outbreak has resulted in 670 suspected cases and 160 suspected deaths to date. The funding and expanded personnel reflect an intensified international response amid conflict and high population movement, as aid workers push to get ahead of the crisis. This marks a major escalation in international assistance.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ危機に対処するため国連が緊急資金とスタッフを派遣
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準3つ以上該当（重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ）、かつ国連による緊急資金投入などから社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo strain（ワクチン未開発）、2ヶ月間未検出で循環、670疑似症例・160死亡、紛争地域での流行で対応難度高い。国連による$60M緊急資金と人員派遣は国際的な関心と懸念の高さを示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in der DR Kongo: Gesundheitsministerium meldet 671 Verdachtsfälle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DR Congo: Ministry of Health reports 671 suspected cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is expanding from Ituri province near Uganda and South Sudan. The Ministry reports 671 suspected cases and 160 suspected deaths, with 64 infections laboratory-confirmed and 6 deaths. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain is involved; there is no vaccine or therapy. This marks the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC since 1976. The WHO previously cited about 600 suspected cases and over 130 suspected deaths, noting underreporting likely. In neighboring Uganda, two cases among Congolese nationals have been recorded; one death and the other tests negative on the second test and still in treatment. Transmission is via contact with body fluids. MSF is deploying staff to establish isolation and treatment sites in Bunia, Butembo and Goma, with emergency stocks in Kinshasa, Kisangani, Bordeaux and Brussels. ICRC urges rapid action and strong community engagement.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ熱：保健省が671件の疑い事例を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ熱の確定例64件、疑い例671件、死亡160件の報告、国境を超えたウガンダへの拡大、未治療病原体での高い致死性により、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性が明確。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIがベルギー（ブリュッセル）、フランス（ボルドー）、スーダン、ウガンダを含めているが、記事サマリーの主題はコンゴ民主共和国内のエボラ熱発生である。ウガンダについては2例の輸入症例が報告されているが、実際の発生地はDRCであり、ウガンダは対象国リストに未含。したがってverified_locationsはDRCのみとした。MSFが複数都市での治療センター設置を準備中で、国際的な対応体制が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: 민주콩고 에볼라 확산세...인접국가는 항공편 잠정 중단
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spread accelerates in the Democratic Republic of the Congo; neighboring countries temporarily suspend flights.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading, with 670 suspected cases and 160 related deaths reported by the health ministry; only 61 cases have been laboratory-confirmed due to limited testing capacity (as of May 21, 2026). The new cases include a confirmed incident in Bukavu, North Kivu, after a 28-year-old man who arrived from Kisangani died; the M23 faction plans to test more than 200 suspect samples in Goma for confirmation. Authorities tightened funeral procedures for Ebola victims, triggering protests, including in Lewampara, Ituri, where families clashed with police over unresolved body handling. Uganda paused flights to DRC for 48 hours to curb cross-border spread, and has barred cross-border buses/boats for four weeks, with border markets also closed.

triage.headline_ja: 民主共和国でエボラ感染が拡大...隣接国は航空便を暫定中断
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の地理的拡大、国際的な感染リスク、渡航制限の実施）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数項目に該当し、エボラウイルス病という高リスク病原体による多国境的な危機である。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病による多地域での同時アウトブレイク。DRC国内での感染確認と拡大に加え、ウガンダによる国際的な移動制限措置が実施されている。限定的な検査能力による確定診断数と疑い例数の大きな乖離が対応の課題を示唆している。葬儀手続きの厳格化による社会不安も報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Ο μέχρι τώρα απολογισμός στη ΛΔ Κονγκό - 160 νεκροί, 671 ύποπτα κρούσματα - HealthStat.gr
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: The toll so far in the Democratic Republic of the Congo - 160 dead, 671 suspected cases - HealthStat.gr.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak concentrated in Ituri province (northeast) with 671 suspected cases and 160 deaths reported to date; 64 infections and 6 deaths are laboratory-confirmed. WHO had previously logged nearly 600 suspected cases and 130 deaths, cautioning that true figures may be higher due to underreporting. In neighbouring Uganda, there have been no new infections beyond two nationals of the DRC; one died, the other tested negative two days ago and remains under treatment. The outbreak is linked to the rare Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain, for which there are no vaccines or specific therapies, hindering containment. Transmission occurs via close contact with infected people or their bodily fluids. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC since 1976. Contextual historic reference includes the 2014–2015 West Africa epidemic, which caused over 11,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：コンゴ民主共和国での現在までの犠牲者 - 160人死亡、671人の疑い患者
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべて該当。Bundibugyo株による稀なエボラ出血熱の発生で、ワクチンや特異的治療法がなく、隣国ウガンダでも患者確認があり、国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain（ワクチン・特異的治療法なし）による希少株の発生。ウガンダでの患者確認により国際的拡大のリスクがある。DRCはWPRO対象国リストに含まれるため、フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Hội nghị Thượng đỉnh Diễn đàn Ấn Độ - châu Phi bị hoãn do dịch Ebola bùng phát
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: India–Africa Forum Summit postponed due to Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: India–Africa Forum Summit Fourth Meeting in New Delhi, scheduled for May 28–31, 2026, is postponed amid the ongoing Ebola outbreak in Africa. A joint statement after consultations between India and the African Union notes public health developments across multiple African countries, including a new Ebola case in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The World Health Organization has previously declared an international public health emergency for recent Central African Ebola outbreaks. As of May 21, about 600 suspected Ebola cases and 139 deaths have been recorded since the outbreak began about two months earlier. Experts warn cross-border transmission remains high due to strained health systems and surveillance gaps. The outbreak is associated with the Bundibugyo variant, rarer than Zaire. India reports no Ebola cases yet, but has intensified border screening, isolation readiness, treatment capacity, and laboratory testing nationwide.

triage.headline_ja: インド・アフリカ首脳会議、エボラ流行により延期
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱は既知の高リスク病原体であり、WHO国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言済みで、国家レベルの対応が実施されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、エボラ発生は中央アフリカ（特にコンゴ民主共和国）が主要発生地であり、インドは国内感染ケースなしだが国家レベルの警戒・対策を実施中。Bundibugyo亜型、約600の疑い患者と139死亡、越境感染リスク高。既知のWHO緊急事態宣言により、シグナル認識の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Сотни россиян оказались под угрозой заражения Эболой в Африке
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hundreds of Russians were at risk of contracting Ebola in Africa.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak concerns Russians in Africa: about 300 Russian nationals are in the risk zone, mainly in Kenya and Tanzania, amid Ebola transmission in the region. The outbreak centers are the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, where Ebola spreads through close contact with infected individuals or their fluids; bat-derived contamination via food like bananas is noted as a potential, albeit uncertain, route. Congo has reported over 500 Ebola cases with 130 deaths; Uganda has 2 cases with 1 fatality. On May 17, the World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern for the Congo-Uganda outbreak. Russia plans to deploy specialists to Uganda in response. Advice for Russians in or traveling to the region includes avoiding outbreak zones, staying in touch with authorities, monitoring health, and seeking care for any symptoms. Emphasis on hygiene and official sources.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでエボラ出血熱の感染リスク、ロシア国民数百人が危機的状況に
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的な感染拡大（コンゴ・ウガンダでの大規模流行、複数国への拡大リスク）、WHOによるPHEIC宣言、高い重症度（死亡例あり）、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性が確認されており、IHR基準2つ以上、WPRO基準複数個該当。国際的な関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明示されているエボラ流行の主要発生地はコンゴとウガンダ。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダ、ケニア、タンザニアは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。WHOがPHEIC宣言（2026年5月17日）しており、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo: Ebola Outbreak, Ituri Province Situation Report #3, May 21, 2026
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda; WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 16. As of May 20, DRC reports >670 suspected cases, 61 confirmed, >160 deaths; Uganda confirms 2 cases, including 1 death; no local transmission detected in Uganda. A new confirmed case in South Kivu died, signaling broader transmission. Ituri province hotspot: Bunia, Mongbwalu, Nyakunde, Rwampara, with transmission from a family cluster to health facilities and community spread. Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccines or treatments; response relies on rapid surveillance, contact tracing, testing, infection prevention and control, RCCE, and cross-border coordination. Health systems are strained; PPE shortages and at least four healthcare-worker deaths. Cross-border risk with Burundi, Rwanda, South Sudan, Uganda. International Medical Corps deployed rapid response teams to DRC (Ituri, Goma, Kinshasa) and Uganda (Kampala) to support MOH and partners.

triage.headline_ja: DR Congo: Ebola Outbreak, Ituri Province Situation Report #3, May 21, 2026
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病のBundibugyo株によるアウトブレイクで、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。WHO国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言済み、複数国への拡大、高い死亡率と医療システム逼迫。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCおよびウガンダにおけるエボラアウトブレイクが述べられているが、発生地域のリストに「Republic of Uganda」(226074)が含まれていても、対象国リスト(Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India)にはウガンダが含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみに限定した。ウガンダの2例(1死亡)については参考情報として記載されるが、当シグナルトリアージの対象外。Bundibugyo株は承認されたワクチンまたは治療法がなく、ヒト-ヒト感染の高い可能性がある。PPE不足と医療従事者の死亡(少なくとも4人)が報告されており、管理能力の懸念がある。

article.articleHeadline: Снова Эбола: кадры из эпицентра вспышки нового вируса в центре Африки
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Again: Footage from the Epicenter of a New Virus Outbreak in Central Africa.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak accelerates in Central Africa, centered in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri province) with cross-border exposure to Uganda. By May 20, DRC has nearly 600 cases and at least 139 deaths; Uganda reports 1 case and 1 death, both among DRC nationals recently in Uganda. The outbreak is caused by Ebola virus Bundibugyo strain; no vaccine exists for Bundibugyo, unlike Zaïre ebolavirus vaccines used in 2014–2016. First cases were registered in Ituri on May 5; a nurse died April 24 in a provincial medical facility. On May 17, WHO declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) due to rapid spread. The United States pledged $13 million for containment and about 50 temporary hospitals; Russia will send epidemiological experts and diagnostic tests. Experts consider the risk of widespread international spread and importation to Russia to be low.

triage.headline_ja: 再びエボラ：中央アフリカで新しいウイルス発生の震源地からの映像
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当、WPROスクリーニング基準全て該当、かつWHOがPHEIC宣言しており、国際的な公衆衛生上の深刻な懸念がある。
triage.notes: 2026年5月時点の記事。DRC（イトゥリ州）を中心としたエボラ・ブンディブギョ株の発生で、ウガンダへの国境を越えた拡大が確認されている。WHOがPHEICを宣言済み。ワクチンが存在しない株であることが懸念事項。米国とロシアが支援を表明。記事はロシア発信で、ロシアへの輸入リスクについても言及されている。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。

article.articleHeadline: Angry crowd torches Ebola treatment centre amid rising fear and confusion in Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ituri province is the outbreak’s epicenter in May 2026. A hospital treating Ebola patients was set ablaze by an angry crowd after relatives allegedly tried to retrieve a deceased patient’s body; officials refused release because Ebola can spread via contact with infected corpses, especially during burial preparations. The incident highlights widespread misinformation in the area, with some residents doubting Ebola’s reality or attributing it to external forces. Health authorities warn suspected cases are climbing rapidly and that the outbreak may be spreading more broadly than first believed, amid overwhelmed health systems, ongoing conflict, and limited access to care. Officials call for improved community engagement and education to prevent fear-driven resistance during health crises. The TikTok/CNN video of the event circulated on May 21, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの怒った群衆がエボラ治療センターに放火、恐怖と混乱の増加の中で
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の既知の流行地域（DRC Ituri州）における治療施設の破壊という異常事象。公衆衛生への深刻な影響、医療システムの混乱、国際的拡大リスク、及び医療不信の拡大が懸念される。
triage.notes: エボラ治療施設への放火は医療インフラの機能不全を招き、患者隔離の困難化を意味する。地域社会の医療不信と根拠なき情報が流行拡大を助長する懸念あり。ソーシャルメディア（TikTok/CNN）での動画拡散により社会的関心は高い。紛争地域での限定的なアクセスと保健システムの過負荷が対応を複雑化させている。

article.articleHeadline: Police clamp after Ebola burial rioting
article.articleSummary: As of 22 May 2026, northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ituri province (Bunia, Rwampara, Mongbwalu) faces an Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo strain, with 670 suspected cases and 160 suspected deaths, making it the third-largest on record. The government declared the outbreak on Friday. A riot over burial of a suspected Ebola victim—a local footballer—saw protesters force entry into a hospital and set fire to Ebola tents, with police firing warning shots and tear gas. The first known case died April 24 in Bunia; the virus spread after his body was returned to Mongbwalu and mourners touched it during a funeral. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or treatment, and unsafe burials—where bodies remain highly infectious after death—are a leading transmission driver, underscoring enforcement challenges for safe burials.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ埋葬暴動後に警察が対応
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な状況、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。第3規模の爆発的なアウトブレイク、死亡者160名以上、ワクチンなし、社会的混乱により管理が困難。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株によるエボラアウトブレイク。記録上3番目の規模、670疑い例、160疑い死亡例。ワクチンおよび治療法が承認されていない。不安全な埋葬慣行が主な感染経路。社会的混乱（暴動、医療施設への放火）により制御が困難。ルワンダとの地理的接近による国際的拡大のリスクあり。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : l'ONU annonce une allocation de 60 millions USD pour accélérer la réponse en RDC et dans la région
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: The UN announces a USD 60 million allocation to accelerate the response in the DRC and the region.
article.articleSummary: Up to $60 million from the UN Central Emergency Response Fund was announced to accelerate Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and the wider region as the 17th Ebola outbreak continues in eastern DRC’s Ituri province amid armed conflict and mass displacement. The Bundibugyo strain has no licensed vaccine or approved treatment, complicating operations and limiting access in areas controlled by armed groups. WHO declared the Bundibugyo outbreak in DRC and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 16, 2026, though it is not deemed a pandemic. Authorities emphasize rapid, coordinated community-level action, strong government communication, and effective early warning and detection systems. The DRC faces a major humanitarian crisis with about 5.6 million displaced and 15 million in need of aid, with cross-border spread into Uganda noted.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：国連がDRC及び地域での対応加速のため6,000万米ドルの配分を発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当。公衆衛生への深刻な影響（PHEIC宣言、ワクチン・治療なし）、予想外の発生状況（Bundibugyo株の出現）、国際的な拡大リスク（ウガンダへの越境拡大）、渡航・貿易制限のリスクが明確に存在する。
triage.notes: 2026年5月16日にWHOがDRC及びウガンダにおけるBundibugyo株エボラ出血熱をPHEIC（国際懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）として宣言済み。記事サマリーではウガンダでの越境拡大が言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCでの発生が主題。ワクチン・承認済み治療がなく、武装勢力統治地域での対応困難が指摘されており、重症度及び管理可能性の課題が明確。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola/Ituri : des malades s'enfuient du site de Rwampara après un incident dû au décès d'un cas suspect
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola/Ituri: patients flee from the Rwampara site after an incident caused by the death of a suspected case.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Ituri, Democratic Republic of the Congo, intensified after a security-health incident at Rwampara General Hospital near Bunia when a patient suspected of Ebola died and family members tried to reclaim the body against medical staff. At the time, six patients were at the facility—three confirmed cases and three suspects—and all reportedly fled during the ensuing chaos. Tents and NGO ALIMA equipment on site were burned. Humanitarian workers were placed under military protection and police were deployed to restore order around the hospital. Health authorities warn that handling bodies of those suspected of Ebola is a major driver of transmission. The Ituri provincial health division reports 626 suspected cases and 160 suspected deaths across five health zones affected by the outbreak as of May 21, 2026. Surveillance continues, with calls for strict adherence to sanitary measures to curb spread in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ/イトゥリ：疑い患者の死亡による事件の後、ルワンパラサイトから患者が逃亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外の状況、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱の大規模流行で、セキュリティ体制の崩壊と患者逃亡は感染制御の大きな脅威。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は高い死亡率を有する指定感染症。患者逃亡による市中感染拡大の重大リスク。5つの保健地域で626疑い症例、160疑い死亡例を報告。医療施設の破壊と患者との接触喪失は感染制御失敗を示唆。DRCは対象国リストに含まれており、フルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）への提出が必須。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Goodwill Ambassador Issues Rallying Cry to Accelerate International Efforts to Eliminate Leprosy: "The Last Mile Starts Now"
article.articleSummary: Leprosy (Hansen’s disease) remains a curable but ongoing global health challenge, with about 180,000 new cases reported each year. At the 79th World Health Assembly in Geneva (May 18, 2026), Yohei Sasakawa, WHO Goodwill Ambassador for Leprosy Elimination, issued a rallying cry—"The Last Mile Starts Now"—urging intensified international action toward a leprosy-free world. The event, hosted by the Sasakawa Leprosy Initiative, highlighted the need to combat persistent stigma and discrimination alongside transmission. Priority countries include India, Brazil, and Indonesia, where leaders discussed accelerating cooperation with WHO and governments. Sasakawa notes decades of field-based work; he has visited 127 countries and logged over 3,700 overseas days in service of elimination efforts. The initiative, a collaboration with The Nippon Foundation and Sasakawa Health Foundation since 1975, has invested over US$200 million and helped place leprosy on UN attention and resolutions.

triage.headline_ja: WHO親善大使がハンセン病排除に向けた国際的取り組みの加速を呼びかけ：「最後の一歩が始まる」
triage.triage_reason: ハンセン病は治療可能だが継続的な公衆衛生上の課題であり、スクリーニング基準（異常性の低さ、重症度の相対的な低さ）に該当する項目が限定的。ただし対象国（インド、ブラジル、インドネシア）での継続的な課題として位置付けられており、政策レベルの国際的関心があるため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は感染症イベントの急性な発生・拡大ではなく、WHO親善大使による国際的排除キャンペーンの進展状況を報じたもの。ハンセン病は慢性感染症で、年180,000件の新規症例が報告される継続的な課題として位置付けられている。対象国3カ国（インド、ブラジル、インドネシア）での政策レベルの関心と協力加速が強調されているが、緊急対応を要するシグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Scare: Kerala sets up airport checks, health surveillance for those from affected nations
article.articleSummary: Kerala mandates 21-day health surveillance for arrivals from Ebola-affected nations, as the World Health Organization flags Congo, South Sudan and Uganda. No Ebola cases have been reported in India as of 22 May 2026. At Kochi airport, a 24x7 monitoring system has been activated with thermal screening, 21-day travel history verification, and self-declaration forms for international passengers; Delhi airport also issued an Ebola advisory. The Bundibugyo Ebola Virus (BDBV) variant spreading in Congo, Uganda and South Sudan has no approved vaccine or specific treatment. Transmission can occur from animals to humans via direct contact with the bodily fluids of infected persons. Incubation ranges from 2 to 21 days; early symptoms include fever, sore throat, and headache, with mortality estimated at 30–50%. Isolation wards are available at Ernakulam General Hospital, Government Hospital Kalamassery, and District Hospital Aluva. Authorities emphasize strict infection prevention, including three-layer masks and proper handwashing.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ不安：ケーララ州が空港チェックと患者監視体制を強化、影響を受けた国からの入国者対象
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の事態、国際的拡大リスク）。WPRO基準でも4項目該当。インド国内でのエボラ対応体制強化は重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴ、南スーダン、ウガンダでのエボラ流行を背景として、インド（ケーララ州およびデリー）において防疫体制を強化している。インド国内でのエボラ確認例はないが、主たる対応実施国はインドである。発生地域リストにはDRC、Uganda、Sudanも含まれているが、これらは事例報告地ではなく参照情報であり、記事の主題はインドの防疫対応のため、verified_locationsはインドのみに限定。

article.articleHeadline: Jelang Iduladha, DKPP Bandung Perketat Pemeriksaan Hewan Kurban, Organ Terindikasi Penyakit Dipastikan Dipisah
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ahead of Eid al-Adha, Bandung's DKPP Tightens Inspections of Sacrificial Animals; Organs Suspected of Disease Must Be Separated.
article.articleSummary: Bandung's Health and Agriculture Agency (DKPP) tightened health inspections of sacrificial animals ahead of Eid al-Adha 2026. Post-mortem checks are conducted after slaughter, examining the head, meat, and internal organs such as lungs, spleen, and heart to detect health issues. If any part indicates disease, it is separated and deemed unfit for consumption. Officials warn of zoonotic risks, with anthrax and foot-and-mouth disease (PMK) among concerns. While Bandung is vigilant due to high livestock traffic, no contagious diseases have been found to date. The city will maintain continuous surveillance during the Eid al-Adha period to protect food safety and public confidence. Gin Gin, head of DKPP Bandung, emphasized the depth of post-mortem over ante-mortem examinations as more detailed. The program aims to ensure safe meat supply during the holiday.

triage.headline_ja: イード・アル=アドハー（犠牲祭）を控えたバンドン、犠牲動物の検査を厳格化、疾患兆候のある臓器は必ず分離
triage.triage_reason: 炭疽症と口蹄疫の2つの人獣共通感染症が懸念されており、スクリーニング基準（異常性・重症度・流行しやすさ）で複数該当する可能性がある。ただし現時点では感染症の確認患者や確定症例がなく、予防的な検査・監視段階であるため、継続的な情報追跡が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は予防的・監視活動の報告であり、現時点では確定患者や感染症の実績がない。ただし、イード・アル=アドハー期間中の大量の家畜取引により、炭疽症・口蹄疫のような人獣共通感染症の流行リスクが存在する。犠牲祭に向けた継続的な公衆衛生対応であり、政府・公衆の関心が高い。今後の検査結果や感染確認の報告に注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: コンゴ反政府勢力支配下にもエボラ出血熱の感染拡大：時事ドットコム
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Spread of Ebola virus disease even under rebel control in Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is spreading from the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ituri and neighboring regions into South Kivu, now under M23 rebel control. An M23 spokesperson said a new positive case was confirmed in Kabare, linked to a person who recently traveled from Kisangani in Tshopo Province (eastern DRC). On May 21, Congolese authorities reported one suspected and one confirmed case in South Kivu. The National Institute of Public Health data showed about 671 suspected cases, 160 suspected deaths, with 64 confirmed cases and 6 deaths to date. Uganda has halted all public transportation to Congo for four weeks to curb cross-border spread, excluding cargo and food. Ituri Province in eastern Congo near Uganda declared a large outbreak, and Uganda reported two suspected Ebola infections linked to Congolese travelers. The WHO has declared this outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, with response hampered by ongoing conflict.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ反政府勢力支配下にもエボラ出血熱の感染拡大：時事ドットコム
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。エボラは高い致死率を持つ感染症であり、複数国への国際的拡大（Uganda）が確認されている。WHO Public Health Emergency of International Concern宣言済み。
triage.notes: Uganda（非対象国）での疑い症例報告があるが、verified_locationsには対象国のみ列挙。DRCがエボラアウトブレイクの主発生地で確認死亡6例、確認症例64例。紛争地域での対応困難とWHO PHEIC宣言により国際的な重要度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: 外縣市境外麻疹確診個案曾於南投縣活動　衛生局呼籲民眾如有疑似症狀請儘速就醫並告知活動史 | yam News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An imported measles case diagnosed outside Nantou County had been active in Nantou County; The Health Bureau urges the public with suspected symptoms to seek medical care promptly and to report their exposure history | yam News
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak update for Nantou County, Taiwan: An imported measles case diagnosed outside Nantou has been active within Nantou; residents with overlapping exposure are asked to self-monitor through June 3. Watch for fever with rash, cough, runny nose, photophobia, tearing, or red eyes; if suspected, contact health authorities and report travel/exposure (TOCC) to facilitate care. During self-monitoring, avoid public places and wear a mask. Health officials note the measles virus survives only 1–2 hours in the environment and local venues have been disinfected. Given ongoing, large measles outbreaks abroad in Japan, Vietnam, Central Asia, the Americas and Europe, travelers are advised to consider MMR vaccination 2–4 weeks before departure at travel medicine clinics (self-paid). After returning, complete 18 days of self-health monitoring; if symptoms arise, seek prompt care and inform clinicians of travel/exposure. For information, visit the CDC site or call 1922 or Nantou line 049-2220904.

triage.headline_ja: 南投県の県外で確診された輸入麻疹患者が南投県内で活動歴あり。衛生局が疑似症状のある住民に迅速な医療受診と活動歴報告を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 台湾での輸入麻疹事例でありWPRO対象地域での事例であり、日本・ベトナム等周辺国での大規模流行が背景にある。IHR基準では異常性と国際的拡大リスク、WPROスクリーニングでは異常性と流行性の基準を満たし、政府機関による公式な対応が取られている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明記されているとおり、台湾南投県での輸入麻疹事例。日本、ベトナム、中央アジア、米国、ヨーロッパでの大規模流行が背景にあり、国際的な拡大リスクが存在。Bluedot APIの発生地域フィールドにはスペイン、台湾、日本、ベトナムが含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題は台湾での事例であり、スペイン等は参考情報として列挙されているものと判断。

article.articleHeadline: エボラがコンゴで拡大、世界へのリスクは？ 感染症の専門家が解説
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is spreading in Congo; what is the risk to the world? An infectious disease expert explains.
article.articleSummary: WHO has declared the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and neighboring Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), though the WHO Director-General said it does not constitute a pandemic emergency. As of May 20, 2026, about 139 deaths suspected and roughly 600 suspected infections have been reported. In Ituri Province, far-flung forest-town infections total 51, and Uganda has 2 confirmed infections. Ebola viruses belong to the genus Ebolavirus; four species cause human disease. The current outbreak is due to Bundibugyo virus, a rare type in which vaccines and treatments do not exist, unlike the Zaire virus. Symptoms begin like influenza — fever, myalgia, fatigue — but can progress to severe diarrhea, vomiting, and bleeding. Without testing, cases are often mistaken for malaria or typhoid. The CFR can be 30-50% among those infected. Early detection and containment are critical.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴで拡大、世界へのリスクは？ 感染症の専門家が解説
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。WHO により PHEIC として宣言され、複数国（DRC、ウガンダ）での確認、稀有なBundibugyo型ウイルス、高い致命率（30-50%）、既知の有効なワクチン・治療法がない点が特に重要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにおいて、発生地域としてウガンダが列挙されているが、サマリーではウガンダでの確認は「2件の確認感染」に限定されており、主要な発生地はコンゴであるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。WHO PHEIC宣言済み、Bundibugyo型（希少種で既知の有効治療法なし）という点が国際的リスクを高める重要要因。

article.articleHeadline: Strah od ebole i hantavirusa raste, stručnjaci upozoravaju da svet nije spreman
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fear of Ebola and hantaviruses is growing, experts warn that the world is not ready.
article.articleSummary: Growing alarm over Ebola, specifically the Bundibugyo strain in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, and hantaviruses on a cruise ship, raises questions about global readiness for a major health crisis. The Ebola outbreak is unfolding in central Africa amid densely populated, politically unstable and conflict-affected regions; the Bundibugyo strain currently has no vaccine. WHO has declared an international health emergency for Ebola outbreaks in DRC and Uganda; latest reports count at least 87 Ebola deaths, with some estimates over 500 cases and more than 130 deaths. Early tests initially targeted a different Ebola strain, delaying response. The outbreaks have crossed major transport routes and borders; authorities are imposing travel controls from Uganda, DRC, and South Sudan, while expanding treatment centers. Experts warn reduced public health funding and weakened international collaboration undermine surveillance and response; hantavirus on cruise ships highlights ongoing threats besides Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: エボラとハンタウイルスへの恐怖が高まり、専門家が世界は準備不足だと警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）がDRC・ウガンダで流行し、WHOが国際的保健上の緊急事態を宣言。死者130人以上、500例以上の報告で重篤な公衆衛生影響があり、国境越境の拡大リスク、渡航制限が実施されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにより、エボラ出血熱の主要な発生地はDRCおよびウガンダで確認されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。スーダンはサマリーで言及されているが発生地ではなく（渡航制限の対象として記載）、対象国リストに含まれていない。ハンタウイルスはクルーズ船での報告であり、特定地域特定不可のため未計上。

article.articleHeadline: Ex-CDC chief Robert Redfield fears Ebola outbreak is going to become 'very significant pandemic'
article.articleSummary: As of 22 May 2026, the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda has 575 suspected cases and 148 suspected deaths, with the burden possibly over 1,000 per MRC analysis. Former CDC director Robert Redfield warns it could become a 'very significant pandemic' with spillover risks to Tanzania, Southern Sudan, and Rwanda. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC since 1976; no cure exists and a vaccine could take six to nine months, though an experimental vaccine is in trials. Health facilities report crowded wards, few isolation spaces, and limited handwashing; MSF notes full capacity. A U.S. case: Peter Stafford tested positive and is treated in Berlin; a Congo passenger caused an Air France flight diversion to Montreal. The U.S. has heightened travel screening and entry restrictions for travelers from Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan in 21 days. Congo's World Cup squad trains in Belgium.

triage.headline_ja: 元CDC長官ロバート・レッドフィールド、エボラ出血熱の流行が「非常に重大なパンデミック」になることを懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべて該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、WPRO基準でも複数項目該当。既に米国とドイツでの輸入症例確認、複数国への拡大リスク、高い社会的・政治的関心があり、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 対象国リストから、DRC（203312）のみが verified_locations に含まれる。記事サマリーではウガンダ、タンザニア、スーダン、ルワンダへの拡大リスクや輸入症例（米国、ドイツ、カナダ）に言及されているが、これら北米・ヨーロッパは対象国に含まれない。ウガンダはアフリカ地域だが対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。既報告の575疑い症例、148疑い死亡、ワクチン未承認による管理困難性、複数国への軸足を持つ輸入症例が判定の根拠。

article.articleHeadline: 泰国王室发布声明：长公主昏迷近3年半后病情恶化，感染严重尚未得到控制
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Thai royal family issues statement: The eldest princess's condition has deteriorated after nearly three and a half years in a coma, with a severe infection remaining uncontrolled.
article.articleSummary: Thai Princess Bajrakitiyabha Nariratana, 47, eldest daughter of King Vajiralongkorn, remains in coma after a cardiac-related collapse in December 2022 at a northeastern military dog training ground. As of May 21, 2026, the royal family disclosed that her condition has deteriorated due to a severe infection causing peritoneal infection from colitis, with ongoing organ dysfunction including hypotension, arrhythmias, and coagulopathy. She is hospitalized at Bangkok's Thai Red Cross Chulalongkorn Hospital, with respiratory and renal support, treated with antibiotics, vasopressors, and antiarrhythmic drugs under close monitoring. The princess, educated at Cornell Law School (LL.M. 2002; LL.D. 2005), previously served in the Thai Attorney General’s Office, as ambassador to the UN CCPCJ (chair in 2011), and as a UN Women Goodwill Ambassador, reflecting a long career in criminal justice and international affairs.

triage.headline_ja: タイ王室が声明発表：長公主は3年半以上の昏睡後に病状悪化、重篤な感染が依然管理されていない
triage.triage_reason: 患者は王族個人であり、公衆衛生上の感染症アウトブレイク事象ではない。病院内での個人の医療状況であり、一般集団への拡大リスクは存在しない。
triage.notes: 本事象は個別患者（王族）の医療状況であり、感染症の集団発生・アウトブレイクではない。個人の健康情報であり、公衆衛生の重大事象、異常な感染症パターン、国際的拡大リスクのいずれも該当しないため、シグナルとしては識別されない。王室声明による高い社会的関心があるが、感染症危機管理の対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Darurat Tuberkulosis, PPTI Komitmen Wujudkan Indonesia Bebas TB di 2030
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tuberculosis Emergency: PPTI Commits to Achieve a TB-Free Indonesia by 2030.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia faces a tuberculosis health emergency as the country holds the world’s second-highest TB burden after India, with an estimated over 1 million patients. The Perkumpulan Pemberantasan Tuberkulosis Indonesia (PPTI) marks its 58th anniversary by reinforcing collaboration to curb transmission through the TOSS campaign—Temukan Obati Sampai Sembuh (Find, Treat, Until Healed). Field cadres conduct intensive outreach to ensure every patient receives medical support at nearby community health centers (puskesmas). Eliminating TB is a strategic step toward a TB-free Indonesia by 2030, with broad public participation needed to detect undiagnosed cases and interrupt transmission chains. Early symptoms include productive cough; six months of treatment can cure TB regardless of economic status. The initiative emphasizes community involvement and sustained treatment access to reach the national target and end TB.

triage.headline_ja: 結核緊急事態、PPTI（インドネシア結核撲滅協会）は2030年までのインドネシアの結核撲滅を公約
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアの結核は重大な公衆衛生問題（世界第2位の患者数）であり、スクリーニング基準の複数項目に該当。ただし、この記事は既知の地域的課題の啓発キャンペーンが主体で、新規のアウトブレイク事象ではなく、情報不足のため経過観察段階とする。
triage.notes: 記事は既知の地域的結核課題（インドネシアが世界第2位の患者数）に関する啓発キャンペーン（TOSS キャンペーン）の実施報告。新規アウトブレイク事象ではなく、既存の公衆衛生プログラムの強化が主体。インドは発生地域に含まれるが、記事サマリー内ではインドでの新規発生事象は述べられていないため verified_locations から除外。結核の長期的な曝露と重症度は確実だが、この記事だけではシグナルとして判定するには根拠不足であり、続報を待つ段階。

article.articleHeadline: La República Democrática del Congo eleva a 671 los casos y a 160 las muertes sospechosas por el brote de ébola que alarma a la OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo raises Ebola cases to 671 and suspected deaths to 160 in the Ebola outbreak that alarms the WHO.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 671 suspected cases with 64 laboratory-confirmed infections across Ituri and North Kivu as of May 22, 2026. Suspected deaths total 160 (6 confirmed), including 80 deaths among 317 suspected cases in Mongbwalu (Ituri) and 44 among 179 suspected cases in Rwampara; 125 suspected cases in Bunia (11 confirmed). Additional clusters are in Nyankunda and Bambu (Ituri) and in Goma, Katwa, and Butembo (North Kivu). In the last 24 hours, 13 new cases were reported (12 in Ituri, 1 in North Kivu); no new lab-confirmed deaths. So far, 160 patients have recovered. The World Health Organization declared an international emergency; Uganda has at least one death, with risk amplified by population displacement and limited vaccines or treatments for the Bundibugyo strain. Rwanda tightened borders; AU and WHO mobilize resources. About 800 contacts have been identified.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ熱の発生例を671件、疑い死亡例を160件に引き上げ（WHO警戒）
triage.triage_reason: エボラ熱の多数の確認症例と死亡、国際的な拡大リスク（ウガンダで死亡確認、ルワンダでの国境措置、WHO国際緊急事態宣言）が複数確認され、IHR基準4項目全て該当、スクリーニング基準5項目全て該当。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にイタリア（Veneto）、ルワンダ（Kigali Province）が含まれているが、サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国での発生が主題であり、ウガンダでの死亡が言及されている。ただしウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。Bundibugyo型エボラという稀な株、人口移動による曝露リスク、ワクチン・治療法の限定的な利用可能性が懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: "La punta del iceberg": expertos alertan de que el brote de ébola Bundibugyo es mucho peor de lo que indican las cifras oficiales
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "The tip of the iceberg": experts warn that the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak is much worse than official figures indicate.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda may be far more severe than official tallies indicate. CEPI warns that roughly 600 suspected cases and 139 deaths represent only the 'tip of the iceberg' of a crisis. WHO reports hundreds of cases and deaths, but real figures could be higher. Six days after WHO declared an international emergency, authorities say the situation resembles Zaire-variant outbreaks; CEPI notes the current crisis echoes the 2014 prelude that killed about 11,000, rather than the 2012 outbreak (13 deaths). CEPI aims to develop vaccines for epidemic pathogens within 100 days using mRNA and AI. The virus has crossed borders: a confirmed case in South Kivu, eastern DRC; two imported cases in Kampala, Uganda; and a suspected case in Western Equatoria, South Sudan. The US bans entry for travelers who have been in DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan in the last three weeks; a Paris–Detroit Air France flight was diverted to Montreal after a passenger from DRC was detected, which CBP called an error.

triage.headline_ja: 「氷山の一角」：専門家がブンディブギョエボラアウトブレイクは公式統計よりもはるかに深刻だと警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的拡大（DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンでの確認例）、IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の重症度、複数国への国際的拡大、渡航制限実施）、WPRO基準全項目該当。フルRRAに進める必要がある。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域には北米（Detroit、Michigan、Québec、Montréal等）やフランス（Paris）が含まれているが、記事サマリーではこれらは渡航禁止や空路迂回のコンテキストでのみ言及されており、実際のエボラ患者発生地ではない。また南スーダン（Western Equatoria）での疑い例が報告されているが、南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外した。DRCとウガンダのみが実際の患者発生地として確認される。WHO緊急事態宣言後6日経過、CEPI警告により実態数が公式統計より大幅に高い可能性が指摘されている点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: RDC eleva a 670 los casos sospechosos de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC raises the number of suspected Ebola cases to 670.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri and North Kivu, shows 671 suspected cases and 160 suspected deaths, with 64 lab-confirmed cases and 6 deaths. Confirmed infections: 60 in Ituri and 4 in North Kivu; confirmed deaths: 4 in Ituri and 2 in North Kivu. About 800 contacts identified; Mongbwalu (317 suspected, 13 confirmed, 80 suspected deaths) and Rwampara (179 suspected, 24 confirmed, 44 suspected deaths) are the focus. Additional suspected cases: 125 in Bunia (11 confirmed) and transmissions in Nyankunda, Bambu, Goma, Katwa and Butembo. In the last 24 hours, 13 new lab-confirmed cases (12 Ituri, 1 North Kivu) and no new deaths; 160 patients recovered. Bundibugyo Ebola strain; WHO declared an international emergency; Uganda reports at least one death linked to the outbreak. Security issues in M23-held North Kivu hinder response; no vaccines or strain-specific treatments.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラウイルス疑い患者数を670人に引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模発生で深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダでも死亡例）、WHO緊急事態宣言。WPROスクリーニング基準も全て満たす。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが返した発生地域にはイタリア（Veneto）、ルワンダ（Kigali Province）、ウガンダが含まれているが、記事サマリーの主要な発生地はコンゴ民主共和国。ウガンダは1死亡例が関連とのことだが、記事主題はDRC発生。イタリア、ルワンダは位置情報の誤りと判断。WHO緊急事態宣言済み、セキュリティ上の課題（M23による北キブ支配地域）が対応を阻害。

article.articleHeadline: India-Africa Forum Summit postponed due to the Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: India-Africa Forum Summit fourth edition postponed due to Ebola outbreak in Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda; originally scheduled May 28–31, indefinitely delayed. In a joint statement, India and the African Union express solidarity with Africa CDC-led efforts to address the evolving health situation and commit to Africa-led response. India pledges continued cooperation to strengthen public health preparedness and response capacities across the continent and to support Africa CDC in combating the latest Ebola strain. No new dates announced; further updates expected in due course. The decision underscores a shared commitment to peace, development, prosperity, and the well-being of their peoples.

triage.headline_ja: インド・アフリカ・フォーラム・サミット、エボラ出血熱の流行により延期
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準では4項目すべてに該当する可能性が高く、エボラ出血熱という高リスク病原体がDRCとウガンダで確認され、国際的なイベント延期まで影響が波及している。WPROスクリーニング基準でも異常性、流行性、国際的管理課題が明確。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCとウガンダでのエボラ出血熱流行を主題としており、これが国際的なハイレベルイベント（インド・アフリカフォーラム・サミット）の延期につながっている。Bluedot APIが付与したIndia (1269750) は発生地でなく、サミット延期国として記載されているため verified_locations には含めない。ウガンダ (226074) は対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。DRC (203312) のみを verified_locations に列挙。エボラ出血熱は極めて高い死亡率と国際的懸念を伴う病原体であり、複数国での確認と国際イベント延期は重要なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: എബോള വൈറസ് ഭീഷണി; കൊച്ചി വിമാനത്താവളത്തിൽ മുൻകരുതൽ, 24 മണിക്കൂറും സർവൈലൻസ് സംവിധാനം
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus threat; precautions at Cochin International Airport, 24-hour surveillance system.
article.articleSummary: As of May 22, 2026, authorities at Cochin International Airport intensified Ebola preparedness with a 24-hour surveillance system, enhanced symptom screening, and travel-history checks. An emergency meeting approved intensified monitoring for Ebola virus cases, noting Bundibugyo Ebola virus (BDBV), one of five species, for which no effective vaccine or specific treatment is available. Animal-to-human and human-to-human transmission via bodily fluids is acknowledged, with an incubation period of 2–21 days and initial flu-like symptoms such as fever, sore throat, and headache. The WHO has declared Ebola outbreaks a global health emergency, leading to special surveillance for travelers arriving from Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan. Isolation wards are established at Ernakulam General Hospital, Kalamassery Government Hospital, and Aluva District Hospital. Personal protection measures, including three-layer masks and handwashing with soap, are to be strictly followed. Self-declaration forms are required for international travelers.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスの脅威; コーチン国際空港での予防措置、24時間監視体制
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当（異常性、重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）。インド（ケララ州）がエボラ対策を強化する記事であり、アフリカ（DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン）での流行を背景としたシグナルとして認識される。
triage.notes: 記事はインド・ケララ州コーチン空港でのエボラ対策強化を主題としている。アフリカ（DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン）での流行が背景にあるが、記事の直接的な対象国はインドである。WHO声明、隔離病棟設置、旅行者スクリーニングなど具体的な対応が記述されており、公式関心が高い。ただし、記事日付が2026年5月という未来日付であり、シミュレーション・演習シナリオの可能性があるため注意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 因伊波拉疫情爆發，印非論壇峰會被延期
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The India-Africa Forum Summit was postponed due to the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: The Republic of India and the African Union jointly postponed the India-Africa Forum Summit due to ongoing Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. The summit, originally scheduled for May 28–31, has been postponed indefinitely as authorities monitor the evolving health crisis. In a joint statement, both sides reiterated their solidarity with Africa’s people and governments and pledged to support Africa CDC-led responses to the shifting health situation, with India promising assistance to Africa CDC’s efforts against the latest Ebola strain and sustained collaboration to strengthen public health preparedness and response across the continent. No new dates were announced for the fourth forum, though officials said more information would be shared at an appropriate time. Both sides remain committed to peace, development, prosperity, and the welfare of Africa’s peoples.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行により、インド・アフリカ・フォーラムサミットが延期される
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的な拡大リスク、アフリカ大陸での複数国での発生、国際的な行動制限（サミット延期）を伴う重大なイベントであり、IHR基準3項目に該当。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUganda（226074）が含まれているが、サマリーではDRCとUgandaでのエボラ発生が述べられている。Ugandaは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。インドはサミット延期の主体として記事の中心であり、国際的関心が高い。アフリカ大陸での複数国での発生とそれに伴う国際的対応（サミット延期、支援誓約）がある。

article.articleHeadline: DR Kongo'da öfkeli kalabalık Ebola hastanesi çadırlarını ateşe verdi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In DR Congo, an angry crowd set fire to Ebola hospital tents.
article.articleSummary: On May 22, 2026, in the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ituri province near Bunia, Rwampara Hospital sits at the epicenter of the Ebola outbreak. Local residents attacked Ebola tents after a family sought to retrieve and bury a relative, but the hospital refused to release the body, citing the corpse’s high infectivity and required burial procedures. The crowd attempted to set the tents alight and injured a aid worker; police were deployed. The deceased was a locally beloved young footballer; his family says they believed he died of typhoid and that burial would not pose a risk. A local politician noted Ebola disbelief among some villagers, who blame outsiders or profit motives. The region has reported over 130 Ebola deaths. WHO declared the outbreak a global health emergency but not a pandemic emergency. Ebola, first identified in 1976, can have up to a 90% fatality rate; symptoms include fever, fatigue, diarrhea, and vomiting.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ病院のテントが怒った群衆に放火される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべて該当。WHOが国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言したエボラ流行で、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: エボラ流行が130人以上の死亡報告と共に進行中。WHO国際保健上の緊急事態宣言済み。地域の医療施設への暴力的な反発と感染症対策への住民の不信が報告されており、管理可能性の課題あり。チフスとエボラの両疾患が関連。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : "Je comprends l'inquiétude" mais le risque d'importation à Mayotte est "très faible", répond la ministre de la Santé à la députée Estelle Youssouffa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: "I understand the concern," but the importation risk to Mayotte is "very low," the Health Minister responds to MP Estelle Youssouffa.
article.articleSummary: Ebola importation risk to Mayotte is very low, says Health Minister Stéphanie Rist, despite WHO declaring an international public health emergency on May 17. The outbreak remains a concern due to high mortality, but risk beyond the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda is deemed very low. In Mayotte, the ARS and prefect have activated anticipatory measures, enhancing professional awareness and strengthening health surveillance. The situation is continuously monitored, with plans to consult scientific experts on potential further measures, which may evolve. French humanitarian clinicians are on the ground in Ebola-affected African regions and increasing in number as organizations mobilize responses. Mayotte, hosting migrants from affected regions, remains under heightened vigilance amid concerns raised by MP Estelle Youssouffa about preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱：「懸念は理解するが」マヨット島への流入リスクは「極めて低い」と保健相が下院議員エステル・ユスーファに回答
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。WHO国際保健上の緊急事態宣言（2026年5月17日）に関連し、DRC・ウガンダでのエボラ流行に対するフランスを含む国際的関心が高く、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、エボラ流行の実際の発生地はDRCとウガンダであることが明示されている。フランスとマヨット島は流入リスク評価の対象地であり、実際の発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外。WHO緊急事態宣言（2026年5月17日）があり、死亡率の高さ、ヒト-ヒト感染可能性、長期的曝露リスク、国際的関心の高さなど複数の懸念要因が存在。
